title: Multimodal Routing and Region Refinement for Language-Guided Medical Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026 (TIA). Final version to appear in the proceedings
summary: Textual descriptions can reduce ambiguity in medical image segmentation by specifying the finding and location to be delineated. Existing text-guided methods mainly improve where image and language features interact but generally retain a single learned update pathway across all image-text pairs. We propose MRSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that uses each image-text pair to route the adaptation of visual and textual features before dense prediction. Frozen ConvNeXt-Tiny and PubMedBERT encoders provide multiscale visual features and clinical text tokens. A joint router uses the deepest visual feature and pooled text to predict a sparse mixture over low-rank adapter bases. The resulting route is shared across separate adapter banks for two visual scales and text, coordinating their adaptation while keeping the feature-specific parameters separate. Region Bridge uses text-derived queries to aggregate dense visual tokens into latent regions, refines these regions through self-attention and text cross-attention, and redistributes the refined information back to the feature maps. Finally, a multiscale decoder combines refined semantic features with shallow image evidence. On QaTa-COV19 and MosMedData+, MRSeg achieves 90.90/83.32 and 81.53/68.82 Dice/mIoU, respectively, with 7.11M trainable parameters and 7.60 GFLOPs. Code: https://github.com/maklachur/MRSeg.

AI.tldr: MRSeg：参数高效的文本引导医学图像分割框架，用图文对路由视觉与文本特征的自适应，在QaTa-COV19与MosMedData+上取得SOTA级Dice/mIoU，仅7.11M可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 文本描述可指定待分割的病灶（finding）与位置（location），从而降低医学图像分割的歧义。现有文本引导方法主要改进图文特征的交互方式，但所有图文对普遍共享同一条学习到的更新路径，缺乏样本自适应的特征更新能力。
AI.method: MRSeg采用参数高效设计。冻结的ConvNeXt-Tiny与PubMedBERT编码器分别提取多尺度视觉特征与临床文本token。联合路由器（joint router）以最深视觉特征与池化文本预测低秩适配器基上的稀疏混合路由，该路由在两个视觉尺度与文本的独立适配器库间共享，实现协同自适应同时保持特征专属参数分离。Region Bridge以文本派生查询将密集视觉token聚合为潜在区域，经自注意力与文本交叉注意力精炼后回写至特征图。最后多尺度解码器将精炼语义特征与浅层图像证据结合进行密集预测。
AI.result: 在QaTa-COV19上达到90.90 Dice / 83.32 mIoU，在MosMedData+上达到81.53 Dice / 68.82 mIoU；可训练参数仅7.11M，计算量7.60 GFLOPs。
AI.conclusion: MRSeg通过图文对驱动的路由式适配与区域桥接模块，在冻结视觉-语言骨干下实现高效、精确的文本引导医学图像分割，兼具高精度与低参数/低计算开销。

title: Direction-Scale Decomposition in Action Representation: Rethinking What to Tokenize for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Action representation plays a central role in discrete-token vision-language-action (VLA) learning but remains underexamined. Under conventional pose-increment representations, action tokens are sensitive to execution speed and dataset-specific normalization, potentially obscuring geometric structure shared across demonstrations and datasets. We introduce Direction-Scale Decomposition (DSD), an action representation that decomposes translation and rotation increments into direction and scale components before tokenization. DSD isolates motion direction while retaining magnitudes in separate scale channels. We evaluate DSD with uniform binning (BIN) and BEAST, a B-spline-based tokenizer, in simulation and real-world manipulation under both single-dataset and mixed-dataset training. On LIBERO, DSD improves average success rates with both tokenizers. On SimplerEnv, DSD-BIN outperforms BIN by 10.3 percentage points in overall success rate under mixed-dataset training. Real-robot experiments further show gains both with and without robotics pretraining. These results support DSD as an effective action representation for discrete-token VLA models and suggest its potential to mitigate performance degradation when training on large and diverse dataset mixtures. Our project page with additional resources is available at https://vla-dsd.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出方向-尺度分解（DSD）动作表示，将平移/旋转增量拆为方向与尺度分量后分词，提升离散token VLA在单/混数据集训练下的操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 离散token的VLA学习中动作表示研究不足；传统位姿增量表示对执行速度和数据集特定归一化敏感，掩盖了跨演示与跨数据集共享的几何结构。
AI.method: DSD将平移与旋转增量分解为方向分量和尺度分量，分别分词：方向分量隔离运动方向，尺度以独立通道保留幅值；并分别搭配均匀分箱（BIN）与基于B样条的分词器BEAST进行评估，涵盖仿真与真实机器人操作、单数据集与混合数据集训练。
AI.result: LIBERO上，DSD在两种分词器下均提升平均成功率；SimplerEnv混合数据集训练下，DSD-BIN总体成功率比BIN高10.3个百分点；真实机器人实验在有/无机器人预训练时均有增益。
AI.conclusion: DSD是离散token VLA模型的有效动作表示，有望缓解在大规模多样数据集混合训练时的性能退化。

title: Neurosymbolic Routing for Reliable Reasoning on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Running a language model on edge hardware provides private and low-latency reasoning without a network connection, and yet the small models that fit on such devices are unreliable on the tasks computers are expected to handle well, such as arithmetic, algebra, and formal logic problems. We argue that much of this unreliability is avoidable. Many queries appearing to demand reasoning are in fact structurally deterministic and permit fast and exact symbolic solutions. Therefore, forcing a probabilistic model to approximate them sacrifices accuracy and energy for little benefit. We present a neurosymbolic router that classifies each incoming query and dispatches it to the cheapest correct solver, sending structured tasks to deterministic engines and reserving the small language model (SLM) for open-ended word problems. Instead of hand-coding the routing logic, we learn a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) with the L* grammatical inference algorithm, using the SLM as a membership oracle and labeled data as an equivalence oracle. On a Raspberry Pi 4B (8 GB RAM, no GPU), evaluated on 100 untested prompts from DeepMind Mathematics, GSM8K, and RuleTaker, learned routing attains 100% routing accuracy and 98.3% overall accuracy with a 512-token reasoning budget (93.3% on word problems), compared with 72.0% for the strongest agent baseline, Program-of-Thought, and 58.7% for a tool-calling agent given the same solvers. Since formatted queries never reach the model, the router answers them in 1-11 ms and, in its 30-token configuration, runs 8.8x faster and 2.8x more energy-efficient than Program-of-Thought.

AI.tldr: 提出一种神经符号路由器，用L*算法学习DFA，将结构化查询分派给确定性求解器，小模型只处理开放词汇题，在树莓派4B上实现100%路由准确率与98.3%总体准确率。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上的小语言模型在算术、代数、形式逻辑等任务上不可靠。作者认为这种不可靠多可避免：许多看似需要推理的查询本质上是结构确定性、可精确符号求解的，让概率模型去近似它们只会牺牲准确率与能耗。
AI.method: 设计神经符号路由器，对每条输入查询分类并分派给最廉价且正确的求解器：结构化任务交给确定性引擎，仅开放式的文字应用题保留给小语言模型（SLM）。路由逻辑不手工编写，而是用L*语法推断算法学习一个确定性有限自动机（DFA），以SLM作为成员查询预言机、以标注数据作为等价查询预言机。
AI.result: 在Raspberry Pi 4B（8 GB RAM，无GPU）上，于DeepMind Mathematics、GSM8K、RuleTaker的100条未测试提示上评估：所学路由达到100%路由准确率、512 token推理预算下98.3%总体准确率（应用题93.3%），显著优于最强智能体基线Program-of-Thought的72.0%及同一求解器下工具调用智能体的58.7%。格式化查询不进入模型，路由响应时间1–11 ms；30 token配置下比Program-of-Thought快8.8倍、能效高2.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 将结构确定性查询交由符号求解器、仅把开放问题留给小模型，可在边缘硬件上以更低延迟与能耗获得更高的准确率与可靠性。

title: Learning New Words from Unlabeled Test Data in Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: New words are invented every day. A human listener can learn a new word by hearing it clearly once and inferring its usage from sentence context. This paper proposes granting ASR a similar ability to learn the contextual representations and spellings of new words from unlabeled test data at test time. A frozen CTC acoustic model provides spellings, a frozen language model provides contextual evidence for out-of-vocabulary (OOV) word detection, and an adaptation module expands the vocabulary by learning the lexical token representations with distributions over CTC-generated candidates. The spelling model of each token is optimized by minimizing a Kullback-Leibler divergence (KLD) objective. We demonstrate that the CTC-weighted language model log likelihood ratio can be interpreted as the KLD between the unknown correct ASR and the unsupervised learned ASR, and that, using a Pinsker bound, the square root of KLD can be interpreted as an upper bound on the total variation distance between the true and estimated spelling of the unknown word. Experiments show relative OOV character-error-rate reductions of up to 14.97% on LibriSpeech and 6.67% on dysarthric Speech Accessibility Project data for recurring OOV words, relative to the corresponding rescoring system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出让ASR在测试时从无标注数据中学习新词的上下文表示与拼写：冻结CTC声学模型提供拼写候选，冻结语言模型提供OOV检测证据，适配模块在CTC候选分布上学习词元表示，并以KLD为目标优化。
AI.motivation: 人类听者只需清晰听到一次新词，即可结合句子上下文推断其用法；而ASR对词表外（OOV）新词缺乏这种从上下文快速学习并推断拼写的能力，因此希望赋予ASR在测试阶段从无标注测试数据中学习新词的能力。
AI.method: 冻结的CTC声学模型提供拼写候选，冻结语言模型提供OOV词检测的上下文证据；适配模块通过在以CTC生成候选上的分布来学习词元的词汇表示，从而扩展词表；每个词元的拼写模型以最小化Kullback-Leibler散度（KLD）目标进行优化。理论上将CTC加权的语言模型对数似然比解释为未知正确ASR与无监督学习ASR之间的KLD，并利用Pinsker界将KLD的平方根解释为真实拼写与估计拼写之间总变差距离的上界。
AI.result: 在LibriSpeech上，针对重复出现的OOV词，字符错误率（CER）相对降低最高14.97%；在构音障碍Speech Accessibility Project数据上相对降低6.67%，均相对于对应的重打分系统。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，ASR可以在测试时利用无标注数据和上下文监督有效学习新词的拼写与表示，显著降低重复出现OOV词的字符错误率，并给出了KLD与总变差距离的理论联系作为支撑。

title: ViRDM: Taming Representation Distribution Matching for Few-Step Causal Video Generation
summary: Few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables low-latency streaming generation, but existing post-training methods predominantly rely on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring both a large pretrained teacher and an online critic to estimate distributional discrepancies through diffusion scores. In this work, we ask whether this resource-intensive teacher--critic stack can be eliminated by post-training only the generator against a precomputed target distribution. Drawing inspiration from representation distribution matching (RDM) for one-step image generation, we systematically study its transfer to few-step causal video generation and identify three key barriers: a memory-intractable gradient path, a distinct video optimization regime, and representation distributions that underconstrain temporal dynamics. We introduce ViRDM, a teacher- and critic-free video post-training recipe that addresses these barriers sequentially. By coupling RDM with stochastically truncated clean-exit supervision, a lightweight VAE decoder, and staged vector--Jacobian products, ViRDM makes representation distribution matching memory-feasible for multi-step causal video rollouts. We further establish effective generated-population and initialization regimes for video RDM, and introduce lightweight dynamics regularization to compensate for the underconstrained temporal dynamics. ViRDM turns three-network distillation into generator-only post-training, reducing GPU memory use and training time while improving video quality. With only 20 generator updates, the recipe reaches 84.87 on the official VBench evaluation, outperforming the previous best few-step causal baseline by 0.36, while requiring 16 A100 GPU-hours. We additionally report exploratory results demonstrating the potential of the same recipe for lower causal sampling budget and for one-, two-, and four-step bidirectional generation.

AI.tldr: ViRDM：一种无需教师模型和判别器的少步因果视频扩散后训练方法，通过表示分布匹配（RDM）实现仅生成器后训练，降低显存与训练时间并提升视频质量。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频扩散的后训练主要依赖分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），需要大规模预训练教师模型和在线判别器，通过扩散分数估计分布差异，资源开销大。本文探索是否可仅对生成器进行后训练，针对预计算的目标分布进行匹配，从而消除昂贵的教师-判别器架构。
AI.method: 将单步图像生成中的表示分布匹配（RDM）迁移到少步因果视频生成。识别三大障碍：显存不可承受的梯度路径、不同的视频优化区域、表示分布对时序动态约束不足。提出ViRDM：结合RDM与随机截断的clean-exit监督、轻量VAE解码器、分阶段向量-雅可比积，使RDM在多步因果视频展开中显存可行；建立有效的生成样本群与初始化区域；引入轻量动态正则化弥补时序动态约束不足。
AI.result: 仅需20次生成器更新，在官方VBench评测上达到84.87，超过此前最佳少步因果基线0.36，仅需16 A100 GPU小时。将三网络蒸馏转变为仅生成器后训练，降低显存使用与训练时间，同时提升视频质量。并探索性展示该配方在更低因果采样预算及一、二、四步双向生成中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: ViRDM证明无需教师与判别器的表示分布匹配可用于少步因果视频扩散后训练，在显著降低资源开销的同时取得更优视频质量，并具备向不同采样步数与生成模式扩展的潜力。

title: PlenoCI: Plenoptic CharacterIstics for View Dependence Aware Change Classification
summary: Radiance field representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) natively encode complex visual phenomena such as occlusions and view dependence, but they are inherently underconstrained. Independently optimized reconstructions converge to different primitive configurations, even in unchanged regions. We introduce Plenoptic CharacterIstics (PlenoCI), a novel feature built from the plenoptic field these representations approximate. PlenoCI directly captures rich visual behaviors while ignoring Lambertian textures. By deriving closed-form analytic plenoptic derivatives from a 3DGS representation, we efficiently detect these 5D structures. Our approach is robust to underconstrained representations by construction, reporting two orders of magnitude fewer false positives between independent reconstructions of unchanged scenes than concurrent work. We demonstrate PlenoCI's utility on change classification. First, we detect changes with an instance-aware 3DGS pipeline, achieving state-of-the-art results on CL-Splats with a 25.7% mIoU gain over the strongest competitor, while remaining competitive on the more challenging PASLCD benchmark. Leveraging PlenoCI, we classify changes as geometric or appearance-based with a balanced accuracy of 0.735, comparable to the best performing baseline. We believe plenoptic derivatives and PlenoCI open new directions for view dependence aware understanding in visually complex environments. Code and data are available at https://js0n-lai.github.io/plenoci.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PlenoCI特征，从3DGS的光场场中推导闭式解析光场导数，用于鲁棒地检测5D视觉结构，并应用于变化分类任务。
AI.motivation: 3DGS等辐射场表示能编码遮挡、视角依赖等复杂视觉现象，但本质上是欠约束的。即使场景未发生变化，独立优化的重建也会收敛到不同的基元配置，导致难以区分真实变化与重建差异。现有方法在欠约束表示下容易产生大量误报。
AI.method: 提出Plenoptic CharacterIstics（PlenoCI）特征，从3DGS表示所逼近的光场场中构建。通过从3DGS表示推导闭式解析光场导数，高效检测这些5D结构。PlenoCI能直接捕获丰富视觉行为，同时忽略朗伯纹理，因而对欠约束表示具有内在鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在未变化场景的独立重建之间，误报数量比同期工作少两个数量级。在变化分类任务上：使用实例感知3DGS流程检测变化，在CL-Splats上取得SOTA，mIoU较最强竞争者提升25.7%，并在更具挑战性的PASLCD基准上保持竞争力；利用PlenoCI将变化分类为几何或外观变化，平衡准确率达0.735，与最佳基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 光场导数与PlenoCI为视觉复杂环境中视角依赖感知的理解开辟了新方向。代码与数据已公开。

title: HelloWorld: Towards Practical Applications of Generative Driving World Models
summary: Driving world models provide a promising route toward scalable counterfactual data generation and interactive simulation beyond recorded driving logs. Realizing this potential requires a system that can generalize across diverse scenes, respond faithfully to prescribed controls, generate coherent multi-sensor observations, and operate efficiently under repeated inference. We present \textbf{HelloWorld}, a 2B driving world model system designed around these requirements. HelloWorld progressively specializes broad visual and motion priors from heterogeneous video data into controllable driving generation using ego pose, HD maps, and 3D boxes. A block-causal generation interface, together with adaptation to self-generated context, aligns the model with sequential simulation. The system further supports synchronized seven-camera RGB generation and conditional LiDAR synthesis, and is distilled toward few-step inference for efficient deployment. Experiments evaluate visual quality, control fidelity, cross-view consistency, robustness under repeated generation, inference efficiency, and LiDAR synthesis. Together, HelloWorld provides a unified framework for scalable driving data generation and interactive simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出HelloWorld——一个2B参数驾驶世界模型系统，通过从异构视频数据渐进式迁移视觉与运动先验，并结合自车姿态、HD地图和3D框实现可控驾驶生成，支持七路相机RGB与条件LiDAR同步合成，经蒸馏实现少步推理，面向可扩展驾驶数据生成与交互式仿真。
AI.motivation: 驾驶世界模型有望突破真实驾驶日志的限制，实现可扩展的反事实数据生成与交互式仿真。但要实现这一潜力，系统需同时满足多场景泛化、对指定控制的忠实响应、多传感器观测的一致性生成以及重复推理下的高效运行等要求，而现有方案难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将来自异构视频数据的通用视觉与运动先验，逐步专化为基于自车姿态、HD地图与3D框的可控驾驶生成；采用块因果（block-causal）生成接口，并适配自生成上下文以对齐序列化仿真；支持七路相机RGB同步生成与条件LiDAR合成；通过蒸馏实现少步推理以利于部署。
AI.result: 围绕视觉质量、控制保真度、跨视角一致性、重复生成下的鲁棒性、推理效率以及LiDAR合成开展了实验评估（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: HelloWorld为可扩展的驾驶数据生成与交互式仿真提供了一个统一框架。

title: Exploiting Target Knowledge from MLLMs for Robust Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) aims to segment unseen object categories with a few (e.g., one or five) labeled examples, enabling efficient adaptation to novel classes. Conventional models typically rely on appearance-based visual matching between support and query images for segmentation. While straightforward, these methods often struggle to handle significant appearance discrepancies and occlusions in the query image due to insufficient target knowledge. To mitigate this, we introduce a novel framework that mines target knowledge using the strong reasoning capacity of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and employs it to enhance FSS. Specifically, building on SAM 2, our method, named MK-FSS, exploits two forms of complementary knowledge derived from a query image by an MLLM for FSS, including spatial knowledge, which provides a spatial prior indicating the potential target location, and semantic knowledge, which describes the target using text. The spatial knowledge is first encoded into a memory representation, and then resulting memory is integrated with the support-guided memory feature from query image through a carefully designed dual-memory debate-fusion (DMDF) module, yielding a more robust target memory feature. In parallel, the semantic knowledge is encoded into the textual feature, which is fused with multi-scale query features via a progressive cross-modal prompt generator (PCPG), producing a target-aware multimodal prompt for segmentation. Working together, the dual-memory feature and the multimodal prompt provide a comprehensive representation of the target, enabling more robust segmentation. In our extensive experiments, MK-FSS shows promising results and largely surpasses existing methods. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出MK-FSS框架，利用多模态大语言模型挖掘目标知识以增强少样本分割。
AI.motivation: 传统少样本分割依赖支持集与查询图像的外观视觉匹配，但面对显著外观差异和遮挡时，因缺乏目标知识而表现不佳。
AI.method: 基于SAM 2，利用MLLM从查询图像中提取两类互补知识：空间知识（指示目标可能位置的空间先验）和语义知识（文本描述目标）。空间知识编码为记忆表示，经双记忆辩论融合（DMDF）模块与支持引导的记忆特征融合，得到更鲁棒的目标记忆特征；语义知识编码为文本特征，通过渐进式跨模态提示生成器（PCPG）与多尺度查询特征融合，生成目标感知的多模态提示。
AI.result: 在广泛实验中，MK-FSS取得有前景的结果，大幅超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 双记忆特征与多模态提示共同提供目标的全面表示，实现更鲁棒的少样本分割，代码将开源。

title: MoVISA: Multi-Token Reasoning for Video Object Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in video object segmentation with Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) reasoning have demonstrated the effectiveness of using a single textual token, such as SEG, to predict segmentation masks across images and videos. However, we observe that this single-token strategy lacks the granularity required to precisely localize multiple objects across time in video segmentation tasks. To address this limitation, we develop Multi-Token Reasoning for Video Object Segmentation, or MoVISA. MoVISA uses multiple segmentation tokens, such as SEG0 and SEG1, to represent an object across different frames. This design enables more fine-grained alignment between language prompts and spatio-temporal mask predictions, improving both performance and interpretability. On the challenging MeViS, DAVIS17, ReVOS, and Ref-Youtube-VOS benchmarks, our model achieves a 13.2 percent J and F improvement on MeViS and an 8.4 percent J and F improvement on ReVOS. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出MoVISA，用多分割token（如SEG0、SEG1）替代单token策略进行视频目标分割，在MeViS与ReVOS等基准上取得显著J&F提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM推理的视频目标分割方法仅使用单一文本token（如SEG）来预测图像与视频中的分割掩码。作者观察到该单token策略缺乏足够粒度，难以在视频分割任务中对跨时间的多个目标进行精确定位。
AI.method: 提出MoVISA（Multi-Token Reasoning for Video Object Segmentation）。其核心是采用多个分割token（例如SEG0、SEG1）在同一目标的跨帧表示上，从而建立语言提示与时空掩码预测之间更细粒度的对齐。
AI.result: 在MeViS、DAVIS17、ReVOS、Ref-Youtube-VOS等基准上验证：MeViS上J&F提升13.2%，ReVOS上J&F提升8.4%。
AI.conclusion: 多token分割推理设计同时提升了视频目标分割的性能与可解释性；代码与模型将开源。

title: Passive LWIR Hyperspectral Ranging via Transmittance Extraction and Distance Alignment
summary: Passive long-wave infrared (LWIR) hyperspectral ranging enables distance estimation in low-light and nighttime scenes by exploiting atmospheric absorption features in thermal radiance received through the atmosphere.Joint estimation of temperature, emissivity, and distance is computationally expensive. Reference-range joint inversion also uses a distance-invariant effective attenuation coefficient, which can bias range estimates.We introduce transmittance extraction and distance alignment (TEDA), which decouples range estimation from temperature--emissivity inversion. In the first stage, a baseline estimator with a data-fidelity term invariant to the known absorption direction yields two closed-form smoothing branches for the slowly varying thermal continuum. An observation-derived gate combines the branches, and subtracting the blended baseline in the log domain recovers atmospheric transmittance. The second stage estimates range by matching the recovered transmittance to sensor-domain transmittance models recomputed for each candidate distance. Monte Carlo simulations show that TEDA effectively reduces the ranging bias caused by the distance-invariant attenuation coefficient approximation. In a measured scene, TEDA's mean range estimates are closer to the LiDAR medians than those of reference-range joint inversion in both evaluated patches. TEDA processes a complete $256\times256$ region of interest in 8.19~s versus 159.47~s for reference-range joint inversion, an approximately 20-fold speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出TEDA方法，通过透射率提取与距离对齐解耦距离估计与温-发射率反演，提升被动长波红外高光谱测距精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 被动长波红外高光谱测距需联合估计温度、发射率与距离，计算成本高；且参考距离联合反演使用距离不变的有效衰减系数，会引入测距偏差。
AI.method: TEDA分两阶段：第一阶段用对已知吸收方向不变的数据保真项构建基线估计器，得到两条闭式平滑分支，通过观测导出的门控融合分支，在对数域减去混合基线以恢复大气透射率；第二阶段将恢复的透射率与逐候选距离重算的传感器域透射率模型匹配来估计距离。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛仿真表明TEDA有效降低距离不变衰减系数近似导致的测距偏差；实测场景中两个评估块的平均距离估计比参考距离联合反演更接近LiDAR中值；处理256×256感兴趣区域耗时8.19秒，对比参考方法的159.47秒，约20倍加速。
AI.conclusion: TEDA通过解耦距离估计与温-发射率反演，在提升被动LWIR高光谱测距精度的同时显著降低计算成本。

title: Personalized Korean Lipreading as Visual Speech Recognition: Transfer, Census and Adaptation on OLKAVS
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. 4 pages plus references
summary: We present a personalized Korean visual speech recognition (VSR) system and quantify, on the nine-camera OLKAVS corpus, the gap between the population-level benchmark score and an individual user's error. A video-only Conformer initialized from English-trained weights attains 9.95 - 12.19% character error rate (CER) under the corpus protocol against the published 26.64, and 19.00 - 21.52 on unseen wording. Per speaker, CER spans 1.0 to 52.2%, with seen wording lowering CER by 7.0 - 9.0 points and professional delivery and spontaneous speech raising it by 8.5 - 10.5 and 12.7 points. A low-rank adapter with 4.6% of the parameters, trained on 4 to 29 minutes of the user's frontal video, lowers the CER of twelve high-error speakers by 2.13 to 3.58 points, transfers to every camera without loss, and keeps 85% of the full fine-tuning gain at 12% of its cost to other speakers. Cameras above the mouth plane add about six CER points as a constant offset that training on all views keeps small.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化韩语视觉语音识别系统，在OLKAVS语料上量化了群体基准与个体用户误差之间的差距，并验证了低秩适配器可实现低成本、可迁移的个性化适配。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语音识别基准多为群体平均性能，无法反映个体用户的实际误差水平，且个性化适配成本高、迁移性不明，因此需要量化个体差异并探索高效个性化方案。
AI.method: 构建仅视频输入的Conformer模型（由英语预训练权重初始化），在九摄像头OLKAVS语料上评估；并采用低秩适配器（仅4.6%参数量），基于用户4至29分钟正面视频训练进行个性化适配。
AI.result: 模型在语料协议下CER为9.95%–12.19%（已见措辞），未见措辞为19.00%–21.52%；个体CER跨度1.0%–52.2%，已见措辞降低7.0–9.0点，专业播报与自发语音分别升高8.5–10.5和12.7点；适配器使十二名高误差说话人CER降低2.13–3.58点，跨摄像头无损迁移，以12%成本保留85%全量微调增益；嘴部平面以上摄像头带来约6点固定CER偏移。
AI.conclusion: 个体差异远大于群体平均指标，低秩适配器可在极低参数与时间成本下显著降低高误差用户CER并具备良好跨视角迁移性，为个性化VSR提供了可行路径。

title: Beneath the Scores: Rethinking Hallucination Evaluation for Video Understanding Models
summary: Video understanding is increasingly performed by multi-stage LLM agents that separate temporal grounding, visual observation, and reasoning. Yet these stages are typically evaluated on different benchmarks and distributions, making it difficult to determine where hallucinations originate. We first organize existing benchmarks around these stages and show that their scores provide inconsistent diagnostic signals: stronger stage-level performance does not reliably imply lower downstream hallucination, and even benchmarks targeting the same capability can disagree. We therefore introduce a causal stage-intervention protocol that overwrites individual stages while holding the downstream task fixed. Across 60,008 runs on three video-agent architectures, we find that grounding is the dominant source of downstream error, with roughly four times the causal impact of corrupting visual observations. Successful grounding depends primarily on locating the correct region rather than precise temporal overlap, explaining why standard mIoU metrics poorly predict downstream reliability. We further find that incorrect evidence is substantially more harmful than missing evidence. Finally, auditing existing benchmarks against these interventions reveals that their scores do not reliably predict causal cascade sensitivity and can fail under distribution shift. These results motivate intervention-based, stage-aware evaluation for trustworthy video agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过因果阶段干预实验发现，在LLM视频智能体的多阶段流程中，时序定位（grounding）是下游幻觉的主要来源，其因果影响约为视觉观测错误的四倍，并据此提出基于干预的阶段感知评测范式。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解的LLM智能体将时序定位、视觉观测与推理分离为多阶段流程，但各阶段通常在不同基准和分布上评测，难以确定幻觉究竟源自哪个环节；同时阶段级得分与下游可靠性之间缺乏一致的诊断关系。
AI.method: 首先按阶段组织现有基准，检验其诊断信号的一致性；进而提出因果阶段干预协议，在固定下游任务的前提下逐一覆写单个阶段的输出；在三种视频智能体架构上进行60,008次运行，比较各阶段错误对下游结果的因果影响。
AI.result: 定位是下游误差的主导来源，其因果影响约为视觉观测损坏的四倍；成功定位主要取决于定位到正确区域而非精确的时间重叠，这解释了标准mIoU难以预测下游可靠性的原因；错误证据比缺失证据危害更大；现有基准得分无法可靠预测因果级联敏感性，且在分布偏移下可能失效。
AI.conclusion: 主张采用基于干预、阶段感知的评测方法，以提升视频智能体的可信度，取代仅依赖阶段级基准分数的传统评测思路。

title: Only What Was Seen: Observation-Gram Compaction of View-Dependent Appearance in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Most of the memory of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model holds spherical-harmonic colour coefficients, yet each Gaussian is seen only from the narrow cone of directions of the training cameras. We turn this into a distortion metric that other compressors can adopt: a per-Gaussian observation Gram matrix, accumulated from viewing directions and blending weights, is the exact first-order map from coefficient changes to squared image error and needs only the model and the camera poses. Under it, degree reduction becomes a closed-form projection that generalises truncation, degree allocation a Lagrangian rate-distortion problem, and vector quantisation the matrix-weighted Lloyd algorithm, of which Compressed3D's quantiser is the scalar case. Swapped into Compressed3D with everything else unchanged, the metric raises PSNR by +0.49 dB before fine-tuning, with SSIM and LPIPS following, and at matched rate still gains +0.32 dB without a single training image. A training-free stack built on the metric alone is 15% smaller than the image-free GSICO at equal quality on Mip-NeRF 360.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于逐高斯观测Gram矩阵的失真度量，统一解释并改进3DGS颜色压缩中的阶数缩减、阶数分配与向量量化，在Compressed3D等框架下提升率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅模型的内存主要被球谐颜色系数占用，但每个高斯仅被训练相机的狭窄视角锥观测到。现有压缩方法未充分利用这一观测局限性，缺乏从系数扰动到图像误差的精确失真刻画。
AI.method: 构造逐高斯观测Gram矩阵：由观察方向与混合权重累加得到，是系数变化到图像平方误差的精确一阶映射，仅需模型与相机位姿。在该度量下：阶数缩减化为闭式投影（推广截断）、阶数分配化为拉格朗日率失真问题、向量量化化为矩阵加权Lloyd算法（Compressed3D的量化器为其标量特例）。
AI.result: 将该度量替换进Compressed3D且其余不变，微调前PSNR提升+0.49 dB，SSIM与LPIPS同步改善；在相同码率下、不使用任何训练图像仍提升+0.32 dB。仅基于该度量构建的免训练方案在Mip-NeRF 360上同等质量下比无图像GSICO小15%。
AI.conclusion: 观测Gram矩阵提供了一个通用、有理论依据的失真度量，可将多种3DGS颜色压缩技术统一为同一框架下的特例或扩展，并在率失真与体积效率上取得一致增益。

title: Polite but Misaligned: Evaluating LLM Politeness Judgments Against Human Pragmatic Norms
summary: Despite strong performance on standard benchmarks, it remains unclear whether large language models (LLMs) evaluate social pragmatics in ways that align with human judgments. We evaluate LLM politeness judgments using two English-language datasets with complementary annotation formats: continuous human ratings and three-way categorical labels. Across the seven evaluated models, we find that inter-model agreement is stronger than model--human agreement. Strategy-level analyses suggest that model--human alignment is associated with explicit linguistic cues, while some rapport-building strategies occur more frequently in misaligned cases. In the categorical task, model predictions exhibit systematic neutral compression, characterized by the overproduction of Neutral labels and the underprediction of Impolite labels. This pattern persists when expert consensus is used as the reference on a diagnostic subset. Our findings highlight the need for pragmatic evaluations that go beyond aggregate agreement metrics by examining directional patterns of model--human disagreement across different human references.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估大语言模型（LLM）礼貌判断与人类判断的一致性，发现模型间一致性高于模型-人类一致性，且存在系统性的中性压缩偏差。
AI.motivation: LLM在标准基准上表现强劲，但其社会语用判断（如礼貌）是否与人类判断一致仍不明确；且现有评估多依赖聚合一致性指标，忽略了模型-人类分歧的方向性模式。
AI.method: 采用两个互补标注格式的英语数据集（连续人类评分与三分类标签）评估LLM礼貌判断，覆盖七个模型；进行策略层面分析，并在诊断子集上以专家共识为参照检验分类预测偏差。
AI.result: 模型间一致性高于模型-人类一致性；模型-人类对齐与显性语言线索相关，某些关系构建策略更多出现在错位案例中；分类任务中模型呈现系统性中性压缩，即过度预测Neutral、低估Impolite，该模式在专家共识参照下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 语用评估需超越聚合一致性指标，通过考察不同人类参照下模型-人类分歧的方向性模式来刻画模型的社会语用能力局限。

title: FluidRain: Incompressible Rain Flow as an Attention Bias for Loop-in-Loop Video Deraining
summary: Existing video deraining methods typically exploit neighboring frames through either explicit alignment or implicit spatiotemporal aggregation. Explicit alignment relies on accurate motion estimation, which can become unreliable under dense rain, while implicit aggregation avoids alignment but lacks explicit guidance on the directional and temporally coherent structure of rain. This leaves a gap between reliable temporal aggregation and explicit modeling of rain motion. To address these limitations, we propose FluidRain, a lightweight video derainer that uses divergence-free rain flow to guide Loop-in-Loop attention across scales and neighboring frames. Motivated by fluid mechanics, we model rain motion as a divergence-free image-space flow and use it to organize multi-scale and temporal aggregation. Specifically, FluidRain first estimates a rain-flow field for each frame and projects it onto the divergence-free subspace. The resulting flow steers window attention along rain streaks, enabling neighboring frames to be aggregated without explicit alignment. Since rain-flow structure is preserved across scales and nearby frames, Loop-in-Loop reuses the same attention operator across both dimensions, resulting in a three-frame model with only 0.80M parameters. Experiments on four benchmarks show that FluidRain remains competitive with substantially larger restoration models. We further examine how temporal evidence scales with different input views. To evaluate whether the model remains reliable when rain motion changes across frames, we introduce RainSyn-Gust, which injects controlled changes in rain-streak direction into existing benchmarks. We also develop a physics-based no-reference metric that evaluates real-rain removal without requiring clean targets.

AI.tldr: 提出FluidRain轻量视频去雨模型，利用无散度雨流引导跨尺度与跨帧的Loop-in-Loop注意力，仅0.80M参数在四个基准上媲美大模型，并给出RainSyn-Gust数据集与物理无参考指标。
AI.motivation: 现有视频去雨方法存在两难：显式对齐依赖精确运动估计，在密集雨下不可靠；隐式时空聚合虽无需对齐，却缺乏对雨痕方向性与时间连贯结构的显式引导，导致可靠的时序聚合与显式雨运动建模之间存在缺口。
AI.method: 受流体力学启发，将雨运动建模为无散度（divergence-free）图像空间流场：先估计每帧雨流场并投影到无散度子空间，用其沿雨痕方向引导窗口注意力，使邻帧无需显式对齐即可聚合；由于雨流结构在尺度与邻近帧间保持一致，Loop-in-Loop在空间与时间两个维度复用同一注意力算子，构成仅0.80M参数的三帧模型。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，FluidRain与规模远大的复原模型保持竞争力；分析了时序证据随不同输入视图的变化；提出RainSyn-Gust，通过在已有基准中注入受控的雨痕方向变化来检验雨运动改变时的可靠性；并开发了无需干净目标即可评估真实雨去除的物理无参考指标。
AI.conclusion: 以无散度雨流显式建模雨运动并统一引导时空注意力，可在极低参数量下实现与大模型相当的去雨性能，同时为雨运动变化的鲁棒性评估和无参考真实雨评估提供了新工具。

title: MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks
summary: Decentralized LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate through local interactions, but an agent can remain responsive while its task-solving quality persistently degrades. Such gray failures require protecting current tasks before sufficient evidence exists to alter future routing, while still allowing recovered agents to rejoin. We introduce MeshHeal, a fully decentralized self-healing framework that couples ability-matched peer review across two timescales. At the fast timescale, an adaptive hierarchy escalates uncertain or low-scoring outputs from repeated single-reviewer evaluation to committee deliberation and, when needed, correction before use. At the slow timescale, a task- and ability-conditioned peer-relative detector aggregates scores to distinguish persistent degradation from ordinary output variation, trigger mandatory committee review, and eventually exclude degraded agents from ordinary routing; recovery probes provide fresh evidence for reintegration. To faithfully evaluate routing, we introduce Model-Backed MAS Evaluation, which ties ability assignments to execution models, since prompt-based ability assignments alone can leave routing errors hidden. Across BBH, MATH, and MMLU-Pro, MeshHeal achieves 0.839 degraded-phase accuracy using 51k total model tokens per task, versus the strongest baseline Symphony's 0.807 accuracy using 115k per task. Under staggered degradation and recovery, MeshHeal isolates degraded agents, keeps them excluded from ordinary task execution until recovery, and returns them to normal routing.

AI.tldr: MeshHeal：一种全去中心化自愈框架，通过两个时间尺度上的能力匹配同伴评审，在灰故障（代理保持响应但任务质量持续退化）下保护当前任务并支持恢复代理重新加入。
AI.motivation: 去中心化LLM多代理系统依赖局部交互协调，代理可能在保持响应的同时任务质量持续退化（灰故障）。此时需在缺乏足够证据改变未来路由前先保护当前任务，同时允许恢复的代理重新加入。
AI.method: MeshHeal耦合两个时间尺度的能力匹配同伴评审：快时间尺度上，自适应层级将不确定或低分输出从重复单评审评估升级为委员会审议，必要时在使用前纠正；慢时间尺度上，任务与能力条件化的同伴相对检测器聚合分数，区分持续退化与普通输出波动，触发强制委员会审查，最终将退化代理排除出常规路由，并通过恢复探针提供新证据以重新整合。同时提出Model-Backed MAS Evaluation，将能力分配绑定到执行模型以忠实评估路由。
AI.result: 在BBH、MATH和MMLU-Pro上，MeshHeal在退化阶段达到0.839准确率，每任务总模型token为51k；最强基线Symphony为0.807准确率，每任务115k token。在交错退化与恢复场景下，MeshHeal能隔离退化代理，将其排除在常规任务执行之外直至恢复，并在恢复后使其回归正常路由。
AI.conclusion: MeshHeal以更少token实现更高退化阶段准确率，有效处理灰故障：保护当前任务、隔离退化代理并支持恢复后重新加入，提升了去中心化LLM多代理系统的鲁棒性。

title: Just for FUNS: LLM-Guided Spatio-Temporal Graph Node Generation for Forecasting Unobserved Node States
summary: Spatio-temporal forecasting is a cornerstone of logistics, urban planning, and intelligent transportation systems. However, constrained by deployment costs and maintenance resources, sensor networks often lack comprehensive spatial coverage, rendering Forecast Unobserved Node States (FUNS) a critical yet formidable challenge. Conventional models rely on historical observations and typically falter when encountering nodes without prior records. To address this, we redefine the problem as a conditional generation task on spatio-temporal graphs and propose GenST, a framework that introduces Large Language Models (LLMs) as a semantic bridge, leveraging a pre-trained LLM fine-tuned to extract rich semantic features from node descriptions, such as functional zones and road network structures, to compensate for missing spatio-temporal signals. Specifically, we design a two-stage generative architecture: a Spatio-Temporal VAE first compresses spatio-temporal dynamics into a latent space, followed by a Generative Transformer (GenT) that reconstructs the future states of unobserved nodes from noise, guided by multi-modal conditions including semantics, geographic coordinates, and neighborhood contexts. Experiments on six traffic and two non-traffic datasets show GenST significantly outperforms existing baselines in zero-shot prediction tasks, demonstrating the practical potential of semantic-guided generation for mitigating spatio-temporal data sparsity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GenST框架，将"预测未观测节点状态(FUNS)"重新定义为时空图上的条件生成任务，用LLM从节点描述中提取语义特征作为补偿信号，并通过"时空VAE+生成式Transformer"两阶段架构实现零样本预测。
AI.motivation: 传感器网络受部署成本与维护资源限制，空间覆盖往往不完整，导致"预测未观测节点状态(FUNS)"成为关键难题。传统模型依赖历史观测，对没有历史记录的节点几乎失效，因此需要引入新的信息源来弥补缺失的时空信号。
AI.method: 1) 将FUNS重新定义为时空图上的条件生成任务；2) 引入预训练并微调的LLM作为"语义桥梁"，从节点描述（功能区、路网结构等）中提取语义特征；3) 设计两阶段生成架构：先由时空VAE把时空动态压缩到隐空间，再由生成式Transformer(GenT)在语义、地理坐标、邻域上下文等多模态条件引导下，从噪声中重建未观测节点的未来状态。
AI.result: 在6个交通数据集与2个非交通数据集上的实验表明，GenST在零样本预测任务中显著优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 语义引导的生成式方法能有效缓解时空数据稀疏问题，验证了LLM语义知识在时空预测中的实用潜力。

title: RGBD20K: A Large-Scale Benchmark for RGB-D Semantic Segmentation
summary: In this paper, we propose RGBD20K, a novel dataset for facilitating the development of more robust and general RGB-D semantic segmentation by encompassing abundant categories and high-quality annotations. RGBD20K possesses several attractive properties: (1) Expanded Semantic Space. In particular, it covers 160 fine-grained categories, largely surpassing the category diversity of existing popular RGB-D benchmarks (e.g., NYUv2 with 40 classes and SUN RGB-D with 37 classes). With such enriched semantic coverage, we expect to promote the learning of more generalizable segmentation models. (2) Larger Scale. Compared with current benchmarks, RGBD20K offers 20,000 RGB-D image pairs, providing a substantially larger training resource that benefits the development of more powerful deep models. (3) High-Fidelity Annotation. We perform rigorous re-evaluation and correction of existing labels to resolve long-standing annotation noise, resulting in a clean and reliable ground-truth foundation. Furthermore, we propose a novel score-purified fusion (SPF) method, which achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach in leveraging high-quality multimodal information for RGB-D semantic segmentation. The dataset is here: https://github.com/ShaohuaDong2021/RGBD20K/.

AI.tldr: 提出大规模细粒度RGB-D语义分割数据集RGBD20K（160类、2万图像对、高质量标注），并提出score-purified fusion (SPF)方法，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-D语义分割基准存在类别多样性不足（如NYUv2 40类、SUN RGB-D 37类）、数据规模有限、标注噪声长期存在的问题，制约了更鲁棒、更通用分割模型的发展。
AI.method: 构建RGBD20K数据集，具备三大特性：扩展语义空间（160个细粒度类别）、更大规模（20000对RGB-D图像）、高保真标注（严格重评估与修正现有标签以消除标注噪声）；同时提出score-purified fusion (SPF)融合方法。
AI.result: SPF方法在所有评估基准上均取得state-of-the-art性能，验证了利用高质量多模态信息进行RGB-D语义分割的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RGBD20K通过丰富类别覆盖、扩大规模与提升标注质量，为发展更通用、更强大的RGB-D语义分割模型提供了可靠基础，SPF方法进一步展示了高质量多模态信息的利用价值。

title: Exploiting answer-invariant redundancies in satellite imagery for efficient VLM inference on edge
summary: Onboard vision-language models could enable satellites to answer queries directly, but exhaustive tiled inference over high-resolution imagery is slow and energy-intensive. We identify answer-invariant token redundancy (AITR): image tiles and vision tokens that can be removed without changing the final answer. We present Rift, a two-stage system that performs query-conditioned tile pruning followed by elastic prefill to reduce token budget. We evaluate it on LLaVA-1.5 7B running on Jetson AGX Orin. Compared with exhaustive tiled inference, Rift reduces energy by 78% and latency by 69%, while increasing accuracy from 45% to 73%.

AI.tldr: 提出Rift两阶段系统，利用答案不变token冗余(AITR)进行查询条件下的图块剪枝与弹性预填充，在星载Jetson平台显著降低能耗与时延并提升精度。
AI.motivation: 星载视觉语言模型虽能让卫星直接回答查询，但对高分辨率影像做穷举式分块推理速度慢、能耗高，难以在资源受限的星上环境部署。
AI.method: 识别答案不变token冗余(AITR)，即删除后不改变最终答案的图像块与视觉token；据此设计Rift两阶段系统：先做查询条件下的图块剪枝，再进行弹性预填充以压缩token预算。
AI.result: 在Jetson AGX Orin上运行LLaVA-1.5 7B评测，相比穷举式分块推理，Rift降低能耗78%、时延69%，同时将准确率从45%提升至73%。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用AITR进行查询条件剪枝与弹性预填充，Rift在星载平台上实现了能效、时延与精度的协同提升，为高分辨率遥感影像的星上视觉语言推理提供了可行方案。

title: Design and Evaluation of LLM Chaining-Based Task Planning for General Purpose Service Robots
comment: Accepted to IEEE GCCE 2026. 5 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: General Purpose Service Robot (GPSR) tasks, as defined in the RoboCup@Home benchmark, require robots to interpret diverse natural language commands and generate multi-step action sequences in real home environments. Conventional Single Prompt (SP) approaches suffer from context bloat and the "Lost in the Middle" phenomenon, leading to unreliable task planning. We propose an LLM chaining architecture that separates instruction classification and action generation into two specialized stages, reducing per-inference prompt length by approximately 45% while improving planning consistency. We evaluate our method using 100 randomly generated GPSR commands across three language models spanning local open-source and frontier cloud deployment contexts. Results show consistent planning improvements over SP across all models, with gains of up to +37 percentage points on local models. Further, real-robot execution experiments on the Toyota Human Support Robot (HSR) reveal that planning success alone does not guarantee task completion, with 6 of 10 tasks completing successfully and execution-layer failures identified as the primary remaining bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM链式架构，将指令分类与动作生成分为两阶段，减少约45%提示长度并提升GPSR任务规划一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统单提示（SP）方法在通用服务机器人（GPSR）任务中存在上下文膨胀与"Lost in the Middle"现象，导致任务规划不可靠。
AI.method: 设计LLM链式架构，将指令分类与动作生成解耦为两个专用阶段；使用100条随机生成的GPSR命令，在3个涵盖本地开源与云端前沿部署的语言模型上评估，并在丰田HSR真机上开展执行实验。
AI.result: 规划性能在所有模型上均持续优于SP，本地模型提升最高达+37个百分点；真机实验中10项任务仅6项成功，执行层失败是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段LLM链式架构可有效缓解上下文膨胀、提升规划一致性，但规划成功并不保证任务完成，执行层鲁棒性仍是关键挑战。

title: Where Hallucinations Live: A Cross-Architecture Circuit in VQ-Tokenized Vision-Language Models
summary: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) that tokenize images through a vector-quantized (VQ) codebook routinely hallucinate objects on grounded yes/no benchmarks, yet existing decoding-time fixes treat this as generic miscalibration without an architectural account. Using activation patching across twenty-five models spanning eight LLM families, we identify an early-layer ($L_0$) attention routing circuit shared across VQ-tokenized VLMs and propose a three-gate diagnostic that distinguishes the models carrying it from those that do not. The diagnostic isolates ten positive models (five natural unified-VQ VLMs across three LLM families and five induced variants) and rejects the remaining fifteen. A single-variable architectural swap (LLaVA-1.6 CLIP+MLP $\rightarrow$ VQ+Linear) installs the circuit, while a matched-compute MLP control on identical data does not, isolating vector quantization as the source of the pathological signal; the routing pathway that carries it is one that the backbone already provides. Against tuned VCD and DoLA baselines, tuned DoLA wins on binary calibration, but \textbf{only $L_0$ ablation reduces object hallucination in open-ended generation} (CHAIR$_i$ reduces by $31\,\%$ relatively, whereas tuned DoLA and VCD leave it unchanged or worsen it). These results recast object hallucination in unified VQ VLMs as a property of architecture and pretraining, and yield a targeted intervention that mechanism-agnostic decoding cannot replicate.

AI.tldr: 通过激活修补在25个模型中发现VQ词表化VLM共有的早期层(L0)注意力路由回路，提出三闸门诊断区分携带该回路的模型，并证明仅L0消融能降低开放式生成中的物体幻觉。
AI.motivation: 统一视觉语言模型(VLM)通过向量量化(VQ)码本对图像进行token化，在grounded yes/no基准上经常出现物体幻觉，但现有解码时修正方法将其视为通用的校准不良问题，缺乏架构层面的解释。
AI.method: 采用激活修补(activation patching)技术，跨8个LLM家族共25个模型进行诊断；提出三闸门诊断方法识别携带早期层(L0)注意力路由回路的模型；通过单变量架构替换(LLaVA-1.6 CLIP+MLP → VQ+Linear)及匹配算力的MLP对照实验进行因果验证；并与调优后的VCD和DoLA基线进行对比。
AI.result: 诊断识别出10个阳性模型(5个自然统一VQ VLMs，跨3个LLM家族；5个诱导变体)，排除其余15个。单变量架构替换可安装该回路，而匹配算力MLP对照不能，从而隔离出向量量化是病理性信号的来源。调优DoLA在二元校准上优于基线，但仅L0消融能降低开放式生成中的物体幻觉(CHAIR_i相对降低31%)，而调优DoLA和VCD则无变化或更差。
AI.conclusion: 统一VQ VLM的物体幻觉应被重新理解为架构与预训练的属性，而非通用校准问题；基于L0的定向干预可有效缓解幻觉，这是机制无关的解码方法无法复现的。

title: Empath: Tracing Multi-Level Emotion Dynamics in Crisis Counseling Dialogues
summary: Emotion dynamics are critical for understanding crisis-support conversations, yet most computational work treats emotion as static utterance-level labels. We introduce EMPATH, a framework for understanding affective dynamics in mental health dialogues across three granularities: turn-level labels, transition probabilities, and global conversation archetypes. Applying EMPATH to text-based crisis conversations with self-identified Black texters discussing grief, we find persistent negative affect, gradual hope-ward transitions, distinct texter-volunteer emotional roles, and heterogeneous recovery trajectories. These results highlight the informative patterns that emerge from computationally understanding crisis support and expressions of grief as dynamic processes within conversations, as well as the overall value of emotion-dynamic analysis for analyzing and comparing affect in dialogues.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EMPATH框架，从轮次级标签、转移概率和全局会话原型三个粒度分析心理健康对话中的情感动态，并应用于黑人丧亲危机文本对话，揭示了持续负性情感、渐进式希望转变、求助者-志愿者情感角色分化及异质恢复轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有计算工作多将情感视为静态的、话语级标签，忽略了危机支持对话中情感随时间演化的动态特性，难以刻画真实求助过程中的情感变化与恢复轨迹。
AI.method: 提出EMPATH框架，在三个粒度上建模情感动态：轮次级情感标签、情感转移概率、以及全局会话原型（对话类型）；并将其应用于求助者自述为非裔（Black）且讨论丧亲（grief）的文本型危机支持对话。
AI.result: 发现四类现象：持续存在的负性情感、向希望方向的渐进式转移、求助者与志愿者之间清晰的情感角色分工、以及异质性的恢复轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 将危机支持与丧亲表达理解为对话内部的动态过程，能揭示静态标签无法捕捉的有信息量模式；情感动态分析对分析与比较对话中的情感具有普遍价值。

title: EIB-Net: Entropy-Guided Information Bottleneck for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: The proliferation of photorealistic AI-generated images demands robust detection methods that generalize across diverse generative models. While existing approaches target manipulation-based forgeries with local artifacts, generation-based images (e.g., from diffusion models) lack such traces, posing a fundamental challenge. We observe that generative models prioritize global semantics at the expense of local texture fidelity, making low-texture regions key indicators of synthetic origin. To exploit this, we propose EIB-Net, an Entropy-guided Information Bottleneck Network. EIB-Net introduces a novel Image Entropy (IE) metric to automatically select the most informative (lowest-entropy) patch, then processes it with a Variational Information Bottleneck (VIB) to learn compact, generalizable features. Extensive experiments on DIFF, DiffusionForensics, and GenImage benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: EIB-Net achieves 85.7\% accuracy using only 2\% of training data, outperforming full-image baselines by over 15\%, and maintains robust cross-generator generalization (83.5\% average accuracy on GenImage). Furthermore, our entropy-guided patch selection (EGPL) consistently enhances diverse backbones (CNNs and Transformers), proving its practical value for data-efficient detection.

AI.tldr: 提出EIB-Net，利用图像熵引导选择低纹理块并结合信息瓶颈学习紧凑特征，实现高数据效率、跨生成模型的AI生成图像检测。
AI.motivation: 逼真AI生成图像泛滥，需具备跨模型泛化能力的检测方法。现有方法针对篡改型伪造的局部伪影，而扩散模型等生成式图像缺乏此类痕迹，构成根本性挑战。
AI.method: 观察到生成模型偏重全局语义而牺牲局部纹理保真度，故低纹理区域成为合成来源的关键线索。据此提出EIB-Net（熵引导信息瓶颈网络）：引入图像熵（IE）指标自动选取信息量最大（熵最低）的图像块，再用变分信息瓶颈（VIB）处理，学习紧凑且可泛化的特征。
AI.result: 在DIFF、DiffusionForensics、GenImage基准上达到SOTA：仅用2%训练数据取得85.7%准确率，超过全图基线15%以上；跨生成器泛化稳健（GenImage平均83.5%）。熵引导块选择（EGPL）在CNN与Transformer等不同骨干上均稳定提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 熵引导的块选择与信息瓶颈结合，为数据高效的AI生成图像检测提供了实用且泛化性强的方案。

title: Seeing Is Not Measuring: Tool-Augmented Metric Spatial Reasoning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe scenes well but reason poorly about metric 3D structure such as absolute distances, physical sizes, or egocentric directions. We present a modular, predictor agnostic, tool-augmented framework that equips a small VLM (Qwen3.5-4B) with geometric tools: 3D object detection, metric depth estimation, and deterministic solvers for distance, size and bearing. Each object is detected in the camera frame of its own best view, and the tools use that frame's pose to lift every detection into one shared world frame. Moving metric computation out of the model's weights and into explicit solvers yields large gains on three of four ReVSI-Bench tasks: with a strong monocular detector (WildDet3D), absolute distance rises from 0.46 to 0.74 Mean Relative Accuracy (MRA), relative distance from 39.1% to 67.4%, and relative direction from a below-chance 25.9% to 73.4%. Because any detector can be swapped in behind the tool interface, comparing real detectors against ground-truth boxes separates perception error from reasoning error: orchestration costs only 0.03 MRA. Object size is bounded by the detector: the tools are near-exact on groundtruth boxes (0.97) yet the best real detector barely beats the no-tool baseline (0.61 vs. 0.58), because size reads straight off a box extent monocular detectors get wrong. Without a predefined recipe, the model already sequences the tools correctly on its own, matching a scripted pipeline on three of four tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化、预测器无关的工具增强框架，为小型VLM（Qwen3.5-4B）接入3D检测、度量深度与确定性求解器，将度量计算从模型权重移至显式求解器，在ReVSI-Bench四项任务中的三项取得大幅提升。
AI.motivation: VLM擅长场景描述，但对绝对距离、物理尺寸、自我中心方向等度量3D结构推理能力差。
AI.method: 模块化、预测器无关的工具增强框架：配备3D目标检测、度量深度估计及距离/尺寸/方位确定性求解器；每个物体在其最佳视角的相机坐标系中检测，再借该帧位姿将检测提升至统一世界坐标系；工具接口后可替换任意检测器。
AI.result: 使用强单目检测器WildDet3D时，绝对距离MRA由0.46升至0.74，相对距离由39.1%升至67.4%，相对方向由低于随机的25.9%升至73.4%；编排仅消耗0.03 MRA；尺寸任务受检测器限制，真值框下近精确（0.97），真实检测器仅0.61略高于无工具基线0.58。
AI.conclusion: 将度量计算外置为显式求解器可有效释放VLM推理能力，并可通过真值框对比分离感知误差与推理误差；无预定义流程时模型能自行正确编排工具，在四项任务中的三项匹配脚本化流水线。

title: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
comment: 21 pages, 13 figures, 7 tables. Keywords: cancer registry, retrieval-augmented generation, large language models, conversational AI, clinical informatics, oncology data specialists, medical question answering, AI safety, clinical decision support
summary: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving human oversight of final abstraction decisions. We built a domain-specific knowledge base from national cancer registry standards, segmented into metadata-tagged passages and indexed as dense embeddings. Retrieved passages were used to generate citation-grounded responses through a large language model (LLM). Open-weight, proprietary, and non-RAG baseline models across Gemini and GPT families were evaluated on easy, medium, and hard registry questions using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocols. RAG configurations consistently outperformed non-RAG approaches, especially as question difficulty increased. Mean grounding scores for RAG were 0.62/0.56/0.59 across easy/medium/hard tiers versus 0.29/0.26/0.29 for non-RAG. RAG models also achieved higher semantic-similarity scores overall. Proprietary RAG models performed strongest on easy and medium questions, while local RAG models ranked highest on hard questions and proprietary models were generally more cautious. Domain-specific RAG improved evidence grounding and response quality for cancer registry questions while enabling citation-supported assistance across complexity levels. CRISS demonstrates the potential of human-centered, citation-grounded AI to support cancer registrars while preserving human oversight for final coding decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了CRISS——一个面向肿瘤登记领域的检索增强生成（RAG）对话助手，用于为肿瘤登记员提供快速、带引用的编码与分期标准指导；评估显示RAG配置在证据支撑与回答质量上显著优于非RAG基线，且随问题难度提升优势更明显。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤登记员（含肿瘤数据专家ODS）需解读复杂且频繁更新的编码与分期标准，人工检索与解读负担重，亟需既高效又可靠、可追溯的智能辅助工具，同时须保留人类对最终编码决策的监督权。
AI.method: 构建领域专用知识库，将国家肿瘤登记标准切分为带元数据标签的文本片段并索引为稠密向量嵌入；检索到的片段经大语言模型生成带引用依据的回答，形成RAG流程。采用LLM-as-a-Judge评测协议，在易、中、难三档登记问题上，对Gemini与GPT系列中的开放权重、专有及非RAG基线模型进行对比评估。
AI.result: RAG配置始终优于非RAG方法，且随问题难度增加优势扩大。RAG在易/中/难三档的平均grounding得分分别为0.62/0.56/0.59，非RAG为0.29/0.26/0.29；RAG模型整体语义相似度得分更高。专有RAG模型在易、中档问题上表现最佳，本地RAG模型在难题上排名最高，专有模型回答总体更为谨慎。
AI.conclusion: 领域专用RAG有效提升了肿瘤登记问题的证据支撑度与回答质量，可在各复杂度层面提供带引用的辅助支持。CRISS体现了以人为中心、基于引用依据的AI在支持肿瘤登记员工作的潜力，同时保留人类对最终编码决策的监督。

title: Can Classical Semantic-Extractive Summarization Be Evaluated in Hindi? A Replication Study
summary: We replicate the distributional-semantics extractive summarisation method of Mohd, Jan and Shah (2020) and adapt it to Hindi, substituting a Devanagari-appropriate component at every language-specific step. The system is evaluated on two independent corpora --- the Hindi portion of XL-Sum and FIRE ILSUM 2.0 Hindi --- under a Devanagari-aware ROUGE implementation validated against the XL-Sum authors' own multilingual scorer, with all comparisons drawn as 1000-resample paired bootstraps. In its published equal-weight configuration the replicated system is significantly worse than a three-sentence lead baseline on both corpora, trailing Lead-3 by 0.042 ROUGE-1 Fon XL-Sum and by 0.265 on ILSUM. A feature ablation shows that sentenceposition is the only feature that contributes: position alone reproduces the lead baseline exactly, removing position gives the weakest configuration,and a validation-tuned weighting can at best equal Lead-3 and never exceed it. TextRank fails identically, making this a class-level rather than an implementation-level result. A selection analysis shows the remaining features steer extraction towards long, entity-dense body sentences while the references reuse the article lead.Current Hindi benchmarks therefore cannot reward non-lead content selection, motivating purpose-built evaluation resources.

AI.tldr: 该研究复现并适配了Mohd等人(2020)的分布语义抽取式摘要方法至印地语，在XL-Sum和FIRE ILSUM 2.0两个语料上评估，发现复现系统在等权配置下显著劣于Lead-3基线，特征消融显示仅有句子位置特征有效，TextRank表现相同，说明这是类级别而非实现级别的问题。
AI.motivation: 印地语抽取式摘要缺乏对现有分布语义方法的验证。作者希望检验该语言无关方法在印地语上的适应性，并考察当前印地语基准是否能有效评估非引导句内容选择能力。
AI.method: 将Mohd等人(2020)的分布语义抽取式摘要方法复现并适配至印地语，在每个语言相关步骤替换为适合天城文的组件。在XL-Sum印地语部分与FIRE ILSUM 2.0 Hindi两个独立语料上评估，采用天城文感知的ROUGE实现（对照XL-Sum作者的多语评分器验证），所有比较均使用1000次重采样配对自助法。进行特征消融实验与选择分析，并与TextRank对比。
AI.result: 在等权配置下，复现系统在两个语料上均显著劣于三句引导基线：XL-Sum上落后Lead-3 ROUGE-1达0.042，ILSUM上落后0.265。特征消融显示仅有句子位置特征有贡献——位置单独即可精确复现引导基线，去除位置配置最弱，验证集调优的加权最多只能与Lead-3持平，无法超越。TextRank表现完全相同。选择分析表明其余特征将抽取导向长且实体密集的正文句子，而参考摘要复用了文章引导句。
AI.conclusion: 当前印地语基准无法奖励非引导句的内容选择，这是一个类级别而非实现级别的问题，因而需要专门构建的评估资源。

title: DAWN: Noise-Robust Quadruped Parkour via Depth-Denoising World Models
summary: Vision-based legged locomotion methods assume clean depth at training time and rely on hand-tuned post-processing filters at deployment. However, filter parameters are rarely disclosed, hindering reproducibility, and performance degrades substantially when depth noise is left unaddressed. Building noise robustness directly into the learning pipeline would eliminate this dependency. While such robustness has been explored for proprioceptive inputs, analogous approaches for depth perception remain largely absent in legged locomotion. We propose DAWN (Denoising and Alignment in World models for Noise-robustness), a noise-robust perception framework for legged locomotion, which builds noise robustness directly into a world model via two modifications: (1) feeding noisy depth to the encoder while keeping clean depth as the reconstruction target, forcing the model to implicitly denoise its input; and (2) applying contrastive learning to align the latent states of noisy and clean depth. Importantly, DAWN is not tied to a specific noise model, requiring no manual tuning to the noise distribution at deployment. Furthermore, it incurs no additional inference cost over existing world model-based methods. Without any manual filter calibration -- relying solely on the learned noise-robust representation -- DAWN achieves zero-shot quadruped parkour on a Unitree Go1: traversing stairs up to 18 cm, clearing gaps up to 70 cm, and mounting steps up to 45 cm from raw depth observations. Ablation studies show that denoising and contrastive alignment contribute at complementary levels -- reconstruction and representation, respectively -- and yield additive gains when combined. Videos and code are available at: https://dawn-parkour.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出DAWN框架，将噪声鲁棒性直接内嵌到世界模型中，实现四足机器人在原始深度观测下的零样本跑酷。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的腿足运动方法在训练时假设深度图干净，部署时依赖手工调参的后处理滤波器；滤波参数鲜少公开，导致可复现性差，且当深度噪声未处理时性能显著下降。虽然本体感知输入的鲁棒性已有研究，但深度感知的类似方法在腿足运动中基本缺失。
AI.method: DAWN通过两项修改构建噪声鲁棒感知框架：(1) 向编码器输入含噪深度，同时以干净深度作为重建目标，迫使模型隐式去噪输入；(2) 采用对比学习对齐含噪与干净深度的潜在状态。该方法不绑定特定噪声模型，部署时无需针对噪声分布手动调参，且相比现有世界模型方法不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在无任何人工滤波标定、仅依赖所学鲁棒表征的情况下，于Unitree Go1上实现零样本四足跑酷：攀爬高达18 cm的楼梯、跨越达70 cm的间隙、登上高达45 cm的台阶（均基于原始深度观测）。消融研究表明，去噪与对比对齐分别在重建层与表征层互补贡献，结合时产生叠加增益。
AI.conclusion: DAWN将噪声鲁棒性直接内建于学习流程，消除对人工滤波后处理的依赖，且在零样本条件下于真实四足平台上验证了有效性，为腿足运动的深度感知鲁棒性提供了免调参、低开销的解决方案。

title: ELF-REG: Scaling Continuous Diffusion Language Models to Reasoning Tasks
summary: Fully continuous diffusion language models (dLMs) denoise continuous representations without intermediate discretization, then decode all response tokens in parallel at the final step. Their performance on challenging reasoning tasks remains less established than that of autoregressive (AR) LLMs and masked dLMs. We scale Embedded Language Flows (ELF) to mathematical reasoning and code generation on GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP. We introduce ELF-REG, which improves learning with representation alignment and entanglement (REPA+REG), where a frozen AR teacher supervises intermediate denoiser features and supplies a global representation that is jointly denoised with the response. ELF-REG-L achieves 55.96% pass@1 on GSM8K at 64 network function evaluations (NFE), and 13.39% on MATH-500 and 22.56% on HumanEval at 128 NFE. It outperforms the evaluated comparable-scale dLMs in pass@1 on GSM8K and code, and improves MATH-500 pass@1 from 10.55% for the ELF-L baseline to 13.39% with ELF-REG-L. Without few-step training, the same task-specific checkpoints support strong low-NFE performance through early-stop, which decodes an intermediate clean prediction without completing the denoising trajectory. At 16 NFE, ELF-REG-L reaches 41.21% HumanEval pass@10, outperforming recent continuous dLMs of comparable scale.

AI.tldr: 本文将嵌入式语言流（ELF）扩展到数学推理与代码生成任务，并提出 ELF-REG 方法，通过表征对齐与纠缠（REPA+REG）改进连续扩散语言模型的学习，取得优于同级扩散模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 全连续扩散语言模型（dLMs）在无中间离散化的情况下对连续表征去噪并并行解码，但其在困难推理任务上的表现尚不明确，且相比自回归（AR）LLM 和掩码 dLMs 的差距有待验证。作者希望评估并提升连续 dLMs 在数学推理与代码生成上的能力。
AI.method: 将 Embedded Language Flows（ELF）扩展到 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval 和 MBPP 上的数学推理与代码生成。提出 ELF-REG，利用 REPA+REG：冻结的 AR 教师模型监督中间去噪器特征，并提供与响应联合去噪的全局表征。此外，通过早停（early-stop）在无需少步训练的情况下实现低 NFE 性能。
AI.result: ELF-REG-L 在 64 NFE 下 GSM8K 达 55.96% pass@1，128 NFE 下 MATH-500 达 13.39%、HumanEval 达 22.56%。在 GSM8K 和代码任务上 pass@1 优于所评估的同级 dLMs；MATH-500 从 ELF-L 基线的 10.55% 提升至 13.39%。16 NFE 下 ELF-REG-L 在 HumanEval 达 41.21% pass@10，优于近期同规模连续 dLMs。
AI.conclusion: 表征对齐与纠缠（REPA+REG）能有效提升连续扩散语言模型在推理与代码任务上的性能；早停机制使同一任务专用检查点无需少步训练即可支持强低 NFE 表现，验证了连续 dLMs 在挑战性推理任务上的可行性。

title: WildHSR: Metric Feed-Forward 4D People-Scene Reconstruction from a 3D Foundation Model
summary: 3D foundation models recover video cameras and geometry in one forward pass, but some of the strongest are up to scale. Joint people-scene reconstruction then requires two missing outputs: metric scale and persistent person identity. We ask whether one up-to-scale foundation representation can support both through lightweight adaptation. Exact metric labels are scarce, but unlabeled in-the-wild video is abundant. We use people in curated web video to initialise the solution: a posed metric body and 2D keypoints give an approximate, closed-form scale pseudo-label. These pseudo-labels pretrain a Scale Readout, which is then fine-tuned together with a lightweight adapter using exact metric supervision from standard real-video training splits. At inference the head predicts metric scale from foundation-model tokens, without the ruler or its teachers. For person identity, we probe the pretrained foundation model alone and find evidence that its intermediate query-key features encode person correspondence across frames. In most evaluated moving-person clips, a mid-layer token prefers that person over the vacated location and other people. A tiny projection reads this correspondence; together with metric pelvis motion and proposal confidence, it drives dustbin-aware Sinkhorn association of per-frame bodies. WildHSR combines both readouts to reconstruct metric cameras, scene and people from monocular video. Each window is predicted feed-forward; analytic association and Sim(3) composition connect windows. On EMDB-2, WildHSR is the first feed-forward method in the published comparison to beat the best optimization-based WA-MPJPE and RTE while leading feed-forward methods on all three world-frame metrics. On RICH, it leads feed-forward people-and-scene methods on WA-MPJPE and W-MPJPE. The complete pipeline runs at 10.1 fps on one GPU.

AI.tldr: WildHSR通过轻量适配把"仅到尺度"的3D基础模型转化为可输出度量尺度与持久人物身份的前馈式联合人物-场景重建管线。
AI.motivation: 现有最强的3D基础模型在前向推理中可恢复视频相机与几何，但仅到尺度（up-to-scale），难以直接用于联合人物-场景重建，因为缺少两个关键输出：度量尺度和跨帧一致的人物身份；而精确度量标注稀缺，无标注的野外视频却大量存在。
AI.method: 1) 尺度：利用精选网络视频中的人体，由带位姿的度量人体+2D关键点构造闭式近似的尺度伪标签，预训练Scale Readout，再用标准真实视频训练集中的精确度量监督，与轻量adapter联合微调；推理时仅由基础模型token预测度量尺度，无需标尺与教师。2) 身份：探测预训练基础模型，发现其中间层query-key特征编码了跨帧人物对应关系（中层token更偏好该人物而非其让出的位置和他人），用极小投影读出该对应，结合度量骨盆运动与候选置信度，驱动dustbin-aware Sinkhorn进行逐帧人体的关联。3) 管线：将两个readout组合为WildHSR，逐窗口前馈预测，通过解析关联与Sim(3)组合跨窗口连接。
AI.result: 在EMDB-2上，WildHSR是已发表对比中首个在前馈方法里同时优于最佳优化式方法的WA-MPJPE与RTE，并在全部三项世界坐标系指标上领先前馈方法；在RICH上，其在WA-MPJPE与W-MPJPE上领先前馈式人物-场景方法；完整管线单GPU达10.1 fps。
AI.conclusion: 一个仅到尺度的基础表示，经轻量适配（尺度伪标签预训练+精确微调、以及从中间层特征读出人物对应）即可同时支撑度量尺度与人物身份，实现快速、准确且可扩展的单目联合人物-场景重建。

title: Spectral Amplitude Purification in Distribution Matching for Diffusion Distillation
summary: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) enables high-quality diffusion sampling in only a few steps, but its optimization dynamics remain dominated by coarse, low-frequency signals, delaying the recovery of fine-grained details. We identify a pronounced concentration of spectral amplitudes at low frequencies in the DMD directional error, where dominant low-frequency components overwhelm weaker mid- and high-frequency signals. To address this issue, we propose Spectral Amplitude Purification for Distribution Matching Distillation (SAP-DMD), a plug-and-play approach that adaptively modulates the amplitude spectrum of the DMD directional field. By suppressing the dominant tail of the amplitude spectrum, SAP-DMD reduces low-frequency dominance and promotes more effective recovery of fine structures and textures. Experiments on PixArt-$α$, SD3, and SD3.5 demonstrate that SAP-DMD accelerates training convergence and improves generation quality under both 2-step and 4-step sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SAP-DMD，一种即插即用方法，通过自适应调制 DMD 方向场的幅度谱，抑制主导的低频成分，从而加速训练收敛并提升少步扩散生成质量。
AI.motivation: DMD 虽能实现少步高质量扩散采样，但其优化动态被粗糙的低频信号主导，导致细粒度细节恢复延迟。作者发现 DMD 方向误差的频谱幅度在低频处高度集中，主导的低频分量压过较弱的中高频信号，这正是细节恢复受限的根本原因。
AI.method: 提出 Spectral Amplitude Purification for DMD（SAP-DMD），一种即插即用方案，对 DMD 方向场的幅度谱进行自适应调制；通过抑制幅度谱中占主导的低频尾部，降低低频主导性，促进细结构与纹理的有效恢复。
AI.result: 在 PixArt-α、SD3 和 SD3.5 上的实验表明，SAP-DMD 能加速训练收敛，并在 2 步与 4 步采样下均提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: SAP-DMD 通过频谱幅度净化有效缓解了 DMD 优化中的低频主导问题，是一种通用、即插即用的改进策略，可在多种扩散模型与少步采样设置下取得更优的收敛速度与生成质量。

title: UpDown-SC: Gravity-Canonicalized Dual-Envelope Scan Context for Indoor LiDAR Place Recognition
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/jiejie567/updown-sc
summary: LiDAR place recognition is a key front end for loop closure and global relocalization, yet indoor retrieval remains difficult when attitude or sensor mounting height changes between mapping and query sessions. Scan Context stores the maximum height in each polar cell; indoors, broad ceilings can suppress the lower and mid-level geometry that distinguishes adjacent rooms and corridors. We present UpDown-SC, a training-free polar descriptor that first canonicalizes gravity and then represents two complementary surfaces: the upper envelope of lower/middle structures and the lower envelope of overhead structures. Their physical split is estimated once from a cell-balanced map height distribution and reused by every query. A mask-aware, non-uniform two-channel distance retains discriminative lower-level evidence while limiting sensitivity to its cross-session variation, without treating unobserved cells as zero-height measurements. Conventional Scan Context shortlisting and circular yaw alignment are retained, so retrieved hypotheses directly initialize geometric verification. Experiments across repeated indoor sessions, mounting-height changes, mixed outdoor-to-indoor trajectories, and an outdoor transfer sequence show more reliable first-choice retrieval on the indoor and mounting-height-varied sessions. A paired test finds a significant gain over Scan Context on the in-house sessions. UpDown-SC also gives the best or second-best F1max and AUPR under threshold-based acceptance while retaining a lightweight CPU front end. Continuous replay confirms that the retrieved hypotheses support metric prior-map localization. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/jiejie567/updown-sc.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的极坐标描述子UpDown-SC，通过重力对齐与上下双表面建模，缓解室内LiDAR场景中姿态与安装高度变化导致的Scan Context失效问题。
AI.motivation: 室内LiDAR地点识别在回环检测与全局重定位中十分关键，但当建图与查询会话之间姿态或传感器安装高度发生变化时，检索性能显著下降。Scan Context仅存储每个极坐标单元的最大高度，在室内环境中宽大天花板会压制区分相邻房间与走廊的中低层几何信息。
AI.method: UpDown-SC为无需训练的极坐标描述子：先进行重力方向规范化，再分别表示两个互补表面——中低层结构的上包络与顶部结构的下包络；其物理分界由单元均衡的地图高度分布一次性估计，并被所有查询复用。距离度量采用掩码感知的非均匀双通道形式，保留低层判别性证据、抑制跨会话变化影响，且不将未观测单元视作零高度。同时保留Scan Context的候选筛选与圆形偏航对齐，检索假设可直接初始化几何验证。
AI.result: 在重复室内会话、安装高度变化、室内外混合轨迹及室外迁移序列上，室内与安装高度变化会话的首选检索更可靠；配对检验显示在自建室内数据集上显著优于Scan Context。在基于阈值的接受策略下，F1max与AUPR达到最优或次优，并保持轻量CPU前端；连续回放验证检索假设可支撑度量先验地图定位。
AI.conclusion: UpDown-SC以双通道上下包络表示与掩码感知距离，在不增加训练成本的前提下提升了室内及安装高度变化场景的LiDAR地点识别鲁棒性，并可直接嵌入现有Scan Context检索与几何验证流程。

title: Less is More: Encoder-only Audio-Visual Segmentation
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Project page https://ease-avs.notion.site
summary: Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation (AVSS) aims to identify, segment, and classify sound-emitting objects in video frames. Previous Transformer-based AVSS approaches largely inherit design principles from image segmentation models. Recent studies show that these image segmentation models contain redundant components that contribute little to the segmentation performance. Following this insight, we propose Encoder-only Audio-Visual Segmentation (EASE). EASE runs at up to 365 FPS, 3x faster than prior State-of-the-Art (SotA) AVS models at comparable accuracy, and trains in under 11 GPU-hours. Furthermore, we achieve SotA AVSS performance across different backbones and input resolutions. Our results demonstrate that AVSS can be both simpler and faster, providing a scalable foundation for future research and real-time applications. Code, model weights, and samples are available at https://ease-avs.notion.site

AI.tldr: 提出仅编码器的音视频语义分割框架 EASE，去除冗余解码器，实现最高 365 FPS 的实时分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的 AVSS 方法沿用图像分割模型的架构设计，其中包含大量对分割性能贡献甚微的冗余组件，导致模型复杂且推理速度慢。
AI.method: 提出 Encoder-only Audio-Visual Segmentation（EASE），即仅保留编码器结构的音视频语义分割框架，剥离冗余解码器设计，从而简化整体架构。
AI.result: EASE 推理速度最高达 365 FPS，在同等精度下比此前 SotA 音视频分割模型快 3 倍，训练时间不足 11 GPU 小时；并可在不同骨干网络与输入分辨率下达到 SotA 的 AVSS 性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 AVSS 可以同时实现更简单、更快速的架构，为未来研究和实时应用提供可扩展的基础。

title: Accent Analogy Guidance: More Speaker Similarity at Equal Accent in Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Listening samples: https://yoomee-cho.github.io/accent-analogy-guidance/
summary: In cross-lingual zero-shot text-to-speech, the accent of the reference leaks into the target speech. We propose accent analogy guidance (AAG), a training-free sampler term that subtracts an accent direction estimated from the model's own predictions for one synthetic voice rendered in both languages, so the voice cancels and only the accent remains. By a blind LLM accent judge on real dubbing data, reweighting classifier-free guidance between reference and text, and its variants, stay near one identity-accent trade-off curve; we score a method by its speaker similarity above that curve at equal accent ($Δ$SIM). Across four open TTS models AAG lies above the curve: on OmniVoice $Δ$SIM is +0.11 to +0.27 on three test sets (accent 3.51 to 4.28 on a 1-5 scale at speaker similarity 0.29, where reweighting keeps 0.02); MaskGCT and CosyVoice 2 also lie above their curves, and on F5-TTS it is more native than any reweighting setting. An LLM-free language-ID measure and a twelve-listener panel agree. A premise test and the reach of a model's own curve indicate in advance whether and roughly how much AAG can gain, predicting the one model where it gains nothing (X-Voice).

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的采样项 AAG，通过从模型自身预测中估计并减去口音方向，分离说话人身份与口音，在跨语言零样本 TTS 中显著提升同等口音水平下的说话人相似度。
AI.motivation: 跨语言零样本 TTS 中，参考语音的口音会泄漏到目标语音，导致生成语音带有非目标语言口音。现有重加权（如无分类器引导在参考与文本间调权）方法只能沿单一的身份-口音权衡曲线移动，无法同时改善两者。
AI.method: 提出 accent analogy guidance（AAG），一种免训练采样项：用同一合成音色以两种语言渲染，从模型自身预测中估计"口音方向"，做减法使音色相互抵消、仅保留口音，从而在不训练的情况下引导采样。采用盲测 LLM 口音评审构建评估框架，以等口音条件下的说话人相似度增量（ΔSIM）作为评价指标，并附 LLM-free 语言 ID 度量与 12 人听测面板验证。
AI.result: 在四个开源 TTS 模型上 AAG 均位于权衡曲线上方：OmniVoice 上三个测试集 ΔSIM 为 +0.11~+0.27（口音 3.51~4.28/5，说话人相似度 0.29，而重加权仅 0.02）；MaskGCT 与 CosyVoice 2 同样高于各自曲线；F5-TTS 上比任何重加权设置都更接近母语口音。前提检验与模型自身曲线范围可预先预测 AAG 的增益及唯一无增益模型（X-Voice）。
AI.conclusion: AAG 是一种免训练、可即插即用的采样引导方法，能有效缓解参考口音泄漏，并在多模型多测试集上取得一致增益；其增益可由模型自身权衡曲线范围预先预测，具有可解释性与可推广性。

title: FoCal: Frequency-Oriented Cross-Modal Interaction and Spectral Calibration for Aerial Visible-Infrared Object Detection
summary: In aerial RGB--IR object detection, effectively exploiting complementary information across modalities is critical for robust perception under complex illumination and environmental conditions. Existing multimodal detectors mainly focus on spatial-domain interaction or frequency-specific feature enhancement, while the cross-modal interaction patterns of different frequency components remain insufficiently explored. Moreover, spectral discrepancy itself may contain both useful complementary cues and unreliable modality-specific responses, making indiscriminate frequency fusion suboptimal. To address these issues, we propose FoCal, a frequency-oriented framework for aerial RGB--IR object detection. First, a Frequency-Aware Dual-Domain Calibration (FADC) module is developed to explicitly model frequency-dependent cross-modal interaction. Low-frequency components are collaboratively consolidated into a shared structural consensus, whereas high-frequency components preserve modality-specific information through selective cross-modal exchange. The resulting frequency-aware cues are further transferred to the original feature domain to regulate cross-modal calibration. Second, we introduce a Discrepancy-Guided Spectral Modulation (DGSM) module, which characterizes cross-modal spectral imbalance using confidence-weighted relative amplitude discrepancy and transforms it into a bounded signed gate for adaptive enhancement, preservation, or attenuation of the joint multimodal spectrum. Extensive experiments on DroneVehicle, ESCVehicle, and ATR-UMOD demonstrate the effectiveness of FoCal, yielding $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ values of 83.5\%, 54.8\%, and 64.6\%, respectively. Meanwhile, with only 3.0M parameters, FoCal achieves 113.6 FPS while preserving leading detection accuracy, highlighting a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. Code is available at {https://github.com/universeliang/FoCal.

AI.tldr: 提出FoCal频率导向框架用于航拍RGB-IR目标检测，包含FADC双域校准与DGSM差异引导频谱调制两个模块，在三个数据集上取得领先精度并保持轻量与高速。
AI.motivation: 航拍RGB-IR检测中跨模态互补信息利用至关重要，但现有方法多聚焦空间域交互或特定频率增强，对不同频率成分的跨模态交互模式探索不足；同时频谱差异既含互补线索也含不可靠的单模态响应，无差别频率融合并非最优。
AI.method: FoCal框架含两个模块：(1) 频率感知双域校准(FADC)，显式建模频率依赖的跨模态交互——低频成分协同整合为共享结构共识，高频成分通过选择性跨模态交换保留模态特有信息，并将频率感知线索传回原特征域以调控跨模态校准；(2) 差异引导频谱调制(DGSM)，用置信度加权相对幅值差异刻画跨模态频谱失衡，转化为有界符号门控，对联合多模态频谱进行自适应增强、保留或衰减。
AI.result: 在DroneVehicle、ESCVehicle、ATR-UMOD数据集上mAP50分别达83.5%、54.8%、64.6%；仅3.0M参数下实现113.6 FPS，在保持领先检测精度的同时具备良好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: FoCal通过频率导向的跨模态交互建模与差异引导频谱调制，有效提升航拍RGB-IR检测的鲁棒性与精度，且计算开销低、推理速度快，具有优越的精度-效率平衡。

title: Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing
summary: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种符号化词汇门控（signed lexical gate），将句子分类器的 logit margin 与稀疏词汇模型对预测意图的支持结合，用于选择性意图路由的风险校准，不改变基础分类器预测。
AI.motivation: 选择性意图路由需要在可靠时行动、不确定时延迟。标准置信度主要反映基础模型自身表示，未利用互补证据，因此存在在不改变原决策前提下引入额外证据以提升置信度校准的空间。
AI.method: 构造符号化词汇门控：把正证据赋予词汇一致情形，把负证据赋予词汇偏好的竞争意图；相较于无符号词汇置信度或硬一致性规则保留更多信息。再用独立的二项校准阶段按指定风险目标选取操作阈值。
AI.result: 在 BANKING77、CLINC150、HWU64 各十次运行中，风险-覆盖率曲线下面积较纯语义学习门控分别降低 15.8%、15.1%、11.8%。名义 5% 误差目标下，BANKING77 与 HWU64 接受覆盖率分别提升 1.83 和 5.14 个百分点，CLINC150 已接近全覆盖。更严格的 2% 目标下，二项程序在全部 30 个数据集-运行组合均得到非空策略。匹配对照显示该特征优于无符号词汇置信度，相对二元一致性有数据集相关增益。
AI.conclusion: 该双特征门控为风险校准的意图路由提供紧凑、可解释的置信度增强，同时保留基础分类器的预测。

title: Tag-Aware Structured Text Translation: Towards a Systematic Understanding
summary: Internet texts are replete with format tags that carry structural, semantic, and functional meaning. Current large language model (LLM)-based translation systems struggle to balance translation fluency with tag fidelity when processing tagged text. We argue that resolving this tension requires a systematic approach at three interconnected levels: data synthesis, capability building, and multi-objective alignment. At the data level, we identify and formalize a fundamental trade-off between structural tag diversity and translation naturalness in synthetic data generation; existing methods optimize for one at the expense of the other. We propose a hybrid synthesis strategy (Hy-LST) combining LLM-based synthesis tag method and Two-Stage LLM-based synthesis tag method to produce both diverse and natural tagged data. At the capability level, we decompose tag-aware translation into four sub-tasks of increasing difficulty in a multi-task supervised fine-tuning framework, enabling targeted capability acquisition and knowledge transfer. At the alignment level, we design three complementary reward functions under a group relative policy optimization framework, each targeting a distinct objective (fluency, tag fidelity, and tag-scoped translation quality), and show that joint optimization consistently outperforms single-reward alternatives. Experiments on six language directions (en2zh, en2ja, en2de, en2fr, en2ru, de2fr) demonstrate that each level contributes measurable improvements, and the complete system significantly outperforms existing methods. Qualitative analysis reveals specific error patterns and their mitigation after training with our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从数据合成、能力构建与多目标对齐三个层面系统解决LLM在带标签文本翻译中翻译流畅性与标签保真度之间的权衡问题，并在六个语言方向上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 互联网文本包含大量承载结构、语义和功能意义的格式标签，而当前基于LLM的翻译系统在处理带标签文本时难以兼顾翻译流畅性与标签保真度。作者认为解决这一矛盾需要在数据合成、能力构建和多目标对齐三个相互关联的层面采取系统性方法。
AI.method: 数据层面，识别并形式化了合成数据生成中结构性标签多样性与翻译自然度之间的基本权衡，提出混合合成策略Hy-LST，结合基于LLM的合成标签方法与两阶段LLM合成标签方法以兼顾多样性与自然度。能力层面，将标签感知翻译分解为四个难度递增的子任务，采用多任务监督微调框架实现针对性能力获取与知识迁移。对齐层面，在组相对策略优化框架下设计三种互补奖励函数，分别针对流畅性、标签保真度和标签范围内的翻译质量。
AI.result: 在六个语言方向（en2zh、en2ja、en2de、en2fr、en2ru、de2fr）上的实验表明，每个层面均带来可测量的提升，完整系统显著优于现有方法；奖励联合优化持续优于单一奖励方案。定性分析揭示了具体错误模式及其在采用本方法训练后的缓解情况。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据合成、能力构建与多目标对齐三层协同的系统性方法，能够有效缓解带标签文本翻译中流畅性与标签保真度的矛盾，实现优于现有方法的翻译性能。

title: BanglaKontho: Closing the Long-Form Gap in Bangla Text-to-Speech
summary: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, remains under-resourced for neural text-to-speech. Public Bangla speech corpora are dominated by short read-prompt utterances collected for speech recognition, leaving long-form prosody and consistent single-speaker narration uncovered. We present BanglaKontho, a single-speaker Bangla TTS corpus of 20 hours derived from professional audiobook recordings: 7,050 segmented utterances with verified transcripts at 24 kHz. We also release a reusable Bangla text normalizer covering Bangladeshi-style digit grouping, currency and date expressions, Danda punctuation and Unicode normalization, together with the full preprocessing pipeline. An MB-iSTFT-VITS baseline trained from scratch reaches 9.5% WER and 4.46 naturalness MOS, against 16.0% and 3.16 for the same architecture retrained on the 12-hour IndicTTS-Bn corpus. The corpus is released openly under CC BY-NC 4.0.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布BanglaKontho——一个20小时单说话人孟加拉语TTS语料库，源自专业有声书，并提出配套的文本归一化工具与预处理流程；同时以MB-iSTFT-VITS基线验证语料质量。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语作为全球第七大语言，神经TTS资源严重不足。现有公开孟加拉语语音语料库多为面向语音识别采集的短句朗读提示，缺乏长文本韵律与一致的单说话人叙述数据。
AI.method: 从专业有声书录音构建单说话人语料库：24 kHz采样、7,050条切分话语并配经验证的转写文本，共20小时。同时发布可复用的孟加拉语文本归一化器，覆盖孟加拉式数字分组、货币与日期表达、Danda标点及Unicode归一化，并公开完整预处理流程。采用从零训练的MB-iSTFT-VITS作为基线。
AI.result: MB-iSTFT-VITS基线达到9.5% WER与4.46自然度MOS；相同架构在12小时IndicTTS-Bn语料库上重训的结果为16.0% WER与3.16 MOS。
AI.conclusion: BanglaKontho填补了孟加拉语长文本、单说话人TTS数据的空白，基线实验表明其训练效果显著优于现有IndicTTS-Bn语料库，且语料与工具以CC BY-NC 4.0协议开放发布，有助于推动孟加拉语神经TTS研究。

title: Recoverable Geographic Location Information in Earth-Observation Embeddings
summary: Earth-observation (EO) foundation models provide reusable embeddings, yet downstream task accuracy does not reveal whether these representations encode geographic information, which may be beneficial for location-aware applications but potentially detrimental when representations invariant to geographic location are desired. We therefore evaluate the geographic coordinate robustness of Tessera v1, Tessera v1.1, and AlphaEarth by testing whether coordinates can be predicted from the embedding representations using 284 quality-verified European solar farms from 2024. We assessed geographic information content information through the association between cosine and geodesic distances and through prediction of projected coordinates in EPSG:3035. Embeddings from all three EO foundation models contain recoverable geographic information. All prediction models significantly outperform training-range uniform random sampling baselines, with AlphaEarth exhibiting the strongest distance association and lowest mean geodesic error. Both Tessera variants also yielded higher geographic distance correlations than the Sentinel-2 controls. These findings motivate geographic information content as an additional criterion for auditing EO foundation models.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了三个地球观测基础模型（Tessera v1、Tessera v1.1、AlphaEarth）的嵌入表示中所含地理信息，结果显示三者均可从嵌入中恢复出地理位置信息。
AI.motivation: 下游任务精度无法揭示基础模型嵌入是否编码了地理信息，而地理信息在位置感知应用中可能有益、但在需要位置不变的表示时可能有害，因此需要额外的审计标准。
AI.method: 使用2024年284个经质量验证的欧洲太阳能电站，通过余弦距离与大地测量距离的关联性，以及在EPSG:3035投影坐标系下的坐标预测，检验坐标能否从嵌入表示中预测出来。
AI.result: 三个模型的嵌入均含可恢复的地理信息；所有预测模型显著优于训练范围均匀随机采样基线，AlphaEarth距离关联最强、平均大地测量误差最低；两个Tessera变体的地理距离相关性也高于Sentinel-2对照。
AI.conclusion: 地理信息含量可作为审计地球观测基础模型的附加评估标准。

title: Med-AR: Autoregressive Vision-Language Pretraining for Long-Tailed Chest X-Ray Classification and Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation
comment: 80 pages including supplementary material, 28 figures, and 22 tables. Supplementary material is included
summary: Long-tailed chest X-ray classification requires visual representations that capture both common abnormalities and subtle, infrequent findings. We propose Med-AR-8B and Med-AR-2B, two radiology-native autoregressive vision-language models pretrained with structured reports, abnormality-focused text, and region annotations.
