We evaluate the transfer of their visual encoders to multi-label classification against contrastive, self-supervised, and supervised pretrained encoders, including Med-CLIP, CheXFound, EVA-Base, ARK, and BioViL-T, using a common ML-Decoder classification head. To assess fine-grained recognition, we also construct LLM-expanded, report-derived label sets for MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert. Across PadChest, MIMIC-CXR, and CheXpert, Med-AR-8B outperforms Med-CLIP in mean AUROC and AUPRC for head, medium, and tail findings. On MIMIC-CXR, it increases tail-label mean AUPRC from 0.1033 to 0.1441. Med-AR-2B achieves the strongest discrimination results on PadChest. Across the broader encoder comparison, a Med-AR variant achieves the highest mean AUROC and AUPRC in every reported prevalence group on each public dataset. Both Med-AR variants also achieve lower excess area under the risk-coverage curve than Med-CLIP on all three public datasets, indicating improved selective-prediction performance under the evaluated protocol. Internal results are metric-dependent, with Med-CLIP retaining advantages in overall and tail AUPRC and in selective prediction. These findings establish Med-AR as a strong pretraining recipe for long-tailed chest X-ray classification on the evaluated public benchmarks and demonstrate the value of assessing discrimination and selective prediction together.

AI.tldr: 提出放射学原生自回归视觉语言模型 Med-AR-8B/2B，其视觉编码器在长尾胸片多标签分类上优于 Med-CLIP、CheXFound 等对比/自监督/监督预训练编码器。
AI.motivation: 长尾胸片分类需要同时捕捉常见异常与罕见细微征象的视觉表征，现有预训练编码器在此任务上的迁移能力尚不明确，且需同时评估判别性能与选择性预测。
AI.method: 用结构化报告、异常聚焦文本和区域标注预训练 Med-AR-8B 与 Med-AR-2B 两个自回归视觉语言模型；将其视觉编码器接入统一 ML-Decoder 分类头，与 Med-CLIP、CheXFound、EVA-Base、ARK、BioViL-T 对比；并构建 LLM 扩展的报告衍生标签集用于 MIMIC-CXR 与 CheXpert 的细粒度识别评估。
AI.result: 在 PadChest、MIMIC-CXR、CheXpert 上，Med-AR-8B 在头部、中部、尾部征象的平均 AUROC 与 AUPRC 均优于 Med-CLIP，MIMIC-CXR 尾部标签平均 AUPRC 从 0.1033 提升至 0.1441；Med-AR-2B 在 PadChest 判别性能最佳；所有数据集的各患病率分组中均有 Med-AR 变体取得最高平均 AUROC/AUPRC；两个变体的风险-覆盖率曲线超额面积均低于 Med-CLIP。内部结果依赖指标，Med-CLIP 在整体及尾部 AUPRC 与选择性预测上仍具优势。
AI.conclusion: Med-AR 是长尾胸片分类的有效预训练方案，在公开基准上表现强劲，并表明联合评估判别性能与选择性预测具有重要价值。

title: Representation World Model: Learning States, Transition and Executable Plans in Representation
summary: We propose the Representation World Model (RWM), which learns states, transitions, and executable plans directly in representation space. Unlike existing world models that typically learn latent representations together with explicit dynamics models and perform planning through search, optimization, or policy-based prediction, RWM directly incorporates planning into the learned representation geometry. RWM learns the representation geometry by applying inverse-dynamics supervision locally along latent paths constructed from endpoint representations, requiring these paths to preserve task-relevant state and transition information. At inference, planning is performed by directly constructing a latent path between the current and goal representations, with inverse dynamics used to recover the corresponding actions, without recursive rollouts or action-space search. Experiments on continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM for direct planning, while results on robotic manipulation further show its potential to extend to more complex embodied control tasks. These results suggest that planning directly in representation space provides a promising alternative to conventional world-model planning.

AI.tldr: 提出表示世界模型（RWM），在表示空间中直接学习状态、转移与可执行计划，将规划内嵌到表示几何中；推理时通过构造当前与目标表示之间的潜在路径并用逆动力学恢复动作，无需递归推演或动作空间搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型通常将潜在表示与显式动力学模型联合学习，并依赖搜索、优化或策略预测进行规划，流程间接且计算开销大；作者希望让规划直接在表示空间中完成，作为传统世界模型规划的替代方案。
AI.method: RWM 直接在学习到的表示几何中融入规划。其通过沿由端点表示构建的潜在路径施加局部逆动力学监督来学习表示几何，要求这些路径保留任务相关的状态与转移信息。推理阶段，直接在当前与目标表示之间构造潜在路径，用逆动力学恢复对应动作，避免递归rollout和动作空间搜索。
AI.result: 在连续控制基准上验证了 RWM 用于直接规划的有效性；在机器人操作任务上的结果进一步显示其可扩展到更复杂的具身控制任务。
AI.conclusion: 规划直接在表示空间中进行，为传统世界模型规划提供了一种有前景的替代思路。

title: Predicting Emerging Topics from Outliers: A Prospective Study of Weak Signals in Embedding Space
summary: Some documents that embedding-based topic models initially classify as noise later become founding members of emerging topics. At publication time, however, they appear as scattered points in embedding space and are difficult to distinguish from ordinary noise without the benefit of hindsight. We study whether such anticipatory outliers can be predicted prospectively, using only information available when a document first appears. We derive labels from the subsequent trajectories of outlier documents, distinguishing those that anticipate new topics from those that reinforce existing topics or remain isolated, and estimate label confidence through agreement across multiple embedding models. On two French news corpora, anticipatory outliers prove predictable at publication time. Under cross-validation, $F_1$ rises from about 0.77 over the full eligible population to above 0.90 on high-consensus subsets, and remains at 0.76-0.80 under a strictly chronological evaluation. Predictive performance is driven mainly by geometric features capturing each outlier's position in embedding space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否在文档发表时（无需事后视角）前瞻性预测"先行性离群点"——即最初被嵌入式主题模型归为噪声、后来成为新兴主题创始成员的文档。作者利用文档后续轨迹构造标签，并通过多个嵌入模型的一致性估计标签置信度，在两组法语新闻语料上验证了预测可行性。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式主题模型在发布时将某些文档判为噪声，但这些文档日后可能成为新兴主题的创始成员。发布时它们在嵌入空间中呈散点状，与普通噪声难以区分，除非借助事后视角。作者希望探究这类"先行性离群点"能否仅凭文档出现时可获得的信息被前瞻性预测。
AI.method: 从离群文档的后续轨迹中推导标签，区分三类：预示新主题者、强化现有主题者、以及保持孤立者；通过多个嵌入模型间的一致性来估计标签置信度。特征方面主要依赖刻画离群点在嵌入空间中位置的几何特征。
AI.result: 在两组法语新闻语料上，先行性离群点在发布时确实可被预测。交叉验证下，F1从全eligible群体的约0.77提升至高一致性子集上的0.90以上；在严格按时间顺序的评估中仍保持0.76–0.80。预测性能主要由几何特征驱动。
AI.conclusion: 先行性离群点可在文档发表时被前瞻性预测，无需事后信息。多模型一致性可有效标定置信度，几何特征为核心预测因子，且在严格时间序列评估下性能稳健。

title: An Automated Georeferencing Technique for Multi-Temporal Stope Point Clouds for Downstream Geotechnical Analysis
summary: The increasing use of UAV laser scanning in underground mines has enabled frequent acquisition of 3D point clouds from challenging environments such as stopes, generating large volumes of multi-temporal spatial data throughout successive excavation stages. However, in GNSS-denied underground environments, independently acquired stope point clouds are generated within local scanner reference frames and require registration and georeferencing before integration with mine reference data for downstream geotechnical analysis, monitoring, and mine planning. This process is commonly performed manually by aligning individual stope scans with mine reference drives, making repeated georeferencing time-consuming and potentially limiting the utilisation of routinely acquired data. This study proposes the 3D Tag-based Automated Registration and Georeferencing Technique (3D-TARGeT), an automated framework using low-cost, generic, non-unique rectangular tags to establish spatial correspondence between stope point clouds and the mine reference coordinate system. The framework combines automated tag identification, geometric tag matching, and rigid transformation estimation. It was evaluated as a proof of concept using four multi-temporal point-cloud scans of an underground mine stope, with the proposed tags simulated under representative scanning conditions. 3D-TARGeT achieved consistent centimetre-level georeferencing accuracy, with median cloud-to-cloud distance and root mean square error below 0.03 m across all scans, while substantially outperforming widely used automatic point-cloud registration techniques. Overall, 3D-TARGeT provides an accurate and robust approach for automating stope point-cloud georeferencing, reducing reliance on manual alignment and facilitating multi-temporal datasets for downstream geological and geotechnical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出3D-TARGeT框架，利用低成本非唯一矩形标签实现地下采场点云自动配准与地理参考，精度达厘米级。
AI.motivation: 地下矿山采场中UAV激光扫描产生大量多时相点云，但GNSS拒止环境导致各期点云处于局部扫描仪坐标系中，需配准与地理参考才能与矿山参考数据融合用于岩土分析与采矿规划。传统人工对齐方式耗时，限制了常规采集数据的利用效率。
AI.method: 3D-TARGeT使用低成本、通用、非唯一的矩形标签建立采场点云与矿山参考坐标系间的空间对应关系，框架集成三个环节：自动标签识别、几何标签匹配、刚体变换估计。以某地下采场四期多时相点云扫描为概念验证，标签在代表性扫描条件下仿真生成。
AI.result: 在所有扫描中实现一致的厘米级地理参考精度，点云间距离中位数与均方根误差均低于0.03 m，显著优于常用的自动点云配准技术。
AI.conclusion: 3D-TARGeT为采场点云地理参考自动化提供了准确且稳健的方法，减少了对手工对齐的依赖，便于构建多时相数据集以支撑后续地质与岩土应用。

title: HGPTrans: Hierarchical Graph-Pooling Transolver for Automotive Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient Prediction
summary: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage design, where many candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost limits large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes the hierarchical graph-pooling Transolver (HGPTrans), which combines hierarchical graph pooling with Transolver-based attention to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, Transolver-style slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and sport utility vehicles (SUVs), achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56\% (sedans) and 2.12\% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.

AI.tldr: 提出分层图池化Transolver（HGPTrans），直接从车辆表面网格预测气动阻力系数，精度高且推理速度较CFD快数个量级。
AI.motivation: 车辆早期设计需评估大量候选几何，CFD虽可靠但计算成本高，限制大规模设计探索；车辆气动既依赖局部几何特征又依赖远距离表面区域间的长程相互作用。
AI.method: HGPTrans融合三个互补组件：图同构卷积编码判别性局部几何；Transolver式切片注意力以线性复杂度捕获全局交互；信息冗余感知的分层池化逐步移除冗余节点并保留信息量大的几何结构，从表面网格直接回归C_D。
AI.result: 在DrivAerNet与DrivAerNet++上取得所评估基线中最低的MAE与MSE；在含轿车与SUV的真实车辆数据集上迁移学习，相对L1误差分别为1.56%与2.12%，单车间推理约0.293 s，相比高保真CFD加速数个量级，预测值与CFD参考相差仅几个百分点。消融实验验证各组件的贡献并揭示深度与池化率的影响。
AI.conclusion: HGPTrans能够以极低推理成本实现接近CFD精度的阻力系数预测，具备良好的泛化能力，适合早期设计阶段的大规模几何探索。

title: ImCorr: Sub-pixel Semantic Correspondence via Implicit Feature Decoding
summary: The strong performance that modern semantic correspondence methods achieve at standard thresholds plateaus sharply at fine-grained thresholds. We argue that this plateau stems not from the representational capacity of backbone features, but from a grid-tied readout. Patch-based vision transformers tokenize images onto discrete grids, introducing two forms of quantization error: querying nearest patch features instead of exact keypoints on the source side, and the absence of grid features representing precise ground-truth locations on the target side. We quantify this quantization ceiling across all 499,188 keypoints in SPair-71k: under the standard 448x448, patch-14 setting, 84.9% of ground-truth keypoints have no grid feature representing their precise location at PCK@0.01. This is a structural limitation at the representation level, independent of the matching strategy. We address this with ImCorr: Sub-pixel Semantic Correspondence via Implicit Feature Decoding, which formulates correspondence estimation over a continuous feature field queryable at arbitrary continuous coordinates. A FiLM-conditioned decoder is trained to embed sub-pixel positional information into the feature field. Querying the field directly at exact keypoint coordinates theoretically eliminates representation-level quantization error on the source side, while decoding onto a grid denser than the backbone grid substantially reduces quantization error on the target side. On SPair-71k and AP-10K (intra-species, cross-species, and cross-family), ImCorr improves performance at fine-grained thresholds (PCK@0.01-0.05), achieving a 6.2 percentage point gain over the prior state of the art at PCK@0.01 on SPair-71k. These results demonstrate that representational continuity is an effective solution for precise semantic correspondence. Code is available at https://github.com/YusungChoi/ImCorr.

AI.tldr: 本文指出语义对应在细粒度阈值下的性能瓶颈源于网格化读出带来的量化误差，提出ImCorr，通过隐式特征解码构建连续特征场，在任意连续坐标查询，显著提升细粒度PCK。
AI.motivation: 现代语义对应方法在标准阈值下表现优异，但在细粒度阈值下性能急剧停滞。作者认为这一瓶颈并非来自骨干特征的表征能力不足，而是源于网格绑定的读出方式。基于patch的ViT将图像token化到离散网格，引入两类量化误差：源端查询最近patch特征而非精确关键点；目标端缺乏代表精确真值位置的网格特征。在SPair-71k全部499,188个关键点上量化该上限：在448x448、patch-14标准设置下，PCK@0.01时有84.9%的真值关键点没有网格特征代表其精确位置。这是表征层面的结构性限制，与匹配策略无关。
AI.method: 提出ImCorr（Implicit Feature Decoding），将对应估计建立在可在任意连续坐标查询的连续特征场上。使用FiLM条件化解码器，将亚像素位置信息嵌入特征场。在精确关键点坐标处直接查询特征场，理论上消除源端的表征级量化误差；将特征解码到比骨干网格更密的网格上，大幅降低目标端的量化误差。
AI.result: 在SPair-71k与AP-10K（同物种、跨物种、跨科）上，ImCorr在细粒度阈值（PCK@0.01-0.05）取得提升，在SPair-71k的PCK@0.01上较此前最优方法提升6.2个百分点。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明表征的连续性（representational continuity）是解决精确语义对应的有效途径。

title: FounRef: Robust, Structure-Preserving, and Fast Metric Refinement of Frozen Monocular Foundation Priors with Sparse Anchors
summary: Dense metric depth from cameras is essential to real-world 3D applications, yet achieving accuracy, faithful surface geometry, and fast inference simultaneously remains challenging. Monocular foundation models provide rich, transferable geometric priors but lack reliable metric scale, while depth-completion networks recover metric depth at the cost of geometric fidelity, cross-domain robustness, or speed. We present FounRef, a training-free method that aligns a frozen monocular foundation prior with sparse metric anchors to produce dense metric depth. FounRef is modular by design: its depth prior, anchor source, and refinement solver can each be replaced independently. We instantiate FounRef with MoGe-2 and LiDAR anchors. FounRef validates each anchor against the prior's dense depth prediction, rejecting inconsistencies caused by cross-sensor misalignment that geometry-only filters cannot detect. It then applies global and local metric corrections through a structure-preserving solver, retaining the prior's fine-grained geometry. FounRef requires no task-specific training and operates out of the box across unfamiliar cameras and scenes. On out-of-domain data, it delivers up to 24% lower depth error, 92% lower surface-normal noise, and almost 15x faster inference than DMD3C, a state-of-the-art depth-completion network. By decoupling metric alignment from geometry prediction, FounRef provides an accurate, geometrically faithful, and efficient approach to dense metric depth that can directly benefit from future advances in foundation models and metric sensors.

AI.tldr: FounRef：免训练框架，将冻结的单目基础模型先验与稀疏度量锚点对齐，实现高精度、几何保真且高效的稠密度量深度估计。
AI.motivation: 稠密度量深度对实际三维应用至关重要，但现有方法难以同时兼顾精度、表面几何保真与快速推理：单目基础模型具备丰富可迁移的几何先验却缺乏可靠度量尺度；深度补全网络虽能恢复度量深度，却在几何保真度、跨域鲁棒性或速度上有所牺牲。
AI.method: 提出免训练方法 FounRef，将冻结的单目基础先验与稀疏度量锚点对齐以生成稠密度量深度。其设计模块化，深度先验、锚点来源与精化求解器均可独立替换。以 MoGe-2 与 LiDAR 锚点为例：先用先验稠密深度预测对每个锚点做一致性校验，剔除几何滤波器无法检测的跨传感器错位；再通过保结构求解器施加全局与局部度量校正，保留先验的细粒度几何。
AI.result: 无需任务特定训练，可在陌生相机与场景中开箱即用。在域外数据上，相较 SOTA 深度补全网络 DMD3C，深度误差降低最多 24%，表面法线噪声降低 92%，推理速度提升近 15 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将度量对齐与几何预测解耦，FounRef 提供了一种准确、几何保真且高效的稠密度量深度方案，并可直接受益于未来基础模型与度量传感器的进步。

title: ComplexSync: High-Fidelity and Real-Time Lip Sync in Complex Scenarios
summary: Lip synchronization aims to generate visual lip dynamics that align precisely with speech audio. Despite the high generation quality of diffusion models, they often struggle in complex scenarios and suffer from prohibitive inference latency, limiting real-world deployment. We present ComplexSync, a unified diffusion-based framework that enables real-time, high-fidelity lip sync under complex conditions. First, we introduce a dual-stream joint training strategy to mitigate information leakage from reference frames while preserving natural dynamics. Second, we develop a distillation-based acceleration scheme for single-step denoising, achieving a throughput of over 70 FPS. Third, we propose a relational alignment loss that leverages structural priors from Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to enhance robustness against complex scene factors. Furthermore, we present the first benchmark specifically designed for complex lip synchronization, comprising over 200 challenging video sequences and specialized metrics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ComplexSync achieves state-of-the-art performance across both standard and complex scenarios while enabling real-time inference.

AI.tldr: ComplexSync：基于扩散模型的统一唇形同步框架，通过双流联合训练、单步蒸馏加速与关系对齐损失，在复杂场景下实现实时高保真唇形同步。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在唇形同步中生成质量高，但在复杂场景下表现不佳且推理延迟过高，难以满足实际部署需求；同时缺乏针对复杂唇形同步的专门评测基准。
AI.method: 提出ComplexSync统一扩散框架，包含三项核心技术：(1) 双流联合训练策略，缓解参考帧信息泄漏并保持自然动态；(2) 基于蒸馏的单步去噪加速方案，吞吐量超过70 FPS；(3) 关系对齐损失，利用视觉基础模型(VFM)的结构先验增强对复杂场景因素的鲁棒性。此外构建了首个复杂唇形同步基准，含200余个挑战性视频序列及专用指标。
AI.result: 在标准与复杂场景下均取得SOTA性能，同时实现实时推理（>70 FPS）。
AI.conclusion: ComplexSync有效兼顾了复杂场景鲁棒性、生成质量与实时性，并提供了首个复杂唇形同步评测基准，推动了该任务的实用化部署。

title: EAGER: Enhancing Generative Event Extraction via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: End-to-end event extraction remains challenging for large language models as it requires simultaneous identification of event triggers, classification of event types, and extraction of schema-grounded argument spans. We present EAGER, a reinforcement learning framework for generative event extraction that combines fine-grained verifiable rewards with Schema-Contrastive Advantage Estimation to alleviate advantage collapse under sparse binary rewards. Our reward design explicitly targets structural validity, extraction accuracy, groundedness, coverage, over-generation, and span precision. Experiments across seven benchmark datasets show that EAGER consistently outperforms prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and prior reinforcement learning baselines, achieving a substantial improvement over the strongest prior method. Results demonstrate that task-aligned verifiable rewards and contrastive advantage estimation substantially improve structured extraction.

AI.tldr: EAGER：一个面向生成式事件抽取的强化学习框架，利用细粒度可验证奖励与模式对比优势估计缓解奖励稀疏导致的价值优势坍缩，在七个基准数据集上超越提示、监督微调和已有强化学习方法。
AI.motivation: 端到端事件抽取对大型语言模型仍具挑战性，需同时完成事件触发词识别、事件类型分类和基于schema的论元片段抽取。以往方法在稀疏二元奖励下易出现advantage collapse（优势坍缩），奖励信号不足以引导结构化输出。
AI.method: 提出EAGER强化学习框架，用于生成式事件抽取。核心包括：(1) 细粒度可验证奖励设计，显式针对结构有效性、抽取准确率、groundedness（基于原文的可溯源性）、覆盖率、过度生成和span精度；(2) Schema-Contrastive Advantage Estimation，通过schema对比缓解稀疏二元奖励下的优势坍缩。
AI.result: 在七个基准数据集上，EAGER一致优于提示方法、监督微调（SFT）以及之前的强化学习基线，相较最强先前方法取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 任务对齐的可验证奖励与对比优势估计能够显著改善结构化抽取性能，说明细粒度奖励设计与优势估计改进是提升生成式事件抽取的有效方向。

title: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
summary: We find that language models can transfer capabilities through task-unrelated text. Post-training typically improves language models using task-specific data. Prior work on subliminal learning shows that information about these updates can pass through unrelated generations, but has largely focused on traits or preferences using extensive teacher outputs. We introduce Active Taskless Distillation (ATD), which achieves capability transfer using only a single word from the teacher per prompt. ATD probes the behavioral shadow of post-training by selecting prompts where the teacher and student's shared public ancestor is nearly indifferent between two ordinary words. A student initialized from this ancestor learns solely from the resulting prompt-word pairs, without target-task examples, teacher logits, or teacher parameters. In the primary coding experiment with Qwen2.5-1.5B, 5,664nses yield a 5.34 pp gain on HumanEval+ over an exact nuisance-matched control thadisrupts prompt-resperiments showtransfer in scientific knowledge, commonsense reasoning, and reading comprehensins across additional model generations, sizes, and families. Functional analyses show that the learned sid composable, andthat its strength tracks the teacher's update strength.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Active Taskless Distillation (ATD)，通过仅使用教师模型对单个普通词的输出，即可实现与任务无关文本的能力迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统后训练依赖任务特定数据来提升语言模型能力，而现有的潜意识学习（subliminal learning）虽能通过无关生成传递信息，但主要依赖大量教师输出且集中于特质或偏好。作者希望探索能否用极少的、与任务无关的信号实现真正的能力迁移。
AI.method: ATD 通过探测后训练的行为阴影来挑选提示：选择教师与学生共享公共祖先模型对两个普通词几乎无差异的提示。随后学生模型从该祖先初始化，仅从生成的“提示-单词”对中学习，不使用目标任务示例、教师 logits 或教师参数。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 的主要编码实验中，5,664 个样本使 HumanEval+ 相比精确匹配的干扰控制组提升 5.34 个百分点。此外，科学知识、常识推理和阅读理解等任务中，跨模型代际、规模和家族均观察到迁移现象。功能分析表明所学信号可组合，且其强度与教师的更新强度相关。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型能够通过任务无关文本迁移能力，ATD 证明了仅用单字教师信号即可有效传递后训练获得的能力，且该效应具有可组合性和与教师更新强度相关的特性。

title: SARFusion: Scene-Aware Routing Fusion for Robust Camera-LiDAR 3D Object Detection
summary: Camera-LiDAR fusion has become a prevailing paradigm for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. However, existing fusion detectors often establish strong inter-modality dependencies by decoding object queries from tightly coupled multimodal representations. Under corrupted driving conditions, such dependencies make the detector vulnerable to unreliable modalities, where degraded observations may interfere with reliable modality-specific evidence and lead to suboptimal predictions. Moreover, modality reliability can vary across both global driving scenes and individual object queries, requiring adaptive fusion decisions at a finer granularity. To bridge this gap, we reformulate robust camera-LiDAR fusion as a scene-aware branch routing problem and propose SARFusion, a robust 3D object detector. Instead of producing detections from a single fused representation, SARFusion decouples object-query decoding into three parallel reasoning branches: a camera branch, a LiDAR branch, and a camera-LiDAR fusion branch. Guided by a Scene Reliability Prior estimated from the global driving context, SARFusion further incorporates object-level evidence to route each query to the most suitable branch. This query-wise routing strategy alleviates harmful cross-modal interference while preserving the benefits of multimodal fusion when complementary cues are trustworthy. On the nuScenes test set, SARFusion achieves strong performance with 72.5 mAP and 74.4 NDS. Extensive analyses demonstrate its robustness under challenging conditions, including sensor corruptions and environmental changes.

AI.tldr: 提出SARFusion：将鲁棒相机-激光雷达融合重新表述为场景感知分支路由问题，通过查询级路由到相机、激光雷达或融合分支，在nuScenes测试集取得72.5 mAP和74.4 NDS。
AI.motivation: 现有融合检测器从紧耦合的多模态表示解码目标查询，建立了强跨模态依赖，在驾驶条件受损时易受不可靠模态干扰，可靠模态的证据被破坏性观测污染，导致预测次优。且模态可靠性在全局场景和单个目标查询两个层面都存在变化，需要更细粒度的自适应融合决策。
AI.method: 将鲁棒相机-激光雷达融合重新表述为场景感知的分支路由问题。SARFusion将目标查询解码解耦为三条并行推理分支：相机分支、激光雷达分支、相机-激光雷达融合分支。由全局驾驶上下文估计的场景可靠性先验引导，并引入目标级证据，将每个查询路由到最合适的分支，实现查询级路由。
AI.result: 在nuScenes测试集上达到72.5 mAP和74.4 NDS。大量分析表明，在传感器损坏和环境变化等挑战性条件下具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 查询级路由策略减轻了有害的跨模态干扰，同时在互补线索可信时保留多模态融合的优势，为鲁棒3D目标检测提供了有效的场景感知分支路由方案。

title: TOLA: Text-aware One-Step Latent Adaptation for Diffusion-based Text Image Super-Resolution
summary: Text image super-resolution (TSR) aims to recover visually faithful and readable text under unknown degradations. Existing diffusion-based methods typically rely on multi-step prediction of either the high-resolution image or its text prior, resulting in prohibitive computational cost and inference latency. More critically, an erroneous text prior may be repeatedly injected into the denoising process, causing image and text predictions to reinforce each other and progressively amplify an early recognition error into a sharp yet semantically incorrect character. To address these limitations, we propose TOLA, a Text-aware One-step Latent Adaptation framework without iterative image-text diffusion. TOLA consists of two key modules. First, a confidence-weighted text conditioning module constructs the semantic condition only once and suppresses unreliable OCR predictions before they contaminate image reconstruction. Second, a lightweight latent residual correction module explicitly estimates and corrects the structured residual errors to recover missing or distorted stroke details. Extensive experiments demonstrate our state-of-the-art performance across all evaluation metrics on both CTR-TSR-Test ($\times 4$) and RealCE-200 benchmarks. It is worth noting that our TOLA consistently surpasses existing diffusion-based TSR methods by at least 2.72 dB in PSNR on CTR-TSR-Test.

AI.tldr: 提出TOLA——一种无需迭代图文扩散的文本感知单步潜空间自适应框架，用于文本图像超分辨率，性能达SOTA且大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的文本图像超分辨率方法依赖多步预测（高分辨率图像或其文本先验），导致计算成本高、推理延迟大；更严重的是，错误的文本先验会在去噪过程中被反复注入，使图像与文本预测相互强化，将早期识别错误逐步放大为笔画清晰但语义错误的字符。
AI.method: TOLA包含两个关键模块：（1）置信度加权文本条件模块，仅构建一次语义条件，在不可靠OCR预测污染图像重建之前对其进行抑制；（2）轻量级潜空间残差校正模块，显式估计并校正结构化残差误差，以恢复缺失或畸变的笔画细节。整体框架避免了迭代式图文扩散。
AI.result: 在CTR-TSR-Test（×4）和RealCE-200两个基准上，TOLA在所有评价指标上均取得最优性能；在CTR-TSR-Test上，PSNR持续超越现有扩散类TSR方法至少2.72 dB。
AI.conclusion: TOLA通过单步潜空间自适应与置信度加权的文本条件、潜空间残差校正，有效规避了扩散方法的高延迟与错误累积问题，在保证文本可读性与视觉保真度的同时实现了SOTA性能。

title: No More Free Lunch: Corpus Task Complexity Matters as Corpora Grow
summary: Given a large corpus, the questions one might ask can vary -- from "When was the first human heart transplant?" to "What are all the contradictory claims in this literature?" -- but what makes some questions more challenging than others? In this work, we define a notion of Corpus Task Complexity (CTC) that characterizes tasks by how their difficulty grows with corpus size; for instance, a retrieval query only requires a single linear pass over a corpus, while finding contradictions requires checking a quadratically growing set of claim pairs. Observing that prior work has largely only studied tasks whose difficulty grows linearly with corpus size, which we call low CTC tasks, we introduce 10 new tasks belonging to a class of high CTC whose difficulty grows quadratically or more in corpus size. We find that high-CTC tasks not only grow much more challenging on average at longer contexts for LCLMs, they reverse many modeling conclusions drawn solely from low-CTC evaluations. For instance, efficient block-sparse and hybrid attention approaches consistently match full attention performance on low-CTC tasks, but degrade much more on high-CTC tasks. Large-corpus high-CTC reasoning thus remains an open challenge as full attention is too costly to scale, motivating future research on these tasks. We release our code, data, and 22-task suite (CTC-Bench), to facilitate future research in this area.

AI.tldr: 提出Corpus Task Complexity (CTC)概念，按任务难度随语料规模的增长方式分类任务，发现高CTC任务在长上下文下更难且颠覆低CTC评估的结论，并发布22任务套件CTC-Bench。
AI.motivation: 以往研究大多只关注难度随语料规模线性增长的任务（低CTC），如检索查询只需对语料做一次线性扫描；然而现实中还存在难度随语料规模平方甚至更高增长的任务（如寻找矛盾需要检查呈平方增长的声明对）。这类高CTC任务此前缺乏系统研究，其与低CTC任务在模型评估上是否存在不同规律尚不清楚。
AI.method: 定义Corpus Task Complexity (CTC)，以任务难度随语料规模的增长速率刻画任务复杂度；将检索等难度线性增长的任务归为低CTC，并新引入10个难度呈平方或更高增长的高CTC任务。
AI.result: 高CTC任务在更长上下文下对LCLM的平均难度增长更显著；且会逆转仅基于低CTC评估得出的建模结论——例如高效的块稀疏与混合注意力方法在低CTC任务上能与全注意力持平，但在高CTC任务上性能下降更明显。
AI.conclusion: 大语料下的高CTC推理仍是开放挑战，因为全注意力难以经济地扩展到大规模语料，这促使未来针对该类任务开展研究；作者发布了代码、数据及22任务套件CTC-Bench以推动该方向研究。

title: Policy as Code: A Coroutine-Bridge Harness for Fast-Reasoning Reliability on CAR-bench
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Technical report for the winning entry in Track 2 (Cerebras Fast-Reasoning) of the CAR-bench Challenge at IJCAI-ECAI 2026
summary: CAR-bench evaluates whether tool-using agents stay reliable under real-world uncertainty, executing every tool inside the evaluator so that each tool-result exchange is a separate agent round-trip. A conventional next-action agent can batch parallel tool calls, but a chain of dependent calls costs it one model call per round of results. We present a coroutine-bridge harness in which the model's only action is to emit a Python program that blocks and resumes in place across evaluator tool exchanges. This decouples model invocation from tool round-trips: on the public test split the agent uses a median of two model calls against seven agent turns per task, resolving a full multi-turn task in a median of 1.8 s of model latency on Cerebras gpt-oss-120b. Because the action surface is executable code, deterministic CAR-bench policies are encoded directly as logic in the tool layer rather than as prompt rules, enforcing compliance at zero reasoning cost. On the official hidden evaluation the harness won Track 2 with 60.0% Pass^3, 4.5x the organizer baseline, at the lowest estimated cost and the fastest median task latency (3.14 s) of any entry scoring above that baseline; the same unchanged harness reproduced an identical 60.0% Pass^3 on GPT-5.5 in the Open track, matching frontier-model agents. A single static prompt, appended with per-task state at the tail, stays byte-identical across calls and across tasks: the frozen submission prompt served 78% of input tokens from cache (86.6% across its warm tail), against 73% over a three-week development corpus in which prompt edits repeatedly reset the cache. This compounds the few-call design into a small fraction of nominal input compute.

AI.tldr: CAR-bench 提出 coroutine-bridge 框架：模型只输出可阻塞/恢复的 Python 程序，将模型调用与工具往返解耦，中位数每任务仅 2 次模型调用，官方隐藏评测 Track 2 获 60.0% Pass^3，为基线 4.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有 next-action 智能体在依赖型工具调用链上每轮工具结果都需一次模型调用，导致模型调用次数多、延迟与成本高；同时策略合规通常依赖提示规则，需消耗推理开销。论文希望在真实不确定性下让工具型智能体保持可靠、低成本与低延迟。
AI.method: CAR-bench 在评估器内部执行每个工具，使每次工具结果交换成为独立的智能体往返。作者提出 coroutine-bridge 框架：模型的唯一动作是生成 Python 程序，该程序在评估器工具交换处就地阻塞与恢复，从而将模型调用与工具往返解耦。由于动作空间是可执行代码，确定性的 CAR-bench 策略被直接编码为工具层逻辑而非提示规则。此外使用单一静态提示，仅在尾部追加逐任务状态，保证跨调用、跨任务字节级一致。
AI.result: 公开测试集上，智能体每任务中位数 2 次模型调用对应 7 个智能体轮次，在 Cerebras gpt-oss-120b 上中位模型延迟 1.8 s。官方隐藏评测中该框架赢得 Track 2，Pass^3 为 60.0%，是组织者基线的 4.5 倍，在得分高于基线的所有参赛者中成本最低、中位任务延迟最快（3.14 s）；同一未改动框架在 Open track 的 GPT-5.5 上复现相同 60.0% Pass^3。冻结的提交提示 78% 输入 token 来自缓存（暖尾部分达 86.6%），对比三周开发语料上因提示编辑反复重置缓存而仅有 73%。
AI.conclusion: 通过可执行代码动作空间与协程式工具桥接，将模型调用次数压缩至少数几次，并把策略合规下沉到工具层以零推理成本强制执行；配合字节一致的静态提示最大化缓存命中，最终在准确率、成本与延迟上同时优于基线，并具备跨模型可复现性。

title: IronViT: Toward Efficient Generalist Visual Representation Learning
summary: A generalist vision encoder must capture semantic, spatial, language-aligned, and action-relevant cues within a unified representation, yet softmax attention underlying today's most capable visual backbones becomes prohibitively expensive at high resolution. A natural attempt to address both challenges is to distill multiple specialist teachers directly into an efficient architecture. We find that directly coupling these objectives degrades representation quality, as the student must simultaneously reconcile heterogeneous capabilities and adapt them to a different token-mixing architecture. We introduce IronViT, built on a simple principle: consolidate capabilities before constraining computation. IronViT first distills complementary specialists into a softmax attention capability bridge, then progressively transfers the consolidated representation to a hybrid softmax-linear attention encoder. A purpose-built data pipeline further curates the distillation corpus for higher information density and broader domain coverage. Across recognition, retrieval, dense prediction, multimodal understanding, and robotic learning, IronViT is competitive with leading specialist and generalist vision encoders. The softmax bridge achieves the strongest aggregate performance in multimodal understanding and robotic learning among the evaluated backbones, while the hybrid encoder retains broad transfer performance with an efficiency advantage that grows with input resolution. Together, these results show that consolidating capabilities before architectural conversion can yield a generalist visual encoder without inheriting the prohibitive high-resolution cost of conventional softmax attention.

AI.tldr: IronViT提出"先整合能力、再约束计算"的通用视觉编码器蒸馏框架：先将多个专家教师蒸馏到softmax注意力能力桥，再渐进迁移至混合softmax-线性注意力编码器，从而在保持多任务通用性的同时获得随分辨率增长的计算效率优势。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉编码器需在统一表示中同时捕获语义、空间、语言对齐与动作相关线索，而当前主流视觉骨干所依赖的softmax注意力在高分辨率下代价过高。直觉上可将多个专家教师直接蒸馏进高效架构以同时解决"通用性"与"效率"两个问题，但作者发现直接耦合这些目标会因学生需同时协调异构能力并适应不同的token混合机制而导致表示质量下降。
AI.method: 提出IronViT，核心原则为"先整合能力、再约束计算"。第一步将互补的专家教师蒸馏进一个基于softmax注意力的"能力桥"（capability bridge）；第二步将整合后的表示渐进式迁移到混合softmax-线性注意力编码器。同时设计专用数据管线，对蒸馏语料进行筛选，以提升信息密度并扩大领域覆盖。
AI.result: 在识别、检索、稠密预测、多模态理解与机器人学习等任务上，IronViT与领先的专家型及通用型视觉编码器具有竞争力。其中softmax能力桥在被评估骨干中于多模态理解与机器人学习上取得最强综合表现；混合编码器在保持广泛迁移性能的同时具备效率优势，且该优势随输入分辨率提升而增大。
AI.conclusion: 结果表 明，在架构转换之前先进行能力整合，能够在不继承传统softmax注意力高昂高分辨率成本的前提下，得到通用视觉编码器，为兼顾通用性与效率提供了一条可行路径。

title: Deep learning of longitudinal visual fields predicts glaucoma progression rate and identifies fast progressors
summary: Glaucoma is the leading cause of irreversible blindness, and timely identification of fast progressors is essential to prevent disability. Current practice estimates progression by ordinary least-squares regression of mean deviation (MD) on time, requiring 6--10 visual field (VF) tests over several years to obtain a reliable slope. We present GLAM (Glaucoma Longitudinal Analysis Model), a deep learning framework that ingests longitudinal Humphrey 24-2 total deviation sequences with five clinical features and predicts MD and visual field index progression rates using attention-based fusion and aleatoric uncertainty. On the open-access University of Washington Humphrey Visual Field dataset (4,276 patient-eyes), GLAM achieved an MD-rate mean absolute error of 0.139 dB yr$^{-1}$ ($R^2 = 0.927$; 73.5% reduction over a ridge baseline) and an AUC of 0.990 for fast-progressor detection. VF-only deep learning can match multimodal pipelines for progression prognostication using routinely collected perimetry alone.

AI.tldr: GLAM：基于纵向视野总偏差序列与注意力融合的深度学习框架，可预测青光眼MD与VFI进展速率，并输出偶然不确定性。
AI.motivation: 青光眼是导致不可逆失明的主要原因，及时识别快速进展者对于预防残疾至关重要。然而，当前临床实践通过将平均偏差（MD）对时间做普通最小二乘回归来估计进展速率，通常需要数年内完成6–10次视野（VF）检查才能获得可靠的斜率，存在滞后性与检测负担。
AI.method: 提出GLAM（Glaucoma Longitudinal Analysis Model）深度学习框架：输入纵向Humphrey 24-2总偏差（total deviation）序列，并融合5项临床特征，采用基于注意力的融合机制与偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）建模，同时预测MD进展速率与视野指数（VFI）进展速率。在公开的华盛顿大学Humphrey视野数据集（4,276只患眼）上评估。
AI.result: GLAM的MD进展速率平均绝对误差为0.139 dB yr⁻¹（R²=0.927，相比ridge回归基线降低73.5%）；快速进展者检测的AUC为0.990。
AI.conclusion: 仅使用常规采集的视野检查数据，纯VF深度学习即可在进展预后方面达到多模态流程的水平。

title: pylazaro: a Python package for anglicism extraction in Spanish
summary: Lexical borrowings are words from one language that are introduced into another language. Identifying lexical borrowings in text is a relevant task for data-centric fields in Linguistics such as lexicography or corpus linguistics, but none of the standard libraries for text processing offers such a functionality. In this paper we present pylazaro, an open-source Python package for the automatic extraction of unassimilated lexical borrowings (mostly anglicisms) from Spanish text. pylazaro offers a single interface to five sequence labeling models that were trained using different libraries, so that users can run and switch between them without having to deal with the idiosyncrasies of each library. We describe the design and usage of the package, contrast the performance of its models with that of general-purpose LLMs (which perform poorly at this task: F1 below 0.40, compared to 0.86 for the best model in pylazaro) and report on its adoption: pylazaro has been downloaded more than 58,000 times and is the library behind Observatorio Lazaro, a resource that monitors anglicism usage in the Spanish press. pylazaro can be installed via PyPI, is documented in readthedocs and can be tried through a live demo hosted on HuggingFace Spaces.

AI.tldr: 介绍开源Python包pylazaro，用于从西班牙语文本中自动抽取未同化的外来词（多为英语借词），统一封装五种序列标注模型，性能显著优于通用大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 词汇借词识别对词典编纂、语料库语言学等数据驱动领域具有重要意义，但现有标准文本处理库均不提供该功能，存在工具空白。
AI.method: 提出pylazaro，一个开放源代码的Python包，提供单一调用接口以统一驱动基于不同库训练的五种序列标注模型，用户无需处理各库的差异即可运行与切换模型。
AI.result: 与通用大语言模型对比，后者在该任务上表现较差（F1低于0.40），而pylazaro最佳模型F1达0.86；该包下载量已超过58,000次，并支撑了监测西班牙语媒体英语借词使用的Observatorio Lazaro资源。
AI.conclusion: pylazaro填补了借词自动抽取工具的空白，具备实用的设计与易用性，可通过PyPI安装、在readthedocs查阅文档，并在HuggingFace Spaces在线试用。

title: Reasoning Instructions Can Break Answer Decoding in Vision--Language Models
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) instructions can distort multiple-choice VLM evaluation when a scorer appends a reasoning cue but reads answer-label logits before the model generates any rationale. We call this CoT-prefix scoring. On ScienceQA, Qwen2.5-VL-7B drops from 80.76% to 45.48%, and across five option-content permutations 93.54% of CoT-prefix predictions select the first slot. Condition-matched linear probes recover 78.94% from the same hidden states, while free generation restores 75.24%, showing that the answer often survives the prefix and the immediate readout fails. Vocabulary and layer diagnostics explain the mismatch: probability mass moves toward continuation tokens, while answer information remains linearly accessible in late layers. The effect recurs with varying severity across datasets and models, though not universally. These results show that CoT-prefix scoring can confound model knowledge with an evaluation-interface mismatch and should be avoided unless the requested and scored output events are aligned.

AI.tldr: CoT指令若以“前缀评分”方式读取答案logits（未生成推理内容即读标签），会严重扭曲VLM多选题评测。
AI.motivation: 揭示一种评测接口层面的隐性偏差：CoT提示词作为“前缀”加入后，评分器在模型生成理由前读取答案标签logits，可能把模型知识误判为能力下降。
AI.method: 以ScienceQA为主，使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B，对比CoT-prefix scoring与自由生成；做五个选项内容置换测试；用条件匹配的线性探针从同一隐状态恢复答案；并进行词表与层级诊断。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-VL-7B在ScienceQA上从80.76%降至45.48%；五个选项置换中93.54%的CoT-prefix预测选第一槽；线性探针恢复78.94%，自由生成恢复75.24%；概率质量转向续写token，答案信息仍在线性可及。
AI.conclusion: CoT-prefix scoring会混淆模型知识与评测接口错配，效果在不同数据集与模型上严重程度不一但非普遍；除非请求与评分的事件对齐，否则应避免该评分方式。

title: PHOSA: Photorealistic 3D Sign Avatar Modeling and Benchmark
summary: In this work, we focus on photorealistic sign avatar modeling, which is crucial for effective communication with the Deaf community and is characterized by complex hand gestures and nuanced facial expressions. To this end, we introduce MVSign, the first multi-view Chinese sign language dataset co-designed with Deaf experts, featuring diverse gestures and rich annotations. For precise SMPL-X annotation, we develop a hybrid fitting pipeline that produces accurate body, hand, and facial parameters and can also be applied to the monocular setting. Building on MVSign, we propose a decoupled sign avatar representation that isolates body, head, and hand components to capture complex articulations, together with a motion-aware sampling strategy to handle motion blur and balance gesture diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity visual results on MVSign, particularly in detailed hand and facial regions, and generalizes well to in-the-wild monocular sign language videos. Project page: https://naaapi.github.io/PHOSA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MVSign——首个与聋人专家共同设计的多视角中文手语数据集，并基于此设计解耦式手语虚拟人表示与运动感知采样策略，实现高保真手语虚拟人建模。
AI.motivation: 手语虚拟人建模对与聋人社区的有效沟通至关重要，其难点在于复杂的手势与细腻的面部表情。然而现有工作缺乏多视角、高质量的手语数据，以及能精确刻画身体、手、面部复杂关节的表达方式。
AI.method: 1) 构建MVSign多视角中文手语数据集，含多样手势与丰富标注，由聋人专家协同设计；2) 提出混合拟合管线，生成精确的SMPL-X身体、手部与面部参数，并可扩展至单目设定；3) 设计解耦式手语虚拟人表示，将身体、头部、手部分离建模以捕捉复杂关节；4) 提出运动感知采样策略，应对运动模糊并平衡手势多样性。
AI.result: 在MVSign上取得高保真视觉效果，尤其在手部与面部细节区域表现突出，并能良好泛化到野外单目手语视频。
AI.conclusion: 多视角数据与解耦表示、运动感知采样的结合可有效提升手语虚拟人建模的保真度与泛化能力，为聋人社区沟通提供支持；数据集与拟合管线亦可服务于单目场景。

title: EgoSpeedUp: Transferring Human Manipulation Tempo to Robot Policies
summary: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning inherit not only the demonstrated behavior but also the conservative execution tempo of robot demonstrations. Existing acceleration approaches can execute faster than the original demonstrations, but determine the appropriate acceleration primarily from robot-side information or a predefined set of tempo factors, leaving open how to obtain a task-appropriate reference for how fast each manipulation phase should progress. We introduce EgoSpeedUp, a framework that uses human manipulation as temporal supervision for robot imitation learning. Our key insight is that human demonstrations naturally reveal task-appropriate, phase-wise manipulation tempo. Given slow robot demonstrations and human demonstrations of the same task, EgoSpeedUp aligns corresponding manipulation phases, estimates their relative execution tempos from multiple human demonstrations, and transfers the resulting phase-wise tempo by retiming the robot demonstrations. The retimed demonstrations are then used for standard behavior cloning, allowing the robot to retain its executable manipulation behavior while learning to perform it at a human-informed tempo. Across two real-world manipulation tasks, EgoSpeedUp improves the task success rate by an average of 25 percentage points (pp) while reducing successful execution time by 36.5%. These results demonstrate that human manipulation tempo provides an effective temporal reference for learning faster and more reliable robot policies.

AI.tldr: EgoSpeedUp利用人类示范作为时间监督，通过相位对齐与速度重定时加速机器人模仿学习。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习训练的机器人策略会继承人类示范的保守执行节奏，现有加速方法主要依赖机器人侧信息或预定义的速度因子，无法确定每个操作阶段应有的合适参考速度。
AI.method: 给定同一任务的慢速机器人示范与人类示范，EgoSpeedUp对齐对应的操作阶段，从多个示范中估计各阶段的相对执行速度，并通过重定时将阶段化速度迁移到机器人示范，再用于标准行为克隆。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界操作任务上，任务成功率平均提升25个百分点，同时成功执行时间减少36.5%。
AI.conclusion: 人类操作速度可为机器人策略学习提供有效的时间参考，使策略更快且更可靠。

title: Grammatical "grandmother neurons" are rare in LLMs
summary: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) encode linguistic structures remains a fundamental challenge in interpretability research. While diagnostic classifiers (or "probes") are widely used for this task, they face significant methodological criticism: training auxiliary classifiers introduces capacity confounds and calibration issues, often making it difficult to distinguish the model's intrinsic representations from the probe's ability to learn the task. To address these limitations, we introduce a probe-free framework for localizing linguistic selectivity at the individual neuron level. Leveraging the controlled contrasts of linguistic minimal pairs, we propose a Neuron Separability Index (NSI), a metric that directly quantifies how reliably single neurons differentiate grammatical from ungrammatical constructions without parameter updates. Applying NSI across 68 linguistic paradigms and seven checkpoints reveals three main patterns: 1) raw separability reaches near-peak levels earlier for morphological and syntactic distinctions than for syntax-semantics interface and conceptual distinctions. 2) after permutation normalization, single-unit selectivity is sparse, weak, and narrowly tuned: only a small fraction of units are sensitive to an average paradigm, and strongly selective "grandmother neurons" are rare. 3) whole-vector linear separability, single-neuron selectivity, and behavioral competence are largely dissociated, and targeted ablations further separate activation selectivity from causal reliance.

AI.tldr: 提出免探针的神经元可分性指数(NSI)，在单神经元层面定位语言选择性，发现单神经元选择稀疏弱且与行为表现解耦。
AI.motivation: 诊断分类器(probe)存在容量混淆与校准问题，难以区分模型内在表征与探针自身的学习能力，因此需要无需训练参数的免探针方法来定位语言结构表征。
AI.method: 利用语言最小对立的受控对比，提出神经元可分性指数(NSI)，在无需参数更新条件下直接量化单个神经元区分合语法与不合语法结构的能力；在68个语言范式和7个检查点上应用NSI，并进行置换归一化与消融实验。
AI.result: 1) 形态与句法区分的原始可分性比句法-语义接口和概念区分更早接近峰值；2) 置换归一化后，单单元选择性稀疏、弱且窄调，仅少数单元对平均范式敏感，强选择性的"祖母神经元"罕见；3) 全向量线性可分性、单神经元选择性与行为表现基本解耦，定向消融进一步分离激活选择性与因果依赖。
AI.conclusion: 免探针NSI框架避免了探针方法的容量混淆，揭示LLM语言选择性在单神经元层面高度稀疏分散，且神经元级选择性与行为能力和因果作用相分离。

title: Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning: A Closest-Admissible Solution
summary: Existing continual-learning methods protect parameters, replayed examples, or Euclidean feature subspaces. When applied to hyperbolic multimodal models, they do not explicitly preserve the Lorentz geometry that jointly encodes within-modality similarity, cross-modal correspondence, and semantic hierarchy; sequential updates can therefore retain task scores while still distorting previously learned relations. We address this gap with Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning (HMCL). We show that preserving the old multimodal geometry amounts to restricting all modalities to one shared hyperbolic isometry, which induces a family of admissible first-order parameter changes. We formulate a joint closest-admissible (CA) correction that retains the shared rotation best matching the candidate modal updates; its minimal-rotation (MR) special case fixes this rotation to zero. Both variants correct the displacement realized by AdamW, and task anchoring bounds within-task accumulation while preserving learning freedom. Across a unified 16-task classification-retrieval stream with three hyperbolic backbones, HMCL improves final performance and backward transfer over sequential fine-tuning and four continual-learning baselines; HMCL-CA gives the highest Overall score on every backbone. A modality-extended stream confirms the retrieval gains. Representation analyses find 81.2 to 95.5 percent less radial, angular, cross-modal, and paired-distance drift; ImageNet-WordNet results show better semantic ancestry and radial hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双曲多模态持续学习（HMCL），通过将所有模态限制到共享双曲等距变换来保持旧有的多模态几何结构，并在16任务流上超越顺序微调与四个持续学习基线。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法保护参数、重放样本或欧氏特征子空间，但应用于双曲多模态模型时，未显式保持编码模态内相似性、跨模态对应与语义层级的Lorentz几何；顺序更新虽能维持任务分数，却扭曲已学关系。
AI.method: 证明保持旧多模态几何等价于将所有模态限制到一个共享双曲等距变换，由此导出可容许的一阶参数变化族；提出联合最接近可容许（CA）校正，保留与候选模态更新最匹配的共享旋转，其最小旋转（MR）特例将旋转固定为零；两种变体校正AdamW产生的位移，并用任务锚定限制任务内累积同时保留学习自由度。
AI.result: 在含三种双曲骨干网络的统一16任务分类-检索流上，HMCL在最终性能与后向迁移上优于顺序微调和四个持续学习基线，HMCL-CA在每个骨干上取得最高Overall分数；模态扩展流验证检索增益；表征分析显示径向、角度、跨模态与成对距离漂移减少81.2%至95.5%；ImageNet-WordNet结果体现更好的语义祖先与径向层级。
AI.conclusion: 显式保持共享双曲几何可有效缓解多模态持续学习中的关系扭曲，CA校正为最优方案，且几何保持与检索及层级语义质量提升一致。

title: Where LLM Graders Succeed and Break: Evidence from Two Computer-Science Exams
summary: One long-form exam in a large course costs hundreds of grader-hours, and qualified graders are scarce; LLM graders are a tempting alternative. To show its pitfalls we grade a practical Computer Vision exam ($570$ dual-graded students) under $171$ configurations spanning closed and open-weights models; the best reaches mean absolute error $1.64/35$, below the $2.61/35$ two human graders achieve against each other. The catch is the prompt: a short ''strict grader'' preamble drives $14$ of $17$ open-weights models out of the graded band ($\text{MAE} \ge 8$), three stopping grading altogether. The damage traces to the preamble's two credit-withholding sentences, not to tone or model scale; one of them, ''never give partial credit'', alone makes two of three probed models stop grading. The closed flagships of three vendors shift calibration under it but stay in the band. In $162$ further configurations on a second, independent Machine Learning exam from another course ($1{,}038$ dual-graded students), the preamble worsens ten models, moving three out of the band into collapse and one into refusal, yet improves seven whose neutral prompts over-mark: the vulnerability replicates, but its direction is exam-specific. Light LoRA fine-tuning repairs it: one adapter on the two exams' pooled $\sim 3{,}900$ graded examples brings five small open models to parity or better with a human grader in agreement with the grader pair, and sensitivity to the three harsh personas nearly vanishes ($\le 0.32$ MAE). We release the anonymised dataset, full ablation grid, and grading, fine-tuning and analysis pipelines.

AI.tldr: LLM阅卷在大规模课程中具吸引力：对570份双评计算机视觉考卷的171种配置测试中，最优配置MAE低至1.64/35，优于人类双评间2.61/35；但一句简短"严格阅卷"提示词会使17个开源权重模型中的14个整体崩溃（MAE≥8），3个完全停止评分，损害源自"never give partial credit"等拒给分句而非语气或模型规模。在另一门课程1038份双评机器学习考卷的162种配置中，脆弱性可复现但方向依赖考卷。轻量LoRA微调（约3900份样本）可将5个小模型修复至与人类评分者持平，并几乎消除对严厉人设的敏感性，同时作者开源数据集与全部流程。
AI.motivation: 大规模课程长篇考试的人工阅卷耗费数百小时且合格评卷人稀缺，LLM自动阅卷被视为诱人替代方案，但其可靠性隐患尚未被系统刻画：提示词（persona）等细微设计是否会导致评分崩溃缺乏实证。作者希望揭示LLM阅卷的脆弱机制并给出可修复方案。
AI.method: 在计算机视觉实践考试上进行171种配置的评分实验，覆盖闭源与开源权重模型，并在第二门独立机器学习考试（1038份双评学生）上扩展162种配置以检验可复现性；对照中性与"严格阅卷"提示词，逐一消解提示词中的施压句以定位损伤来源；再以LoRA在两次考试合并的约3900份评分样本上微调小型开源模型，评估其与人类双评的一致性及对严厉人设的敏感性。
AI.result: 最优配置在CV考试达MAE 1.64/35，优于人类双评间2.61/35；但"严格阅卷"前言使17个开源权重模型中的14个脱离可接受区间（MAE≥8），3个停止评分，损伤源于两句拒给分表述而非语气或模型规模，"never give partial credit"单独即令三分之二受测模型停评；三家厂商闭源旗舰模型仅校准偏移但仍在区间内。在ML考试上，前言使10个模型变差、3个崩溃、1个拒评，却改善7个中性提示下过度给分的模型。LoRA微调使5个小模型达到或超过单个人类评分者与双评一致性水平，且对三种严厉人设的敏感性几乎消失（MAE≤0.32）。
AI.conclusion: LLM阅卷的精度可超越人类双评一致性，但对提示词中拒给分语句高度脆弱，该脆弱性可跨考试复现且方向依赖考卷；轻量微调能有效修复。研究强调部署LLM自动阅卷需审慎设计提示词并进行校准，同时开源数据集、消融网格与全部流水线以支持后续研究。

title: A Study of the Limits of Collaborative DCT-Based Image Denoising via Interpretable Neural Networks
comment: Preprint submitted to Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision (JMIV). 17 pages, 11 figures. Supported by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 under grant PID2021-125711OB-I00, and by the Spanish Ministry of Universities under grant FPU24/02805
summary: Image denoising remains a fundamental problem in image restoration, with applications in photography, biomedical, and scientific imaging. Modern deep neural networks achieve strong performance by learning powerful image priors, but often rely on large black-box models with limited interpretability. In contrast, DCT-based sliding-window and collaborative filtering methods such as BM3D offer clear algorithmic structure, but depend on handcrafted and non-differentiable operations. This work studies how far such structured collaborative filtering principles can be pushed when reformulated as trainable models. We introduce DeepBM3D, a compact fully differentiable architecture that combines non-local patch grouping, DCT-domain filtering, and multi-stage refinement within a BM3D-inspired pipeline. Lightweight convolutional feature extractors guide patch grouping, while filtering is performed through learned Wiener weights in the DCT domain. Experiments show that DeepBM3D improves over classical and hybrid baselines, remains competitive with FFDNet at low and moderate noise levels, and performs particularly well on repetitive textures.

AI.tldr: 本文将 BM3D 的结构化协同滤波思想重构为可训练模型，提出紧凑全可微架构 DeepBM3D，在低中噪声水平下与 FFDNet 具竞争力，尤其擅长重复纹理。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪是图像恢复的基础问题。深度神经网络性能强但依赖大型黑盒模型、可解释性有限；而基于 DCT 的滑窗与协同滤波方法（如 BM3D）算法结构清晰，却依赖手工设计且不可微的操作。作者希望探究：将这类结构化协同滤波原理改写为可训练模型后，其潜力能被推进到何种程度。
AI.method: 提出 DeepBM3D，一种紧凑的全可微架构，在 BM3D 式流程中融合非局部块分组、DCT 域滤波与多阶段精化。使用轻量卷积特征提取器引导块分组，滤波则通过 DCT 域中的可学习维纳权重完成。
AI.result: 实验表明 DeepBM3D 优于经典与混合基线方法，在低噪声与中等噪声水平下与 FFDNet 保持竞争力，并在重复纹理上表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 将 BM3D 的结构化协同滤波原理重构为可训练、全可微的紧凑模型是可行且有效的，可在保持算法结构可解释性的同时取得有竞争力的去噪性能。

title: SEE Challenge 2026: Event-Guided Brightness Adjustment Across a Broad Illumination Range
comment: This report has been accepted for publication at an ECCV 2026 Workshop
summary: Event cameras provide a high dynamic range and preserve brightness-change cues in lighting conditions where conventional RGB frames may be noisy or saturated. To benchmark event-guided restoration across a broad illumination range, we organized the SEE Challenge 2026 with the Event-Based Multimodal Vision Workshop at ECCV 2026. The task conditions restoration on one or more RGB frames, synchronized events, and a scalar target-brightness statistic provided by the organizers. It uses SEE-600K, which contains 610,126 image-event observations from 202 real-world scenes spanning low-light, normal-light, and high-light conditions with illumination variations of up to 1,000$\times$. The challenge follows an open-system protocol: participants may use different temporal contexts, architectures, pretrained weights, test-time augmentation, and post-processing strategies. PSNR determines the ranking, and SSIM is reported as a secondary metric. Around 70 teams registered interest and 15 valid CodaBench submissions were received. Six distinct teams completed organizer-side identity and technical verification, provided method descriptions, checkpoints, inference code, and instructions, and are included in the verified open-system ranking reported here. Beyond the ranking, this report analyzes exposure subsets, semantically distinct test cases, a shared failure pattern, system design choices, and inference strategies. The top systems obtain closely spaced average scores, while the best-performing method varies across cases and metrics; under severe underexposure, all verified systems retain visible local errors.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了ECCV 2026 SEE Challenge 2026（事件相机引导多模态图像复原）的赛题设置、SEE-600K数据集、开放系统评测协议、验证排名及系统设计分析。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备高动态范围并能保留亮度变化线索，在RGB帧易噪声或饱和的极端光照下具有优势；但缺乏跨大范围光照条件的事件引导复原基准，因此组织该挑战赛以进行系统化评测。
AI.method: 任务以一幅或多幅RGB帧、同步事件流及组织方提供的标量目标亮度统计量为条件进行复原。采用SEE-600K数据集，包含来自202个真实场景的610,126个图像-事件观测，覆盖低光、正常光与高光条件，光照变化达1000倍。采用开放系统协议，允许使用不同时间上下文、架构、预训练权重、测试时增强与后处理；以PSNR排序，SSIM作为次要指标。
AI.result: 约70支队伍注册，收到15份有效CodaBench提交，6支不同队伍通过组织方身份与技术验证并提交方法描述、检查点、推理代码与说明，进入验证排名。报告进一步分析曝光子集、语义不同测试样例、共性失败模式、系统设计选择与推理策略。顶级系统平均分接近，最佳方法因样例与指标而异；在严重欠曝条件下，所有验证系统均保留可见局部误差。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛建立了跨光照范围的事件引导复原基准与开放系统评测流程，显示当前最优方法性能接近且在极端欠曝下仍存在局限，为后续研究提供了排名、失败模式与设计策略参考。

title: ArGuard Shared Task: Harmful Content Detection in Arabic Memes and LLM Prompts
summary: ArGuard is a shared task on harmful content detection in Arabic memes and LLM prompts. It includes two tracks: Track A focuses on multimodal hate detection in Arabic memes, while Track B addresses harmful prompt detection for Arabic LLM safety evaluation. In total, 58 teams registered, 35 participated in the final evaluation, and 27 submitted system-description papers. Participating teams explored models such as AraBERT, Jais, and Qwen3-VL. The best systems achieved macro-F1 scores of 0.823 on A1, 0.419 on A2, 0.984 on B1, and 0.790 on B2. Fine-grained meme classification in A2 was the most challenging setting, partly due to sparse labels and train-test distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: ArGuard是阿拉伯语模因与LLM提示中有害内容检测的共享任务，含两个赛道：Track A（模因多模态仇恨检测，子任务A1/A2）与Track B（阿拉伯语LLM安全评估的有害提示检测，子任务B1/B2）。共有58支队伍注册、35支参加最终评测、27支提交系统描述论文，最佳系统macro-F1分别为A1 0.823、A2 0.419、B1 0.984、B2 0.790。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语内容中的有害信息检测（尤其是模因多模态仇恨内容与面向LLM的有害提示）缺乏系统性评测基准；该共享任务旨在推动该方向的研究并建立统一评测平台。
AI.method: 设置两个赛道：Track A针对阿拉伯语模因的多模态仇恨检测（细分为A1、A2等设置），Track B针对阿拉伯语LLM安全评估的有害提示检测（细分B1、B2）。采用共享任务评测形式，参赛队伍基于AraBERT、Jais、Qwen3-VL等模型构建并提交系统。
AI.result: 58支队伍注册，35支参与最终评测，27支提交系统描述论文。最佳系统macro-F1：A1为0.823，A2为0.419，B1为0.984，B2为0.790。A2的细粒度模因分类最具挑战性，部分原因在于标签稀疏与训练-测试分布偏移。
AI.conclusion: ArGuard为阿拉伯语有害内容检测提供了包含多模态模因与LLM提示的共享任务评测基准，揭示了不同子任务难度差异显著，细粒度模因分类受标签稀疏和分布偏移影响仍是主要难点。

title: UNMATCH: Selective Unbalanced Token-Patch Matching for Forensic Image-Claim Verification
summary: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图文语境误用检测，提出"方向性多尺度覆盖"表示与UNMATCH分类器，在Fauxtography的Snopes子集上取得69.82 Macro-F1，超过MCOT适配版2.60分。
AI.motivation: 图文误用对（图片+误导性主张）检测中，现有方法将双模态压缩为全局兼容性分数或使用过于灵活的交互相应模块，容易掩盖决定性的局部不匹配。
AI.method: 提出方向性多尺度覆盖表示：在三个空间尺度上、双向汇总图像—主张的局部亲和度。每个尺度每个方向用均值、下四分位数及两个阈值化支撑比汇总，方向均值间的带符号差构成九维尺度描述符，三个尺度拼接得到紧凑局部表示，供轻量级全局—局部分类器使用。
AI.result: 在防泄漏的三折三随机种子评估下，于Fauxtography基准的Snopes子集上，UNMATCH达到69.82 Macro-F1与71.05平衡准确率，分别超过MCOT适配版2.60与2.16个百分点。匹配—重分配干预实验显示，破坏原有配对会降低覆盖度并同时提高差异度与假配对概率。
AI.conclusion: 方向性多尺度覆盖能有效刻画局部不匹配且保持表示紧凑，UNMATCH在图文误用检测上优于MCOT适配基线，干预实验验证了配对结构对覆盖度的因果性作用。

title: Learning a Flow to Self-Supervised Representations
summary: Explicit geometric references offer a direct way to structure self-supervised representations. Existing adversarial distribution-matching formulations, however, require costly encoder-critic optimization. We introduce Flow-Based Distribution Matching (FBDM), a non-adversarial framework that learns this reference-directed geometry through spherical conditional velocity regression. An ETF-inspired reference allows its number of components K' to exceed the auxiliary flow dimension d* while retaining structured geometric separation. We assign both augmented views of each image to the same target, while limiting how many images each reference center can receive. An explicit alignment loss further pulls the two views' representations closer together. Experiments across benchmarks ranging from CIFAR to ImageNet show that FBDM achieves performance nearly on par with DM and remains competitive with existing SSL methods. Matched training-cost comparisons show a 1.48- to 1.83-fold speedup over DM with a negligible increase in GPU memory usage. We also provide a theoretical explanation for the usefulness of the learned representations: under stated conditions, we bound the downstream misclassification rate in terms of the FBDM pretraining loss.

AI.tldr: 提出FBDM，一个非对抗的分布匹配自监督学习框架，通过球面条件速度回归学习显式几何参考结构，在多个基准上性能接近DM且训练速度提升1.48–1.83倍。
AI.motivation: 现有显式几何参考方法（如对抗式分布匹配DM）需要昂贵的编码器-判别器对抗优化，计算成本高。作者希望以非对抗方式实现参考导向的几何结构学习。
AI.method: FBDM采用非对抗框架，通过球面条件速度回归学习参考导向几何。引入受ETF启发的参考（reference），使分量数K'可超过辅助流维度d*，同时保持结构化几何分离；将同一图像的两个增强视图分配到同一目标，并限制每个参考中心可接收的图像数量；额外加入显式对齐损失拉近两视图表示。
AI.result: 在CIFAR到ImageNet等基准上，FBDM性能几乎与DM持平，并与现有SSL方法具有竞争力；在匹配训练成本比较下，相比DM获得1.48–1.83倍加速，GPU显存增加可忽略。
AI.conclusion: FBDM提供了一种高效的非对抗分布匹配方案，并给出理论解释：在给定条件下，将下游误分类率用FBDM预训练损失进行上界约束。

title: Domain Recentering and Confidence-Weighted Prior Calibration for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP achieve strong zero-shot classification, yet under distribution shift, visual embeddings drift from fixed text embeddings. Training-free calibration avoids the per-sample optimization of prompt learning, but prior feature calibration gives each image the full bias of one hard cluster. We propose Domain Recentering with Confidence Calibration (DRC), a training-free method adapting CLIP from a set of unlabeled target images. DRC fits a Gaussian mixture once and subtracts from each embedding a posterior-weighted average of component means. It then removes residual class preference with a log-prior correction, estimating the prior from confidence-weighted predictions. Among compared methods, DRC achieves the highest average accuracy on cross-domain datasets, exceeding zero-shot CLIP by 4.13 and 5.07 points with ViT-B/16 and ResNet-50, with gains over CLIP also holding under ImageNet distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的DRC方法，通过对齐目标域视觉嵌入与文本嵌入、并进行置信度校准，在跨域分类中显著超越零样本CLIP。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉语言模型虽具强零样本分类能力，但在分布偏移下视觉嵌入会偏离固定的文本嵌入。提示学习需逐样本优化，而此前的特征校准方法对每张图像施加单一硬聚类的全部偏置，过于粗糙。
AI.method: DRC为免训练方法：仅用一组无标注目标图像，一次拟合高斯混合模型，从每个嵌入中减去按后验加权的各分量均值，实现域重心校正；随后用对数先验修正去除残余类别偏好，先验由置信度加权预测估计得到。
AI.result: 在多个对比方法中，DRC在跨域数据集上取得最高平均准确率，ViT-B/16与ResNet-50分别超过零样本CLIP 4.13和5.07个百分点；在ImageNet分布偏移下同样保持相对CLIP的增益。
AI.conclusion: DRC以无需训练、无需逐样本优化的方式有效缓解分布偏移下的视觉-文本嵌入错位，验证了软加权重心校正加置信度先验修正的有效性。

title: Parts-of-Speech as Emergent Categories in SAE Latent Space
summary: Sparse AutoEncoders (SAEs) offer a promising way to inspect language model representations, but it is still unclear what kind of linguistic structure their latents expose. We use part-of-speech (PoS) categories as a controlled test case to study whether morpho-syntactic information is encoded by individual latents or by structured groups of features. We find that PoS distinctions are highly recoverable from SAE activations, but do not align with one-to-one latent / category mappings. This recoverability is not reducible to lexical memorisation, and Open and Closed PoS classes differ substantially. Categories are supported by compact groups of sparse latents, with substantial variation across tags. These groups remain stable on held-out data, while also showing overlap between related categories. Our results show that SAEs localise morpho-syntactic information in a distributed and category-dependent form rather than through atomic grammatical features.

AI.tldr: 本文以词性（PoS）作为受控测试用例，探究稀疏自编码器（SAE）潜在变量所暴露的语言结构：词性区分可从SAE激活中高度还原，但不与单一潜在变量形成一对一映射，而是由紧凑的稀疏潜在变量组分布式支持，且不同词类差异显著。
AI.motivation: SAE被认为是检查语言模型表征的有效工具，但其潜在变量究竟暴露何种语言结构尚不清楚。作者希望明确形态句法信息是由单个潜在变量编码，还是由结构化的特征组编码，因此选取词性范畴作为受控测试对象。
AI.method: 以词性（PoS）范畴为受控测试用例，分析SAE激活与词性标签之间的对应关系；检验词性区分的可还原性，并排除词汇记忆（lexical memorisation）这一混淆因素；区分开放与封闭词类，考察支持各范畴的潜在变量组规模与稳定性，并在留出数据上验证其稳定性及跨相关范畴的重叠情况。
AI.result: 词性区分可从SAE激活中高度还原，但不与潜在变量/范畴形成一对一映射；该可还原性不能归约为词汇记忆；开放与封闭词类差异显著；各范畴由紧凑的稀疏潜在变量组支持，且不同标签间存在较大差异；这些组在留出数据上保持稳定，同时在相关范畴间表现出重叠。
AI.conclusion: SAE以分布式且依赖范畴的形式定位形态句法信息，而非通过原子式语法特征进行编码。

title: From Policy Documents to Structured Survey Responses: Evaluating Large Language Models for Policy Monitoring
comment: Accepted as a full paper to FLINS-ISKE 2026
summary: Science, technology, and innovation policies are crucial for competitiveness, yet their diversity and scale make them difficult to map and monitor consistently. Existing approaches rely heavily on manual survey efforts, which are costly and challenging to scale across countries. Large language models (LLMs) enable new possibilities for extracting and structuring information from long and unstructured policy documents. This paper presents an application of LLMs as "AI respondents" for generating structured survey responses from policy texts. We develop a data extraction pipeline based on long-context in-context learning to map information from public web sources into predefined survey categories, including policy instruments, target groups, and thematic areas. The pipeline integrates a validation step using a secondary LLM to assess relevance and evidence, alongside comparisons with human-provided responses. Using a multi-country dataset, we evaluate the alignment between LLM-generated and human-generated outputs through overlap measures and cross-validation. Results show that LLMs achieve high agreement for structured indicators (84-95%), while differences remain in free-text fields, where models tend to provide more detailed procedural descriptions. These findings highlight the potential of hybrid human-AI workflows for policy monitoring, improving both efficiency and scalability while maintaining the need for human validation and contextual interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以LLM作为"AI受访者"，通过长上下文情境学习流程将公开政策文本映射为结构化调查条目，在多国数据集上验证其与人工回答的一致性。
AI.motivation: 科技创新政策对竞争力至关重要，但其多样性与规模使一致性的测绘与监测十分困难；现有方法依赖人工调查，成本高且难以跨国扩展。LLM为从长文本、非结构化政策文件中提取和结构化信息提供了新可能。
AI.method: 构建基于长上下文情境学习的数据抽取流程，将公共网络来源信息映射到预定义调查类别（政策工具、目标群体、主题领域）；引入由第二个LLM执行的验证步骤以评估相关性与证据支撑，并与人工提供的回答进行比较；使用多国数据集，通过重叠度量和交叉验证评估LLM生成结果与人工结果的一致性。
AI.result: LLM在结构化指标上达到较高一致性（84–95%）；在自由文本字段上仍存在差异，模型倾向于提供更详细的程序性描述。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明人机混合工作流在政策监测中具有潜力，可在保持人工校验与情境解读必要性的同时提升效率与可扩展性。

title: BanglaTurn: A Benchmark and Whisper-Based Model for End-of-Turn Detection in Bangla Speech
summary: This paper presents BanglaTurn, a corpus for end-of-turn detection in Bangla conversational speech, and a model trained on it. The corpus holds 35,374 samples of 3 to 15 s of podcast speech, labelled for turn state by combining speaker diarization with an LLM pass, with every label then checked by a human annotator. The model pairs a Whisper encoder with task-specific classification heads. On a class-balanced test set drawn from a held-out podcast, it reaches 84.33% accuracy (95% CI 80.3 to 88.1) against 69.28% for the Smart-Turn v3 baseline, and lowers the false negative rate from 51.57% to 7.55% at the cost of a higher false positive rate. We report what encoder layer fine-tuning, multi-scale pooling and INT8 quantization each contribute, and latency stays within 165 to 191 ms end to end on CPU.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出孟加拉语对话语音的轮次结束检测语料库BanglaTurn及相应模型，模型以Whisper编码器配合任务专用分类头，在类别平衡测试集上达到84.33%准确率，显著优于基线并大幅降低假阴性率，端到端CPU延迟为165-191毫秒。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语对话语音缺乏用于轮次结束检测的语料和模型，现有基线（Smart-Turn v3）在该任务上表现不佳，尤其假阴性率高。
AI.method: 构建BanglaTurn语料库，包含35,374个3-15秒播客语音样本；通过说话人日志（diarization）结合大语言模型（LLM）生成轮次状态标签，并由人工标注者逐一核查。模型将Whisper编码器与任务专用分类头结合，并考察编码器层微调、多尺度池化和INT8量化的作用。
AI.result: 在来自留出播客的类别平衡测试集上，模型准确率达84.33%（95%置信区间80.3-88.1），基线Smart-Turn v3为69.28%；假阴性率由51.57%降至7.55%，但假阳性率上升。端到端CPU延迟保持在165-191毫秒。
AI.conclusion: BanglaTurn语料库和基于Whisper编码器的模型有效提升了孟加拉语轮次结束检测性能，在保持低延迟的同时大幅降低假阴性率，并明确量化了各设计组件的贡献。

title: Shadow Reduction in Ultrasound Imaging Using Differentiable Simulation and Radiance Field Decomposition
comment: 39 pages, 19 figures, submitted to Medical Image Analysis
summary: Acoustic shadows from bone and other highly attenuating tissues obscure clinically important structures in ultrasound. In fetal brain imaging, skull-induced artefacts disproportionately degrade the hemisphere closer to the transducer (proximal), limiting symmetric assessment of the two hemispheres. Existing correction methods require raw scanner data, impose restrictive assumptions on tissue properties, or rely on generative models that may hallucinate anatomy. We present RFlash, a physics-informed post-processing method that decomposes beamformed ultrasound images into explicit attenuation and scatter-intensity maps using a differentiable radiance-field formulation of image formation. Attenuation-adaptive re-rendering then removes the dependence of the signal at each depth on the intervening tissue, equivalent to virtually advancing the transducer into the tissue. Across 1,261 3D fetal brain volumes, 143 real 2D curvilinear abdominal scans, and 1,200 simulated 2D linear-probe liver scans, RFlash reduces shadow-related intensity differences more effectively than classical Hughes-Duck attenuation correction. For a gestational-age model trained on the distal hemisphere (further from the transducer) and applied to the proximal hemisphere, prediction error decreases by 5.1 days (40%) relative to the original images. The estimated attenuation maps also yield shadow-confidence maps that improve random-forest bone-shadow segmentation over the image alone and receive greater SHAP importance than an existing neural confidence-map baseline, suggesting greater physical consistency. RFlash requires neither hardware modification nor access to raw scanner data and supports 2D and 3D acquisitions with linear and curvilinear probes, making it widely applicable allowing clinicians to use our method on their already acquired scanners and images.

AI.tldr: RFlash是一种物理信息后处理方法，将波束形成后的超声图像分解为衰减图和散射强度图，通过衰减自适应重渲染消除声影影响，无需原始扫描数据或硬件改造，在胎儿脑、腹部和肝脏数据上优于经典衰减校正。
AI.motivation: 骨及高衰减组织产生的声影会遮蔽超声中的临床重要结构。在胎儿脑成像中，颅骨伪影对靠近探头一侧（近端）半球的退化尤为严重，限制了两侧半球的对称评估。现有校正方法需要原始扫描数据、对组织特性施加严格假设，或依赖可能虚构解剖结构的生成模型。
AI.method: RFlash基于可微分辐射场形式的图像形成模型，将波束形成后的超声图像分解为显式的衰减图与散射强度图；随后通过衰减自适应重渲染，去除各深度信号对中间组织的依赖，等效于将探头虚拟推进到组织内部。方法仅需2D/3D线阵与凸阵采集图像，无需硬件改造或原始数据。
AI.result: 在1,261个3D胎儿脑体积、143例真实2D凸阵腹部扫描及1,200例模拟2D线阵肝脏扫描上，RFlash比经典Hughes-Duck衰减校正更有效降低声影相关强度差异。以远侧半球训练的孕龄模型用于近侧半球时，预测误差相较原始图像降低5.1天（40%）。估计的衰减图还可产生声影置信图，在随机森林骨影分割上优于仅用图像，且SHAP重要性高于现有神经置信图基线。
AI.conclusion: RFlash提供了一种不依赖硬件改动或原始数据的物理一致后处理方案，支持2D与3D采集及线阵、凸阵探头，具有广泛适用性，可使临床医生在现有扫描仪和已有图像上直接使用。

title: FMCW-LIO: A Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
comment: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2024. Project Page: https://github.com/IMRL/FMCW-LIO
summary: Conventional LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) or simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) methods heavily rely on geometric features of environments, as LiDARs primarily provide range measurements instead of motion measurements. From now on, however, the situation changes thanks to the novel Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDARs. FMCW Doppler LiDARs not only offer the point range with high resolution but also capture the instant point Doppler velocity through the Doppler effect. In the letter, we propose FMCW-LIO, a novel and robust LIO, leveraging intrinsic Doppler measurements from FMCW Doppler LiDARs. To correctly exploit Doppler velocities, a motion compensation method is designed, and a Doppler-aided observation model is applied for on-manifold state estimation. Then, dynamic points can be effectively removed by the Doppler criteria, deriving more consistent geometric observations. FMCW-LIO eventually achieves accurate state estimation and static mapping, even in structure-degenerated environments. Extensive experiments in diverse scenes are performed and FMCW-LIO outperforms other algorithms on both accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FMCW-LIO，一种利用FMCW多普勒激光雷达内禀多普勒测量的鲁棒LIO方法，通过运动补偿与多普勒辅助观测模型实现流形上的状态估计，并借助多普勒准则剔除动态点，在结构退化环境下仍能实现准确的状态估计与静态建图。
AI.motivation: 传统LIO/SLAM高度依赖环境的几何特征，因为激光雷达主要提供距离测量而非运动测量；在结构退化环境中几何约束不足，导致状态估计不稳定。FMCW多普勒激光雷达的出现改变了这一局面，它除了高分辨率点距离外还能通过多普勒效应获取瞬时点多普勒速度，为LIO提供了新的运动信息源，如何正确利用该内禀多普勒测量成为关键问题。
AI.method: 提出FMCW-LIO框架：1）针对多普勒速度设计运动补偿方法，以正确利用多普勒测量；2）引入多普勒辅助的观测模型，用于流形（on-manifold）上的状态估计；3）基于多普勒准则有效剔除动态点，从而获得更一致的几何观测。
AI.result: 在多种场景下进行了大量实验，FMCW-LIO在精度和鲁棒性方面均优于其他算法；即使在结构退化环境中也能实现准确的状态估计与静态建图。
AI.conclusion: FMCW多普勒激光雷达的内禀多普勒测量可被有效用于LIO，通过运动补偿、多普勒辅助流形状态估计与动态点剔除，显著提升退化环境下的定位与建图精度和鲁棒性。

title: Free-Init: Scan-Free, Motion-Free, and Correspondence-Free Initialization for Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Systems
comment: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2024. Project Page: https://github.com/IMRL/Free-Init
summary: Robust initialization is crucial for online systems. In the letter, a high-frequency and resilient initialization framework is designed for LiDAR-inertial systems, leveraging both inertial sensors and Doppler LiDAR. The innovative FMCW Doppler LiDAR opens up a novel avenue for robotic sensing by capturing not only point range but also Doppler velocity via the intrinsic Doppler effect. By fusing point-wise Doppler velocity with inertial measurements under non-inertial kinematics, the proposed framework, Free-Init, eliminates reliance on motion undistortion of LiDAR scans, excitation motions, and map correspondences during the initialization phase. Free-Init is also plug-and-play compatible with typical LiDAR-inertial systems and is versatile to handle a wide range of initial motions when the system starts, including stationary, dynamic, and even violent motions. The embedded Doppler-inertial velocimeter ensures fast convergence and high-frequency performance, delivering outputs exceeding 10 kHz. Comprehensive experiments on diverse platforms and across myriad motion scenes validate the framework's effectiveness. The results demonstrate the superior performance of Free-Init, highlighting the necessity of fast, resilient, and dynamic initialization for online systems.

AI.tldr: 提出Free-Init——一种面向LiDAR-惯性系统的高频、鲁棒初始化框架，融合FMCW Doppler LiDAR的逐点Doppler速度与惯性测量，无需运动去畸变、激励运动或地图对应即可完成初始化，输出频率超10 kHz。
AI.motivation: 在线系统对鲁棒初始化需求迫切；传统LiDAR-惯性初始化依赖LiDAR扫描的运动去畸变、激励运动与地图对应，在静止、剧烈运动等场景下易失效。
AI.method: 利用FMCW Doppler LiDAR同时获取点距离与Doppler速度，在非惯性运动学模型下将逐点Doppler速度与惯性测量融合，构建内嵌的Doppler-惯性测速器；框架与典型LiDAR-惯性系统即插即用兼容。
AI.result: 在多种平台与多样运动场景（静止、动态乃至剧烈运动）下实验验证有效；Doppler-惯性测速器保证快速收敛与高频性能，输出频率超过10 kHz。
AI.conclusion: Free-Init实现快速、鲁棒、动态的初始化，凸显在线系统高频鲁棒初始化的必要性。

title: A Hybrid CNN--State-Space--Attention Backbone with Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining for 12-Lead ECG Classification
summary: Automatic 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) classification requires representations that jointly capture local waveform morphology, long-range temporal dynamics, and cross-lead dependencies, yet integrating these properties within a single efficient architecture remains challenging. This paper introduces a hybrid CNN-SSM-Attention backbone for 12-lead ECG classification. A convolutional stem performs early waveform tokenization and temporal reduction, mixed state-space and depthwise-convolutional blocks model temporal dynamics and local morphology, and a late self-attention stage enables global token interaction at reduced resolution. To improve transfer from unlabeled data, we further develop an ECG-oriented Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining (JEPA) framework. Unlike ViT-based JEPA methods that mask patch tokens before the encoder, the proposed method samples span masks at the latent temporal resolution and projects them back to the waveform domain, then predicts clean latent targets from a momentum encoder without waveform reconstruction. Experiments on CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL, with pretraining on approximately 350K unlabeled CODE-15 recordings, show that the proposed backbone provides strong supervised baselines under a compact parameter budget. JEPA pretraining further improves transfer, particularly in reduced-label settings and under both full fine-tuning and LoRA-based adaptation. Code: https://github.com/yakoubbazi/Hybrid_ECG_Jepa

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种混合CNN-SSM-Attention骨干网络用于12导联心电图分类，并设计面向ECG的JEPA自监督预训练框架，在多个数据集上取得强监督基线并提升迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 12导联ECG自动分类需同时建模局部波形形态、长程时序动态与跨导联依赖，而在单一高效架构中整合这些特性仍具挑战；同时需改善无标签数据的迁移利用。
AI.method: 骨干由卷积stem完成早期波形token化与时序降采样，混合状态空间与深度可分离卷积块建模时序动态与局部形态，末段自注意力在低分辨率下实现全局token交互；预训练采用ECG导向的JEPA框架，在潜在时序分辨率采样span掩码并投影回波形域，从动量编码器预测干净潜在目标，不做波形重构。
AI.result: 在CPSC2018、Chapman-Shaoxing、PTB-XL上评估，并以约350K无标签CODE-15记录预训练：在紧凑参数预算下取得强监督基线；JEPA预训练进一步改善迁移，在少标签设定及全微调与LoRA适配下均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该混合骨干结合ECG导向的JEPA预训练，可在紧凑参数下有效整合局部形态、长程时序与跨导联信息，并提升低标签迁移性能。

title: On the second-order optimization for spiking neural networks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient alternative to conventional neural networks by exploiting sparse, binary spikes, and event-driven computation. However, the training of SNNs remains challenging, as spiking activations create a sharp loss landscape that hinders training, and diagonal-curvature optimizers such as the Adam family may fail to capture this geometry. The extension of curvature-based optimization methods to SNNs is further complicated by the sparse, discrete, and temporally recurrent nature of their underlying dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose SpiKFAX, a second-order optimization method that formulates a computationally tractable, Kronecker-factored approximation of the Fisher information matrix specifically adapted to the structure of SNNs. Empirical evaluation across five architectures and seven datasets demonstrates that SpiKFAX consistently yields improvements in test accuracy and training stability relative to other popular optimizers.

AI.tldr: 提出SpiKFAX，一种针对脉冲神经网络结构定制的二阶优化方法，通过可计算的Kronecker因子化Fisher信息矩阵近似，在5种架构、7个数据集上稳定提升测试精度与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: SNN凭借稀疏二值脉冲与事件驱动计算具有能效优势，但训练困难：脉冲激活导致损失曲面尖锐，Adam等对角曲率优化器难以刻画该几何；同时，SNN动力学具有稀疏、离散、时间递归特性，使曲率类优化方法难以直接扩展。
AI.method: 提出SpiKFAX二阶优化方法，针对SNN结构构建计算可行的、Kronecker因子化的Fisher信息矩阵近似，以捕捉其损失曲面几何。
AI.result: 在五种架构和七个数据集上的实验表明，相较其他常用优化器，SpiKFAX在测试精度与训练稳定性上均取得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: SpiKFAX为SNN提供了一种结构适配的二阶优化方案，有效缓解尖锐损失曲面与现有优化器几何刻画不足的问题，验证了曲率信息在SNN训练中的价值。

title: Segment-Level Risk Discovery in Online Handwriting for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
summary: Online handwriting provides a non-invasive and low-cost behavioral biomarker for Alzheimer's disease (AD) detection, as it reflects both cognitive planning and fine motor control. Existing handwriting-based AD detection methods usually rely on global trajectory features or whole-sample representations, which can be strongly affected by individual writing style, task-specific variation, and acquisition noise. In this paper, we propose NormPaST-Risk, a healthy-normative Paper-Air selective trajectory state-space risk network for interpretable AD detection from online handwriting. Instead of treating the entire trajectory as a single holistic representation, our method reformulates AD handwriting detection as local disease-relevant segment discovery. Specifically, a multi-scale temporal encoder captures stroke dynamics at different temporal resolutions, while a selective Paper-Air state-space encoder models long-range handwriting progression and distinguishes on-paper motor execution from in-air planning and transition behaviors. To explicitly characterize abnormal deviations, a healthy normative branch learns normal handwriting dynamics from healthy controls, and a task-aware multi-expert segment-risk module estimates segment-level AD risk calibrated by hidden-state changes and normative deviations. A weakly supervised segment-level objective further enables high-risk segment discovery without manual segment annotations. Experiments on the DARWIN benchmark demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior AD/HC classification performance compared with existing methods. Moreover, the discovered high-risk segments can be projected back to the original handwriting trajectory, providing interpretable evidence associated with AD-related handwriting variations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NormPaST-Risk，一种健康规范化的纸-空选择性轨迹状态空间风险网络，将在线手写AD检测重构为局部疾病相关片段发现任务，在DARWIN基准上取得优于现有方法的AD/HC分类性能，并提供可解释的高风险片段。
AI.motivation: 在线手写是非侵入、低成本的行为生物标志物，反映认知规划与精细运动控制。现有基于手写的方法多依赖全局轨迹特征或整样本表示，易受个体书写风格、任务差异与采集噪声影响，且缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 多尺度时间编码器捕捉不同时间分辨率的笔画动态；2) 选择性纸-空状态空间编码器建模长程书写进程，区分纸上运动执行与空中规划/过渡行为；3) 健康规范分支从健康对照学习正常书写动态；4) 任务感知多专家片段风险模块结合隐状态变化与规范偏差估计片段级AD风险；5) 弱监督片段级目标函数，无需人工片段标注即可发现高风险片段。
AI.result: 在DARWIN基准上，该框架的AD/HC分类性能优于现有方法；所发现的高风险片段可投影回原始手写轨迹，提供与AD相关书写变化关联的可解释证据。
AI.conclusion: 将AD手写检测建模为局部疾病相关片段发现，并结合健康规范化建模与纸-空状态空间编码，能同时提升检测性能与可解释性。

title: When Misalignment Becomes Supervision: Structured Label Noise in Supervised Synthetic CT Generation
summary: Supervised synthetic CT (sCT) generation is commonly trained and evaluated as voxel-wise regression against registered reference CT images. In practice, MRI-CT and CBCT-CT pairs are aligned through registration procedures that leave residual misalignments. These residuals are not independent intensity noise but spatially coherent geometric discrepancies that act as structured label noise. We investigate how this registration-induced bias affects supervised MRI-to-CT and CBCT-to-CT synthesis on 1,784 paired patients covering five anatomical regions. Voxel-wise scores strongly depend on the consistency between the registration used to build the training targets and the one used for evaluation: models score best when both conventions match, showing that networks partly learn the geometric convention of the registration pipeline and that standard metrics reward it. Training on more anatomically consistent registrations reduces prediction variability and improves out-of-distribution robustness, and CT-only controls show that registration alone produces metric errors in the range of top challenge submissions. To mitigate the limits of voxel-wise supervision, we introduce a perceptual loss computed in the feature space of a pretrained Segment Anything encoder. Compared with MAE-only and VGG-based objectives, it improves downstream segmentation and yields sharper, more structurally coherent sCT. Perceptual and voxel-wise metrics disagree under imperfect alignment and agree when the evaluation geometry is reliable. These results identify registration-induced bias as a central confounder in supervised sCT generation and argue for complementing voxel-wise agreement with anatomy-oriented evaluation criteria.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出监督式合成CT（sCT）生成中，配准残留误差构成结构化标签噪声，会主导体素级指标并诱导网络学习配准几何约定；作者提出基于SAM编码器特征空间的感知损失以缓解该偏置，并主张补充面向解剖的评估标准。
AI.motivation: 监督式sCT生成通常以配准后的参考CT为标签、以体素级回归进行训练与评估。但MRI-CT、CBCT-CT配对在配准后仍存在残余错位，这些残差并非独立强度噪声，而是空间相干的几何偏差，等价于结构化标签噪声。作者希望厘清这种配准诱导偏置对MRI-to-CT与CBCT-to-CT合成的具体影响，并寻找缓解体素级监督局限的途径。
