AI.method: 在覆盖五个解剖部位、共1,784对患者的数据上系统研究配准诱导偏置；对比训练与评估所用配准一致性对体素级得分的影响；使用解剖一致性更高的配准训练以考察预测方差与分布外鲁棒性；设置仅CT对照实验以量化配准本身引入的度量误差；并提出在预训练Segment Anything编码器特征空间中计算的感知损失，与仅MAE目标和VGG类目标对比，评估其在下游分割与sCT结构质量上的表现，并分析感知指标与体素级指标在不同对齐质量下的一致性。
AI.result: 体素级得分强烈依赖训练目标所用配准与评估所用配准之间的一致性：当二者约定匹配时模型得分最佳，说明网络部分学习了配准流水线的几何约定，且标准指标对此给予奖励。使用解剖一致性更高的配准训练可降低预测变异性并提升分布外鲁棒性。仅CT对照显示，仅配准本身即可产生与顶级挑战赛提交相当的度量误差。所提出的SAM特征空间感知损失相比仅MAE与VGG类目标，改善了下游分割并生成更锐利、结构更连贯的sCT。感知指标与体素级指标在不完美对齐下相互分歧，在评估几何可靠时趋于一致。
AI.conclusion: 配准诱导偏置是监督式sCT生成中的核心混杂因素，会通过结构化标签噪声扭曲体素级评价并奖励对配准几何约定的拟合。应在体素级一致性指标之外，补充面向解剖的评估标准；基于强预训练编码器特征空间的感知目标可作为缓解体素级监督局限的有效手段。

title: Likelihood Ranking doesn't Scale Like Prompting in LLMs
summary: LLM evaluation is commonly performed either by prompting models to produce answers or by scoring candidate outputs with likelihood-based metrics. In multiple-choice QA, however, standard likelihood-based scoring is still conditioned on the question and answer set, and can therefore leverage the same task-conditioned answer-selection interface used in prompting. We study a complementary protocol based on likelihood ranking of declarative statements constructed from the same question--answer pairs. Across 95 decoder-only models, ranging from 0.1B to 104B parameters, and 10 MCQA datasets, we find a systematic divergence between declarative-statement likelihood ranking and prompted answering. Statement-likelihood accuracy remains comparatively stable across scale, whereas prompted answering improves sharply with scale and instruction-tuning. These results suggest that likelihood preferences over controlled declarative alternatives and task-conditioned answer selection probe distinct aspects of model behavior, and should not be treated as interchangeable.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了多选题问答中两种评估协议：基于陈述句似然排序与基于提示作答。在95个模型（0.1B–104B）和10个数据集上发现二者存在系统性差异：陈述似然准确率随规模相对稳定，而提示作答随规模和指令微调显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有多选题问答评估通常依赖两种方式：提示模型生成答案，或用似然指标对候选输出打分。但多选题场景下的标准似然打分仍以问题和选项集为条件，因而可能复用了与提示作答相同的"任务条件化答案选择"接口。作者希望探索一种互补协议，即基于由同一问答对构造的陈述句的似然排序，以判断这两类信号是否探测模型行为的不同方面。
AI.method: 提出基于陈述句似然排序的评估协议：将同一问答对构造为陈述句，通过比较陈述句的似然进行排序打分。在95个仅解码器（decoder-only）模型上（参数范围0.1B至104B）和10个多选题问答数据集上进行实验，对比陈述句似然排序与提示作答两类协议的结果。
AI.result: 发现陈述句似然排序与提示作答之间存在系统性分歧。陈述似然准确率在不同规模间相对稳定，而提示作答随模型规模和指令微调显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 对受控陈述性备选项的似然偏好与任务条件化的答案选择探测的是模型行为的不同方面，二者不应被视为可互换的评估方式。

title: Baseline Shape Decides the Verdict: A Controlled Re-Examination of Ternary Language Models at 60K Parameters
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Code and run logs: https://github.com/veldanda/ByteLM (tag p1-v1). Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22937824
summary: Ternary (1.58-bit) weights are attractive for microcontroller-class language models, but the sub-1M-parameter regime rests mainly on isolated, single-seed comparisons. One prominent example reports that a routed ternary block (convolution, diagonal SSM and sparse attention mixed by a per-token router) beats a parameter-matched full-precision transformer by 22% at 60K parameters, attributing this to inductive bias. We re-run it under one fixed recipe, three seeds per cell, 98 byte-level runs on one laptop. (i) Baseline shape dominates: at a 16M-byte budget, param-matched transformers span 22.6% in validation loss purely by depth/width choice - far more than any architecture effect we measure there - and the best-shaped transformer ties the routed model, so the published margin is at least partly a baseline-shape effect; the ordering of shapes reverses with budget, so no single fixed shape can be trusted. (ii) At 130M bytes the routed model does win, by 22.2-24.0% over the three transformer shapes we evaluate there - but a plain gated diagonal-SSM block beats it by a further 9.1%, and the routed model's own router puts most of its weight on its recurrent pathway, so the gain does not require routing. (iii) The ternary penalty differs by architecture at the larger budget (+5.3% best transformer vs. +19.5% routed, +28.1% gated SSM), but we cannot attribute that to architecture alone: our transformers keep learned positional embeddings in full precision, 11-22% of their parameters, so they are less quantized than the models they are compared with. (iv) A 90/10 full-precision-then-ternary schedule beats all-ternary training, but only at a stage-2 learning rate about 10x the pretraining peak; at a conventional fine-tuning rate it looks 15.3% worse, reversing the conclusion. The from-scratch baseline was not itself learning-rate tuned, which bounds (iii) and (iv). Code and run logs released.

AI.tldr: 在统一配方、每格3个随机种子、单机98次字节级训练的复现下，原论文"路由式三值块优于同参数量全精度Transformer 22%"的结论大幅削弱：基线形状效应、SSM主干而非路由、量化程度不一致、以及学习率选择均可解释或反转该优势。 三值（1.58-bit）权重对微控制器级语言模型有吸引力，但亚百万参数区间主要依赖孤立的单种子对比。原工作报告：在60K参数下，路由式三值块（卷积、对角SSM与稀疏注意力经逐token路由器混合）比参数匹配的全精度Transformer好22%，并归因于归纳偏置。本文旨在以固定配方、多种子、多配置的严格复现检验该结论的稳健性与归因。 固定单一训练配方，每个实验单元训练3个随机种子，共98次字节级训练，在单台笔记本上完成。(1)在16M字节预算下系统改变Transformer的深度/宽度以考察基线形状；(2)在130M字节预算下对比三种Transformer形状与路由模型、纯门控对角SSM块，并分析路由器权重分配；(3)比较不同架构在全精度与三值下的性能差（量化惩罚），并检查位置嵌入是否保留全精度；(4)消融90/10"先全精度后三值"两阶段时间表与全三值训练，并扫描第二阶段学习率（含预训练峰值10倍与传统微调率）。
AI.motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable
AI.method: Method extraction failed
AI.result: (i)基线形状主导：16M字节预算下，参数匹配的Transformer仅因深度/宽度选择，验证损失跨度达22.6%，远超所测任何架构效应；最佳形状Transformer与路由模型打平，故已发表的优势至少部分是基线形状效应，且形状优劣随预算反转。(ii)130M字节下路由模型确实获胜，比所测三种Transformer形状好22.2%–24.0%，但纯门控对角SSM块又比它好9.1%，且路由模型的多数权重落在其循环通路上，说明增益不依赖路由。(iii)三值惩罚因架构而异（较大预算下最佳Transformer +5.3%，路由+19.5%，门控SSM +28.1%），但Transformer保留了全精度学习位置嵌入（占参数11%–22%），量化程度更低，故无法将该差异单独归因于架构。(iv)90/10时间表优于全三值，但仅在第二阶段学习率约为预训练峰值的10倍时成立；在常规微调率下反而差15.3%，结论反转。从头训练基线本身未经学习率调优，限制了(iii)(iv)的结论强度。代码与运行日志已开源。
AI.conclusion: 原论文所报告的路由式三值块相对参数匹配Transformer的22%优势，主要由基线形状选择、量化预算不均及学习率设定等混杂因素造成，而非路由机制带来的归纳偏置。作者指出缺乏对基线调优与多因素控制，提醒亚百万参数区间结论需在统一配方、多种子、多形状与公平量化条件下验证，并公开代码与日志以支持可复现性。

title: Large Language Models for Programming: Actually Fixing or Reimplementing Incorrect Code?
summary: Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models can effectively solve problems and fix bugs in diverse programming environments, including competitive programming. Existing approaches primarily evaluate LLM performance in problem solving or bug fixing independently, but do not explore the relationship between these two capabilities. This work focuses on determining how much the LLM deviates from a buggy solution to fix the bug compared to a human-written patch, and if there is a bias towards generating entirely new solutions. We construct a dataset with all the submissions ($\sim$ 3000) from a couple of users from Codeforces, and we match each buggy submission with its corresponding human fix. By using the similarity between the buggy solution and the human fix as a baseline, we evaluate the quality of LLM-generated bug fixes on 3 OpenAI GPT models (gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5.1). We check if the generated solutions solve the problem by using the Codeforces-R1 dataset, an openly available dataset that has tests generated with the DeepSeek-R1 model. Our findings suggest that LLMs tend to modify more lines than necessary compared to human fixes and, in some cases, generate entirely new solutions. We also observe that LLMs solve more problems correctly when allowed to generate solutions from scratch rather than patch buggy submissions, even when those submissions are close to the human patch. This has important implications for the design of AI-assisted programming tools, particularly in supporting user debugging processes and promoting incremental problem-solving strategies rather than solution replacement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM修复竞赛编程bug时相对人类补丁的偏离程度，构建约3000份Codeforces用户提交及对应人类修复的数据集，评估3个OpenAI GPT模型的修复质量，发现LLM倾向过度修改甚至重写整解，且从头生成比打补丁更易通过测试。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将LLM的解题能力与修bug能力分开评估，未探讨二者关系，也不清楚LLM修复时是否偏离人类补丁、是否偏好生成全新解法，这对AI辅助编程工具设计（支持增量调试而非解法替换）具有重要意义。
AI.method: 构建包含两位Codeforces用户全部提交（约3000份）的数据集，并将每份buggy提交与对应的人类修复匹配。以buggy解法与人类补丁之间的相似度作为基线，评估3个OpenAI GPT模型（gpt-5-nano、gpt-5-mini、gpt-5.1）生成修复的质量；使用Codeforces-R1数据集（测试由DeepSeek-R1生成）检验生成解法能否正确解决问题，并对比"打补丁"与"从头生成"两种设置。
AI.result: LLM相比人类修复倾向于修改更多行，某些情况下直接生成全新解法。即使buggy提交已接近人类补丁，LLM在允许从头生成解法时正确解决的问题数仍多于仅对buggy提交打补丁的情形。
AI.conclusion: LLM的bug修复存在过度修改与解法替换偏差，且从头生成在正确率上优于补丁式修复。这提示AI辅助编程工具应侧重于支持用户调试过程和促进增量式问题解决策略，而非直接替换解法。

title: Controlling Backchannels in Streamable Full-duplex Models
summary: Backchannels, brief acknowledgements like "uh-huh" produced while the other party may still be talking, are central to natural conversation, but full-duplex spoken dialogue models rarely model them explicitly. We introduce a lightweight backchannel head that predicts, from a full-duplex model's own hidden states, when a backchannel should begin. Once this probability crosses a tunable threshold, a backchannel is force-decoded. Attached to both a 7B (PersonaPlex) and a 1B (F-Actor) model, it generalizes across scale. Probing confirms the hidden states anticipate real human timing, and generation evaluation shows more frequent, better-timed backchannels. Human raters judge the resulting backchannels on par with real ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级"反馈信号头"（backchannel head），可从全双工对话模型自身的隐状态预测何时应开始发出反馈信号（如"嗯哼"），当概率超过可调阈值时强制解码，在7B与1B模型上均验证有效。
AI.motivation: 反馈信号（backchannels）是自然对话的核心要素，但现有全双工语音对话模型很少对其进行显式建模，导致生成反馈的时机与频率不自然。
AI.method: 设计一个轻量级预测头，接入全双工模型的隐状态以预测反馈信号的起始时机；当预测概率越过可调阈值时，强制解码一个反馈信号。该方法分别挂载于7B（PersonaPlex）与1B（F-Actor）模型上。
AI.result: 探针实验证实隐状态确实能预见真实人类的反馈时机；生成评估显示反馈信号更频繁且时机更佳；人类评分者认为生成的反馈信号与真实反馈信号质量相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过在隐状态上附加轻量预测头，可在不改变模型架构的前提下实现跨规模泛化的显式反馈信号建模，生成质量接近真实人类水平。

title: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe
comment: 48 pages, 9 figures, 20 tables. Authors are listed alphabetically by surname; all contributed while at Amazon. The two authors named Zixuan Zhang are different people
summary: Rufus-Air is an open and reproducible post-training recipe on GLM-4.5-Air-Base (106B-A12B), organized as a serial pipeline of eight stages: SFT, Reasoning RL, Coding RL, Instruction-Following RL, General Agent, Coding Agent, Search Agent, and RLHF. We document the data, reward design, infrastructure, stage order, and stagewise results needed to reproduce the recipe. Stages progress from basic to advanced capabilities and from hard, verifiable rewards to softer judge-based signals. Training builds on open-source components and public data, much of it used as released, without new human annotation or an in-house distillation teacher. Our main findings are that (i) diverse, high-quality SFT establishes a strong capability floor; (ii) difficulty filtering keeps RL prompts within a productive learning range; (iii) reward reliability provides a practical principle for ordering stages; and (iv) infrastructure and engineering choices are part of the recipe, not just an implementation detail. Rufus-Air improves over the official GLM-4.5-Air post-trained release and is competitive with similarly sized open models.

AI.tldr: Rufus-Air 是一个基于 GLM-4.5-Air-Base（106B-A12B）的开放可复现后训练配方，由 SFT、推理 RL、代码 RL、指令遵循 RL、通用 Agent、代码 Agent、搜索 Agent 和 RLHF 八个阶段串行组成，公开了数据、奖励设计、基础设施、阶段顺序及分阶段结果；其性能超过官方 GLM-4.5-Air 后训练版本，并与同规模开源模型具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 该工作旨在提供一个完全开放、可复现的 LLM 后训练流程，填补现有后训练配方在数据、奖励设计、基础设施与阶段顺序等关键细节上不透明的空白；同时验证仅依赖开源组件与公开数据、无需额外人工标注或自有蒸馏教师模型即可构建强竞争力模型。
AI.method: 方法上，Rufus-Air 将后训练组织为八阶段串行流水线：SFT、推理 RL、代码 RL、指令遵循 RL、通用 Agent、代码 Agent、搜索 Agent、RLHF。阶段设计遵循两个递进维度：能力由基础到高级，奖励由硬性可验证信号到较软的 judge-based 信号。训练基于开源组件与公开数据，大部分数据按原发布状态使用，不引入新的人工标注或内部蒸馏教师。核心做法包括：用多样化高质量 SFT 建立能力下限；用难度过滤将 RL 提示控制在有效学习区间；以奖励可靠性作为阶段排序的实用原则；并将基础设施与工程选择视为配方的一部分。
AI.result: 结果显示 Rufus-Air 相较官方 GLM-4.5-Air 的后训练发布版本有所提升，并与同规模开源模型具有竞争力。此外，研究得出四点主要发现：(i) 多样且高质量的 SFT 能建立稳固的能力下限；(ii) 难度过滤可使 RL 提示保持在有效学习范围内；(iii) 奖励可靠性为阶段排序提供了实用原则；(iv) 基础设施与工程选择是配方的重要组成部分，而非单纯实现细节。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：后训练配方可以通过开放组件与公开数据实现可复现，且无需新人工标注或自有蒸馏教师；SFT 质量、难度过滤、奖励可靠性与基础设施工程共同决定后训练效果。Rufus-Air 为开放后训练实践提供了可复现的八阶段参考流程，并在同规模模型中具备竞争力。

title: agentic-ger: terminology recovery in long-form speech using global context
summary: Recent advances in speech language models have improved automatic speech recognition (ASR) for long-form audio. However, accurately and consistently transcribing domain-specific terminology remains challenging. Motivated by the world knowledge and contextual capability of large language models (LLMs), we propose Agentic-GER, an LLM-based agent for terminology correction in long-form speech. The agent uses global context from the full transcript to identify suspicious terms and resolve ambiguous hypotheses. It selectively re-transcribes the source speech to check candidate corrections, and uses accepted edits to guide subsequent decisions. Experiments with four LLMs and two ASR systems on GigaSpeechBench show consistent terminology improvements in both Chinese and English, with and without thinking. On Chinese speech, Agentic-GER achieves up to a 36.8% relative reduction in biased character error rate (B-CER) over the Whisper baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的智能体Agentic-GER，利用全文上下文和选择性重转写来纠正长语音中的领域术语转写错误，在中英文及多种LLM/ASR组合上均取得一致的术语改进。
AI.motivation: 长语音ASR虽有进步，但领域特定术语的转写仍不准确、不一致，而LLM具备世界知识与上下文能力，可用于术语纠错。
AI.method: 构建LLM智能体：以完整转写文本的全局上下文识别可疑术语并消解歧义假设；选择性重转写源语音以验证候选修正；将已接受的编辑反馈用于指导后续决策。
AI.result: 在GigaSpeechBench上使用4个LLM与2个ASR系统实验，中英文、含/不含思维链均获得一致的术语改进；中文语音上相对Whisper基线的偏置字错误率（B-CER）最多降低36.8%。
AI.conclusion: Agentic-GER验证了LLM智能体结合全局上下文与验证式重转写在长语音术语纠错上的有效性，可作为ASR后处理的通用增强方案。

title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
summary: Detectors of alignment failures screen deployed language models and score alignment benchmarks. Most are generative judges that spend a decoding pass on every criterion, and classifiers that read token probabilities, such as Llama Guard, still score one fixed label per call. Jev, a model trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), answers many typed questions about one input with calibrated probabilities in a single call. Whether it detects alignment failures has not been measured. We present RLCDAlignBench, which benchmarks Jev on ten alignment failures: sycophancy, jailbreaks, deception, prompt injection, hallucination, privacy violation, social bias, reward hacking, concealing uncertainty, and power seeking. It spans 44 benchmarks and five target models, labelled by each benchmark's scorer and, on two, by humans. Many of these failures are relational, defined against a reference, such as the user's belief or an injected instruction, that the response alone does not reveal. Our key idea is therefore to vary what Jev is asked separately from what it sees: the question's wording and answer type on one side, the fields of the input on the other. A single generic question reaches a median AUROC of 0.886 zero-shot and beats supervised baselines on most benchmarks. Question wording matters little, while context matters more, mostly through fields that encode the label. Jev matches the reference scorer's agreement with human labels, surfaces label defects in existing benchmarks, and costs 63x less than LLM-judge scorers. Code and data: https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RLCDAlignBench 基准，首次系统评测以 RLCD 训练的模型 Jev 在十类对齐失效上的检测能力，发现单一通用提问即可零样本达到中位 AUROC 0.886，且成本比 LLM 裁判低 63 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐失效检测器多为生成式裁判（每个标准消耗一次解码）或固定单标签分类器（如 Llama Guard），评测成本高且灵活性差；Jev 能在单次调用中以校准概率回答关于同一输入的多个类型化问题，但其对齐失效检测能力尚未被测量，需要专门基准进行系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 RLCDAlignBench，覆盖谄媚、越狱、欺骗、提示注入、幻觉、隐私侵犯、社会偏见、奖励黑客、隐瞒不确定性、权力寻求共十类失效，横跨 44 个基准与 5 个目标模型，标签来自各基准评分器（其中两个含人工标注）。针对失效的“关系性”特点，将提问内容与输入内容解耦：一侧变化问题措辞与答案类型，另一侧变化输入字段，以定位标签信息来源。
AI.result: 单一通用问题零样本中位 AUROC 达 0.886，在多数基准上超越有监督基线；问题措辞影响很小，而上下文影响更大，且主要来自编码标签的字段。Jev 与参考评分器在人工标签上的一致度相当，并揭示现有基准中的标签缺陷，同时相较 LLM 裁判评分器成本降低 63 倍。
AI.conclusion: Jev 可作为高效、校准良好的对齐失效检测器，单次调用多问题、低成本的特性使其具备替代昂贵 LLM 裁判的潜力；同时该工作表明基准标签质量本身值得审视，解耦提问与输入的设计为关系性失效检测提供了有效分析框架。

title: Detecting Glaucoma Across Multi-ethnic Myopic and Non-Myopic Populations Using an Uncertainty-Aware Vision Transformer: A Multicentre Model Development and Validation Study
summary: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based glaucoma detection from colour fundus photographs (CFP) offers scalable screening, but performance may decline on external datasets because of differences in ground-truth definitions, populations, and coexisting conditions such as high myopia (HM). We developed and validated a Vision Transformer-based deep learning (DL) model for glaucoma detection across multi-ethnic cohorts with and without HM. Methods: A ViT-B/16 model with predictive uncertainty estimation was developed using 56,483 CFPs (57.1% with myopia; 14.4% with HM). Glaucoma labels were standardised using clinical, imaging, and perimetry data. The model was validated on 16 independent datasets across three continents, including four datasets with explicit HM labels. Findings: Internal AUROC was 98.7% (95% CI 98.2-99.1%), with sensitivity 94.5% and specificity 97.3%. Across 16 external datasets from eight countries, AUROCs ranged from 86.4% to 99.6%. In HM eyes, internal AUROC was 97.8% (95% CI 96.1-99.2%), with sensitivity 94.8% and specificity 93.7%. External HM AUROCs were 86.5% in the Beijing Eye Study and 93.3%, 91.8%, and 85.5% in hospital-based datasets from Taiwan, Thailand, and South Korea. In an exploratory HM clinical evaluation, the model had higher CFP-only diagnostic accuracy than ophthalmologists and trained graders (92.0% vs 70.0%; p=0.008) and performed comparably to glaucoma specialists using full clinical information. Interpretation: The model showed robust glaucoma detection across myopic and non-myopic multi-ethnic populations and may support AI-assisted screening in settings with high HM prevalence.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发并验证了一种基于ViT-B/16的深度学习模型，用于在合并或不合并高度近视的多族裔队列中从彩色眼底照片检测青光眼；模型在16个外部数据集上AUROC为86.4%–99.6%，在高度近视眼中亦保持稳健表现，并可媲美青光眼专科医师。
AI.motivation: 基于彩色眼底照片的AI青光眼检测具备可扩展筛查潜力，但在外部数据集上性能可能因真值定义、人群差异及高度近视等共病因素而下降，因此需开发并验证在多族裔、合并或不合并高度近视人群中均稳健的模型。
AI.method: 采用带预测不确定性估计的ViT-B/16模型，基于56,483张彩色眼底照片（57.1%合并近视，14.4%合并高度近视）开发；青光眼标签通过临床、影像和视野数据标准化；并在三大洲16个独立数据集（含4个有明确高度近视标签的数据集）上进行外部验证。
AI.result: 内部AUROC为98.7%（95% CI 98.2–99.1%），敏感度94.5%、特异度97.3%；16个来自8个国家的外部数据集AUROC为86.4%–99.6%。高度近视眼中内部AUROC为97.8%（95% CI 96.1–99.2%），敏感度94.8%、特异度93.7%；外部高度近视AUROC在北京眼研究中为86.5%，在台湾、泰国和韩国的医院数据集分别为93.3%、91.8%和85.5%。探索性高度近视临床评估中，模型仅用彩色眼底照片的诊断准确率高于眼科医师和受训阅片者（92.0% vs 70.0%；p=0.008），并与使用完整临床信息的青光眼专科医师表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在近视与非近视多族裔人群中均表现出稳健的青光眼检测能力，可能有助于在高度近视高发地区支持AI辅助筛查。

title: Pose Adaptive Dynamic FiLM Modulation for Visual Speech Recognition
comment: Submitted for conference publication and currently under review
summary: Head-pose variation introduces substantial appearance transformations in visual speech recognition (VSR), making pose-aware feature modulation desirable. However, performance degradation and unwanted feature interactions may result from using numerous Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) circuits with fixed modulation intensity. We propose a Pose Adaptive Dynamic FiLM framework with a Dynamic Residual FiLM (DR-FiLM) modulator that predicts input-dependent weights to adaptively control the strength of pose-conditioned modulation. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 demonstrate that unweighted multi-pathway modulation substantially degrades phoneme recognition, increasing PER to 20.33% and 29.42%, respectively, compared with 16.20% and 20.96% for the single ResFiLM configuration. In contrast, the proposed DR-FiLM with dynamic Deep-Res weighting reduces PER to 15.74% on LRS2 and 23.91% on LRS3, substantially mitigating the adverse effects of unweighted modulation. The analysis of the learned weights further reveals a consistent tendency to assign greater weight to the deeper FiLM pathway as head-pose variation increases. These results show that merging pose-conditioned FiLM circuits is more efficient when the modulation strength is dynamically controlled.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出姿态自适应动态FiLM框架（DR-FiLM），通过预测输入相关权重动态控制姿态条件调制的强度，有效缓解多路FiLM融合带来的性能退化，在LRS2和LRS3上降低PER。
AI.motivation: 头部姿态变化在视觉语音识别（VSR）中引入显著的外观变换，因此需要姿态感知的特征调制。然而，使用大量固定调制强度的FiLM电路会导致性能退化和不期望的特征交互，这促使研究更有效的动态调制方式。
AI.method: 提出Pose Adaptive Dynamic FiLM框架，核心为Dynamic Residual FiLM（DR-FiLM）调制器，可预测输入相关权重以自适应控制姿态条件调制的强度，并对多路（Deep-Res）FiLM通路进行动态加权融合。
AI.result: 在LRS2和LRS3上，未加权的多通路调制严重损害音素识别，PER分别升至20.33%和29.42%，而单路ResFiLM配置为16.20%和20.96%；所提DR-FiLM结合动态Deep-Res加权将PER降至LRS2的15.74%和LRS3的23.91%。权重分析显示，随头部姿态变化增大，模型持续倾向于给更深的FiLM通路分配更大权重。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当调制强度被动态控制时，融合姿态条件FiLM电路更为高效；动态加权能显著缓解未加权调制带来的负面影响。

title: IterSynth: Rethinking Deep Search Agents via Role-Decoupled Iterative Synthesis
summary: Deep search requires LLM agents to decompose complex queries, search for evidence, and synthesize grounded answers, yet existing ReAct-style agents suffer from two limitations: role coupling, where one policy must handle planning, evidence use, and synthesis; and context accumulation, where growing search histories introduce noise and obscure useful information. To address these issues, we propose IterSynth, a role-decoupled and summary-based paradigm that alternates between a Planner for identifying information needs and a Synthesizer for integrating evidence into an evolving summary state. This design separates planning from synthesis while using the summary as the persistent state of search, reducing both capability coupling and context noise. To train IterSynth effectively, we further introduce Role-Decoupled Policy Optimization (RDPO) for reinforcement learning, which combines terminal outcome rewards with turn-level rubric evaluations and computes role-specific advantages for more precise credit assignment. Experiments on five long-horizon deep-search benchmarks such as BrowseComp and Xbench-DS show that IterSynth-8B achieves an average score of 50.7, surpassing the strongest prior $\leq$8B agent by +4.2\%. Moreover, IterSynth serves as a model-agnostic prompting paradigm, delivering substantial zero-shot gains over ReAct and similar prompting paradigms on frontier proprietary models.

AI.tldr: 提出角色解耦、基于摘要的IterSynth范式，配合RDPO强化学习训练，在多个深度搜索基准上超越同规模最强智能体，并可作为通用提示范式提升前沿模型零样本表现。
AI.motivation: 现有ReAct式智能体在深度搜索任务中存在两大局限：一是角色耦合，单一策略需同时承担规划、证据使用与综合；二是上下文累积，不断增长的搜索历史引入噪声并掩盖有用信息。
AI.method: 提出IterSynth范式，在Planner(识别信息需求)与Synthesizer(将证据整合为演化摘要状态)之间交替，分离规划与综合，并以摘要作为搜索的持久状态，降低能力耦合与上下文噪声。训练上引入RDPO强化学习方法，结合终端结果奖励与回合级评分量表评估，并计算角色特定优势以实现更精确的信用分配。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp、Xbench-DS等五个长程深度搜索基准上，IterSynth-8B平均得分50.7，比之前最强的≤8B智能体高出+4.2%。此外作为模型无关的提示范式，在多个前沿闭源模型上相较ReAct等提示范式带来显著的零样本提升。
AI.conclusion: IterSynth通过角色解耦与摘要状态有效缓解角色耦合和上下文累积问题，RDPO实现更好的信用分配，在深度搜索任务上兼具训练有效性与通用提示泛化能力。

title: Two Emojis of Difference: What Multilingual Affective Generation Benchmarks Actually Measure
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, accpeted in 6TH MULTILINGUAL REPRESENTATION LEARNING (MRL) WORKSHOP 2026 at EMNLP 2026 in Budapest, Hungary
summary: We audit a multilingual affective generation benchmark eight instruction-tuned LLMs producing emoji summaries for 17,100 Bangla, English and Hindi sentences, with 6,960 human judgements and find its headline conclusions to be artefacts of the measurement instrument rather than properties of the systems. Treating annotators as a random rather than a fixed factor, no system differs significantly from any other ($F(7,14)=0.59$, $p=0.76$), although the conventional analysis declares 19 of 28 pairwise differences significant. Annotator identity explains far more rating variance than system identity, and the winning system changes whenever any single annotator is removed. The ordering that does emerge tracks output length: mean emoji count explains 78.7\% of between-system variance, and a within-item length-matched comparison over 2,599 pairs reverses the leaderboard. We further show that cross-provider anisotropy differences vanish under mean-centring, that per-language token costs change sign with the normalising unit, and that multi-view row-wise splits inflate macro-F1 by $3.1$ points and change the top-ranked system. In place of preference scoring we propose **emoji-affect decodability**, a reference-based probe whose rankings are stable to $\pm0.003$ macro-F1 across seeds.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了一个多语言情感生成基准（孟加拉语、英语、印地语），发现其结论源于测量工具的伪影而非系统真实属性：将标注者作为随机因子后系统间无显著差异，评分排序主要由输出长度驱动，跨模型差异在均值中心化后消失，多视图行式划分会虚高macro-F1。作者提出基于参照的"emoji-affect decodability"探针，其排名在不同随机种子下稳定（±0.003 macro-F1）。
AI.motivation: 现有情感生成基准（如emoji摘要）常以偏好评分排行榜形式给出系统优劣结论，但这些结论可能受标注者变异、输出长度等混杂因素影响。作者希望检验这些"头条结论"究竟是系统特性还是测量工具的伪影，并提供一个对测量噪声稳健的替代评估方法。
AI.method: 使用8个指令微调LLM为17,100条孟加拉语、英语、印地语句子生成emoji摘要，收集6,960条人工评分。将标注者视为随机因子（而非固定因子）进行方差分析；比较标注者与系统对评分方差的解释力；进行留一标注者稳健性检验；用均值emoji数量解释系统间方差；对2,599对样本做项目内长度匹配比较；对跨提供商各向异性做均值中心化；检验每语言token成本随归一化单位的变化；评估多视图行式划分对macro-F1的影响；并提出基于参照的emoji-affect decodability探针。
AI.result: 将标注者作为随机因子时，系统间无显著差异（F(7,14)=0.59, p=0.76），而传统分析却报告28对比较中有19对显著。标注者身份解释的评分方差远多于系统身份，且去除任一单个标注者后胜出系统即改变。均值emoji数量解释系统间方差的78.7%，长度匹配比较（2,599对）使排行榜反转。跨提供商各向异性差异在均值中心化后消失，每语言token成本随归一化单位改变符号，多视图行式划分使macro-F1虚高3.1点并改变排名第一的系统。所提emoji-affect decodability在各随机种子下排名稳定（±0.003 macro-F1）。
AI.conclusion: 该基准的表面结论多为测量工具伪影而非系统属性；偏好评分对标注者构成、输出长度与分析选择高度敏感。作者主张以基于参照、排名稳定的emoji-affect decodability替代偏好评分，以提供更可靠的系统比较。

title: Frame-to-Panorama Localization and Context-Aware Sampling for Scene-Specific Ship Detection in a Smart Marina Testbed
summary: Smart maritime infrastructures provide continuous access to heterogeneous sensing streams, enabling repeated experimentation, digital-twin development, and AI-based maritime services. However, sensing hardware alone is not sufficient for scene-specific model development: historical video streams must also be spatially indexed, contextualized, and reduced to informative subsets for annotation. This paper presents a frame-to-panorama localization and context-aware sampling pipeline for ship detection in historical PTZ maritime video lacking reliable pan, tilt, and zoom metadata. The main contribution is an end-to-end data-curation approach that recovers camera-view information from historical PTZ video and combines it with environmental context and visual diversity to construct compact, scene-specific training sets. Specifically, frames are localized on a reference panorama using SuperPoint and LightGlue, enriched with weather and solar-state metadata, and selected through diversity sampling to preserve variation across camera view and environmental conditions. A second context-aware stage targets under-represented distant-vessel cases near the horizon using tile-level visual embeddings and Gaussian Mixture Model clustering. Applied within the CMMI MDigi-I Smart Marina testbed, the proposed pipeline reduces 40,718 candidate frames to 220 images for annotation, corresponding to a 99.5% reduction. A YOLO26-m detector fine-tuned on this subset achieves a mean AP50 of 94.78% $\pm$ 0.51% and a mean AP50-95 of 75.10% $\pm$ 1.73% under sequence-grouped five-fold cross-validation. These results demonstrate that highly redundant infrastructure video streams can be transformed into compact, spatially and contextually diverse training sets for scene-specific detector adaptation while substantially reducing annotation effort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向历史PTZ海事视频的帧-全景定位与上下文感知采样流程，将40718帧精简至220张标注图像（减少99.5%），微调的YOLO26-m在五折交叉验证下达到94.78%±0.51%的AP50。
AI.motivation: 智慧海事基础设施虽可持续采集异构感知流，但仅有硬件不足以支撑场景专用模型开发：历史视频流需先完成空间索引、上下文标注与信息量筛选，才能用于标注。历史PTZ视频常缺乏可靠的pan/tilt/zoom元数据，导致相机视角信息缺失、冗余度高、标注成本大。
AI.method: 端到端数据治理流程：1）用SuperPoint与LightGlue将帧定位到参考全景图，恢复相机视角信息；2）融合天气与太阳状态（solar-state）元数据；3）通过多样性采样保留视角与环境条件的变化；4）第二阶段的上下文感知采样针对地平线附近远距离船舶的欠代表样本，采用瓦片级视觉嵌入与高斯混合模型（GMM）聚类进行补充选取。流程部署于CMMI MDigi-I Smart Marina测试平台。
AI.result: 候选帧从40718张压缩到220张标注图像，减少99.5%；在此子集上微调的YOLO26-m检测器在按序列分组的五折交叉验证下，平均AP50为94.78%±0.51%，平均AP50-95为75.10%±1.73%。
AI.conclusion: 高度冗余的基础设施视频流可被转化为紧凑、空间与上下文多样的训练集，用于场景专用检测器适配，同时显著降低标注工作量。

title: YODAS v3: Over 1 Million Hours of High-Bandwidth, Stereophonic, Multilingual Speech
summary: We present YODAS v3, a weakly-labeled speech corpus containing over 1.1 million hours of 48kHz multi-channel audio in 147 languages, released under a CC BY 3.0 license. YODAS v3 is not only the largest open speech dataset to date, but also the first truly large-scale speech corpus with high-fidelity stereo audio. We first provide the collection methodology for the corpus, where we introduce new techniques for gathering language-balanced speech data. The effectiveness of our approach is shown by the language distribution of the crawled data: 22 languages in YODAS v3 have over 10K hours and 73 languages have over 5K hours of data. We then conduct extensive analyses on the composition of the data, such as the distribution of languages, audio quality, and transcription quality. Finally, we train baseline speech recognition and neural codec models to show the effectiveness of the dataset. Download at https://huggingface.co/datasets/espnet/yodas3.

AI.tldr: YODAS v3是一个包含147种语言、超过110万小时48kHz多声道音频的弱标注语音语料库，是目前最大的开放语音数据集，也是首个真正大规模的高保真立体声语音语料库。
AI.motivation: 构建一个大规模、多语言、高保真立体声的开放语音数据集，以弥补现有开放语音数据在规模和音频质量上的不足。
AI.method: 提出新的语料收集方法，特别是用于采集语言均衡语音数据的技术；并对数据的语言分布、音频质量与转录质量进行分析；最后训练基线语音识别与神经编解码模型验证数据集有效性。
AI.result: YODAS v3含147种语言、22种语言超10K小时、73种语言超5K小时数据；语言分布体现方法有效性，基线模型验证了数据集的有效性。
AI.conclusion: YODAS v3作为迄今最大开放语音数据集及首个大规模高保真立体声语料库，为多语言语音识别与神经编解码研究提供了有力支撑。

title: Dense Coverage, Sparse Refinement: Byte-Constrained Cooperative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception improves autonomous perception by sharing intermediate Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features across connected agents, but dense feature exchange is difficult to deploy under strict Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) bandwidth limits. Existing efficient methods typically either compress the full feature map uniformly, spending bits on low-value background, or sparsify communication, risking the loss of useful context. We propose a coverage-refinement design for byte-constrained cooperative perception: each agent transmits a highly compressed coarse layer over the full BEV map and allocates the remaining budget to selected high-resolution patches. A Task-Aware Benefit Selector ranks cells by estimated downstream utility, enabling deterministic budgeted refinement and zero-retraining adaptation to changing bandwidth. The receiver reconstructs a dense BEV tensor compatible with standard fusion modules. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and OPV2V show strong accuracy-payload trade-offs at kilobyte-scale budgets. On DAIR-V2X, our method reaches 0.60 AP@0.7 at only 1.87 KB per non-ego agent, compared with 0.52 at 4.61 KB for uniform SimVQ compression. Controlled diagnostics further show that the gain arises from coverage-refinement allocation rather than quantization alone. Code will be published.

AI.tldr: 提出“覆盖-细化”式BEV特征传输方案：全网低比特粗层加少量高分辨率补丁，在千字节级带宽下取得更优精度-负载权衡。
AI.motivation: V2X带宽受限，密集BEV特征交换难部署。现有方法或对全图统一压缩、浪费比特于低价值背景，或稀疏化通信而丢失有用上下文。
AI.method: 每智能体传输全BEV图的极压缩粗层，并将剩余预算分配给选定的高分辨率补丁；用Task-Aware Benefit Selector按估计下游效用对单元排序，实现确定性预算化细化和零重训练带宽自适应；接收端重建与标准融合模块兼容的稠密BEV张量。
AI.result: 在DAIR-V2X与OPV2V上于千字节级预算展现强精度-负载权衡。DAIR-V2X上每非自车智能体仅1.87 KB即达0.60 AP@0.7，而统一SimVQ压缩4.61 KB仅为0.52；对照诊断表明增益来自覆盖-细化分配而非单纯量化。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖-细化设计可在严格字节约束下高效传输协同感知BEV特征，兼顾覆盖率与关键区域分辨率，优于统一压缩与纯稀疏化方案。

title: Industrial Anomaly Detection via Defect-Grounded Reasoning in Visual Latent Space
summary: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) is evolving beyond conventional detection and localization toward multimodal inspection systems that can describe, explain, and reason about fine-grained defects. Although recent multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based methods improve anomaly understanding through textual reasoning and visual guidance, they face two limitations in fine-grained inspection. First, their visual refinement often requires iteratively revisiting local image regions or augmenting with additional tools. Second, the resulting local defect evidence may not be reliably preserved throughout subsequent reasoning. To address these, we propose Anomaly-LR, a defect-grounded latent reasoning framework that first forms a global understanding of the input and then progressively refines anomaly-relevant representations directly in the visual latent space. We further construct IAD-LR-22K, the first IAD instruction dataset designed for latent reasoning, containing 22,228 image-question instances from 4,523 industrial images, with global textual reasoning traces and region-level visual annotations. Extensive experiments show that Anomaly-LR achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable-scale methods across multiple IAD benchmarks, without requiring external references or tools. The code and data will be released at https://github.com/Yen666/Anomaly-LR.

AI.tldr: 提出 Anomaly-LR，一个缺陷锚定的潜在推理框架，先形成全局理解，再在视觉潜在空间中逐步细化异常相关表征，解决多模态大模型细粒度工业异常检测中视觉细化的迭代回访与局部证据丢失问题；并构建首个面向潜在推理的 IAD 指令数据集 IAD-LR-22K（22,228 条实例、4,523 张工业图像）。多个基准上达到同规模方法 SOTA，且无需外部参考或工具。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测正从传统检测与定位迈向可描述、解释与推理细粒度缺陷的多模态检测系统。现有基于 MLLM 的方法虽通过文本推理与视觉引导提升了异常理解，但在细粒度检测上存在两点不足：一是视觉细化常需迭代回访局部图像区域或借助额外工具；二是所得局部缺陷证据在后续推理中难以被可靠保留。
AI.method: 提出 Anomaly-LR 缺陷锚定潜在推理框架：先对输入形成全局理解，随后在视觉潜在空间中直接逐步细化异常相关表征，而非迭代回访局部图像或调用外接工具，从而稳定保留缺陷证据。同时构建 IAD-LR-22K，首个面向潜在推理的工业异常检测指令数据集，含 22,228 个图像-问题实例，覆盖 4,523 张工业图像，并附带全局文本推理轨迹与区域级视觉标注。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Anomaly-LR 在多个 IAD 基准上于同规模方法中取得 SOTA 性能，且无需外部参考或工具。代码与数据将开源。
AI.conclusion: Anomaly-LR 通过在视觉潜在空间中进行缺陷锚定推理，有效缓解了现有 MLLM 方法在细粒度工业异常检测中的迭代回访与证据保留难题，并配套 IAD-LR-22K 数据集，推动工业异常检测向可解释、可推理的多模态检测发展。

title: AgriCountDINO: Parameter-Efficient Exemplar-Guided Counting and Localization in Agriculture
summary: Accurate counting and localization of plants and their organs support phenotyping and yield estimation, yet target appearance, scale, and density vary widely across species and imaging conditions. Exemplar boxes specify the target without category-specific retraining, and point predictions identify the individual instances contributing to the count. We introduce AgriCountDINO, a parameter-efficient exemplar-guided framework for joint counting and localization. It conditions frozen multiscale DINOv3 features on exemplar appearance and size, then progressively decodes them into target points. Missed-object recovery extends supervision to targets overlooked by initial matching, and exemplar-adaptive point NMS filters duplicate predictions according to exemplar scale. With 8.4M trainable parameters, approximately one-tenth of TasselNetV4's, AgriCountDINO achieves a three-shot MAE of 11.92 on the TPC-268 benchmark, reducing counting error by 9.7\% while providing individual target locations. Trained only on TPC-268, it achieves a zero-shot MAE of 14.25 on unseen generic object categories in FSC-147, improving upon the best compared zero-shot method by 6.0\% without target-domain training or fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgriCountDINO，一个参数高效的示例引导框架，用于联合计数与定位，仅需8.4M可训练参数即可在计数与零样本泛化上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 植物及器官的精准计数与定位对表型分析和产量估测至关重要，但目标外观、尺度和密度在不同物种与成像条件下差异巨大，现有方法往往需要类别特定的重新训练，且难以兼顾计数与个体定位。
AI.method: 以示例框指定目标而无需类别特定重训练，将冻结的多尺度DINOv3特征按示例外观与尺寸进行条件化，并逐步解码为目标点；引入漏检恢复机制（将监督扩展到初始匹配遗漏的目标）和示例自适应点NMS（依据示例尺度过滤重复预测）。
AI.result: 仅8.4M可训练参数（约为TasselNetV4的十分之一），在TPC-268基准上三样本MAE为11.92，计数误差降低9.7%，同时给出个体目标位置；仅在TPC-268上训练即可在FSC-147未见通用类别上实现14.25的零样本MAE，较最佳对比零样本方法提升6.0%。
AI.conclusion: AgriCountDINO以极少参数实现了示例引导的联合计数与定位，兼具高精度、参数高效性和跨域零样本泛化能力，无需目标域训练或微调。

title: CodeGraph: Open-Taxonomy Knowledge Graph for Source Code with Wikidata Grounding
summary: Public software repositories, like GitHub and Software Heritage Archive, store billions of files, yet extracting their implicit engineering knowledge ---i.e., the algorithms they implement, the paradigms they follow, the patterns they instantiate, and the application domains they serve--- remains challenging, as current tools are constrained to syntactic and token-level analysis. We present a pipeline for building an open-taxonomy semantic annotation of source code using a code-specialised Large Language Model. The extracted entities are grounded in Wikidata through a three-stage linking procedure: a deterministic SPARQL stage handles unambiguous entities, a Deep Research Agent resolves the residual long tail, and a hierarchy-rollup stage imports the parent-of closure of each resolved Wikidata identifier. The resulting annotations are materialised as a source-code-specific open-taxonomy knowledge graph. We further introduce a calibrated quality-assurance protocol that quantifies annotation precision by combining a small human gold set with an LLM-as-a-judge filter. We applied our pipeline to the 167 million files of the Stack-Edu corpus, creating the first known large-scale open-taxonomy knowledge graph for source code. Our graph, named CodeGraph, contains approximately 158 million nodes, which include around 145 million files, about 63,000 extracted concept entities (such as algorithms, paradigms, design patterns, and application domains), and roughly 19,800 grounded Wikidata entities. Furthermore, CodeGraph features approximately 1 billion typed edges that connect files to their respective concepts, link these concepts to their grounded Wikidata identifiers, and relate them to their parent categories, covering 14 programming languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用代码专用大语言模型对源代码进行开放分类法的语义标注流水线，通过三阶段Wikidata链接与校准质量保证协议，构建了覆盖1.67亿文件、约1.58亿节点和10亿条类型化边的源代码开放分类法知识图谱CodeGraph。
AI.motivation: 公共软件仓库（如GitHub、Software Heritage Archive）存储了数十亿文件，但现有工具受限于句法和词元级分析，难以提取其隐含的工程知识（算法、范式、设计模式、应用领域）。
AI.method: 构建基于代码专用LLM的源代码开放分类法语义标注流水线；通过三阶段链接程序将抽取实体锚定到Wikidata：确定性SPARQL阶段处理无歧义实体，Deep Research Agent解决残余长尾，层级上卷阶段导入已解析Wikidata标识符的父类闭包；将标注物化为源代码专用开放分类法知识图谱；并引入校准质量保证协议，结合小型人工金标准集与LLM-as-a-judge过滤器量化标注精度。
AI.result: 将该流水线应用于Stack-Edu语料的1.67亿文件，创建了首个已知的大规模源代码开放分类法知识图谱CodeGraph：约1.58亿节点（约1.45亿文件、约6.3万个抽取概念实体如算法/范式/设计模式/应用领域、约1.98万个锚定Wikidata实体），约10亿条类型化边连接文件与概念、概念与Wikidata标识符及其父类，覆盖14种编程语言。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了源代码隐含工程知识的大规模语义抽取与结构化，构建的CodeGraph为首个已知的大规模源代码开放分类法知识图谱，为代码语义检索与知识发现提供了基础设施。

title: TTLab at AlexandriaX-2026: A Fine-Tuned Surface Tagger for Arabic Machine-Translation Error-Span Detection and Classification
comment: Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026, shared task AlexandriaX-2026
summary: We present TTLab's submission to the AlexandriaX-2026 Subtask~3 on Arabic MT error span detection and classification. Our system frames the task as token-level classification over surface forms, preserving character offsets to ensure exact alignment with the evaluation metric. To handle severe label imbalance, we employ a focal loss with class weighting and dialect-specific decoding thresholds. Among six Arabic pre-trained encoders, MARBERTv2 achieves the best overall performance of 40.8 and 40.91 on the development and test set, respectively, ranking $\nth{3}$ out of all participating teams. While our system localizes error spans effectively, classification of rare error types remains challenging, highlighting the need for data augmentation for tail categories. The code is available at ${\href{https://github.com/ENTAILab/arabic-dialectal-mt-error-span-detection}{\faGithub~ TTLab at AlexandriaX-2026}$

AI.tldr: TTLab参加AlexandriaX-2026子任务3，将阿拉伯语机器翻译错误跨度检测与分类建模为基于表层形式的token级分类，使用focal loss、类别加权和方言特定解码阈值应对标签不平衡，MARBERTv2取得40.8（开发集）和40.91（测试集）的成绩，排名第3。
AI.motivation: 该研究针对阿拉伯语机器翻译错误跨度检测与分类任务，核心挑战在于标签严重不平衡，尤其是稀有错误类型（尾类）样本稀少，导致分类性能不佳，因此需要专门的处理策略来提升整体与细粒度性能。
AI.method: 将任务建模为对表层形式的token级分类，并保留字符偏移量以保证与评测指标的精确对齐；为应对标签不平衡，采用带类别加权的focal loss以及方言特定的解码阈值；在六个阿拉伯语预训练编码器中进行对比，最终选择MARBERTv2。
AI.result: MARBERTv2取得最佳整体表现，开发集得分为40.8，测试集得分为40.91，在全部参赛队伍中排名第3。系统能够有效定位错误跨度，但对稀有错误类型的分类仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 系统在错误跨度定位方面表现良好，但稀有错误类型的分类仍是瓶颈，未来需要通过针对尾类的数据增强来改进。代码已开源。

title: SALI: Shot-Aware Late Interaction for Cross-Shot Relation Matching in Text-to-Video Retrieval using Film-Grammar Knowledge
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Text-to-video retrieval usually represents a video clip by a single embedding. This embedding often loses important relations between people. E.g., an interaction "Anna confronts Mark" is regularly filmed as alternating shot and reverse shot of both (Fig. 1a). No single shot or averaged embedding over clip shots captures this relation. Thus, we propose SALI (Shot-Aware Late Interaction). It extracts the subject and object from a single-sentence query, and matches the query, its subject and object text embeddings against each visual shot embedding of a video clip. The matching operator is greedy max or optimal transport. A film-grammar penalty in fine-tuning adds a small, consistent shift. Built on CLIP4Clip-meanP, SALI keeps overall recall on par on Condensed Movies and ActivityNet while raising R@1 on multi-shot relation queries by 3 and 12 points, the most among all compared methods, and improves such queries on MSR-VTT at a cost of 1.4 R@1 overall.

AI.tldr: 提出SALI（Shot-Aware Late Interaction）方法，将单句查询拆分为主语、宾语文本嵌入，并与视频各镜头嵌入做晚交互匹配（贪婪最大或最优传输），配合电影语法惩罚微调，提升多镜头关系型查询的检索性能。
AI.motivation: 文本到视频检索常用单一嵌入表示视频片段，但这种聚合嵌入会丢失人物间的重要关系。例如"Anna confronts Mark"这类交互通常以正反打交替镜头呈现，任何单镜头或镜头平均嵌入都无法捕捉该关系。
AI.method: SALI从单句查询中抽取主语和宾语，将查询、主语、宾语三种文本嵌入分别与视频片段中每个视觉镜头嵌入进行匹配；匹配算子采用贪婪最大值（greedy max）或最优传输（optimal transport）；在微调阶段引入电影语法惩罚（film-grammar penalty）以施加微小且一致的偏移。模型基于CLIP4Clip-meanP构建。
AI.result: 在Condensed Movies和ActivityNet上整体召回率与基线持平，但多镜头关系型查询的R@1分别提升3分和12分，在所有对比方法中提升最大；在MSR-VTT上此类查询也有提升，整体R@1代价为1.4分。
AI.conclusion: 通过镜头感知的晚交互与主宾语分解匹配，能够有效建模人物关系型查询，显著改善多镜头关系查询的检索效果，同时基本保持整体检索性能。

title: A Multimodal Dataset for Survival Prediction in Resected Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
summary: Survival research in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is limited by the scarcity of datasets linking whole-slide histology with clinical, molecular, and long-term outcome data. We present a retrospective single-centre cohort of 302 patients who underwent PDAC resection at University Medical Center Gottingen. The dataset comprises 446 H&E whole-slide images, clinicopathological variables, targeted sequencing data for 154 patients, and overall-survival outcomes. During follow-up, 253 patients died, and the median follow-up was 76 months. To establish initial reference values, we evaluated fourteen survival-prediction configurations using identical five-repetition Monte Carlo cross-validation partitions. Ridge Cox regression using numeric clinicopathological variables achieved a mean concordance of $0.649 \pm 0.042$ and $0.652 \pm 0.046$ after adding KRAS and TP53 mutation status. The image-only attention model achieved $0.603 \pm 0.030$, while multimodal fusion achieved $0.619 \pm 0.025$, the highest concordance among the neural models. These results establish promising initial benchmarks for future research using this pancreas-specific multimodal dataset, paving the way for external validation.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了一个包含302例PDAC切除术患者的单中心回顾性多模态数据集（446张H&E全切片图像、临床病理变量、154例靶向测序及总生存结局），并给出十四种生存预测配置的基线性能（Ridge Cox临床变量C-index约0.649，加入KRAS/TP53后0.652，图像注意力模型0.603，多模态融合0.619）。
AI.motivation: PDAC生存研究受限于缺乏将全切片组织学与临床、分子及长期结局数据相链接的数据集，故需构建胰腺专属的多模态资源以支撑生存预测研究。
AI.method: 构建哥廷根大学医学中心302例PDAC切除患者的单中心回顾性队列，含446张H&E全切片图像、临床病理变量、154例靶向测序数据与总生存结局（随访中253例死亡，中位随访76个月）；在统一的五次重复蒙特卡洛交叉验证划分下评估十四种生存预测配置，包括数值临床病理变量的Ridge Cox回归、加入KRAS与TP53突变状态、纯图像注意力模型以及多模态融合模型，以一致性指数（C-index）为指标。
AI.result: Ridge Cox使用数值临床病理变量平均一致性为0.649±0.042，加入KRAS与TP53突变状态后为0.652±0.046；纯图像注意力模型为0.603±0.030；多模态融合为0.619±0.025，为神经模型中最优。
AI.conclusion: 该胰腺专属多模态数据集为后续研究建立了初步参考基线，并为外部验证奠定基础。

title: TTLab at StanceEval-2026: A Cloze-Style Prompting Approach for Arabic-Language Stance Detection (CLASP-Ar)
comment: Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026 StanceEval-2026 shared task
summary: Arabic-language stance detection remains challenging, and previous shared-task systems have largely relied on multitask learning and ensembles. While these systems achieve state-of-the-art performance, their applicability and transferability are limited by the additional complexity introduced by multitask learning.To reduce this complexity, we introduce $\texttt{CLASP-Ar}$, which reformulates the task as cloze-style masked language modeling. In this approach, the target, predicted sentiment, and text are combined into a single prompt whose $\texttt{[MASK]}$ prediction is restricted to a verbalizer-constrained label vocabulary.

AI.tldr: CLASP-Ar 将阿拉伯语立场检测重构为基于提示的完形填空式掩码语言建模，通过限定 verbalizer 词表进行标签预测，以降低多任务学习与集成方法带来的复杂性。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语立场检测任务本身具有挑战性，现有共享任务系统多依赖多任务学习与集成方法。这些系统虽达到最优性能，但多任务学习引入的额外复杂性限制了其适用性与可迁移性。
AI.method: 将立场检测任务重构为完形填空式掩码语言建模：把目标（target）、预测情感（predicted sentiment）与文本（text）拼接成单一提示（prompt），对 [MASK] 位置的预测限制在由 verbalizer 约束的标签词表内。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或性能指标，仅提出方法框架（CLASP-Ar）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将阿拉伯语立场检测转化为提示式掩码语言建模任务，CLASP-Ar 有望在保持性能的同时降低由多任务学习与集成带来的系统复杂度，从而提升方法的适用性与可迁移性。

title: C3M: Cross-Session Multimodal Memory Maintenance for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Long-horizon tasks require preserving and later recovering cross-session evidence under a bounded, query-blind memory budget. Existing compression can discard fine-grained visual cues or conflate semantically similar but incompatible observations. We present C3M, a cross-session multimodal memory organization that maintains a bounded active index over persistent source text-image evidence. Relation-aware updates consolidate safe redundancy while preserving complementary and incompatible records. At query time, budgeted routing selects useful index pages and expands their associated source evidence under a fixed reader budget. Together, these mechanisms establish a compact, provenance-preserving multimodal memory organization for cross-session long-horizon tasks, retaining temporal distinctions and source links required for reliable downstream reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M.

AI.tldr: 提出C3M，一种跨会话多模态记忆组织方法，在有限、查询无关的记忆预算下维持有界活跃索引并保留源文本-图像证据，兼顾跨会话长时程任务的时序区分与来源链接。
AI.motivation: 长时程任务需要在有界且查询无关（query-blind）的记忆预算下保留并后续恢复跨会话证据。现有压缩方法要么丢弃细粒度视觉线索，要么将语义相似但互不兼容的观测混为一谈，损害下游推理可靠性。
AI.method: C3M 在持久化的源文本-图像证据之上维护一个有界的活跃索引；通过关系感知更新（relation-aware updates）合并安全冗余，同时保留互补与不兼容记录；查询时采用预算化路由（budgeted routing）选取有用的索引页，并在固定读取器预算下扩展其关联的源证据。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅说明该机制形成紧凑、保留来源的多模态记忆组织，并保留可靠下游推理所需的时序区分与源链接；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 关系感知更新与预算化路由相结合，构成面向跨会话长时程任务的紧凑、可溯源多模态记忆组织，在压缩记忆的同时保留时序区分与来源关联。

title: Decision Models vs. LLMs as Rubric Judges: Cheaper, Faster, and Wrong in the Same Places
summary: LLM judges now score outputs against rubrics, in benchmarks and as training rewards. Decision models return probabilities over permitted answers with a confidence score but no free text. Two such models are Jev and an open reproduction, Perplexity's Decider. We compare each with three flash-tier LLM judges on nine panels from seven benchmarks with human judgments, giving every judge identical criterion texts. The LLM judges run in two setups, reading a whole rubric at once or one criterion at a time. Our findings suggest both decision models can often stand in for them. The LLM judges cost 16 to 357 times as much and take 5 to 350 times as long, yet in both setups each decision model trails them significantly in at most 6 of 27 comparisons. The two kinds of judge err alike, agreeing more with one another than with the human-annotated judgment labels on ordinal criteria. Over 85% of flash-tier LLM verdicts on either decision model's most confident errors repeat them, where independent errors would give about half. Each decision model's confidence ranks its errors on most ordinal panels, so each is a natural first stage for a cascade deferring uncertain verdicts to an LLM judge. Yet with flash-tier fallbacks, such cascades gained a mere 2.7 points at best over the strongest single judge, even with oracle thresholds, suggesting they mainly save cost. A cascade needs a fallback that is right where its first stage errs, but the LLM judges are mostly wrong in the same places as Jev, and the Decider is already the strongest single judge on most panels. Even each vendor's higher-tier model repeats those errors, and as a fallback it lifted no cascade more than 1.7 points above both tiers' strongest single judge. Holding across setups, effort levels, and tiers, these findings suggest designing future decision models afresh to get right what LLM judges get wrong, and vice versa.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了两类"决策模型"（Jev 与 Perplexity 的 Decider）与三种 flash 级 LLM 评委在九个评测面板上的表现，发现决策模型常可替代 LLM 评委，成本更低、速度更快，但误差模式高度相似，导致级联方法收益有限。
AI.motivation: LLM 评委已广泛用于基准评分与训练奖励，但成本高、耗时长；决策模型只输出概率与置信度而无自由文本，可能更高效，但其能否替代 LLM 评委、误差是否互补尚不明确。
AI.method: 在来自 7 个基准、含人工标注的 9 个面板上，将 Jev 与 Decider 两个决策模型与 3 个 flash 级 LLM 评委对比，统一使用相同准则文本；LLM 评委采用两种设置（整体读取完整评分标准 vs. 逐条读取单一准则）；并测试以决策模型为第一阶段、LLM 评委为回退的级联方案。
AI.result: LLM 评委成本高 16–357 倍、耗时 5–350 倍，但两种设置下每个决策模型在 27 次比较中最多仅 6 次显著落后；两类评委误差相似，彼此一致性高于与人工标签的一致性；在决策模型最自信的错误上，超过 85% 的 flash 级 LLM 判定重复同样错误（独立误差约 50%）；决策模型置信度能对序数面板错误排序；级联在 oracle 阈值下最多仅比最强单评委高 2.7 分，更高层级回退最多提升 1.7 分。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可高效替代 flash 级 LLM 评委，但两者误差高度重叠导致级联主要节省成本而非提升精度；未来应设计误差互补的决策模型，使其在 LLM 评委出错处正确，反之亦然。

title: Mind the Gap: Mesh-Guided Repair of Broken Vessels
comment: Accepted at ShapeMI 2026 (Shape in Medical Imaging), MICCAI 2026 Workshop. 17 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: Vessel segmentation is commonly optimized as voxel-wise classification, but small local errors can strongly disrupt vascular connectivity while having little effect on overlap scores. This is particularly problematic for downstream analyses that rely on centerlines, branches, connected components, or graph structure. We propose a mesh-guided post-processing framework for repairing broken vessel segmentations produced by nnU-Net. For each predicted binary mask, a deformable template mesh is fitted to the mask surface in physical space and used as a case-specific geometric scaffold. The fitted mesh is not voxelized as the final segmentation; instead, it guides conservative reconnection of disconnected components by proposing or validating thin bridge candidates under foreground-growth constraints. We evaluated this approach in three vascular anatomies using AortaSeg24 and SEGA for the aorta, TopCoW for the Circle of Willis, and PARSE for the pulmonary arteries. Performance is measured using Dice, connected-component Dice (ccDice), and the Betti-0 number. Across these datasets, repair substantially improved connectivity while preserving overlap: Dice remained nearly unchanged, whereas ccDice increased from 0.596 to 0.992 for aorta, from 0.722 to 0.835 for TopCoW, and from 0.028 to 0.862 for PARSE. The FOMAML meta-initialization further accelerated the fitting per-case, supporting practical mesh-based repair of the vascular topology. These results suggest that explicit mesh representations can provide a useful geometric prior for correcting topological failures in otherwise accurate voxel segmentations.

AI.tldr: 提出网格引导的后处理框架，通过可形变模板网格为nnU-Net血管分割结果提供几何先验，保守地修复断裂连通性，在保持Dice的同时大幅提升连接性指标。
AI.motivation: 血管分割通常被优化为体素级分类，小的局部错误会严重破坏血管连通性，却对重叠度指标影响很小。这对依赖中心线、分支、连通分量或图结构的下游分析尤为不利，因此需要显式修复拓扑失败。
AI.method: 针对nnU-Net预测的二值掩膜，在物理空间中拟合可形变模板网格至掩膜表面，作为个案特定的几何支架。拟合后的网格不被体素化为最终分割，而是在前景增长约束下提出/验证细桥候选，从而引导断开组件的保守重连。另用FOMAML元初始化加速逐例拟合。
AI.result: 在三种血管解剖结构上评估：主动脉（AortaSeg24、SEGA）、Willis环（TopCoW）、肺动脉（PARSE）。修复后Dice几乎不变，ccDice显著提升：主动脉0.596→0.992，TopCoW 0.722→0.835，PARSE 0.028→0.862。FOMAML元初始化进一步加速逐例拟合。
AI.conclusion: 显式网格表示可为校正体素分割中的拓扑失败提供有效的几何先验，在不牺牲重叠精度的前提下修复血管连通性，支持实用的基于网格的血管拓扑修复。

title: Lightweight Vision Transformer-Based U-Net for Brain Tumor Segmentation from MRI
comment: Accepted at The 2026 IEEE International Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Computer and Information Technology for Health (BECITHCON)
summary: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from Magnetic Resonance Imaging is essential for diagnosis, treatment planning, and surgical guidance. Although Convolutional Neural Networks, particularly UNet, have achieved significant success in medical image segmentation, they often struggle to capture the long-range spatial dependencies required to model tumors with irregular shapes and complex boundaries. This paper proposes a lightweight Vision Transformer UNet that combines the hierarchical feature extraction capability of UNet with the global context modeling of Vision Transformers. The proposed architecture incorporates a compact ViT bottleneck within a U-Net encoder-decoder framework, enabling effective learning of both local and global features while maintaining computational efficiency with only 2.6 million trainable parameters. The model was evaluated on the TCGA LGG MRI Segmentation dataset, achieving a mean Intersection over Union of 0.8100 and a Dice score of 0.8446, outperforming the baseline UNet by 3.75% and 3.15%, respectively. Extensive quantitative and qualitative analyses, including confusion matrix evaluation, precision recall curves, per-image performance distribution, and tumor size dependency analysis, demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method for brain tumor segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级ViT-UNet混合架构，在U-Net编解码框架中嵌入紧凑ViT瓶颈以兼顾局部与全局特征，仅2.6M参数，在TCGA LGG数据集上mIoU 0.8100、Dice 0.8446，优于基线UNet。
AI.motivation: MRI脑肿瘤分割对诊断、治疗计划和手术导航至关重要。CNN（尤其UNet）虽在医学图像分割中成功，但难以捕捉建模不规则形状和复杂边界肿瘤所需的长程空间依赖。
AI.method: 提出轻量级Vision Transformer UNet：在U-Net编码器-解码器框架内嵌入紧凑ViT瓶颈层，结合UNet的层次化特征提取能力与ViT的全局上下文建模，实现局部与全局特征的有效学习，同时保持计算效率（仅260万可训练参数）。
AI.result: 在TCGA LGG MRI分割数据集上评估，取得平均IoU 0.8100、Dice 0.8446，分别较基线UNet提升3.75%和3.15%。通过混淆矩阵、精确率-召回率曲线、逐图像性能分布及肿瘤尺寸依赖性分析等定量与定性分析，验证了方法的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的轻量级ViT-UNet在保持低参数量的同时有效提升脑肿瘤分割性能，兼顾效率与精度，具有较好的鲁棒性。

title: OREO: Fidelity Alignment in 3D Generation via On-the-fly Rendering-Editing Optimization
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Our project page is at https://theericma.github.io/oreo/
summary: Despite recent advancements in 3D generation, models often struggle to produce assets with high visual fidelity. To bridge this gap, we propose OREO, an alignment framework that enhances the realism of 3D generators by leveraging rich 2D diffusion priors. Instead of relying on static datasets, OREO establishes a dynamic optimization loop that produces on-the-fly edited renderings as 2D pseudo-targets. At its core, we introduce Reinforced Editing, which utilizes a 2D model to refine rendered views of the 3D output, enhancing their overall visual fidelity while preserving the underlying geometry, viewpoint, and content. These refined views serve as high-quality supervision targets, enabling the 3D generator to learn from its own generated samples and progressively improve its visual quality. Experiments demonstrate that OREO effectively improves upon pre-trained baselines, producing 3D assets with enhanced visual realism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OREO，一个利用丰富2D扩散先验来增强3D生成器真实感的对齐框架。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成模型难以产出高视觉保真度的资产，为此需要弥合这一差距。
AI.method: OREO建立动态优化循环，即时生成编辑后的渲染作为2D伪目标；核心是Reinforced Editing，用2D模型精修3D输出的渲染视图，在保持几何、视角与内容的同时提升视觉保真度，并将其作为高质量监督信号，使3D生成器从自身样本中学习并逐步提升视觉质量。
AI.result: 实验表明OREO能有效改进预训练基线，生成视觉真实感更强的3D资产。
AI.conclusion: OREO通过2D扩散先验与强化编辑的自监督对齐，显著提升3D生成视觉真实感。

title: TimeBraid: Unifying Time Series and Language for Understanding and Forecasting
summary: We present TimeBraid, a series of unified time-series and language models that align pretrained language models and pretrained time-series foundation models through interleaved global residual attention layers. Each model inherits knowledge, instruction following, and reasoning from one side, continuous-signal perception and zero-shot forecasting from the other, and fuses the two in a shared representation space where both modalities are understood and generated. We study the design choices that make such unified modeling work: where to align the two representation spaces, how to ground language in temporal structure, how to balance understanding with generation, and how to keep joint optimization stable. The resulting recipe combines a unified prompting scheme for diverse time-series and text tasks, stabilized joint training, and supervision from 2.2M curated series--text pairs and 4.9M instruction-tuning samples. Across benchmarks spanning time-series perception, understanding, reasoning, and both context-aided and unimodal forecasting, TimeBraid remains competitive with far larger general-purpose models and task-specific counterparts.

AI.tldr: TimeBraid 通过交错全局残差注意力层，将预训练语言模型与预训练时间序列基础模型对齐，构建统一的时间序列-语言模型，在感知、理解、推理及预测等多任务上具备竞争力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型擅长知识、指令跟随与推理，时间序列基础模型擅长连续信号感知与零样本预测，但二者长期分离；作者希望将两种模态统一到共享表征空间，使模型能同时理解并生成文本与时间序列。
AI.method: 采用交错的全局残差注意力层对齐两个预训练模型；研究对齐位置、语言对时间结构的落地、理解与生成的平衡、联合优化稳定性等设计选择；提出统一提示方案，配合稳定联合训练，并使用 220 万条精选序列-文本对与 490 万条指令微调样本进行监督。
AI.result: 在覆盖时间序列感知、理解、推理以及上下文辅助预测和单模态预测的基准上，TimeBraid 与规模远大的通用模型及特定任务模型相比仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 交错全局残差注意力对齐结合统一提示与稳定联合训练，可实现语言与时间序列的统一建模，在多种任务上达到与更大通用模型和专用模型相当的表现。

title: Benchmarking and Domain Adaptation of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) for Adolescent Health Communication in Ghanaian Languages
summary: This paper presents an end-to-end study of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for adolescent health communication in three Ghanaian languages (Twi, Dagbani, and Ewe). The work proceeds in three connected stages; First, we benchmark five ASR systems (three language-specific Wav2Vec2 models and two multimodal LLMs, Gemma 3n and Gemma 4) on a general-domain Bible corpus and a Youth Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health (ASRH) Domain ASR dataset, using Character and Word Error Rate (CER, WER). Second, guided by the benchmark, we perform supervised domain adaptation: although Gemma 4 was the strongest zero-shot candidate, fine-tuning it proved computationally infeasible, so we pivoted to the compact Qwen3-ASR-0.6B, fine-tuned on a large Ghana Bible corpus (~90k samples) and evaluated strictly on held-out human-collected in-domain audio. Fine-tuning reduced WER on every language, most dramatically for Ewe (WER from 109.3% to 64.8%, a drop of 44.5 pp; CER from 65.1% to 24.9%). Third, we validate the work through KasaHealth, a live voice-first ASRH application deployed in all three languages, complemented by Senti-Check, a technical evaluation harness. KasaHealth was tested by 50 community respondents and achieved a 100% chat-approval rate, a 72% Good-or-Excellent translation rating, and a 92% would-recommend rate, while surfacing the domain gaps that most constrain real-world use. Across all three stages the evidence converges: for these languages the binding constraint is validated in-domain data, not model capability or computation.

AI.tldr: 本文对加纳三种语言(Twi、Dagbani、Ewe)的青少年性生殖健康(ASRH)语音识别展开端到端研究：先基准评测五套ASR系统，再基于评测结果做监督式领域自适应微调，最后通过实际部署应用KasaHealth与评估工具Senti-Check验证，结论是制约因素为缺乏经过验证的域内数据，而非模型能力或算力。
AI.motivation: 青少年性生殖健康(ASRH)是低资源语言场景中语音交互的高价值应用方向，但加纳Twi、Dagbani、Ewe等语言缺乏域内标注语音，导致通用ASR难以直接落地；同时现有大模型在低资源语言上的零样本表现与微调可行性尚不清楚，因此需要系统厘清"模型能力、算力、数据"三者中真正的瓶颈。
AI.method: 研究分三阶段：①基准测试——在通用领域圣经语料与ASRH域语音数据集上，对5个ASR系统(3个语言专属Wav2Vec2、2个多模态大模型Gemma 3n和Gemma 4)用CER/WER进行零样本评测；②监督式领域自适应——因微调Gemma 4算力不可行，转用轻量Qwen3-ASR-0.6B，在约9万条加纳圣经语料上微调，仅在留出的真人采集域内音频上评估；③应用验证——部署三语语音优先ASRH应用KasaHealth及技术评估工具Senti-Check，由50名社区受访者实测。
AI.result: 微调在每种语言上均降低了WER，Ewe改善最显著：WER从109.3%降至64.8%(下降44.5个百分点)，CER从65.1%降至24.9%。KasaHealth实测获得100%的对话审批率、72%的"良好或优秀"翻译评分、92%的推荐意愿，同时暴露出制约实际使用的主要领域缺口。
AI.conclusion: 三阶段证据一致表明：对这些语言而言，真正的瓶颈是经过验证的域内数据，而非模型能力或计算资源；大模型零样本虽强但微调成本高，轻量模型结合域内数据微调是更可行的路径。

title: Adaptive Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance for Low-Resource Speech Recognition
summary: Adapting multilingual speech foundation models to low-resource languages remains difficult, especially for languages that are poorly represented during pre-training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the cost of adapting large models, conventional approaches such as LoRA rely on generic low-rank parameterizations and do not explicitly use downstream task information to define the adaptation subspace. To investigate whether task-informed PEFT can better support low-resource ASR, we apply Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance Analysis (FCCA) to Whisper and Qwen3-ASR, and introduce two complementary extensions: Asymmetric-Coupled FCCA (AC-FCCA), which exploits structured cross-layer sharing, and Adaptive-Rank FCCA (AR-FCCA), which reallocates adaptation capacity across projection matrices under a fixed parameter budget. Under controlled multilingual experiments, we evaluate these approaches on languages that are poorly represented or unsupported during pre-training alongside well-represented languages. Standard FCCA is competitive with, and usually outperforms, trainable-parameter-budget-matched LoRA. AR-FCCA provides the most consistent improvement over standard FCCA across both model architectures, with statistically significant gains in several evaluation settings, while retaining the same number of trainable parameters. These results show that task-informed subspace construction can be effective for low-resource speech adaptation, and that adaptive rank allocation provides a robust way to improve parameter efficiency without increasing model capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究任务信息驱动的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法，将Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance Analysis (FCCA)应用于Whisper和Qwen3-ASR，并提出AC-FCCA和AR-FCCA两种扩展，以提升低资源语言的语音识别适应效果。
AI.motivation: 多语言语音基础模型在低资源、预训练中表征不足的语言上适应困难；LoRA等传统PEFT使用通用低秩参数化，未显式利用下游任务信息定义适应子空间，因此需要探究任务信息驱动的PEFT能否更好支持低资源ASR。
AI.method: 将FCCA应用于Whisper和Qwen3-ASR，并提出两种互补扩展：AC-FCCA利用结构化跨层共享，AR-FCCA在固定参数预算下跨投影矩阵重新分配适应容量。通过受控多语言实验，在预训练中表征不足或未支持的语言及表征较好的语言上进行评估。
AI.result: 标准FCCA与可训练参数量匹配的LoRA相比具有竞争力，且通常表现更优；AR-FCCA在两种模型架构上均对标准FCCA带来最一致的提升，在多个评测设置中取得统计显著增益，同时保持相同的可训练参数量。
AI.conclusion: 任务信息驱动的子空间构建对低资源语音适应有效，自适应秩分配是提升参数效率且不增加模型容量的稳健方式。

title: Learning to Ideate for Scientific Impact
summary: Scientific ideation is increasingly mediated by large language models, but current ideation systems are usually trained and evaluated on immediately judgeable proxies such as novelty, clarity, and feasibility. This leaves open whether delayed signals of scientific uptake can be used as feedback for steering models toward research directions with higher expected \emph{impact}. We study this question using citation-normalized impact as a noisy but scalable proxy for scholarly uptake. We construct a large-scale dataset from over 100K computer science papers by extracting goal-conditioned idea descriptions and assigning each paper an ordinal, year-normalized citation label. We then train a goal-conditioned reward model to predict citation-impact labels from research goal and idea pairs, and use this reward to align an idea generator through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. To reduce circularity, we evaluate generated ideas with a held-out, reference-grounded protocol that compares model outputs against historical ideas under the same research goal and weights judgments by the reference idea's citation-impact label. Experiments show that our RL-tuned model consistently produces ideas with higher estimated impact than both the base model and supervised fine-tuning baselines. Our findings position scientific impact as a practical, outcome-grounded feedback signal for aligning LLMs in open-ended scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用引用归一化影响力作为可扩展的延迟反馈信号，构建10万+计算机科学论文数据集并训练目标条件奖励模型，通过SFT加RL对齐创意生成器，实验证明RL调优模型生成的创意预估影响力更高。
AI.motivation: 现有科学创意系统多以新颖性、清晰度、可行性等即时可判断的代理指标进行训练和评估，无法反映科学成果的延迟采纳信号（如引用影响力），因此不清楚能否用延迟信号引导模型走向更高预期影响力的研究方向。
AI.method: 以引用归一化影响力作为学术采纳的噪声但可扩展代理；从10万+计算机科学论文中提取目标条件化创意描述，并为每篇论文赋予序数化、按年份归一化的引用标签；训练目标条件奖励模型，从研究目标与创意对预测引用影响力标签；再用该奖励通过监督微调加强化学习对齐创意生成器；为减少循环性，采用留出的、基于参考文献的评估协议，在同一研究目标下将模型输出与历史创意对比，并按参考创意的引用影响力标签加权评判。
AI.result: 实验显示，经RL调优的模型生成的创意预估影响力持续高于基础模型和监督微调基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明科学影响力可作为实用且基于真实结果的反馈信号，用于在开放式科学发现中对齐大语言模型。

title: CORDIAL: Calibrating Ordinal LLM Outputs from Few Labels
summary: A large language model (LLM) can turn a text into a distribution over an ordered scale, but that distribution is a noisy measurement: saturated, compressed or exaggerated, and biased in a consistent direction. We propose CORDIAL, which treats the model's output as a noisy reading of the true label and corrects it with a channel of five interpretable parameters. The channel is small enough for its posterior to be averaged from a handful of labels, and we prove that the resulting calibration preserves first-order stochastic order. On Amazon reviews and CMU-MOSEI transcripts with four LLMs, CORDIAL has the lowest log loss among nine calibrators in 76 of 80 settings with 5 to 100 labels; with 20 labels and the main 7B reader, it matches the strongest baseline using 28-54 labels. The same posterior lets us learn priors from other tasks and fuse several LLMs. Unrestricted calibrators such as Dirichlet calibration overtake it only as the calibration set grows into the hundreds or thousands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CORDIAL，将大语言模型输出的有序分布视为对真实标签的噪声测量，并用五参数可解释信道进行校正，在少量标签下实现优于九种校准器的对数损失表现，同时保持一阶随机占优。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可将文本映射为有序尺度上的分布，但该分布是噪声测量：存在饱和、压缩或夸大，且偏差方向一致，因此需要一种能在标签极少时进行可靠校准的方法。
AI.method: CORDIAL 把模型输出建模为真实标签经过五参数可解释信道的噪声读数；信道足够小，使其后验可由少量标签平均估计，并从理论上证明所得校准保持一阶随机占优。同一后验还可用于学习其他任务先验并融合多个 LLM。
AI.result: 在 Amazon 评论与 CMU-MOSEI 转写文本上使用四个 LLM 评估：在 5 至 100 个标签的 80 种设置中，CORDIAL 在 76 种设置取得九种校准器中最低对数损失；在 20 个标签与主 7B 阅读器下，其表现匹配使用 28-54 个标签的最强基线。无约束校准器（如 Dirichlet 校准）仅在校准集增长到数百或数千时才超过它。
AI.conclusion: CORDIAL 通过小规模可解释信道实现对 LLM 有序输出的低标签校准，在少标签场景显著优于现有方法，并能支持先验迁移与多 LLM 融合；其优势随校准集增大而减弱。

title: S2Planner: Multi-Scale Semantic Planner for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: We present S2Planner, a trajectory planner that combines three front-facing cameras with ego-motion history and the current driving command. A fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone and a Spatial Tuning Adapter produce multi-scale image features; a coarse-to-fine decoder then uses trajectory self-attention and camera-projected cross-attention to refine candidate waypoints. The contribution is the integration of ego-conditioned trajectory initialization with iterative, geometry-guided sampling of multi-scale image features, rather than a new visual backbone or attention operator. On the NAVSIM v1 non-reactive evaluation, the previously reported navtest run obtained 88.03 PDMS. Because that run was selected using navtest performance, this number is exploratory and cannot be interpreted as an unbiased test estimate. Validation-selected evaluation on unexposed data, repeated runs, and computational measurements are needed to establish generalization and efficiency.

AI.tldr: S2Planner 是一个融合三路前视相机、自车运动历史与驾驶指令的轨迹规划器，核心贡献在于"自车条件化的轨迹初始化 + 迭代式几何引导的多尺度特征采样"这一集成设计，而非新的视觉骨干或注意力算子。其 88.03 PDMS 结果因在 navtest 上选型而属探索性，尚不能作为无偏的测试估计。
AI.motivation: 面向端到端轨迹规划，作者并非追求新的视觉骨干网络或注意力算子，而是希望通过集成已有组件（视觉基础模型、多相机几何、自车状态）来提升规划质量，并强调需要更严格的评测协议来验证泛化性与效率。
AI.method: 方法上结合三路前视相机、自车运动历史和当前驾驶指令；使用微调的 DINOv3 骨干与 Spatial Tuning Adapter 提取多尺度图像特征；采用粗到细解码器，通过轨迹自注意力与相机投影的交叉注意力迭代细化候选路点。核心是自车条件化的轨迹初始化与几何引导的迭代采样。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 非反应式评测中，此前报告的 navtest 运行取得 88.03 PDMS。由于该结果依据 navtest 性能进行选型，作者明确指出这一数值仅为探索性结果，不能解释为无偏的测试估计；尚未报告验证集上选型后的未见数据评测、重复实验与计算量测量。
AI.conclusion: S2Planner 的价值在于系统集成思路而非模块级创新；其现有性能证据不足以支撑泛化性和效率结论。后续需在未见数据上进行基于验证集选型的评测、进行多次重复运行并给出计算开销测量，以确立方法的可靠性与实用性。

title: AV-GRPO: Modality-Anchored Decoupling Diffusion Reinforcement Learning for Joint Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent years have witnessed major progress in joint audio-video generation. Existing models still suffer from limited per-modality fidelity, insufficient text-modality alignment and weak cross-modal synchronization. While reinforcement-learning post-training offers a promising remedy, directly adapting it to joint audio-video generation is challenging. Heterogeneous multimodal rewards entangle learning signals and complicate credit assignment. Joint optimization of two modality towers is computationally expensive given their divergent dynamics. Moreover, synchronization evaluation difficulty depends on paired samples, preventing fair reward comparisons. We propose AV-GRPO, a modality-anchored online diffusion RL framework, and 5DAV, a decoupled, difficulty-controllable training dataset. AV-GRPO includes three key modules: (1) modality-anchored rollouts to disentangle learning signals and stabilize difficulty; (2) trajectory-locked frozen-tower optimization to reduce cost and reassign credit; (3) adaptive objectives and perturbation strengths tailored to modality-specific dynamics. This converts coupled multimodal preference learning into unimodal subproblems for precise reward attribution and better synchronization. Our 5DAV dataset decouples samples across five dimensions for systematic training. Experiments on JavisBench and VABench demonstrate AV-GRPO outperforms LTX-2.3 in generation quality, semantic alignment and cross-modal synchronization under LoRA and full fine-tuning. Ablations confirm our designs. Code and data: https://github.com/zhiyuxu03/AV-GRPO

AI.tldr: 提出 AV-GRPO——一种模态锚定的在线扩散强化学习框架，配合 5DAV 解耦数据集，将耦合的联合音视频偏好学习分解为单模态子问题，在生成质量、语义对齐与跨模态同步上超越 LTX-2.3。
AI.motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型存在三方面不足：单模态保真度有限、文本-模态对齐不充分、跨模态同步性弱。强化学习后训练虽有潜力，但直接迁移面临三重挑战：异构多模态奖励纠缠学习信号、信用分配困难；双模态塔联合优化因动态差异而计算昂贵；同步性评估依赖成对样本，难以进行公平的奖励比较。
AI.method: AV-GRPO 包含三个关键模块：(1) 模态锚定的 rollout，用于解耦学习信号并稳定难度；(2) 轨迹锁定的冻结塔优化，以降低成本并重新分配信用；(3) 针对模态特定动态自适应设计的目标函数与扰动强度。该设计将耦合的多模态偏好学习转化为单模态子问题，实现精确的奖励归因。此外构建 5DAV 数据集，在五个维度上解耦样本以支持系统性训练。
AI.result: 在 JavisBench 与 VABench 上，AV-GRPO 在 LoRA 与全量微调设定下，于生成质量、语义对齐和跨模态同步方面均优于 LTX-2.3；消融实验验证了各项设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过模态锚定的在线扩散 RL 与难度可控的解耦数据，AV-GRPO 有效缓解了异构奖励纠缠与信用分配难题，在较低成本下提升了联合音视频生成的保真度、对齐度与同步性，为多模态后训练提供可行范式。

title: Anatomy-Aligned Surface Field Learning for Myocardial Reconstruction from Sparse Short-Axis Cine MRI
summary: Patient-specific 4D myocardial reconstruction from cine MRI supports quantitative functional assessment, regional motion analysis, and simulation-based modeling. However, routinely acquired short-axis (SAX) cine MRI is sparsely sampled along the through-plane direction, making dense and anatomically consistent surface reconstruction challenging. In this study, we propose an anatomy-aligned surface learning framework that parameterizes the epicardial and endocardial surfaces on a shared circumferential-longitudinal UV domain. This formulation converts irregular 3D reconstruction into structured coordinate-field completion with explicit correspondence across subjects and cardiac phases. Sparse SAX contours are encoded as UV observation fields, coverage-aware sampling improves robustness to incomplete slice coverage, and topology- and distortion-aware learning preserves circumferential continuity and local surface quality. Experiments on three public cine MRI datasets showed that the proposed method consistently outperformed representative mesh-based and implicit reconstruction approaches, achieving overall Chamfer distances of $2.887$~mm on ACDC, $2.641$~mm on M\&Ms, and $2.810$~mm on M\&Ms-2. The reconstructed sequences also preserved ventricular function, with end-diastolic volume and ejection fraction errors of $3.3$~mL and $1.1 \%$, respectively. These results demonstrate that anatomy-aligned UV learning provides an accurate, efficient, and correspondence-aware representation for sparse cine MRI reconstruction and myocardial modeling. The source code will be available at https://github.com/yuan-xiaohan/SAX2MyoSurf.

AI.tldr: 本文提出解剖对齐的UV曲面学习框架，将稀疏短轴电影MRI重建为稠密、对应一致的4D心肌表面，在三个公开数据集上取得优于代表性网格与隐式方法的精度。
AI.motivation: 患者个性化4D心肌重建支持定量功能评估、区域运动分析与仿真建模，但常规采集的短轴（SAX）电影MRI在穿平面方向采样稀疏，难以实现稠密且解剖一致的表面重建。
AI.method: 提出解剖对齐的曲面学习框架，将心外膜与心内膜表面参数化到共享的周向-纵向UV域，把不规则3D重建转化为结构化坐标场补全，从而实现跨受试者与心动时相的显式对应；将稀疏SAX轮廓编码为UV观测场，采用覆盖率感知采样提升对切片覆盖不全的鲁棒性，并通过拓扑与畸变感知学习保持周向连续性与局部曲面质量。
AI.result: 在三个公开电影MRI数据集上持续优于代表性网格法与隐式重建方法，整体Chamfer距离分别为ACDC 2.887 mm、M&Ms 2.641 mm、M&Ms-2 2.810 mm；重建序列保持心室功能，舒张末期容积与射血分数误差分别为3.3 mL与1.1%。
AI.conclusion: 解剖对齐的UV学习为稀疏电影MRI重建与心肌建模提供了准确、高效且具备对应感知能力的表示，代码将开源于 https://github.com/yuan-xiaohan/SAX2MyoSurf。

title: Robot Manipulation with GPT-6-Astra: Body Knowledge, Experience Reuse, Emergent Skills, and Sim2Real Transfer
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code, data, prompts, and skills: https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real
summary: General-purpose multimodal agents can write robot-control programs, but repeated exploration and model-mediated action selection can make execution slow. We study how external body knowledge, successful experience, and executable skills improve an XLeRobot controlled by GPT-6-Astra in a simulated and a physical elevator-button task. In 30 fixed-start simulation trials, complete robot geometry and camera information reduce mean completion time by 57.4% relative to a baseline with only the common control interface and no prior experience; images with synchronized action and state records reduce it by 68.6% without additional body assets. In nine paired comparisons (18 trials) at starts displaced by 10-100 cm, experience recorded at the original start reduces mean time by 58-63% relative to no experience, demonstrating generalization to the tested new starting positions. During experience experiments, GPT-6-Astra spontaneously generates a short visual-feedback program. Researcher-refactored versions reduce mean local-task time by 29-31% in 27 simulation trials. Finally, 12 real-robot trials using operator-confirmed button contact demonstrate sim2real reuse: at a shared nominal start, simulation XML assets and simulation experience reduce mean time by 53.0% and 49.9%, respectively; real experience also transfers to two new starts. These results suggest a practical way to build general-purpose manipulation experiments around GPT-6-Astra: supply machine-readable body descriptions and synchronized demonstrations, and turn useful agent-generated feedback routines into reusable skills, while the agent adapts actions from current images. We release all task prompts, trial-level experimental data, and acquired skill implementations at https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real.

AI.tldr: 研究外部身体知识、成功经验与可执行技能如何加速 GPT-6-Astra 控制的 XLeRobot 在电梯按钮任务中的操作，并在仿真与真机间验证 sim2real 复用。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态智能体虽能编写机器人控制程序，但反复探索与模型中介的动作选择导致执行缓慢，需要探索可行的加速途径。
AI.method: 在仿真与实物电梯按钮任务中，引入三类外部先验：(1) 机器可读的完整机器人几何与相机信息；(2) 同步动作-状态记录的图像经验；(3) 将智能体自发产生的视觉反馈程序重构为可复用技能，并进行固定起点、位移起点（10–100 cm）与真机迁移实验。
AI.result: 仿真 30 次固定起点试验中，几何与相机信息使平均完成时间较仅含通用控制接口的基线降低 57.4%，图像+同步记录降低 68.6%；18 次位移起点试验中经验使时间降低 58–63%；重构技能在 27 次仿真试验中使局部任务时间降低 29–31%；12 次真机试验中，仿真 XML 资产与仿真经验分别降低 53.0% 与 49.9%，真机经验亦可迁移至两个新起点。
AI.conclusion: 为 GPT-6-Astra 构建通用操作实验提供实用范式：提供机器可读的身体描述与同步演示，将智能体生成的有用反馈程序固化为可复用技能，同时由智能体基于当前图像自适应调整动作。

title: ChunkRank: Model-Aware Text Chunking and Abstention-Aware Answer Selection for LLM Pipelines
summary: We present ChunkRank, an open-source Python library that derives chunk boundaries from a target model's tokenizer and context window, and selects an answer among candidates produced independently per chunk. It ships a validated registry of 90 models across 15 providers and six answer-selection methods, and needs only three core dependencies. For chunking, ChunkRank avoids context-window overflow automatically from the model name, whereas character-based splitters overflow or waste the budget, and a fidelity study across 11 languages shows why token-exact budgets matter beyond English. For answer selection we report a negative result: on NaturalQuestions, TriviaQA and HotpotQA, with extractive and generative readers, no content-based ranker reliably beats taking the first non-empty answer. The reason is reader abstention on chunks that lack the answer, not answer position. A long-context baseline shows that chunking matches single-call reading on single-hop questions, so ChunkRank targets small-window and beyond-window settings. Code, registry and evaluation harness are released.

AI.tldr: ChunkRank 是一个开源 Python 库：依据目标模型的 tokenizer 与上下文窗口自动推导分块边界，并对各块独立生成的候选答案进行选择；包含 90 个模型、15 个提供商、6 种答案选择方法的注册表，仅需三个核心依赖。
AI.motivation: 字符级切分器容易导致上下文窗口溢出或浪费预算，且基于字符的预算不足以保证跨语言（非英语）的 token 精确性；同时需要明确分块式长文档问答中答案选择方法的实际有效性。
AI.method: 从模型 tokenizer 和上下文窗口推导块的边界（token 精确预算），按模型名自动避免窗口溢出；对每块独立生成候选答案，再以六种内容型重排/选择方法中择一输出；在 NaturalQuestions、TriviaQA、HotpotQA 上以抽取式和生成式阅读器评估，并与长上下文单次调用基线对比。
AI.result: 11 种语言的保真度研究表明显式 token 预算的重要性；答案选择方面得到负面结果：没有内容型排序器能稳定优于“取第一个非空答案”的基线，原因是阅读器在缺少答案的块上弃答，而非答案位置；长上下文基线显示分块在单跳问题上与单次调用阅读相当。
AI.conclusion: ChunkRank 适用于小窗口及超窗口场景，而非替代单次长上下文阅读；代码、模型注册表与评测框架均已开源发布。

title: Retrieve-to-Localize: Bridging Large Language Models and LiDAR Geometry for Spatial Grounding
summary: LiDAR provides precise geometric information for spatial perception tasks such as object detection in autonomous driving and outdoor robotics. However, recognizing and localizing individual objects is not sufficient to answer questions that require composing spatial relations and grounding the intended target. Motivated by recent advances in large language models (LLMs) for autonomous driving, we leverage their language priors to interpret complex spatial questions and ground the referred target in LiDAR geometry. To support this spatial grounding capability, we introduce SpatialLiDAR-QA, which combines single- and multi-step relational grounding with complementary spatial understanding tasks. We further propose SpatialLiDAR-LM, which aligns LiDAR point features with an LLM and grounds target coordinates through language-conditioned, position-aware proposal retrieval and local point refinement. This design derives target coordinates directly from local LiDAR geometry rather than through textual language decoding. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over representative LiDAR--language models and multi-camera VLMs on precise coordinate prediction tasks. Our dataset and model training code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpatialLiDAR-QA 数据集与 SpatialLiDAR-LM 模型，将 LiDAR 点云特征对齐到大语言模型，通过语言条件的位置感知候选检索与局部点精化实现目标坐标的几何定位，在精确坐标预测上显著超越代表性 LiDAR-语言模型与多相机 VLM。
AI.motivation: LiDAR 能提供精确几何信息用于目标检测等空间感知任务，但仅识别与定位单个目标不足以回答需要组合空间关系并定位所指目标的问题。受 LLM 在自动驾驶中进展的启发，作者希望利用其语言先验来解读复杂空间问题，并在 LiDAR 几何中定位被指代的目标。
AI.method: 作者构建 SpatialLiDAR-QA，包含单步与多步关系定位任务以及补充性的空间理解任务；并提出 SpatialLiDAR-LM，将 LiDAR 点特征与 LLM 对齐，通过语言条件、位置感知的候选检索与局部点精化来定位目标坐标，使目标坐标直接来源于局部 LiDAR 几何，而非通过文本语言解码获得。
AI.result: 实验表明，在精确坐标预测任务上，该方法相较代表性 LiDAR-语言模型与多相机 VLM 取得显著提升。数据集与模型训练代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语言先验与 LiDAR 几何对齐并直接基于局部几何回归坐标，可有效支撑复杂空间关系指代定位，为 LiDAR-语言空间定位提供数据集与模型方案。

title: SplatLabel: Pseudo-Labelling through 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: While 2D Vision Foundation Models offer a pathway to automate 3D semantic pseudo-labelling, translating these priors into robust 3D representations typically requires complex heuristics or multi-model ensembles. We introduce SplatLabel, an automated pipeline that leverages a 4D Gaussian representation to extract LiDAR segmentation with predictive confidence, as well as semantic occupancy grids at arbitrary voxel resolutions. At its core, SplatLabel handles dynamic environments through an explicit temporal manifold that models the trajectories and lifespans of individual 3D primitives. This allows the system to accurately track moving actors and strictly define when objects appear and disappear, completely eliminating the need for pre-annotated 3D bounding boxes. To robustly support this dynamic tracking, the representation is grounded by structural and semantic priors: we guide scene geometry in unobserved regions by integrating 360-degree LiDAR via virtual depth maps, and rather than relying on domain-specific prompt engineering, we directly distill continuous soft probabilities from 2D models to inherently resolve semantic ambiguities over time and space. Finally, to accurately reflect the real-world trade-off between precision and recall, we reframe pseudo-label evaluation as a selective classification task using a generalized risk-recall metric. Experiments on SemanticKITTI demonstrate that SplatLabel consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple recall levels, establishing a highly robust framework for both 3D LiDAR segmentation and occupancy prediction.

AI.tldr: SplatLabel 是一个自动化流水线，利用 4D 高斯表示从 2D 视觉基础模型中提取 LiDAR 分割与任意体素分辨率的语义占据栅格，无需预标注 3D 边界框。
AI.motivation: 2D 视觉基础模型虽可用于自动化 3D 语义伪标注，但将其先验迁移为鲁棒 3D 表示通常依赖复杂启发式规则或多模型集成；同时动态环境的跟踪与目标生命周期建模困难，且伪标签评估未能反映精度-召回的真实权衡。
AI.method: 核心是显式时间流形，建模各 3D 基元的轨迹与生命周期，从而跟踪运动目标并严格界定目标出现/消失，免除 3D 边界框标注。表示由结构与语义先验支撑：通过虚拟深度图融合 360 度 LiDAR 以引导未观测区域几何；直接蒸馏 2D 模型的连续软概率以解析时空语义歧义，避免领域特定提示工程。此外将伪标签评估重构为选择性分类任务，采用广义风险-召回指标。
AI.result: 在 SemanticKITTI 上，SplatLabel 在多个召回水平下持续优于当前最优基线，验证了其在 3D LiDAR 分割与占据预测上的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SplatLabel 通过 4D 高斯表示结合时间流形与结构/语义先验，实现了无需 3D 边界框的高质量自动伪标注，并提出了更贴合实际权衡的评估范式，为 3D 分割与占据预测提供了鲁棒框架。
