title: PUBG Ally: A Conversational Embodied Agent as an AI Teammate
comment: Authors are listed alphabetically. Project leads are Kangwook Lee and Hyunseung Kim
summary: We introduce PUBG Ally, an embodied agent for PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS that can reason, act autonomously, and play alongside players as a voice-enabled teammate. Building such a teammate requires combining two difficult capabilities: it must perceive and respond to a constantly changing game world under strict latency constraints while interacting naturally with players, keeping its speech synchronized with its actions. Ally therefore combines agentic tool use with real-time game control. A language-model agent uses a controlled interface to inspect game information, interpret player speech, maintain context, decide what to say, and issue high-level action choices that steer a faster control layer for movement, combat, and recovery. Because the player's and Ally's speech and actions continually shape each other and the course of the match, training requires data from actual gameplay. We therefore collect data across nearly 39k sessions in which real players play alongside Ally, recording gameplay, player speech, agent decisions, tool use, actions, and player feedback, and use these records for iterative training. To evaluate teammate quality, we use player feedback and preference comparisons to identify gaps between offline evaluations and player preferences, and iteratively refine the evaluation criteria. Deploying Ally in live service further requires low-latency on-device execution and safeguards for player-facing communication, which we address through model compression, context compaction, targeted safety training, runtime guardrails, and memory redaction. During the live service, we surveyed players in 141 countries. Among respondents whose play with Ally was confirmed in game records, positive responses exceeded negative responses by 25.1 percentage points when asked whether they would recommend Ally, with players describing Ally not only as a tool but also as a teammate or companion.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍 PUBG Ally——一个面向战术竞技游戏的具身智能体，可作为语音队友与玩家协同游玩，融合实时游戏控制与语言模型智能体工具调用，并通过近3.9万局真实对局数据迭代训练与评估，最终上线服务并获玩家正向反馈。
AI.motivation: 构建游戏内 AI 队友需同时攻克两大难题：在严格延迟约束下感知并响应动态变化的游戏世界，以及与玩家自然交互并使语音与行动保持同步。传统离线评估与玩家真实偏好存在差距，且上线服务还面临低延迟端侧部署与玩家沟通安全等挑战。
AI.method: Ally 采用分层架构：语言模型智能体通过受控接口查看游戏信息、理解玩家语音、维护上下文、决定说话内容并输出高层动作选择，驱动更快的控制层完成移动、战斗与恢复。训练依赖真实对局数据，采集近3.9万局真实玩家与 Ally 同玩会话，记录玩法、玩家语音、智能体决策、工具调用、动作及玩家反馈用于迭代训练。评估采用玩家反馈与偏好比较，识别离线评估与玩家偏好间的差距并迭代细化评估标准。部署方面通过模型压缩、上下文压缩、针对性安全训练、运行时护栏与记忆脱敏实现低延迟端侧执行和玩家沟通防护。
AI.result: Ally 在线上服务中对141个国家玩家进行调研，在游戏记录确认与 Ally 同玩的受访者中，被问及是否推荐 Ally 时，正向回应比负向回应高出25.1个百分点；玩家不仅将 Ally 视为工具，更将其描述为队友或伙伴。
AI.conclusion: 结合智能体工具使用与实时游戏控制，并以真实对局数据迭代训练的具身语音队友方案可行且获玩家认可；通过端侧低延迟优化与多重安全机制可支撑其线上规模化部署，同时揭示了离线评估需向玩家偏好对齐的评估范式。

title: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly non-linear components, in this work we demonstrate that they exhibit fundamental linearity: when inputs from distinct text streams are linearly combined, the model outputs a superposition of the individual next-token distributions. We term this the \textit{Superposition Linearity Hypothesis}. We provide evidence that superposition is an intrinsic property of the Transformer architecture rather than an emergent consequence of training; in fact, we observe that it tends to diminish as pretraining progresses. However, we demonstrate that linearity can be substantially restored through lightweight fine-tuning, significantly reducing the divergence between the predicted next-token distribution and the average of the individual next-token distributions. Finally, we introduce a guided decoding procedure that disentangles superposed outputs, enabling the simultaneous generation of two coherent continuations from a single forward pass.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"叠加线性假说"，论证Transformer存在固有的线性叠加特性，并可经微调恢复、用于引导解码实现双续写生成。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型由高度非线性组件构成，通常被认为整体行为是非线性的。作者希望探究这种非线性表象之下是否隐藏着基本的线性结构，尤其是当不同文本流的输入被线性组合时，模型输出是否呈现可预测的叠加性质。这一问题的动机在于：若存在线性，将有助于理解LLM内部表征与计算机制，并为高效解码、可控生成提供新的操作手段。
AI.method: 1) 提出"叠加线性假说"（Superposition Linearity Hypothesis）：将来自不同文本流的输入线性组合后，模型输出的下一词分布近似为各单独分布的平均/叠加。2) 通过实验检验该性质的来源，认为其是Transformer架构的内在属性而非训练涌现的结果。3) 观察叠加线性随预训练进程的变化趋势。4) 采用轻量微调（lightweight fine-tuning）以显著恢复线性，降低预测分布与个体分布平均之间的散度。5) 设计引导解码（guided decoding）流程，对叠加输出进行解耦，从单次前向传播中同时生成两个连贯续写。
AI.result: 1) 模型输出确实表现出叠加线性：输入线性组合时，下一词分布近似为各分布的平均。2) 该性质源于Transformer架构本身，而非训练涌现；且随预训练推进，线性倾向会减弱。3) 轻量微调可显著恢复线性，明显缩小预测分布与个体分布平均之间的差异。4) 引导解码能够解耦叠加输出，实现单次前向传播生成两条连贯续写。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型虽由非线性组件构成，但存在可被利用的基本线性叠加结构；该结构源于架构本身，会随预训练减弱，却可通过轻量微调恢复。基于此性质的引导解码可高效地从一个前向过程中生成多个连贯续写，为理解和控制LLM提供新视角与新工具。

title: Encoded but Not Decoded: Layer-Localized Evidence for a Three-Level Gap in LLM Syntax
summary: A language model can fail a syntactic test in two distinct ways: by not encoding the relevant structure, or by encoding it but failing to use it at the output. Behavioral evaluation alone cannot tell these apart. We propose a three-level evaluation framework (behavioral deployment, LM-head readout, and probe recoverability) measured on the same items under the same binary decision. Using a compact trilingual (English, Chinese, German) control-dependency benchmark, we find that probe recoverability exceeds or equals LM-head readout, which in turn exceeds or equals behavioral deployment, across seven models and all three languages in the aggregate. The recoverability surplus is never negative across all 14 (model, task) conditions. The disconnect concentrates in subject-control, where a nearest-noun heuristic gives the wrong answer. The single largest gap (0.653) appears on Qwen3-0.6B Instruct in question answering. The gap persists at Qwen3-14B Instruct. Instruction tuning degrades deployment more than encoding in percentage terms. We rule out option-position bias, late-layer erasure, output-formatting artifacts, and probe-training variance. The pattern is consistent with decoding that favors surface shortcuts, and the behavior-probe gap measures the strength of that preference. Activation patching shows the gap is layer-localized. Under instruction tuning, the LM-head-decoded layer shifts approximately ten layers later than the probe-decoded layer. These findings argue that behavioral evaluation understates what models encode, while probing alone overstates what they deploy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出三层评估框架（行为表现、LM-head读出、探针可恢复性），在同一批条目、同一二元判定下测量，发现模型编码的句法结构多于其部署使用的部分。
AI.motivation: 行为评估无法区分语言模型句法测试失败的两种成因：未编码相关结构，还是编码了但在输出阶段未使用。需要一种能分离"编码"与"部署"的评估手段。
AI.method: 提出三层评估框架——行为部署（behavioral deployment）、LM-head读出、探针可恢复性（probe recoverability），在同一批条目和同一二元决策下测量。使用紧凑的三语（英、中、德）控制依存基准，覆盖七个模型、三种语言，共14个（模型，任务）条件；辅以激活修补（activation patching）定位层级，并排除选项位置偏差、后层擦除、输出格式伪影与探针训练方差等干扰因素。
AI.result: 总体上探针可恢复性 ≥ LM-head读出 ≥ 行为部署，14个条件中可恢复性盈余均为非负。断层集中在主语控制（subject-control），最近名词启发式会给出错误答案。最大差距0.653出现在Qwen3-0.6B Instruct的问答任务上，且在Qwen3-14B Instruct上依然存在。指令微调对部署的削弱（百分比）大于对编码的削弱。激活修补显示该差距具有层级局部性；指令微调下LM-head解码层比探针解码层后移约十层。
AI.conclusion: 行为评估低估了模型所编码的内容，而仅用探针又高估了模型所部署的内容。该模式与解码偏好表层捷径一致，行为-探针差距度量了这种偏好的强度。

title: BeyondRetarget: Learning Executable Humanoid Motions Directly from Monocular Video
summary: Learning executable motions from human videos offers a scalable solution for humanoid robots to acquire demonstration motions. However, existing pipelines typically first construct an explicit human motion representation and then convert it into robot motions via motion retargeting. Although such methods can effectively leverage large volumes of existing human data for training, the substantial differences between humans and humanoid robots in locomotion mechanisms and joint degree-of-freedom configurations make motions generated by this human-representation-centric approach difficult to execute on robots. Furthermore, errors introduced during human motion estimation inevitably propagate to the retargeting stage and cannot be eliminated via joint optimization. We propose BeyondRetarget, an end-to-end framework that directly maps monocular RGB videos to robot motions. Discarding the explicit human representation, this framework learns robot-oriented implicit representations directly from visual observations, enabling the model to capture cross-morphology motion structures. To generate motions more suitable for robot execution, we further design a contact-aware motion optimization mechanism to improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility. Experiments show that BeyondRetarget significantly improves the accuracy and robustness of generated robot motions, while achieving higher execution success rates and lower latency in both simulation environments and real humanoid robots.

AI.tldr: 提出BeyondRetarget端到端框架，直接将单目RGB视频映射为人形机器人运动，摒弃显式人体表征转而学习面向机器人的隐式表征，并设计接触感知运动优化机制，在仿真与真机上实现更高精度、鲁棒性和执行成功率及更低延迟。
AI.motivation: 从人类视频学习可执行运动是人形机器人获取示范运动的可扩展方案，但现有流程先构建显式人体运动表征、再经运动重定向转换为机器人运动。由于人与机器人在运动机理与关节自由度配置上差异巨大，这种以人体表征为中心的方法生成的机器人动作难以执行；且人体运动估计误差会传播至重定向阶段，联合优化也无法消除。
AI.method: BeyondRetarget为端到端框架，直接从单目RGB视频映射到机器人运动。它舍弃显式人体表征，从视觉观测中直接学习面向机器人的隐式表征，使模型能捕捉跨形态的运动结构；并设计接触感知运动优化机制，以提升时间一致性与物理合理性。
AI.result: 实验表明，BeyondRetarget显著提升生成机器人运动的准确性与鲁棒性，在仿真环境和真实人形机器人上均获得更高的执行成功率和更低的延迟。
AI.conclusion: 通过端到端、面向机器人的隐式表征学习并辅以接触感知优化，可绕开显式人体表征与运动重定向带来的形态差异与误差传播问题，为从人类视频获取人形机器人可执行运动提供更有效的路径。

title: Multi-Task Learning by using Contextualized Word Representations for Syntactic Parsing of a Morphologically Rich Language
summary: We address the challenge of syntactic parsing for Urdu, a morphologically rich language, and present state-of-the-art results for both constituency and dependency parsing. This paper offers four major contributions: 1) the conversion of the CLE-UTB phrase structure treebank into a dependency treebank by developing language-specific head-word and phrase-to-dependency label mapping rules; 2) a novel sequence labeling scheme that transforms the parsing task into a unified representation; 3) the training of contextualized word representations on a large 220 million tokens Urdu corpus collected from the web; and 4) development of parsing framework using two learning paradigms, single-task and multi-task learning. Several post-processing rules are applied to improve the quality of the automatically converted dependency structure treebank. The proposed sequence labeling scheme enables the use of a shared architecture that learns the syntactic structures from both grammatical structures simultaneously and hence improves generalization. Experiments show that the multi-task learning setup significantly enhances parsing performance, achieving an F1 score of 91.39 for constituency parsing (an improvement of 3.29 points) and a labeled attachment score of 85.69 for dependency parsing (an improvement of 1.49 points). These results demonstrate that learning cross-task representations provides measurable benefits and advances the state of syntactic parsing for Urdu.

AI.tldr: 本文针对乌尔都语句法分析，构建依存树库、提出统一序列标注方案、训练上下文词表示，并采用多任务学习框架，取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 乌尔都语形态丰富，句法分析具有挑战性，现有成分句法与依存句法分析结果有待提升。
AI.method: 四项贡献：1) 通过语言相关中心词和短语到依存标签映射规则，将CLE-UTB短语结构树库转为依存树库；2) 提出将句法分析转为统一表示的序列标注方案；3) 在2.2亿词网络乌尔都语语料上训练上下文词表示；4) 构建单任务与多任务两种学习范式的分析框架，并施后处理规则提升自动转换依存树库质量。
AI.result: 多任务学习显著提升性能：成分句法F1为91.39（提升3.29点），依存句法LAS为85.69（提升1.49点）。
AI.conclusion: 跨任务表示学习带来可量化收益，推进了乌尔都语句法分析水平。

title: Modelling dynamic systems transfer functions from events in computational neuromorphic imaging
summary: Event Vision Sensing (EVS) report threshold crossings of log-irradiance, so a static optical system imaging a static scene produces no output at all. The classical procedure for measuring a Point Spread Function (PSF), illuminating the system with a constant point source, therefore has no event-based equivalent: the probe must carry a temporal profile, and that profile becomes part of the measurement. A growing body of Computational Neuromorphic Imaging (CNI) work already exploits this, pairing engineered or modulated optics with event sensing, but each system adopts a particular excitation together with a particular reading of the event stream without the correspondence between the two being stated. We examine that correspondence directly within a analytical framework of an Linear Shift-Invariant (LSI) optical system with a specified Modulation Transfer Function (MTF), a first-order filter EVS pixel model, and three different temporal probes: a step function, a linear ramp and an exponential ramp. By analysing the inverse of the entire chain for different event-statistic, and comparing the results to the specified MTF, we identify the context where each probe is most relevant. We consider how photon-noise and cross-array threshold mismatch effects the analytical accuracy of the probe-inverse. Results show that the widely used step probe is highly susceptible to mismatch while resilient to photon shot-noise, while a linear rise probe and exponential rise probe retain their ability to infer signal levels even with high mismatch. We discuss the potential of dynamic-PSFs as components of a full forward operator from scene to events. In this, we use this analytical description to define dynamic-PSFs around EVS, and discuss the gaps toward a unified pixel model and a scene-composition framework required for CNI.

AI.tldr: 本文在LSI光学系统、一阶滤波EVS像素模型框架下，分析阶跃、线性斜坡与指数斜坡三种时间探针的逆问题，指出阶跃探针对阈值失配敏感但抗光子散粒噪声，线性/指数斜坡探针在高失配下仍可推断信号，并提出动态PSF作为场景到事件完整前向算子的组件。
AI.motivation: 事件视觉传感器仅在log-irradiance发生阈值穿越时输出，因此静态系统对静态场景无输出，经典恒定点源测量PSF的方法在事件域没有对应形式：探针必须携带时间轮廓，而该轮廓本身成为测量的一部分。现有计算神经形态成像工作虽已结合工程化/调制光学与事件传感，但各自采用特定激励与特定事件流解读方式，二者之间的对应关系未被明确阐述。本文旨在直接考察这一对应关系。
AI.method: 构建解析框架：线性移不变（LSI）光学系统并给定调制传递函数（MTF）、一阶滤波EVS像素模型，以及三种时间探针（阶跃函数、线性斜坡、指数斜坡）。对整条链路的逆进行不同事件统计量的分析，并将结果与指定MTF比较，以确定各探针最适用的情境。同时考察光子噪声与跨阵列阈值失配对探针逆解析精度的影响。
AI.result: 结果表明：广泛使用的阶跃探针对阈值失配高度敏感，但对光子散粒噪声具有鲁棒性；线性上升探针与指数上升探针即使在高失配条件下仍能保持推断信号水平的能力。分析还给出了不同探针-事件统计量组合与MTF恢复之间的适用边界。
AI.conclusion: 本文将动态PSF作为场景到事件完整前向算子的潜在组件进行讨论，利用该解析描述围绕EVS定义动态PSF，并指出实现计算神经形态成像所需的统一像素模型与场景合成框架仍存在的差距。

title: Efficient Continuous DEM Reconstruction under Limited Target-Resolution Supervision
summary: High-resolution digital elevation models (DEMs) support Earth observation applications, but paired training references are often available only at coarser output resolutions. Reconstructing finer terrain grids therefore requires both effective transfer beyond the supervised scale and control of dense-query computation. To address this problem, SCOPE learns a continuous terrain representation from coarser-resolution pairs. It predicts a latent coefficient field on the low-resolution grid and reuses local Fourier residual functions through basis evaluation and geometry-guided ensemble fusion. This separates high-dimensional coefficient prediction from output-grid construction. Experiments on geographically distributed land--ocean samples assess supervised reconstruction, unseen-scale inference, cross-domain generalization, and theoretical computation. SCOPE leads the compared methods across six metrics in the main supervised-scale evaluation. At an unseen factor three times the training factor, land reconstruction reduces RMSE and MAE by approximately 12\% relative to bicubic interpolation, with errors close to target-scale fine-tuning. Ninefold output density increases counted multiply--accumulate operations by only about 2\%. Frozen-model validation on held-out external marine regions reduces RMSE relative to the DEM-specific implicit baseline EBCF-CDEM by approximately 19\% under self-downsampling and 2\% with cross-product inputs, while also yielding lower RMSE than LIIF-MS in both settings. These results demonstrate the value of reusable coefficient fields for accurate reconstruction beyond the supervised resolution with low incremental arithmetic cost.

AI.tldr: SCOPE通过从粗分辨率DEM配对中学习连续地形表示，将隐系数场预测与输出网格构建解耦，在高分辨率重建、跨尺度推理与跨域泛化上优于对比方法，且增量算力开销极低。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率数字高程模型（DEM）对地观测应用很重要，但配对训练参考通常仅在较粗的输出分辨率上可获得。因此，在监督尺度之外重建更精细地形网格，需要同时实现有效的跨尺度迁移与稠密查询计算量的控制。
AI.method: SCOPE从粗分辨率配对中学习连续地形表示：在低分辨率网格上预测隐系数场，并通过基函数求值与几何引导的集成融合复用局部傅里叶残差函数，从而将高维系数的预测与输出网格构建分离。
AI.result: 在主监督尺度评估中，SCOPE在六项指标上均领先对比方法。在训练倍率三倍的未见尺度上，陆地重建相对双三次插值的RMSE与MAE约降低12%，误差接近目标尺度微调；输出密度增至九倍时，乘加运算量仅增加约2%。冻结模型在外部海洋留出区域验证中，自下采样设置下相对DEM专用隐式基线EBCF-CDEM的RMSE约降低19%，跨产品输入下约降低2%，两种设置下RMSE均低于LIIF-MS。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可复用的系数场能够以较低的增量算术成本，实现超越监督分辨率的精确重建。

title: When Can Agents Forget Their Reasoning? ICLR for Long-Horizon Agent Context Compression
summary: Long horizon language model agents continually accumulate reasoning history, increasing context length and inference cost even after earlier decisions have been executed and observed. Unlike static Chain of Thought compression, removing historical reasoning can change future actions and the resulting interaction trajectory. We study when such reasoning can be safely forgotten. We propose Interaction Aware Compression for Long Horizon Reasoning (ICLR), a training free online method that ranks reasoning blocks using frozen proxy entropy while preserving actions, tool calls, and observations. On 260 WorkBuddyBench tasks, ICLR improves average reward from 0.699 to 0.718, while reducing input, output, and cache read tokens by 25.5%, 14.4%, and 33.3%, respectively. Ablations reveal trajectory amplification, where local reasoning deletion produces nonlinear changes in total computation by altering subsequent interaction. Representation probing, activation patching, and controlled trajectory analyses further suggest that historical reasoning becomes more replaceable once task relevant derived state has been reliably externalized into code, files, tool outputs, or environmental feedback. These results characterize agent reasoning as dynamic working state rather than permanent interaction history.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练在线压缩方法 ICLR，利用冻结代理熵对推理块排序，在保留动作、工具调用与观察的前提下安全遗忘历史推理，从而在不损失甚至提升奖励的同时显著降低长程智能体的上下文与推理成本。
AI.motivation: 长程语言模型智能体持续累积推理历史，导致上下文长度与推理开销不断增长，即便早期决策已被执行和观察。与静态思维链压缩不同，删除历史推理会改变未来动作和交互轨迹，因此需要研究"何时可以安全遗忘推理"这一问题。
AI.method: 提出 Interaction Aware Compression for Long Horizon Reasoning（ICLR），一种免训练的在线方法：使用冻结代理熵（frozen proxy entropy）对推理块进行排序，在压缩时保留动作、工具调用与观察，仅对可替换的历史推理进行删除。并通过消融、表征探测、激活修补与受控轨迹分析进行验证。
AI.result: 在 260 个 WorkBuddyBench 任务上，ICLR 将平均奖励从 0.699 提升至 0.718，同时将输入、输出与缓存读取 token 分别减少 25.5%、14.4% 与 33.3%。消融实验揭示"轨迹放大"现象：局部推理删除会通过改变后续交互而对总计算量产生非线性影响。
AI.conclusion: 表征探测、激活修补与受控轨迹分析表明，一旦任务相关的派生状态被可靠地外化到代码、文件、工具输出或环境反馈中，历史推理就变得更可替换。这些结果将智能体推理刻画为动态工作状态，而非永久保留的交互历史。

title: MILO: Efficient Many-shot In-Context Learning with Block-wise Low-rank Compression
summary: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to complex tasks by conditioning on thousands of demonstration examples, but this paradigm shifts the inference efficiency bottleneck to the key-value (KV) cache memory. Due to the linear scaling behavior of the KV cache, storing these intermediate tensors has become a paramount challenge for both online serving and on-device deployment. To address this issue, we propose a novel compression framework, termed MILO, that exploits the low-rank redundancy inherent in many-shot contexts. Specifically, MILO features a block-wise low-rank compression strategy that compresses the KV cache at the block granularity, where each block contains multiple many-shot examples. Furthermore, to handle the heterogeneous context density across different blocks, MILO dynamically allocates rank budgets based on the information entropy, preserving the fidelity of critical blocks while aggressively compressing redundant ones. Experimental results on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that our method achieves up to 50% reduction in KV cache memory and 1.8x throughput improvement, with negligible performance degradation on classification and reasoning benchmarks, significantly outperforming prior baselines.

AI.tldr: MILO：一种基于分块低秩压缩与熵驱动动态秩分配的KV cache压缩框架，用于缓解many-shot ICL的推理内存瓶颈。
AI.motivation: many-shot ICL让LLM通过上千个示例适配复杂任务，但推理效率瓶颈转移到KV cache内存；KV cache随序列长度线性增长，成为在线服务与端侧部署的主要挑战。
AI.method: MILO利用many-shot上下文中固有的低秩冗余：1）块级低秩压缩策略，以块为粒度压缩KV cache，每块包含多个many-shot示例；2）针对不同块间上下文密度异质性，基于信息熵动态分配秩预算，保留关键块保真度，同时激进压缩冗余块。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5模型上，KV cache内存最多减少50%，吞吐量提升1.8倍，分类与推理基准上性能下降可忽略，显著优于既有基线。
AI.conclusion: MILO通过分块低秩压缩与熵驱动秩分配，有效压缩many-shot ICL场景下的KV cache，在内存、吞吐与精度间取得良好权衡。

title: Cultural Divergence Preservation: Diagnosing Flattening and Caricature in LLM-Simulated Survey Populations
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Pluralistic AI & NLP (PANDORA)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents to estimate population response distributions. In cross-cultural survey simulation, evaluations should assess not only distributional fidelity within countries but also whether differences across countries are preserved. However, existing distance-based metrics such as Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) do not directly capture such cross-country differences. To address this limitation, we introduce Cultural Divergence Preservation (CDP), a reference-light diagnostic based on a one-time human calibration. CDP identifies reduced cross-country divergence as cultural flattening and increased divergence as cultural caricature. To evaluate CDP, we conduct experiments across four LLM backbones, three persona-based prompting methods, and two survey domains, the World Values Survey (WVS) and the Big Five Personality Test. The results reveal a systematic discrepancy between conventional fidelity metrics and CDP. Controlled experiments show that CDP changes monotonically as cross-country divergence is attenuated or amplified, while the corresponding changes in JSD remain relatively small. In our audit of real LLM generations, DeepPersona-Inspired prompting is frequently favored by conventional fidelity metrics but exhibits the strongest flattening in every model--domain block. CDP thus complements fidelity metrics by directly quantifying the attenuation or amplification of cross-country divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出文化分歧保持度（CDP）指标，用于诊断LLM跨文化调查模拟中跨国差异被削弱（文化扁平化）或夸大（文化漫画化）的问题，弥补JSD等距离指标无法直接刻画跨国差异的缺陷。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作合成调查受访者来估计人群回答分布。跨文化模拟评估不仅需衡量各国内部的分布保真度，还须检验跨国差异是否被保留。但JSD等基于距离的指标并不直接捕捉跨国差异，导致评估维度缺失。
AI.method: 提出CDP，一种基于一次性人工校准的轻参考诊断指标：将跨国分歧减弱识别为文化扁平化，增强识别为文化漫画化。在4个LLM骨干、3种基于人设的提示方法、2个调查域（WVS与Big Five）上开展实验，并进行受控实验检验CDP随跨国分歧衰减/放大的单调变化。
AI.result: 结果显示传统保真度指标与CDP之间存在系统性差异。受控实验中，当跨国分歧被衰减或放大时，CDP单调变化，而JSD变化相对很小。在真实生成审计中，DeepPersona-Inspired提示常被传统指标青睐，但在每个模型—领域组合中都表现出最强的扁平化。
AI.conclusion: CDP通过直接量化跨国分歧的衰减或放大，对保真度指标形成补充，为跨文化调查模拟提供更全面的评估视角。

title: EndoFSA: Endoscopic Few-Shot Image Generation via Rank-Constrained Parameter Adaptation
comment: Presented at the 39th IEEE International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems (CBMS 2026), June 2026
summary: WCE produces large-scale gastrointestinal image data yet pathological findings remain significantly underrepresented limiting the generalization performance of deep-learning based abnormality detection systems. SDG methods offer a practical solution to mitigate this imbalance. However their training directly on scarce abnormal samples often results in instability overfitting and structural distortions. Addressing these challenges requires controlled adaptation mechanisms that preserve anatomical priors while enabling realistic pathological variation. This paper presents EndoFSA a GAN-based model for Endoscopic Few-Shot image generation by Adaptation in WCE imaging. EndoFSA leverages a generator pretrained on abundant normal data and adapts it to abnormal domains using limited number of training samples through a rank-constrained parameter adaptation where only a small number of modulation parameters is updated while the pretrained weights remain frozen. By restricting parameter updates to a low dimensional subspace and incorporating perceptual boundary regularization and cluster-wise diversity control EndoFSA enables efficient model adaptation under limited data conditions and mitigates mode collapse while preserving the anatomical priors learned from normal data. Importantly EndoFSA operates without requiring pixel-level annotations, masks or bounding box supervision. Evaluation on publicly available WCE benchmark datasets spanning various abnormal categories demonstrates that EndoFSA generates abnormal images reproducing real lesions morphology. Moreover in a downstream classification task training an image classifier solely on synthetic abnormal images generated by EndoFSA yields performance comparable to that obtained with real images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EndoFSA，一种基于GAN的WCE内镜少样本异常图像生成模型：在正常数据预训练生成器基础上，仅通过秩约束的低维调制参数适配到异常域，并结合感知边界正则与簇级多样性控制，在无像素级标注条件下实现稳定、多样的病变图像合成。
AI.motivation: WCE可产生大规模胃肠道图像，但病理阳性样本严重不足，导致基于深度学习的异常检测系统泛化性受限。合成数据生成（SDG）可缓解类别不平衡，但直接在稀缺异常样本上训练易出现不稳定、过拟合与结构失真。因此需要一种在保留解剖先验的同时实现真实病理变化的受控适配机制。
AI.method: 提出EndoFSA：1）使用在充足正常数据上预训练的GAN生成器，冻结预训练权重；2）通过秩约束参数适配，仅更新少量调制参数，将更新限制在低维子空间，实现少样本异常域适配；3）引入感知边界正则化与簇级多样性控制，缓解模式坍塌并保持由正常数据学到的解剖先验；4）全程无需像素级标注、掩码或边界框监督。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种异常类别的公开WCE基准数据集上评估，EndoFSA可生成复现真实病变形态的异常图像；在下游分类任务中，仅使用EndoFSA生成的合成异常图像训练分类器，性能可与使用真实图像训练相媲美。
AI.conclusion: EndoFSA通过低维秩约束适配与正则化设计，在极少异常样本和无像素级监督下实现了稳定的内镜少样本异常图像生成，有效保留解剖先验并提升多样性，生成的合成数据可作为真实数据的有效替代用于下游异常检测/分类任务。

title: It's the Geometry, Not the Model: Effective Rank and Subspace Alignment in Functional Connectivity Classification
summary: Resting-state functional connectivity (FC) is widely used to classify brain phenotypes and disorders. Most pipelines use the full connectome and seek gains through model design. We instead examine how FC geometry constrains classification and cross-site transfer. Across-subject FC variation concentrates in a small effective subspace, suggesting substantial redundancy in nominal dimensions. Across cohorts, these subspaces may differ in orientation even when their effective ranks are comparable, potentially limiting transfer. Across 2,330 subjects from HCP, ABIDE, and ADHD-200, effective-rank analysis reveals strong spectral concentration. Projection onto leading components at the effective-rank scale recovers most of the full-FC classification performance. In ABIDE, site-specific effective subspaces are weakly aligned, and their principal-angle overlap predicts pairwise transfer after covariate adjustment despite comparable per-site effective ranks. Controlled rotations that alter subspace orientation while preserving the mean and covariance spectrum drive transfer toward chance, whereas displacement-matched label-orthogonal rotations do not. These results identify subspace orientation as a key factor in transfer degradation under controlled perturbations. This study offers a geometric diagnostic of FC generalization and suggests evaluating cross-site harmonization by its ability to align effective subspaces alongside classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究从"几何"视角剖析静息态功能连接（FC）分类与跨站点迁移：FC变异集中于低维有效子空间，投影到该子空间即可恢复大部分分类性能；但不同队列的有效子空间取向（而非有效秩）差异显著，取向错位是迁移性能下降的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 现有FC分类流程大多使用全连接组（full connectome），并通过模型设计追求性能提升，较少关注FC数据本身的几何结构如何限制分类上限与跨站点泛化。作者希望回答：FC的几何结构（有效维度与子空间取向）在多大程度上约束分类性能与跨站点迁移，从而为FC泛化能力提供几何层面的诊断依据。
AI.method: 在HCP、ABIDE、ADHD-200共2,330名被试上开展有效秩（effective-rank）分析，考察FC变异的谱集中性；将FC投影到有效秩尺度的主成分上并比较其与全FC的分类性能；在ABIDE中分析各站点有效子空间的对齐程度，用主夹角（principal angles）度量子空间重叠，并在协变量校正后检验其与成对跨站点迁移的关系；进一步通过受控旋转（保持均值与协方差谱不变、仅改变子空间取向）以及位移匹配的标签正交旋转作为对照，检验取向变化对迁移的影响。
AI.result: 跨被试FC变异高度集中：谱能量集中于少数有效维度，表明名义维度存在大量冗余。在有效秩尺度上投影到前若干主成分，即可恢复全FC分类性能的大部分。ABIDE中各站点的有效子空间对齐程度较弱，尽管各站点有效秩相近；在协变量校正后，主夹角重叠能预测成对站点间的迁移表现。受控旋转实验显示，在保持均值与协方差谱不变的前提下改变子空间取向会使迁移退化至接近随机水平，而位移匹配的标签正交旋转则不产生该效应。
AI.conclusion: FC分类的信息主要位于低维有效子空间，其取向差异（而非有效秩差异）是跨站点迁移退化的关键因素。研究提供了一种FC泛化的几何诊断工具，并建议在评估跨站点协调（harmonization）方法时，除分类精度外还应考察其对齐有效子空间的能力。

title: An Empirical Study of VLM Pipelines for Long-Document QA
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for long-document processing, where the inputs combine text with charts, tables, figures, and complex layouts. Deploying them means choosing how to feed the document to the model, which retriever to use when only a subset of pages is sent, and whether to run the model agentically or as a static pipeline. We study these choices on two long-document QA benchmarks with both frontier API and open-weight VLMs. First, on MMLongBench-Doc our six-tool agent with page, table, figure, and search calls pays off only once the answering VLM is large enough: with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B it trails static page input, with Qwen3.5-27B it draws level, and with Sonnet 4.5 it leads. On LongDocURL it is level with or ahead of static input at every reader. Its lead over the strongest static pipeline is clearest with the frontier reader on MMLongBench-Doc and narrows to within noise on LongDocURL. Second, retrieval modality matters more than the specific retriever: the strongest image retriever leads the strongest text pipeline, and on the text side a single off-the-shelf cross-encoder rerank essentially matches a much heavier multi-stage LLM pipeline. Top-k image retrieval is also the most token-efficient input at every reader we paired it with, at roughly a seventh to a quarter of the tokens of sending every page. Third, cutting across all three choices, three of our strongest pipelines succeed on different questions, and an oracle that picks the best pipeline per question gains roughly thirteen points over the best single pipeline, though evidence-type routing recovers almost none of it.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了长文档问答中视觉语言模型的三种部署选择：文档输入方式、检索器选择、以及静态流水线vs智能体式调用，发现智能体增益依赖模型规模，检索模态比具体检索器更关键，且不同流水线互补性强但难以路由。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型被越来越多用于长文档处理，输入包含文本、图表、表格与复杂版式。部署时需决定：如何向模型输入文档、仅发送部分页面时选用哪种检索器、以及采用智能体式还是静态流水线。这些选择缺乏系统性研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在两个长文档问答基准（MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL）上，同时使用前沿API模型与开放权重VLM进行对比实验。构建含页面、表格、图像与搜索六种工具调用的智能体，对比静态页面输入；比较图像检索与文本检索模态及不同检索器（含单阶段cross-encoder重排与多阶段LLM流水线）；并以oracle按问题选择最优流水线，评估证据类型路由的效果。
AI.result: 其一，MMLongBench-Doc上智能体仅在回答VLM足够大时才有增益：Qwen3.5-4B/9B落后静态输入，27B持平，Sonnet 4.5领先；LongDocURL上各reader持平或领先。其二，检索模态比具体检索器更重要，最强图像检索器优于最强文本流水线，单阶段cross-encoder重排约等于重型多阶段LLM流水线；Top-k图像检索token效率最高，约为全页输入的1/7至1/4。其三，最强流水线在不同问题上互补，oracle每问选最优流水线比最佳单流水线提升约13个百分点，但证据类型路由几乎无法回收该增益。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式调用的收益依赖回答模型能力规模；检索模态的选择比检索器本身更关键；不同流水线间存在强互补性但现有路由方法难以有效利用，表明长文档VLM部署需在模型规模、检索模态与流水线编排间进行权衡。

title: Beyond Spatial Benchmarks: From Spatial Reasoning to Navigation
summary: Does progress on spatial reasoning benchmarks translate into better navigation? Existing benchmarks test isolated inferences from images or videos, with little connection to downstream navigation. Our analysis reveals a gap between benchmark-oriented spatial specialization and navigation performance, and shows how aligning spatial supervision with navigation goals, phases, and decision learning improves navigation. Guided by these findings, we build \textsc{Spatial-Nav-100K} and fine-tune in two stages, \textit{i.e.} first learning a shared spatial-navigation foundation, and then specializing each phase with the abilities it relies on. We further introduce Spatial-NPD, where a teacher conditioned on spatial priors produces grounded action preferences and distills them into a student policy, so no explicit spatial reasoning is needed at inference. With 45 A100 GPU-hours of policy training, our 8B model reaches SR/SPL of 77.4/35.4 on HM3D-v0.2, 60.2/30.5 on HM3D-v0.1, and 47.9/20.6 on train-unseen MP3D. It outperforms several systems that rely on closed-source models or thousands of GPU-hours of training, at 148 ms per action step. All code and datasets will be publicly available at https://github.com/ylwhxht/Spatial-Nav.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示空间推理基准与导航性能之间的差距，提出将空间监督与导航目标、阶段和决策学习对齐的方法，构建Spatial-Nav-100K数据集并采用两阶段微调，同时提出Spatial-NPD将空间先验蒸馏为学生策略，使8B模型在多个导航基准上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准仅测试图像或视频中的孤立推理，与下游导航任务联系薄弱，导致基准导向的空间专精与导航性能之间存在差距，亟需研究如何将空间监督与导航需求对齐以提升导航能力。
AI.method: 构建Spatial-Nav-100K数据集，采用两阶段微调：先学习共享的空间-导航基础，再针对各导航阶段所需能力进行专门化。提出Spatial-NPD方法，由教师模型基于空间先验生成有依据的动作偏好，并蒸馏到学生策略中，使推理时无需显式空间推理。
AI.result: 8B模型仅用45 A100 GPU小时进行策略训练，在HM3D-v0.2上达到SR/SPL为77.4/35.4，HM3D-v0.1上为60.2/30.5，train-unseen MP3D上为47.9/20.6，每步动作耗时148 ms，性能优于依赖闭源模型或数千GPU小时训练的系统。
AI.conclusion: 将空间监督与导航目标、阶段及决策学习对齐可有效提升导航性能，且通过空间先验蒸馏可避免推理时的显式空间推理，以较低训练成本超越现有系统，代码与数据集将公开。

title: Mind What Matters for Reasoning: Aligning Cross-Modal Attention via Selective Probability Mass Concentration
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on visual reasoning tasks, yet remain prone to hallucinations and over-reliance on language priors, often generating answers without adequately using task-relevant visual evidence. Existing approaches primarily improve reasoning through reasoning-oriented supervision or inference-time strategies. In this work, we study a complementary question: can multimodal reasoning be improved by strengthening implicit visual grounding without directly supervising the reasoning process? Motivated by the functional specialization of attention heads, we investigate whether reasoning can be improved by guiding only the heads most responsive to visual evidence grounding. We propose Selective Probability Mass Concentration (sPMC), a training framework that identifies grounding-responsive heads and selectively regularizes their text-to-image attention. sPMC treats normalized attention over visual tokens as a spatial probability distribution and encourages the probability mass to be assigned to semantically relevant regions using segmentation-derived spatial priors. Adaptive Head Selection restricts this guidance to visually responsive heads while leaving the remaining heads unconstrained to preserve their complementary functions. Across 6 multimodal benchmark suites, sPMC achieves an average zero-shot improvement of 3% and gains of up to 11.3% across multiple MLLMs while regularizing only 3%-15% of their attention heads. These results demonstrate that targeted guidance of sparse and implicit visual evidence pathways can directly improve multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出sPMC训练框架，通过识别对视觉证据敏感的注意力头并选择性正则化其文本到图像注意力，在不直接监督推理过程的情况下增强隐式视觉 grounding，从而提升多模态大模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在视觉推理任务上表现虽强，但仍易产生幻觉并过度依赖语言先验，常在未充分利用任务相关视觉证据的情况下生成答案。已有方法主要通过推理导向的监督或推理时策略改进推理，本文则研究一个互补问题：能否通过强化隐式视觉 grounding 来提升多模态推理，而不直接监督推理过程。
AI.method: 受注意力头功能专门化启发，作者提出 Selective Probability Mass Concentration（sPMC）训练框架。该方法将视觉 token 上的归一化注意力视为空间概率分布，利用分割导出的空间先验鼓励概率质量分配至语义相关区域；并通过 Adaptive Head Selection 将该指导限制在视觉响应强的注意力头上，其余头不加约束以保留其互补功能。
AI.result: 在 6 个多模态基准套件上，sPMC 在多个 MLLMs 上取得平均 3% 的零样本提升，最高提升达 11.3%，且仅正则化 3%-15% 的注意力头。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对稀疏且隐式的视觉证据通路进行定向引导，可直接改善多模态推理能力。

title: Augur: A Synthetic Decision Lab for Rehearsing Reactions to Product and Policy Changes
summary: Before a product or policy change ships, the question that matters is how people will react to it. Augur rehearses that reaction offline: it builds a typed knowledge graph from the change documents, populates a grounded persona market, simulates the interaction, and returns an auditable decision memo recommending one of five actions. We assemble Gold-50, fifty real product and policy episodes whose real-world outcome is known, adjudicated against the public record, and score the five-way release verdict against it. Our central finding is methodological and negative: most of the measured gap between frontier cloud models and open-weight models we fine-tune and serve offline is attributable to an under-specified evaluation, not a difference in capability. We show this three ways. First, the prompt envelope alone can dominate the score: holding weights, cases and scorer fixed, one system -- a LoRA-SFT adapter on Qwen3-32B -- swings from 0% to 73%. Second, in a matched 2x2 ablation, defining the decision taxonomy in the prompt -- with no model change -- lifts every frontier model by +24 to +34pp; under the under-specified prompt, Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT served offline beats all three frontier models (paired McNemar, Holm-corrected), and once the prompt is fair no significant difference from any of them is detected. Third, agreement with the distillation teacher rises without accuracy following, and the full pipeline amplifies a systematic "over-doom" bias rather than improving the verdict. Separately, we validate the reaction layer on its own terms: blind judges across four model families find the synthetic reaction recovers 67-90% of the concerns the public actually raised, and a pre-registered ablation locates its value -- largest where the decision is hardest, redundant near ceiling. The pipeline that regenerates every number and figure here is available from the authors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Augur 系统：从变更文档构建类型化知识图谱、填充有依据的角色市场并模拟交互，输出五类动作的可审计决策备忘录；同时构建 Gold-50 基准（50 个结果已知的真实产品/政策事件）。核心结论是方法论层面的负面发现：前沿云模型与离线微调开源模型之间的多数性能差距源于评测规格不足，而非能力差异。
AI.motivation: 产品与政策变更上线前，关键在于预测人们将如何反应。现有做法缺乏可离线演练、可审计且与真实结果对齐的评估框架；同时，前沿模型与自部署开源模型之间的比较常受评测设置混淆，导致能力差距被高估。
AI.method: Augur 流水线：由变更文档构建类型化知识图谱 → 填充 grounded persona market → 模拟交互 → 输出推荐五类动作之一的可审计决策备忘录。评测：构建 Gold-50（50 个真实产品/政策事件，结果经公共记录裁定），按五路发布裁决打分。验证手段包括：固定权重、案例与评分器的提示包络实验；2×2 匹配消融（在提示中定义决策分类体系，不改模型）；与蒸馏教师的一致性分析；以及反应层的盲评与预注册消融。
AI.result: （1）提示包络可主导得分：固定权重、案例与评分器时，Qwen3-32B 的 LoRA-SFT 适配器从 0% 波动到 73%。（2）在匹配 2×2 消融中，仅在提示中定义决策分类体系、不改模型，就使每个前沿模型提升 +24 至 +34 个百分点；在欠规格提示下，离线服务的 Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT 击败三个前沿模型（配对 McNemar，Holm 校正）；提示公平后，与任一前沿模型均未检出显著差异。（3）与蒸馏教师的一致性上升但准确率未随之上升，完整流水线放大了系统性的“过度悲观”（over-doom）偏差，而非改善裁决。反应层单独验证：四个模型家族的盲评裁判认为合成反应覆盖了公众实际提出的 67–90% 关切；预注册消融显示其价值在决策最难处最大、在接近上限处冗余。
AI.conclusion: 前沿云模型与离线开源模型之间测得的大部分差距可归因于评测规格不足，而非能力差异；评测设计（尤其提示中对决策分类体系的界定）对结论具有决定性影响。完整流水线未提升裁决质量，反而放大“over-doom”偏差。生成全部数字与图表的流水线可向作者索取，以支持可复现性。

title: Not All Confusion Is Equal: A Source-Aware Uncertainty Diagnosis for Fine-Grained Aircraft Detection
summary: Fine-grained object detectors are commonly evaluated with confusion matrices, which show where the model is confused but not why, nor whether the confusion can be reduced. We argue that confusion can be attributed to distinct, separable sources, each quantitatively measurable, turning a passive measurement into actionable guidance. We present $A^2E^2$, a diagnostic tool that decomposes the sources of confusion along two axes, $\{$aleatoric, epistemic$\} \times \{$within-class, between-class$\}$, giving a $2\times2$ taxonomy that enumerates the source types. Each quadrant is measured by its own quantity, computed in one of three places (input geometry, output-space disagreement, and the bias-parameter posterior), so the two epistemic sources are separated by construction rather than by an empirical correlation. On fine-grained aircraft detection, the four quadrants become four named sources with their own remedy verdict: affinity (geometric similarity, irreducible from size alone), heterogeneity (geometrically heterogeneous sub-variants, pointing to re-labeling rather than more data), contested (an insufficiently trained but learnable boundary, improvable), and collapsed (a class starved of data, reducible). After attributing the confusion to a specific reducible source, we apply a targeted intervention and verify experimentally that it reduces the diagnosed source specifically while leaving the irreducible sources unchanged. $A^2E^2$ thus turns confusion measurement into a concrete, validatable and actionable "diagnosis" in which the same off-diagonal mass can carry opposite causes and opposite remedies. We also state this framework's limits, including which sources are only partially identifiable on this specific dataset and why.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断工具A²E²，将细粒度检测的混淆分解为{偶然,认知}×{类内,类间}四象限，各自量化并可指导针对性干预。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度检测用混淆矩阵评估，只显示"混淆在哪里"，不解释"为什么混淆"以及"混淆是否可减少"，属于被动测量，缺乏可操作的指导。
AI.method: 提出A²E²诊断工具，沿{偶然,认知}×{类内,类间}两轴做2×2分类，每象限用独立量度，并在三个位置计算（输入几何、输出空间分歧、偏置参数后验），使两类认知来源在构造上分离而非依赖经验相关性。
AI.result: 在细粒度飞机检测上，四象限对应四个具名来源及处置结论：affinity（几何相似，仅由尺寸不可约）、heterogeneity（子变体几何异质，指向重标注）、contested（训练不足但可学的边界，可改进）、collapsed（数据匮乏的类，可减少）。针对性干预实验验证其仅降低被诊断的可约来源，不可约来源保持不变。
AI.conclusion: A²E²将混淆测量转化为具体、可验证、可操作的"诊断"，同一非对角质量可对应相反成因与相反补救。论文还说明了框架的局限，包括在该特定数据集上哪些来源仅部分可识别及其原因。

title: ADATEX4D: adaptive texture capacity allocation for 4D gaussian splatting
summary: Textured Gaussians improve local appearance capacity, but assigning the same texture resolution to every primitive wastes storage on low-detail or weakly visible regions. We introduce AdaTex4D, an adaptive texture-capacity module for deformation-based 4D Gaussian Splatting. Each Gaussian carries packed RGBA triplanes whose two axes grow independently according to visibility normalized screen-space gradients and deformed local scales. Experiments on N3DV and PanopticSports show that AdaTex4D reduces texture storage by more than half while preserving reconstruction quality. Under fixed memory budgets, adaptive allocation also improves quality over uniform texture assignment and reduces overall model and peak memory. These results show that dynamic, anisotropic texture allocation provides a more efficient way to distribute local appearance capacity in 4D Gaussian representations.

AI.tldr: AdaTex4D：一种面向4D高斯的自适应纹理容量分配模块，让每个高斯的RGBA三平面两轴按可见度归一化的屏幕空间梯度与形变局部尺度独立增长，在N3DV与PanopticSports上将纹理存储减少一半以上且保持重建质量。
AI.motivation: 纹理高斯提升了局部外观表达能力，但对每个图元分配相同纹理分辨率会在低细节或弱可见区域浪费存储，缺乏对局部外观容量的高效分配机制。
AI.method: 为基于形变的4D高斯泼溅设计自适应纹理容量模块。每个高斯携带打包的RGBA三平面，其两个轴依据可见度归一化的屏幕空间梯度和形变局部尺度独立增长（各向异性、动态分配）。
AI.result: 在N3DV和PanopticSports上，纹理存储减少超过一半且重建质量保持；在固定内存预算下，自适应分配相比均匀纹理分配提升质量，并降低整体模型与峰值内存。
AI.conclusion: 动态、各向异性的纹理分配为4D高斯表示中局部外观容量的分配提供了更高效的方式。

title: OceanXL: Large-scale Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting via Block Partitioning and Adaptive Pruning
summary: Underwater 3D reconstruction is critical for marine exploration, ecological monitoring, and subsea infrastructure inspection, yet remains challenging at large scale due to light attenuation, scattering, and limited capture coverage. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality real-time rendering, its application to large underwater scenes is constrained by high memory consumption and inefficient optimization over extensive areas. We propose OceanXL, a fast and scalable 3DGS-based framework for large-scale underwater reconstruction. OceanXL adopts a divide-and-conquer strategy, partitioning scenes into spatially coherent blocks to enable efficient optimization while preserving global geometric consistency. We further introduce an adaptive pruning scheme tailored to underwater conditions that removes redundant primitives, producing compact representations without sacrificing visual fidelity. Together, these components improve training efficiency and rendering performance for large scenes. We also introduce a large-scale underwater dataset covering diverse marine environments. Experiments on five large-scale scenes demonstrate favorable scalability, compactness, and efficiency--quality trade-offs over large-scene baselines. Controlled comparisons on the small-scale SeaThru-NeRF dataset further show competitive reconstruction quality with substantially smaller model sizes than underwater-specific methods.

AI.tldr: 提出OceanXL，一种基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的大规模水下3D重建框架，采用分治策略与自适应剪枝实现高效、紧凑的重建，并发布大规模水下数据集。
AI.motivation: 水下3D重建对海洋探索、生态监测与海底基础设施检测至关重要，但受光衰减、散射及采集覆盖有限影响，大规模重建仍具挑战。3DGS虽可实现高质量实时渲染，但直接应用于大型水下场景时存在内存消耗高、在广阔区域优化效率低的问题。
AI.method: OceanXL采用分治策略，将场景划分为空间连贯的块以提升优化效率，同时保持全局几何一致性；并针对水下条件设计自适应剪枝方案，去除冗余基元，在不牺牲视觉保真度的前提下生成紧凑表示。此外，构建了覆盖多样海洋环境的大规模水下数据集。
AI.result: 在五个大规模场景上的实验表明，OceanXL相较大型场景基线在可扩展性、紧凑性和效率-质量权衡方面表现更优；在小规模SeaThru-NeRF数据集上的受控对比显示，其重建质量具有竞争力，且模型规模显著小于水下专用方法。
AI.conclusion: OceanXL为大规模水下场景提供了快速、可扩展的3DGS重建方案，通过分块优化与自适应剪枝在效率、紧凑性和质量间取得良好平衡，并配套大规模水下数据集推动相关研究。

title: GHOST-Q: Towards Studying Grounding Hallucinations Overlooked Under Same-score TradeOffs in Quantized VLMS
summary: Post-training quantization of vision--language models (VLMs) is typically assessed through aggregate task accuracy and memory savings, but preserving a headline score does not guarantee preservation of visual grounding behavior. We present GHOST-Q, a cross-precision controlled evaluation of three 8B VLM families under FP16, INT8, and NF4 across utility and hallucination-sensitive benchmarks. Rather than comparing only aggregate accuracy, we pair FP16 and quantized predictions item by-item to quantify how compression redistributes grounding successes and failures. Five of six quantized variants preserve MMStar accuracy within $\pm2$ percentage points, yet 10 of 36 paired effects remain significant after false-discovery-rate correction, nine on hallucination-sensitive conditions. Same-device A100 profiling further demonstrates that substantial memory reduction does not necessarily mean lower inference latency. Finally, an open-ended AMBER audit reveals strong generation budget censoring whose severity varies by architecture and precision. These results show that quantized VLMs should be evaluated jointly for aggregate utility, grounding reliability, generation behavior, and realized deployment efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出GHOST-Q跨精度控制评估框架，对三个8B视觉语言模型系列在FP16、INT8、NF4下进行逐样本配对比较，发现量化虽能保持总体准确率，但仍会显著改变视觉 grounding 行为，且内存节省不等于延迟下降。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型训练后量化评测多依赖总体任务准确率和内存节省，但保持 headline 分数并不保证视觉 grounding 行为或生成行为保持不变，可能掩盖量化带来的可靠性风险。
AI.method: 对三个8B VLM家族在FP16、INT8、NF4三种精度下，在效用基准和幻觉敏感基准上进行跨精度控制评估；将FP16与量化预测逐项配对，量化压缩如何重新分配 grounding 成功与失败；并在同设备A100上进行性能分析，同时开展开放式AMBER审计以考察生成预算截断。
AI.result: 六个量化变体中五个在MMStar准确率上保持在±2个百分点内，但36个配对效应中有10个经FDR校正后仍显著，其中9个出现在幻觉敏感条件；同设备A100分析显示显著内存下降不一定带来更低推理延迟；开放式AMBER审计发现强生成预算截断，其严重程度随架构和精度变化。
AI.conclusion: 量化VLM应联合评估总体效用、grounding可靠性、生成行为和实际部署效率，而不能仅依据聚合准确率与内存节省得出结论。

title: VietPrism: A large-scale Vietnamese speech and deepfake corpus with diverse dialects and code-switching
summary: Vietnamese speech research is constrained by resources that isolate automatic speech recognition from speaker, dialect, code-switching, and deepfake analysis. We introduce VietPrism, an open, multi-domain corpus that brings these dimensions together at scale: 993.4 hours and 403,941 bona fide utterances from 1,262 verified speakers across 8,388 real-world videos. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale Vietnamese corpus to jointly provide transcripts, consistent speaker identities, five dialect groups, and naturally occurring Vietnamese--English code-switching, which constitutes nearly half of the corpus by duration. We further create over 3.1K hours of spoof speech with four open-source and commercial synthesis systems. Every spoof is conditioned on a verified speaker reference and paired with a transcript- and speaker-matched bona fide utterance, enabling unique controlled evaluation with reduced lexical and identity confounds. Zero-shot evaluation of five pretrained multilingual detectors reveals striking brittleness: EER greatly varies across detector--generator pairings, while recent multilingual detector DFA-1B degrades from 16.3% to 33.6% as speaker similarity increases. Dialect-stratified results expose further model-dependent disparities. By unifying natural linguistic diversity with controlled spoof generation, VietPrism provides a challenging foundation for Vietnamese speech modeling and trustworthy audio-deepfake detection.

AI.tldr: VietPrism：首个大规模越南语多域语音语料库（993.4小时真实语音+3.1K小时伪造语音），统一转录、说话人身份、方言、越英语码转换与深伪检测维度。
AI.motivation: 越南语语音研究受资源匮乏制约，现有语料将自动语音识别与说话人、方言、语码转换及深度伪造分析割裂开来，缺乏统一的多维度大规模资源。
AI.method: 构建VietPrism开放多域语料库：采集8388个真实视频、1262位已验证说话人，共993.4小时、403941条真实话语，提供转录、一致的说话人身份、五类方言分组及自然越英语码转换标注（约占时长一半）；并使用四套开源与商业语音合成系统生成超3.1K小时伪造语音，每条伪造语音以已验证说话人参考为条件，并与转录和说话人均匹配的真实话语配对，以减少词汇与身份混淆变量。
AI.result: 对五个预训练多语言检测器的零样本评估显示明显脆弱性：EER在检测器—生成器组合间差异巨大；多语言检测器DFA-1B在说话人相似度升高时EER从16.3%恶化至33.6%；方言分层结果进一步揭示模型依赖性的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: VietPrism将自然语言多样性与受控伪造生成相结合，为越南语语音建模和可信音频深伪检测提供了具有挑战性的基础资源。

title: Automated Regulatory Compliance Question Answering in Financial Services with Domain-Adapted Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Financial institutions operate under dense, frequently amended rulebooks, and answering a compliance question correctly requires not only fluency but verifiable grounding in the authoritative text. Large language models are attractive for this task, yet the models that firms can realistically deploy on-premise are compact ones, and compact models hallucinate obligations. We study whether a carefully domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation pipeline closes that gap. Our retriever is built in three stages on top of LegalBERT: entailment tuning that recasts question--passage matching as premise--hypothesis reconstruction, contrastive tuning with in-batch negatives, and score-level fusion with BM25. Our generator is a compact model (2B--12B parameters) served under 4-bit quantization, either prompted or adapted with retrieval-aware fine-tuning (RAFT) through LoRA. On ObliQA, a question-answering benchmark built from the Abu Dhabi Global Market rulebooks, the staged retriever raises Recall@10 from 0.256 to 0.774 and outperforms BM25 (0.678) and E5-large-v2 (0.758), the strongest general-purpose dense encoder we tested. RAFT-LoRA then improves the composite RePASs answer-quality score for every model we could adapt, with the largest gain on the weakest one. However, the adapted models do not transfer to Australian case-law questions, and a closed-book model that receives no passages at all scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full pipeline while producing answers that cite nothing and misstate obligations. The retrieval gain is therefore measured directly, the generation gain is a gain in RePASs rather than demonstrated grounding, and grounding itself requires an evaluation protocol that RePASs does not provide.

AI.tldr: 本文研究紧凑型模型在金融合规问答中的可部署RAG方案：以LegalBERT三阶段构建检索器（蕴含调优、批内负样本对比调优、与BM25分数融合），生成器为2B–12B的4-bit量化小模型（提示或RAFT-LoRA微调）。在ObliQA上Recall@10由0.256升至0.774，超过BM25(0.678)与E5-large-v2(0.758)；RAFT-LoRA提升所有可适配模型的RePASs分数，但对澳大利亚判例不迁移，且闭卷模型分数仅差0.011却无引用并错述义务，说明该提升是RePASs上的增益而非有据可依的grounding。
AI.motivation: 金融机构面对密集且频繁修订的规则手册，合规问答不仅要求语言流畅，更要求答案能可验证地溯源到权威原文。可现实部署的只能是本地紧凑模型，而紧凑模型容易凭空编造义务，因此需要检验经过领域适配的RAG流水线能否弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 检索器基于LegalBERT三阶段构建：①蕴含调优，将问题—段落匹配重构为前提—假设关系；②采用批内负样本的对比学习调优；③与BM25进行分数级融合。生成器使用2B–12B紧凑模型，4-bit量化部署，采用提示方式或经LoRA的检索感知微调（RAFT）。评测基准为基于Abu Dhabi Global Market规则手册构建的ObliQA。
AI.result: 分阶段检索器将Recall@10从0.256提升至0.774，优于BM25的0.678与该研究中最强的通用稠密编码器E5-large-v2的0.758。RAFT-LoRA对每个可适配模型都提升了复合RePASs答案质量分数，且在最弱模型上增益最大。但适配后的模型无法迁移到澳大利亚判例问题；一个完全不接收段落的闭卷模型，其RePASs分数与完整流水线仅差0.011，同时答案不引用任何来源并错误陈述义务。
AI.conclusion: 检索增益是被直接测量的，而生成增益只是在RePASs指标上的提升，并不等同于已证明的grounding；真正意义上的grounding需要一套RePASs无法提供的评测协议。

title: Low-Cost Assays for Measuring Model Behavior Across Vendors and Releases
summary: Language models advise people, keep them company, and write software while they sleep. Measuring what they do is hard: behavior has to be sampled repeatedly across models, prompts and releases, most of it lives in unstructured text that has to be coded before it can be counted, and the result has to be legible and rigorous enough to meaningfully compare models and vendors. To address these constraints, we present a simple, cheap, scalable, and replicable model for studying model behavior. Each study is a frozen, public stimulus run identically on a cross-vendor panel, at a few dollars per model or less. Each reads its transcripts one of three ways, chosen by how much interpretation the behavior needs: exact match on a clamped reply, a codebook applied by LLM judges whose agreement with a human coder is reported per code, and an instrumented environment that records what an agent did independently of what it said. Run across four years of model releases from both frontier and open-source labs, these instruments find four things. Convergence: asked to pick a word, 27 of 44 models answer serendipity at least once in four tries. Resistance: a trailing "right?" moves endorsement by up to 32 points, and the sign flips from sycophantic to resistant as generations advance, keyed to the tag's surface form. House: whether a model holds a position under pressure tracks its generation, and how it holds tracks the lab that built it. Account: told to do something the documentation in their repository contradicts, some coding agents never went along silently and others always did, and the same model can change with the harness it runs in. Re-run on every release, batteries like these track how behavior is changing across vendors and over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低成本、可复现、可扩展的模型行为研究范式：以冻结的公开刺激在跨厂商模型面板上同条件运行，并用三种由低到高的解读方式（精确匹配、LLM评判加码本、仪器化环境）读取转录，追踪四年间模型行为变化。
AI.motivation: 测量语言模型行为面临三重困难：需在多模型、多提示、多版本间反复采样；行为多藏在非结构化文本中，必须先编码才能计数；结果还需足够清晰严谨，以支持跨模型与跨厂商的比较。作者希望用简单、廉价、可扩展且可复现的方法解决这些约束。
AI.method: 每项研究都是一个冻结的公开刺激，在跨厂商面板上以相同方式运行，成本为每模型数美元或更低。转录解读分三种方式：对受限答复做精确匹配；由LLM评判依据码本编码，并逐码报告与人编码者的一致性；用仪器化环境记录智能体实际做了什么，而非它说了什么。
AI.result: 在四年间前沿与开源实验室的模型版本上发现四点。趋同：要求选一个词时，44个模型中有27个在四次尝试里至少一次回答“serendipity”。抵抗：句尾附加“right?”可使认可度变化最多32个百分点，且随世代推进符号从谄媚翻转为抵抗，并与该标签的表面形式绑定。立场：模型在压力下是否坚持某立场与世代相关，而如何坚持则与构建它的实验室相关。账目：当指令与仓库文档相矛盾时，一些编码智能体从不默默顺从，另一些则总是顺从，且同一模型会随运行它的框架而改变。
AI.conclusion: 这类电池式评测在每个版本发布时重跑，可以跨厂商并随时间追踪行为如何变化，为模型行为研究提供了一种可比较、可复制的测量基础设施。

title: Training-Free Hold-Usage Detection in Sport Climbing with Foundation Pose Models
comment: Accepted at AI2ML Conference 2026 (2nd International Conference on Advancement & Innovation in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
summary: Detecting which holds a climber uses, and when, underpins automated scoring, movement analysis, and assistive systems for sport climbing. Existing approaches train task-specific models or repurpose 2D pose estimators whose hand keypoint sits at the wrist and foot keypoint at the ankle i.e. offset from the fingertips and toes that actually contact the holds, and whose hands are occluded in roughly half of all frames. We show that a frozen, off-the-shelf pose foundation model is sufficient: using the fingertip and toe keypoints of Sapiens, a per-frame proximity test against the annotated holds, per-limb mutual exclusion, and a short temporal-persistence rule, we detect hold usage without any climbing-specific training. On the The Way Up dataset (22 videos, 10 athletes, two routes), our method reaches an event F_1 of 90.2% on a held-out split (89.8% under leave-one-participant-out cross-validation) and 79.9% over all 22 videos at any temporal overlap, and performs best on footholds (F_1,89.8% overall, 96.6% held-out). Under an identical protocol it exceeds our reproductions of the YOLOv8-pose and ViTPose pipelines at every temporal threshold, with the margin widening under strict timing. An ablation shows that two intuitively helpful additions---dense foundation-feature change gating and body-part segmentation---both hurt, arguing that a minimal, keypoint-only design is the right one for this task. Finally, standard coaching statistics computed from our automatic predictions track ground truth closely (Pearson r=1.00 for climb time, 0.94 for pace), turning ordinary single-camera video into reliable performance metrics with no instrumentation.

AI.tldr: 使用冻结的Sapiens姿态基础模型的指尖与脚尖关键点，配合逐帧接近判定、肢体互斥与短时持续性规则，无需攀岩专用训练即可检测抓握/踩点事件，事件F_1达90.2%（留出划分）。
AI.motivation: 攀岩自动计分、动作分析与辅助系统需要判断运动员使用了哪些支点及使用时刻。现有方法要么训练任务专用模型，要么复用2D姿态估计器，但后者手部关键点在腕、脚部关键点在踝，与实际接触支点的指尖/脚尖存在偏移，且约半数帧手部被遮挡。
AI.method: 直接采用冻结的现成姿态基础模型Sapiens，取其指尖与脚尖关键点；对每帧与标注支点做接近性测试，施加每条肢体的互斥约束，并加入短时持续性规则，整个过程不进行任何攀岩相关训练。同时复现YOLOv8-pose与ViTPose流程作为对照，并做消融实验。
AI.result: 在The Way Up数据集（22段视频、10名运动员、两条路线）上，留出划分事件F_1为90.2%（留一参与者交叉验证89.8%），全部22段视频在任意时间重叠下为79.9%；脚点表现最佳（整体F_1 89.8%，留出96.6%）。相同协议下所有时间阈值均优于YOLOv8-pose与ViTPose复现结果，时间要求越严格优势越大。消融显示密集基础特征变化门控与身体部位分割两项"看似有益"的加入均导致性能下降，说明仅用关键点的极简设计更合适。由自动预测计算的常规训练统计量与真值高度一致（攀爬时间Pearson r=1.00，节奏0.94）。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的通用姿态基础模型的指尖/脚尖关键点，配合极简的几何与时间规则，即可在无需攀岩专用训练的情况下高精度检测支点使用事件，并支持从普通单摄像头视频中提取可靠的训练表现指标。额外模块（特征变化门控、部位分割）无益，验证了极简关键点方案的有效性。

title: Artificial Societies Benchmark: A Validation Framework for Synthetic Research
summary: A synthetic survey can reproduce the average answer while misrepresenting how people differ, how their answers relate to one another, or how they respond to changes in conditions. We introduce the Artificial Societies Benchmark to help researchers assess whether synthetic populations support their intended analyses. The framework combines eleven tests across internal, construct, and external validity, drawing on twenty human sources and comparing nine language models. It connects each research use to the evidence it requires and tests how results change with the information we supply about respondents. Importantly, strong performance in one domain does not establish fidelity in the others. Models often answer too consistently, compress response scales, and alter relationships between traits whilst richer profiles improve prediction for some models and worsen it for others. The resulting scorecard helps researchers identify which aspects of a synthetic population can support their analysis and where researchers need further human evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Artificial Societies Benchmark，用十一项测试从内部效度、构念效度、外部效度三方面评估合成群体（大语言模型模拟的人类回答）能否支撑特定研究分析，比较二十个人类数据源与九个语言模型。
AI.motivation: 合成调查能复现平均回答，却可能错误呈现个体差异、回答间的关联以及对条件变化的响应。研究者缺乏判断合成群体是否适用于其分析目标的评估工具，因此需要系统化的基准来衡量合成群体的数据保真度。
AI.method: 构建 Artificial Societies Benchmark 框架，整合内部效度、构念效度、外部效度三类共十一项测试，基于二十个人类数据源，对比九个语言模型；并将每类研究用途与其所需的证据对应起来，检验补充受访者信息后结果如何变化。
AI.result: 某一方面表现优异并不能保证其他方面的保真度；模型往往回答得过于一致、压缩回答量表、改变特质间的关联；更丰富的个人画像对部分模型提升预测，对另一些模型则降低预测。
AI.conclusion: 该评估计分卡可帮助研究者识别合成群体的哪些方面能支撑其分析，以及哪些方面仍需进一步的人类证据。

title: AERIAL: Adversarial Evaluation of Robustness in Accuracy-Preserving Low-Precision EEG Decoders
summary: Deployment-oriented compression is attractive for resource-constrained brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but whether it changes adversarial vulnerability remains unclear. On BCI Competition IV-2a, we compare 32-bit floating-point (FP32) EEGNet and ShallowConvNet models with global magnitude pruning and simulated INT8 post training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) across nine subjects and three seeds. Simulation provides differentiable quantize--dequantize models for white-box attacks and gradient analysis, while native TensorRT deployment is used for validation. Accuracy-preserving compression does not improve direct robustness: at $ε=0.005$, EEGNet PGD accuracy remains 22--24\% across FP32, 50\% pruning (P50), PTQ, and QAT. However, P50 reduces bidirectional transfer efficiency to 0.963/0.928 (FP32$\rightarrow$P50/P50$\rightarrow$FP32), versus 0.994/0.997 for PTQ; the same trend holds for ShallowConvNet. Gradient alignment shows a corresponding separation, while native PTQ agrees with simulated clean/adversarial predictions in 95--98\% of cases. These results show that direct robustness, adversarial transfer, and deployment efficiency are distinct properties of compressed EEG decoders.

AI.tldr: 在BCI Competition IV-2a上对比FP32、全局幅度剪枝(P50)、INT8 PTQ/QAT的EEGNet与ShallowConvNet，发现保精度压缩不提升直接鲁棒性，但P50可降低对抗迁移效率，表明直接鲁棒性、对抗迁移性与部署效率是压缩EEG解码器的三种独立属性。
AI.motivation: 面向资源受限BCI的部署导向压缩具有吸引力，但压缩是否会改变模型的对抗脆弱性尚不清楚，缺乏系统性的实证评估。
AI.method: 在BCI Competition IV-2a上，对9名被试、3个随机种子，比较FP32 EEGNet与ShallowConvNet、全局幅度剪枝(50%)、模拟INT8 PTQ与QAT。模拟提供可微的quantize–dequantize模型以支持白盒攻击与梯度分析，并用原生TensorRT部署进行验证。
AI.result: 保精度压缩未提升直接鲁棒性：ε=0.005时EEGNet的PGD准确率在FP32、P50、PTQ、QAT下均保持22–24%。但P50将双向迁移效率降至0.963/0.928（FP32→P50/P50→FP32），而PTQ为0.994/0.997；ShallowConvNet呈相同趋势。梯度对齐显示出相应分离，原生PTQ在95–98%情况下与模拟的干净/对抗预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 直接鲁棒性、对抗迁移性与部署效率是压缩EEG解码器的相互独立属性，部署导向压缩不必然改变直接鲁棒性但可影响对抗迁移性。

title: ConPro: Contrast Projection Pretraining for Label-Efficient Vessel Segmentation in DSA Sequences
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Dense vessel annotation in digital subtraction angiography (DSA) is labor-intensive, yet every unlabeled sequence records how contrast passes through the vessels. Semi-supervised methods take their targets from the current model, and generic self-supervised pretexts reconstruct static appearance, so this signal goes unused. We propose ConPro, a self-supervised pretraining scheme whose target is a contrast projection, the normalized drop of every pixel below its temporal median over the sequence. On DIAS and DSCA, with 10%, 20% and 50% of the training cases labeled, ConPro improves on training from scratch at every label fraction and is the best of the compared methods on DSCA at 20% and 50% labels. Controlled comparisons show that the gain comes from the target. A temporal-median target with the same input, loss and budget stays at scratch level, and using the projection directly instead of learning it, as an input channel or a pseudo-label, helps little or hurts. ConPro provides pretrained weights without changing the segmentation architecture, so it combines with semi-supervised training, and UniMatch, the strongest baseline, gains 0.5 to 2.0 Dice and 0.9 to 2.3 clDice at every label fraction when started from ConPro weights, reaching 75.4 Dice on DIAS and 81.3 on DSCA.

AI.tldr: ConPro是一种自监督预训练方案，其目标为"造影投影"（每个像素相对于其时序中位数的归一化下降量），在DSA血管分割中于低标注比例下优于从头训练，并能与半监督方法结合提升Dice与clDice。
AI.motivation: 数字减影血管造影（DSA）中密集血管标注耗费大量人力。然而每个未标注序列都记录了造影剂流经血管的过程，这一时序信号未被利用：半监督方法以当前模型输出为目标，通用自监督 pretext 任务则重建静态外观，均忽略了造影剂流动信号。因此作者希望设计一种能利用该信号的预训练方案。
AI.method: 提出ConPro自监督预训练方案，其预训练目标为"造影投影"（contrast projection）：即序列中每个像素相对于其时序中位数的归一化下降量。该方案不改变分割网络架构，仅提供预训练权重。
AI.result: 在DIAS与DSCA数据集上，标注比例为10%、20%、50%时，ConPro在各比例下均优于从头训练，并在DSCA的20%与50%标注下为对比方法中最优。对照实验表明增益来源于目标本身：相同输入、损失与预算下的时序中位数目标仅与从头训练持平；将投影直接作为输入通道或伪标签使用则收益甚微甚至有害。结合最强半监督基线UniMatch后，在各标注比例下Dice提升0.5~2.0、clDice提升0.9~2.3，在DIAS达到75.4 Dice，在DSCA达到81.3。
AI.conclusion: ConPro通过以造影投影为自监督目标，有效利用了未标注DSA序列中的造影剂流动信号，提供了不改变分割架构的预训练权重，可即插即用地与半监督训练结合，在低标注场景下显著提升血管分割性能。

title: Style, Not Self: Surface Cues Explain Zero-Shot Code Attribution by Large Language Models
summary: If a language model can recognize code it wrote, it may favor that code as a judge, and instances of one model monitoring each other could collude. We test this zero-shot on current commercial models. Five LLMs generate solutions to MBPP, HumanEval, and DS-1000, seven more to MBPP, and models act as evaluators in four tasks: picking their own solution from a pair, judging whether a single solution is their own, identifying which of two solutions a named model wrote, and judging quality blind. In the single-solution task, balanced accuracy is 49-58% for all 15 model-benchmark combinations, while raw accuracy (38-67%) mostly reflects how readily a model claims authorship. In the pairwise task, accuracy across 14 evaluator-opponent combinations correlates at r=0.93 with how often the evaluator's solution is longer. Attribution to a named model succeeds on some pairs and is consistently inverted on others. A rule-based normalization that strips docstrings, comments, type hints, and local names preserves Pass@1 and leaves ten of twelve re-tested results at chance; the other two follow a length difference it leaves, although a trained classifier still separates most normalized pairs. Claude Haiku's self-preference also disappears. We recommend reporting balanced accuracy, heuristic baselines, and label consistency.

AI.tldr: 该研究对当前商用大语言模型进行零样本测试，检验其能否识别自己生成的代码，并考察这种自我识别能力是否会导致评判时的自我偏好与模型间串通，同时提出以平衡准确率和启发式基线进行评估的建议。
AI.motivation: 若语言模型能识别自己写出的代码，它在担任评判者时可能偏袒该代码；多模型互相监督时甚至可能彼此串通。因此有必要检验当前商用模型是否具备这种零样本自我识别能力，以及评估结果是否被表面启发式（如代码长度）和标签一致性所混淆。
AI.method: 在MBPP、HumanEval和DS-1000基准上，让5个LLM生成代码、另外7个生成MBPP代码，共15种模型-基准组合。设计四类评估任务：从一对方案中选出自己的方案、判断单个方案是否为己所写、识别两个方案中哪个出自具名模型、以及盲评质量。随后用规则化归一化方法去除文档字符串、注释、类型提示和局部变量名，重新测试；并辅以训练分类器。
AI.result: 单方案任务中，15种组合的平衡准确率为49-58%；原始准确率（38-67%）主要反映模型多倾向于声称作者身份。成对任务中，14种评估者-对手组合的准确率与评估者方案更长这一因素的相关达r=0.93。具名模型归因在某些组合上成功，在其他组合上一致反转。归一化后保留Pass@1，12项重测中有10项回到随机水平，其余2项仍受残余长度差异影响，尽管训练分类器仍能区分多数归一化后的成对样本；Claude Haiku的自我偏好也消失。
AI.conclusion: 当前商用模型的自我识别能力大体处于随机水平，表面上的自我偏好多由代码长度等启发式因素驱动。建议在相关评估中报告平衡准确率、启发式基线和标签一致性，以避免高估模型的自我识别能力。

title: M3GD: Multi-Modal Multi-View Geometric Diffusion for Camera--LiDAR Novel View Synthesis
summary: Robotic novel view synthesis (NVS) must recover both visual appearance and metric 3D structure, yet most generative NVS methods rely only on images, overlooking LiDAR, a complementary sensor common on robotic platforms. We present M3GD, a Camera--LiDAR multimodal representation for generative NVS that composes independently pretrained 2D image and 3D point-cloud foundation models without separately pretraining a cross-modal translator. We show that, after camera projection, frozen LiDAR and image features exhibit substantial shared spatial structure, providing a natural cross-modal representation. M3GD conditions generation on LiDAR through this structure: it combines explicit geometry statistics with learned point-cloud descriptors into view-aligned packets on the image-latent grid, injected through a lightweight residual adapter into a multi-view flow-matching generator whose latent space, decoders, and training objective remain intact. On the GrandTour dataset, M3GD improves target-view RGB and depth synthesis over an image-only version of the same backbone. Ablations show that the gains come from pixel-aligned LiDAR content and that target-view LiDAR acts as a geometric query linking the requested view to source observations. Deployment on a ground robot demonstrates practical real-world operation, with a configurable quality--cost trade-off controlled by the number of Euler integration steps.

AI.tldr: M3GD是一种相机-激光雷达多模态生成式新视角合成方法，无需单独预训练跨模态转换器，通过将冻结的激光雷达与图像基础模型特征在相机投影后对齐，并用轻量残差适配器注入多视图流匹配生成器，在GrandTour数据集上同时提升RGB与深度合成质量，并在地面机器人上实现实际部署。
AI.motivation: 机器人新视角合成需同时恢复视觉外观与度量3D结构，但多数生成式NVS方法仅依赖图像，忽略了机器人平台常见的互补传感器LiDAR。现有方法若要利用LiDAR，通常需额外跨模态预训练或转换器，成本高且复杂。
AI.method: M3GD组合独立预训练的2D图像与3D点云基础模型，不单独预训练跨模态转换器。核心观察是：相机投影后，冻结的LiDAR特征与图像特征存在显著共享空间结构，构成自然跨模态表示。方法将显式几何统计与学习到的点云描述子组合成图像潜变量网格上的视图对齐数据包，经轻量残差适配器注入多视图流匹配生成器，同时保持其潜空间、解码器与训练目标不变。生成以LiDAR为条件，目标视图LiDAR充当几何查询，将请求视图与源观测关联。
AI.result: 在GrandTour数据集上，M3GD在目标视图RGB与深度合成上优于同一骨干网络的纯图像版本。消融实验表明性能增益来自像素对齐的LiDAR内容，且目标视图LiDAR作为几何查询有效连接请求视图与源观测。
AI.conclusion: M3GD验证了利用冻结的跨模态基础模型特征进行像素对齐融合的有效性，避免额外跨模态预训练。该方法成功部署于地面机器人，并可通过Euler积分步数调节质量-成本权衡，具备实际应用价值。

title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
comment: AC, KD, and MYL contributed equally; authors are listed alphabetically
summary: Advances in language modeling have been driven by scaling pretraining on ever more data. Yet, the training data is still largely curated on the model's behalf. A more general approach to pretraining would let the model learn to generate the data most useful for its own improvement. This would provide an effectively unbounded source of training data, limited by compute rather than human knowledge. We introduce Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data, an initial proof-of-concept towards realizing this vision. Our procedure casts synthetic data generation as a search over the space of all computable structure, taking inspiration from Solomonoff induction. Starting from random initialization, two models learn in tandem: a generator proposes programs interpreted by a universal Turing machine, generating byte sequences, while a learner autoregressively predicts these byte sequences. The learner is trained with standard cross-entropy, while the generator is trained with reinforcement learning to produce sequences at the frontier of the learner's capabilities, yielding an adaptive curriculum. A universal Turing machine gives us a search space over all computable data-generating processes, imposing little domain-specific structure, and self-play searches over this space for useful training data. We test whether zero-shot performance on natural data improves predictably with self-play compute; this is a clean test of transfer since neither generator nor learner is trained on natural data. Across several natural datasets, zero-shot loss exhibits predictable scaling in compute. The models also exhibit in-context learning, and discover recognizable mathematical sequences during training.

AI.tldr: 提出Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data方法，将合成数据生成视为对可计算结构空间的搜索，通过生成器与学习者的自博弈实现无自然数据预训练，并在多个自然数据集上观察到零样本损失的可预测缩放。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型预训练依赖人工筛选的数据，数据受限且带有领域先验。作者希望让模型自行生成对其自身提升最有用的数据，从而获得受算力而非人类知识限制的近乎无限的训练数据来源。
AI.method: 将合成数据生成建模为对全体可计算结构空间的搜索，受Solomonoff归纳启发。从随机初始化开始，生成器提出由通用图灵机解释的程序并生成字节序列，学习者自回归预测这些字节序列。学习者用标准交叉熵训练，生成器用强化学习训练，目标是产出处于学习者能力前沿的序列，形成自适应课程。
AI.result: 在多个自然数据集上，零样本损失随自博弈算力呈现可预测的缩放；模型展现出上下文学习能力，并在训练中发现可识别的数学序列。
AI.conclusion: 作为一个初步概念验证，该工作表明无需自然数据、仅通过自博弈与图灵机搜索空间即可获得可缩放且可迁移的预训练信号，为受算力限制而非人类知识限制的通用预训练提供了可能路径。

title: Scoring Both Directions: LLMs realize the MRS they cannot reliably parse
summary: The English Resource Grammar (ERG) is a hand-written computational grammar of English. Given a sentence, its processor, ACE, produces a formal meaning representation called Minimal Recursion Semantics (MRS): a graph of the sentence's predicates and their arguments. The grammar is bidirectional and can also turn an MRS back into an English sentence. \citet{hajdik2019} used the ERG's treebank to build a benchmark for that generation task, MRS to text, and trained sequence-to-sequence models to solve it. The parsing task, text to MRS, can be tested on the same sentences. We reconstruct their 10K-sentence test split, and score two large language models, Claude Sonnet~4.5 and Claude Opus~5, in both directions against their trained systems and against ACE, with no task-specific training. Given an MRS and three examples, Opus writes the sentence at 76.3 BLEU, ten points above their system trained on 72k pairs (66.1 BLEU), and comparable to their system trained on a million extra pairs (77.2 BLEU). Sonnet scores 65.7 BLEU, and letting it choose among ACE's own candidate sentences lifts it to 69.6, while a pooled judge that keeps Opus's own sentence among the candidates adds 0.6 points (77.0 BLEU). In the parsing direction, however, the models fall far behind ACE: asked for the MRS of the same sentences, they reach 57.2 (Sonnet) and 65.5 (Opus) F$_1$ on the graph's predicates and arguments against 91.0 for ACE, and exact-match the gold on about 1\% of sentences. We characterize the failure modes for the parsing tasks, and conclude that a generation score alone does not show that models understand formal semantic representations.

AI.tldr: 该研究重建了基于ERG的MRS生成/解析基准测试集，在无任务特定训练的条件下评测Claude Sonnet 4.5与Claude Opus 5：生成方向（MRS转文本）Opus达76.3 BLEU，接近甚至超越有监督基线；但解析方向（文本转MRS）表现远逊于ACE（F1 65.5 vs 91.0），说明高生成分并不代表模型真正理解形式语义表示。
AI.motivation: 作者关注的核心问题是：大语言模型在形式语义表示任务上的表现究竟反映了真正的语义理解，还是仅仅在自然语言生成一侧"看起来像"。既有工作（hajdik2019）以ERG树库构建MRS↔文本双向基准并训练seq2seq模型，但未检验当代大模型在零任务训练条件下的双向能力。本文希望通过在同一测试集上双向评测，揭示生成指标与解析能力之间的不对称性。
AI.method: 1) 依托ERG（英语资源语法）及其处理器ACE，将句子解析为MRS（谓词与论元构成的图），并可反向生成句子。2) 重建hajdik2019的10K句测试划分。3) 在无任务特定训练的前提下，将Claude Sonnet 4.5与Claude Opus 5与对方已训练系统及ACE进行双向对比。4) 生成方向：给定MRS与三个示例，让模型写出句子，并采用让模型在ACE候选句中挑选、以及融合Opus自身句子作为候选的pooled judge策略。5) 解析方向：要求模型输出同一批句子的MRS，在图的谓词与论元上计算F1及精确匹配率。6) 分析解析任务的失败模式。
AI.result: 生成方向（MRS→文本）：Opus达到76.3 BLEU，比其基于72k对训练的基线（66.1 BLEU）高10分，与基于额外百万对训练的基线（77.2 BLEU）相当；Sonnet为65.7 BLEU，允许其在ACE自身候选句中挑选后提升至69.6；采用保留Opus自身句子的pooled judge再提升0.6分，达77.0 BLEU。解析方向（文本→MRS）：Sonnet与Opus在谓词与论元图上分别仅得57.2与65.5 F1，远低于ACE的91.0，且仅约1%的句子与金标精确匹配。
AI.conclusion: 大模型在MRS→文本生成上已达到甚至超越强监督基线，但在文本→MRS解析上远落后于符号化系统ACE，精确匹配率极低。论文刻画了解析任务的失败模式，并得出结论：仅凭生成分数不足以证明模型理解形式语义表示，生成与解析之间存在显著的双向不对称性。

title: How Reproducible Are Evaluation Conclusions? A Self-Audit of LLM-Inferred Prompt Structure
comment: 13 pages. Previously submitted to TAE (Trust-AI-Eval), a NeurIPS 2026 workshop
summary: Evaluations of LLM systems routinely average over small prompt sets and report models as a ranked table. We ask how much confidence such a table deserves, using LLM-based prompt-structure inference as the case study: eight open model variants across five families and 8B to 675B parameters, caching disabled, 293 raw intermediate representations persisted. The measured phenomenon is unstable to begin with. Identical calls do not reliably recover identical structure, with mean node-set Jaccard from 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of prompt-model cells never node-set-perfect. Auditing the evaluation weakens its conclusions further, and this is our main contribution. Under a joint cluster bootstrap over prompts, only the bottom of the ranking is firm: the two least reproducible models hold rank in 99% and 86% of replicates, the middle four in 27% to 48%, and the top two in 68% each, so the table identifies the worst model reliably but does not reliably identify the best. Two equally defensible rules for merging repeated campaigns change four of eight rows and move the study-wide headline by 7 percentage points. Checking the inferred structure against ground-truth annotations shows reproducibility cannot be read as accuracy. And four of the eight endpoints were withdrawn within ten weeks of measurement, so the study as specified can no longer be run. Small-sample LLM evaluations can therefore look far more definitive than their evidence supports. We recommend reporting rank stability, per-cell provenance, executed sensitivity comparisons, raw per-run outputs, and a measurement date alongside any ranking.

AI.tldr: 该研究以"LLM推断提示结构"为案例，通过禁用缓存、保留293份原始中间表示并对8个模型变体（8B–675B参数）做联合聚类自助法审计，发现常规排行榜式评估严重高估了结论的确定性：只有排名最差的两模型可靠（99%/86%复现排名），最优模型反而不可靠（68%），且改换合并规则会使8行中4行变化、总体指标移动7个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM系统评估通常只在小规模提示集上取平均并给出排序表，读者往往默认该排名具有较强证据力，但这一默认缺乏检验。作者希望量化这种排名表究竟应当获得多少置信度，并以"LLM推断提示结构"这一本身具有不稳定性的任务作为压力测试场景。
AI.method: 选取8个开放模型变体（跨5个模型族，8B至675B参数），禁用缓存以暴露真实波动，持久化保存293份原始中间表示。以节点集Jaccard衡量同一调用能否复现同一结构，统计72%的"提示-模型"单元格从未达到节点集完全一致；随后在提示维度上做联合聚类自助法（joint cluster bootstrap）检验排名稳定性，并比较两种同样合理的重复实验合并规则、将推断结构与真实标注对照、以及记录端点撤销情况。
AI.result: 同一调用无法可靠复现相同结构，节点集Jaccard均值介于0.39至0.96，72%的提示-模型单元格从未完全一致。自助法下排名底部最稳固：最不可复现的两个模型分别在99%和86%的重复中保持原排名，中间四个仅27%至48%，最优两个各为68%，即排名表能可靠识别最差模型却无法可靠识别最优模型。两种合并规则导致8行中4行改变，研究层面头条指标移动7个百分点；结构复现性无法被解读为准确性；8个端点中4个在测量后10周内被撤销，原设定实验已无法重跑。
AI.conclusion: 小样本LLM评估的呈现可能远比其证据支撑更为确定。作者建议在任何排名旁同时报告排名稳定性、逐单元格来源（per-cell provenance）、已执行的敏感性对比、每次运行的原始输出以及测量日期，以避免过度断言。

title: A Native-Reference Phone-Class Geometry for Second-Language Pronunciation Analysis
summary: Automatic speaking assessment systems can provide holistic proficiency scores, but often lack interpretable measures that characterize pronunciation quality. We propose a native-reference phone-class geometry for measuring second language (L2) pronunciation deviation without requiring pronunciation labels, read-aloud prompts, or matched recordings of the same text from native and L2 speakers. Given a native speech corpus, we average frame-level self-supervised representations for each context-dependent phone-class and use singular value decomposition (SVD) to derive a compact native-reference coordinate system. For each L2 utterance, we compute the corresponding averages and project them into the native-reference space. We then demonstrate that the distances between L2 and native-reference coordinates for matched phone-classes show consistent negative correlations with holistic speaking proficiency on the Dev subset of the Speak and Improve Corpus 2025 (Spearman's $ρ\!=\!-0.53$) and with pronunciation quality on the learner subset of the English Read by Japanese Students dataset ($ρ\!=\!-0.34$). These findings suggest that the proposed geometry captures acoustic-phonetic information relevant for proficiency rating while remaining applicable to spontaneous L2 speech without matched native recordings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种“母语参考音素类几何”方法，无需发音标签、朗读提示或母语-二语匹配录音，即可量化二语发音偏离度，并与整体口语熟练度和发音质量呈负相关。
AI.motivation: 自动口语评估系统虽能给出整体熟练度分数，但缺乏可解释的发音质量度量，且现有方法多依赖发音标签、朗读文本或同一文本的母语与二语匹配录音，限制了在自然二语语音中的应用。
AI.method: 给定母语语音语料，对每个上下文相关音素类平均帧级自监督表征，并用奇异值分解（SVD）构建紧凑的母语参考坐标系；对每条二语话语计算对应平均表征并投影到该参考空间，再以匹配音素类的二语坐标与母语参考坐标之间的距离作为发音偏离度量。
AI.result: 在 Speak and Improve Corpus 2025 开发子集上，该距离与整体口语熟练度呈显著负相关（Spearman ρ=-0.53）；在 English Read by Japanese Students 数据集学习者子集上，与发音质量呈负相关（ρ=-0.34）。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的几何方法能够捕捉与熟练度评分相关的声学-音素信息，同时适用于无匹配母语录音的自发性二语语音。

title: Can Frozen Hyperspherical Features Guide the Selection of Pseudo Masks?
summary: Foundation segmenters such as SAM return several plausible masks for an unlabeled image, and a student trained on the wrong one inherits its errors. Choosing among them means querying a second large model or fitting a quality head to annotated masks. We show that a candidate can be judged by what it does to a frozen self-supervised backbone's features. Normalized DINOv2 patch features lie on a hypersphere, and a candidate mask splits that sphere in two. Based on this reading, we introduce SphereTrust, which scores each candidate by three properties of the split, the angular contrast between the two sides, the coverage of the foreground's appearance modes, and contact with the image frame, one for each of three common ways a mask fails, and ranks a pool in 0.55 s per image from the frozen features alone. On eight SAM and SAM3 candidate pools spanning camouflaged, salient, and dichotomous segmentation and camouflage under low light, SphereTrust exceeds the strongest evaluated external baseline on six pools by 1.7 to 9.3 percentage points in mean selected Dice. These comparisons include published selection rules and explicitly labeled adaptations of DSS and UCOD-MKD. On the two prompted camouflage pools, its mean selected Dice is within 0.1 percentage points of the candidate-derived DSS adaptation, with a lower catastrophic-error rate. Which cue carries the signal depends on the candidate pool. The same sphere also supports training. The leading candidates enter as a candidate set with their scores as priors, prototypes reorder them, and a cross-fitted second round completes the labels, raising weighted F by 4.5, 2.3, and 5.5 points over fixed-label training on the three MLLM anchor pools, with students competitive with published unsupervised methods on nineteen test sets.

AI.tldr: 提出 SphereTrust，利用冻结自监督骨干（DINOv2）特征在超球面上的分布来评估候选分割掩码质量，无需额外大模型或标注掩码即可在 0.55s/图 内排序候选池。
AI.motivation: SAM 等基础分割模型对无标注图像返回多个看似合理的掩码，学生模型若学习错误掩码会继承其错误；在候选中挑选正确掩码通常需查询第二个大模型或基于标注掩码训练质量头，成本高。
AI.method: 归一化 DINOv2 块特征位于超球面上，候选掩码将球面分成两部分。SphereTrust 依据该划分的三个属性对候选打分：两侧的角度对比度、前景外观模态的覆盖度、与图像边框的接触情况——分别对应三类常见掩码失败模式。仅用冻结特征对候选池排序，0.55s/图。此外，同一球面结构支持训练：领先候选作为候选集并以分数为先验，用原型重排序，交叉拟合第二轮完成标签。
AI.result: 在八个 SAM/SAM3 候选池（伪装、显著、二分分割及低光伪装）上，SphereTrust 在六个池上以平均选中 Dice 超出最强外部基线 1.7–9.3 个百分点，对比包含已发表选择规则及 DSS、UCOD-MKD 的显式标注改编。在两个提示伪装池上，平均选中 Dice 与候选派生的 DSS 改编相差 0.1 个百分点以内，且灾难性错误率更低。三个 MLLM 锚池上加权 F 分别提升 4.5、2.3、5.5 点，学生在 19 个测试集上与已发表无监督方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 冻结自监督特征的超球面几何可作为候选掩码质量的可靠判据，且哪个线索携带信号取决于候选池；该框架同时能改进训练标签生成，无需额外大模型或标注。

title: Return or Revise? Learning When Revision Helps Retrieval-Augmented QA
summary: We consider the decision of whether to return an existing draft answer or revise it using retrieved evidence, as in answer-revision systems. Draft confidence estimates whether the current answer is correct, but the decision requires estimating the effect of a specified revision. For offline training and evaluation, we grade both the returned draft and its candidate revision under the same correctness judge, which makes repair, harm, and the gap to an oracle observable. We call this paired effect its recoverability, and we train policies to predict it before revision. On 25,870 held-out open-domain questions across three revision setups, a scorer trained on the paired outcome has greater area under the accuracy--revision-rate curve than a matched draft-correctness scorer in all nine Llama setup--seed fits, and gains 0.23--0.68 accuracy points on average at development-selected thresholds, a difference significant across training runs only for dense retrieval. The resulting policy improves on always revising and on average closes more than a third of the oracle gap, although it still applies 38--46% of the harmful revisions. When a draft-free standard-RAG answer is also available, however, choosing between the draft and that answer is stronger by about two points for Llama and four for OLMo, and adding candidate revision as a third option yields no significant gain. Recoverability describes one revision; its value as an available action also depends on the alternatives.
