AI.tldr: 本文研究答案修订系统中"直接返回草稿还是用检索证据修订"的决策问题，提出用配对结果（草稿与候选修订在同一正确性评判下的表现）刻画修订的可恢复性（recoverability），并训练策略在修订前预测该效应。在25,870个开放域问题上，配对结果训练的打分器在全部九组Llama设置-随机种子拟合中均取得更高的准确率-修订率曲线下面积，平均提升0.23-0.68个准确率点；所得策略优于总是修订，弥补了超过三分之一的oracle差距，但仍执行38-46%的有害修订。
AI.motivation: 现有答案修订系统通常依赖草稿置信度来决定是否修订，但置信度只反映当前答案是否正确，无法估计"指定修订"带来的收益或损害。决策真正需要的是对修订效果的预估，而非仅对现状正确性的判断。
AI.method: 将返回草稿与候选修订置于同一正确性评判器下打分，使"修复、损害、与oracle的差距"变为可观测变量，称此配对效应为recoverability；据此训练策略，在修订前预测该配对效应，并沿准确率-修订率曲线评估。在25,870个留出开放域问题、三种修订设置、多随机种子上与仅基于草稿正确性的匹配打分器对比。
AI.result: 配对结果训练的打分器在全部九组Llama设置-种子拟合中AUC优于草稿正确性打分器，在开发集选定阈值上平均提升0.23-0.68准确率点，但该差异仅在稠密检索下跨训练运行显著。所得策略优于总是修订，弥补超过三分之一的oracle差距，仍执行38-46%的有害修订。当同时存在无草稿的标准RAG答案时，在草稿与该答案间选择对Llama约强2点、OLMo约强4点，而加入候选修订作为第三选项无显著增益。
AI.conclusion: Recoverability刻画的是单次修订的效果，其作为可选动作的价值取决于是否存在更强的替代方案；相较修订，直接与无草稿的标准RAG答案比较往往更有效，且将修订作为额外选项收益有限。

title: Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate impressive capabilities in robotic manipulation, their memoryless nature renders them brittle to test-time environment shifts, particularly hardware shifts caused by wear or imperfect calibration. Enabling these models to self-adapt during deployment without requiring continuous on-site recalibration remains a critical bottleneck for real-world scalability. In this work, we introduce Self-Adaptive VLA, a novel post-training recipe that enables the policy to iteratively adapt to deployment-time hardware shifts leveraging its own rollouts as context. To do so, we first collect policy rollouts under deliberately injected hardware shifts. We then transform the base policy's training data into shift-conditioned expert demonstrations by pre-compensating the expert actions for these known shifts. Next, we introduce a lightweight, plug-in context encoder that compresses the context, including visual observation, proprioception, and actions in the shifted environment, into a latent context token. This token modulates the policy through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN). Furthermore, we find that context tokens can be ensembled, allowing the policy to iteratively self-correct and mitigate failures step by step. Extensive experiments across four precision-critical bi-manual and dexterous manipulation tasks show that Self-Adaptive VLA recovers over 80% of the base policy's performance under hardware shifts, such as actuation bias and joint encoder offsets. Moreover, Self-Adaptive VLA enables more robust deployment to new workstations compared to the base policy. Our approach provides a pathway for robust large-scale real-world robot deployments and easier maintenance. See videos at https://icefoxzhx.github.io/self-adaptive-vla.

AI.tldr: 提出Self-Adaptive VLA后训练方案，用自身上下文迭代适应部署时的硬件偏移，在四类精细双手/灵巧操作任务中恢复80%以上基础策略性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽在机器人操作上表现优异，但缺乏记忆，对测试时环境偏移（尤其磨损或标定不良导致的硬件偏移）非常脆弱；如何让模型在部署中自适应、无需持续现场重标定，是大规模落地的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 在故意注入硬件偏移的条件下采集策略rollout；2) 将基础策略训练数据转换为偏移条件专家示范，即对专家动作预补偿已知偏移；3) 引入轻量可插拔上下文编码器，将视觉观测、本体感觉与偏移环境中的动作压缩为潜在context token，并通过AdaLN调制策略；4) 上下文token可集成（ensemble），使策略逐步自纠正、迭代缓解失败。
AI.result: 在四项精度关键的双手与灵巧操作任务中，Self-Adaptive VLA可在执行器偏置、关节编码器偏移等硬件偏移下恢复基础策略80%以上性能，并相较基础策略对新工作站部署更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为鲁棒的大规模真实机器人部署与更简便的维护提供了可行路径。

title: PrivDrift: Auditing User-Secret Leakage Under Topic Drift in Active LLM Conversations
summary: Large language models increasingly operate as persistent assistants in user-facing, shared-session, and tool-augmented settings. When users disclose sensitive information during an active conversation, that information may remain behaviorally recoverable through later prompts even after the dialogue shifts to unrelated topics. We introduce PrivDrift, a benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable after conversational topic drift and persuasion-based probing. PrivDrift contains 1,000 controlled multi-turn dialogues with seeded secrets, content-dense drift turns, and standardized extraction probes. Across three LLMs with extended context windows, dialogue-level hybrid leakage remains substantial, ranging from 38.7% to 54.6%, and varies strongly by model, secret type, and persuasion intensity. Within the tested drift window, additional topic drift does not reliably reduce leakage, suggesting that privacy risk in active LLM contexts should be evaluated as a persistent behavioral failure mode rather than only as training-data memorization or immediate jailbreak behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 PrivDrift 基准，用1000段多轮对话审计用户主动披露的敏感信息在话题漂移和劝说式追问下是否仍可被提取，发现泄露率高达38.7%–54.6%，且额外话题漂移并未可靠降低泄露。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益作为持久助手在共享会话与工具增强场景中运行，用户主动披露的敏感信息可能在话题转移后仍被后续提示"行为性"地恢复。已有隐私评估多聚焦训练数据记忆或即时越狱，缺少对"活跃上下文中的持续可恢复性"这一失败模式的系统审计。
AI.method: 构建 PrivDrift 基准：包含1000段受控多轮对话，每段植入种子秘密（seeded secrets）、内容密集的话题漂移轮次（drift turns）以及标准化的提取探针（extraction probes），并引入不同程度的劝说式追问（persuasion intensity）。在三个具备长上下文的 LLM 上进行评估，按对话层面统计混合泄露（hybrid leakage）率。
AI.result: 对话级混合泄露率介于38.7%至54.6%，并随模型、秘密类型与劝说强度显著变化；在测试的漂移窗口内，增加话题漂移并不可靠地降低泄露。
AI.conclusion: 活跃 LLM 上下文中的隐私风险应被视为一种持续性的行为失败模式（persistent behavioral failure mode），而非仅等同于训练数据记忆或即时越狱行为。

title: Accelerating Video Diffusion via Training-Free Trajectory Routing
summary: Video diffusion is computationally expensive, as it requires executing a large model across many denoising steps. Even with step-distillation, inference remains expensive because every distilled step still requires a costly model evaluation. We present TRACK: TRajectory-Aware Capacity routing via top-K selection, a heterogeneous denoising strategy that switches between compatible large and small models at selected steps, reducing the average cost per denoising evaluation. The switching steps are determined using a calibration process. TRACK first rolls out a reference trajectory with the large model. Then at each step, the small model's prediction is also collected and compared against the large model's prediction to obtain a relative disagreement score. Both models receive the same latent, timestep, conditioning, and guidance inputs. Aggregating this signal over a calibration set produces a disagreement score map across diffusion steps, which determines a switching policy for an efficient inference process: quality-sensitive steps keep using the large model, while steps with low disagreement scores are routed to the small model. Inference executes only the selected model at each step, requiring no retraining, architecture or scheduler changes, or online dual-model evaluation. Across Wan 2.1, Cosmos 3, TurboDiffusion, and FastVideo, TRACK yields $1.95\times$, $2.04\times$-$2.73\times$, $2.69\times$, and $2.17\times$ speedups, respectively, with comparable aggregate quality and high diversity retention. TRACK thereby establishes automated, training-free model switching as a practical acceleration paradigm for video diffusion.

AI.tldr: TRACK提出一种无需训练的视频扩散加速范式：通过校准得到各去噪步的模型间"分歧分数图"，在质量敏感步用大模型、低分歧步用小模型，实现异构去噪路由。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散推理计算昂贵，需在大量去噪步上执行大模型；即使采用步数蒸馏，每个蒸馏步仍需一次昂贵的模型评估，单步成本未被降低。
AI.method: TRACK（TRajectory-Aware Capacity routing via top-K selection）先由大模型 rollout 一条参考轨迹，并在每一步收集小模型预测，与大模型预测比较得到相对分歧分数；两模型接收相同的 latent、timestep、conditioning 与 guidance 输入。在校准集上聚合该信号，生成跨去噪步的分歧分数图，据此确定切换策略：质量敏感步保留大模型，低分歧步路由至小模型。推理时每步仅执行被选中的模型，无需重训练、不改变架构或调度器，也无需在线双模型评估。
AI.result: 在 Wan 2.1、Cosmos 3、TurboDiffusion、FastVideo 上分别取得 1.95×、2.04×–2.73×、2.69×、2.17× 的加速，同时保持可比的聚合质量与较高的多样性保留。
AI.conclusion: TRACK 确立了自动化、免训练的模型切换作为视频扩散实用加速范式。

title: R-DEIM Net: An Efficient Rationale-Augmented Dual-Expert Interaction Model for Paraphrase Detection
summary: Recent advances in paraphrase detection reveal a fundamental trade-off: large language models achieve high accuracy but require high computation, while efficient Siamese-BERT variants offer practical scalability with reduced transparency in rationale generation. We present R-DEIM Net, a 76M-parameter dual-expert architecture exploring whether moderate-scale models can achieve competitive accuracy on paraphrase detection while enabling human-readable rationale generation. The architecture combines two specialized components: an Interaction Expert that captures token-level similarity patterns through multi-scale 2D convolutions and attention head allowing variable input length, and a Reasoning Expert that uses a Flan-T5-small decoder to generate rationales as auxiliary supervision. Rather than re-encoding generated text, we extract and pool decoder hidden states as complementary features for classification. On the Quora Question Pairs dataset, R-DEIM Net achieves 90.07% accuracy and 90.16% F1-score via 10-fold cross-validation. This represents competitive performance with strong transformer-based baselines (e.g., MFAE BERT: 90.54% accuracy) and recent large language model based approaches (LLaMA-70B) while using a substantially smaller parameter budget. The model generates rationales alongside predictions, providing potential for auxiliary human-readable descriptions.

AI.tldr: 提出R-DEIM Net（76M参数双专家架构），在Quora Question Pairs上以10折交叉验证达到90.07%准确率与90.16% F1，兼顾竞争性精度与可读理由生成。
AI.motivation: 复述检测存在权衡：大语言模型精度高但算力开销大，高效Siamese-BERT变体可扩展但理由生成不透明。作者探索中等规模模型能否在保持竞争性精度的同时生成人类可读的决策理由。
AI.method: R-DEIM Net包含两个专家：交互专家用多尺度2D卷积与注意力头捕捉token级相似模式并支持变长输入；推理专家用Flan-T5-small解码器生成理由作为辅助监督。不重新编码生成文本，而是提取并池化解码器隐状态作为补充特征用于分类。
AI.result: 在Quora Question Pairs数据集上，10折交叉验证取得90.07%准确率与90.16% F1。与强Transformer基线（如MFAE BERT 90.54%）及近期大语言模型方法（LLaMA-70B）相比具竞争性，且参数量显著更小。模型在输出预测的同时生成理由。
AI.conclusion: 中等规模双专家架构可在复述检测中以小参数预算取得竞争性精度，并提供人类可读的辅助描述，兼顾效率与可解释性。

title: Smartphone-Based Method for Automated Speed Enforcement
summary: Smartphone cameras and computer vision (CV) hold significant promise in assisting public agencies with enforcing traffic laws and enhancing road safety. This work designs and tests a smartphone-based method for automated speed estimation and vehicle identification (license plate, make/model, and color recognition) via an automated pipeline to assist enforcement agencies in reliably identifying speeders. The CV code accurately recognizes nearly half (46%) of the license plates' text on 1,800 images from a Brazil open-source dataset, called UFPR-ALPR. Code tests on daytime recordings from hand-held smartphone videos (n = 73) and roadside cameras (n = 42) in Austin, Texas yield 60.8% accuracy for color detection (among all possible RGB color categories), 48.6% on vehicle make/manufacturer identification, and 16.89% on vehicle make and model identification. Prediction accuracy for speed estimation (within a 20% range), vehicle make (within the top 3 predictions), and license plate recognition (within the top 10 predictions) are 16.3%, 16.9%, and 29.7%, respectively. This paper also illuminates the legal, technological, and practical aspects of using smartphones for enforcement, including the potential use of recordings for enforcement purposes, emphasizing the need to transform the potential of smartphone-based CV technologies into practical tools for vital information on traffic violations.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并测试了一种基于智能手机的自动测速与车辆识别方法，通过计算机视觉流水线协助交管部门识别超速车辆。在UFPR-ALPR公开数据集上，车牌文本识别准确率约46%；在德州奥斯汀手持智能手机视频和路边摄像头录像上的实测中，颜色检测准确率为60.8%，车辆厂商识别为48.6%，品牌与型号识别为16.89%；测速（±20%范围内）、车辆厂商（前3预测内）和车牌识别（前10预测内）的准确率分别为16.3%、16.9%和29.7%。文章还讨论了智能手机用于执法的法律、技术和实践层面的问题。
AI.motivation: 智能手机摄像头与计算机视觉在协助公共机构执行交通法规、提升道路安全方面具有重要潜力。作者希望利用智能手机平台，构建自动化流水线，帮助执法机构可靠地识别超速者，并将智能手机CV技术从潜力转化为实际执法工具。
AI.method: 设计并测试一种基于智能手机的自动测速与车辆识别方法，通过自动化CV流水线完成速度估计以及车牌、厂商/型号、颜色识别。评估使用两类数据：(1) 巴西开源数据集UFPR-ALPR的1800张图像用于车牌文本识别；(2) 德州奥斯汀的手持智能手机日间视频（n=73）与路边摄像头录像（n=42）用于颜色、厂商/型号识别及速度估计测试。
AI.result: 车牌文本识别：在UFPR-ALPR的1800张图像上准确率约46%。在奥斯汀实测数据上：颜色检测（所有RGB类别中）60.8%，车辆厂商识别48.6%，品牌与型号识别16.89%。测速（误差20%范围内）准确率16.3%，车辆厂商（前3预测内）16.9%，车牌识别（前10预测内）29.7%。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了智能手机用于执法的法律、技术和实践层面的问题，包括将录像用于执法目的的潜在可行性，并强调需要将基于智能手机的CV技术潜力转化为能够提供交通违法关键信息的实用工具。

title: What, When, and How: Audio Description as Constrained Global Optimization
summary: Audio Description (AD) makes movies accessible to blind and visually impaired audiences by narrating visual information in gaps between dialogue. Existing automatic AD systems largely treat generation as a local video-to-text problem, assuming that the content to describe and its temporal location are already provided. Realistic AD instead requires coupled decisions about what visual information is narratively important, when it can be spoken without interfering with dialogue, and how it should be formulated to fit within the available time. We formalize AD generation as a constrained optimization problem over these three decisions. Our hybrid system uses large language models to propose and ground visual elements, estimate their salience to the narrative, and generate compressed realizations. A mixed-integer linear program then jointly selects and schedules descriptions across a scene subject to temporal constraints. When evaluated on REFRAMED, a benchmark for realistic AD of movies, our approach makes better decisions than prompted LLMs about what to describe and when to describe it, establishing a new SOTA on narrative QA and temporally grounded metrics. Ablations show that explicit temporal constraints drive gains in placement, while salience estimation controls how much narratively useful content is retained. Improvements are concentrated on temporal and narrative measures rather than n-gram overlap, although a significant gap to professional describers remains.

AI.tldr: 本文将自动音频描述（AD）生成形式化为对"描述什么、何时描述、如何表述"三个耦合决策的约束优化问题，提出结合LLM与混合整数线性规划的混合系统，在REFRAMED基准上取得叙事QA与时序指标的新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有自动AD系统将生成视为局部的视频到文本问题，假设待描述内容和时间位置已给定；而真实AD需要同时决定哪些视觉信息叙事上重要、何时在对白间隙中插入、以及如何在可用时长内表述，这三者相互耦合。
AI.method: 将AD生成形式化为约束优化问题；混合系统用大语言模型提出并定位视觉元素、估计其叙事显著性、生成压缩表述；再用混合整数线性规划在时序约束下对整场景的描述进行联合选择与调度。
AI.result: 在REFRAMED电影真实AD基准上，相比提示式LLM，本方法在"描述什么"和"何时描述"上决策更优，在叙事QA和时序接地指标上取得新SOTA；消融显示显式时序约束驱动放置性能提升，显著性估计控制叙事有用内容的保留量；提升集中在时序与叙事指标而非n-gram重叠，与专业描述者仍有明显差距。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模选择、调度与表述的约束优化框架优于局部生成范式，但自动AD与专业水平之间仍存在显著差距。

title: Diffu-LoRA: A Novel Low-Rank Adaptation for Personalized Diffusion Models
summary: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models from a few reference images requires preserving subject identity while following prompts that describe new contexts. Full-model fine-tuning is parameter-intensive, whereas low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the number of trainable parameters but leaves open how adaptation capacity should be distributed across layers. We introduce Diffu-LoRA, a parameter-efficient method that learns this allocation through gated low-rank adaptation. Diffu-LoRA inserts trainable low-rank components into the linear layers of Transformer blocks and assigns a learnable gate to each component. Bilevel optimization updates the adaptation weights and gate parameters on separate data splits, while progressive pruning removes components with the lowest gate values to meet a prescribed rank budget. This procedure allocates adaptation capacity nonuniformly across layers while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. Experiments with Stable Diffusion on subjects from DreamBooth and additional collected datasets show improved overall subject fidelity and prompt alignment relative to the evaluated fine-tuning baselines. Ablation studies examine the contributions of bilevel optimization, progressive pruning, and adapter placement. These results support learned rank allocation as a practical approach to parameter-efficient diffusion model personalization.

AI.tldr: 提出 Diffu-LoRA，通过门控低秩适配与双层优化学习各层适配容量分配，实现参数高效的扩散模型个性化。
AI.motivation: 基于少量参考图像个性化文生图扩散模型，需在保持主体身份的同时跟随描述新场景的提示。全模型微调参数量大，LoRA 虽减少可训练参数，但如何在各层间分配适配容量仍未有定论。
AI.method: Diffu-LoRA 在 Transformer 块的线性层中插入可训练低秩组件，并为每个组件分配可学习门控；采用双层优化在不同数据划分上更新适配权重与门控参数，并通过渐进剪枝移除门控值最低的组件以满足指定秩预算，从而在冻结预训练主干的前提下实现各层非均匀的适配容量分配。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 上对 DreamBooth 主体及额外采集数据集进行实验，相比所评估的微调基线，整体主体保真度与提示对齐均有所提升；消融实验考察了双层优化、渐进剪枝与适配器放置各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可学习的秩分配是参数高效扩散模型个性化的一种实用途径。

title: Multimodal Thinking with Renderable Programs
summary: Current vision-language models (VLMs) excel at visual content understanding and text-based reasoning, yet their structure limits the advancement of incorporating images into the reasoning chain. Though Omnimodal models have made efforts in unifying text and image generation, they focus on visual tasks in the open-domain, lacking tractability due to rasterized or latent representations of images. We introduce SVGLM, a framework that uses scalable vector graphics (SVG) primitives to connect text and image in reasoning tasks. We exploit the duality of SVG as both image description and text instructions, yielding a more compact, interpretable solution to equip general VLMs with the capability of generating images within the reasoning process. We provide a large curated dataset of SVG-based image editing dataset, as well as the paradigm to tune open-source VLMs. Experiments on a mathematical reasoning benchmark demonstrate that SVGLM achieves strong SVG generation power as well as think-with-image intelligence. Our results highlight SVG as a suitable medium for building more robust digital domain agents, bridging the gap between text-based thinking and pixel-based images.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SVGLM框架，利用可缩放矢量图形（SVG）作为文本与图像之间的中间媒介，使通用视觉语言模型能够在推理链中生成图像，从而获得"以图思考"的能力。作者构建了大规模SVG图像编辑数据集并提供开源VLM微调范式，在数学推理基准上验证了SVGLM兼具强大的SVG生成能力与图像推理智能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型擅长视觉内容理解与文本推理，但结构限制使其难以将图像纳入推理链。全模态模型虽尝试统一文本与图像生成，却局限于开放域视觉任务；由于图像采用栅格化或潜在表示，缺乏可追踪性与可解释性。因此需要一个既能表征图像、又能作为文本指令、且紧凑可解释的媒介来弥合文本思考与像素图像之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 1）提出SVGLM框架，使用可缩放矢量图形（SVG）基元在推理任务中连接文本与图像；2）利用SVG的双重属性——既可作为图像描述、又可作为文本指令——为通用VLM赋予在推理过程中生成图像的能力；3）构建大规模精选的SVG图像编辑数据集；4）设计微调开源VLM的范式。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，SVGLM不仅具备强大的SVG生成能力，还展现出"以图思考"（think-with-image）的智能，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SVG是构建更鲁棒数字域智能体的合适媒介，能够桥接基于文本的思考与基于像素的图像，为VLM在推理链中融入图像生成提供了紧凑、可解释的解决方案。

title: Screen Before You Serve: Simulation for Production Customer Experience AI Agents at 140M Scale
summary: Customer experience (CX) agents use tools and large language models to address customer requests and guide conversational interactions with an organization's products. Improving these agents, especially in regulated industries, is difficult: they must detect intent, follow complex operational policies and use tools reliably. Manual end-to-end testing offers limited coverage, while live experiments expose customers to failures that can erode trust. We present a hypothesis-driven simulation workflow for screening candidate CX agents before deployment. Synthetic customers react to agent responses and simulated tool outputs enable multi-step agentic workflows without invoking production backends. We use the Snowglobe simulator on Nubank's Card Delivery agent and its expanded successor, Card Management - Nubank's highest-volume chat-support agent in Brazil. Across 4 deployed versions, simulated and production version-level binary evaluator scores show high correlation. Simulation-guided iteration increased transactional net promoter score (tNPS) by 36.69 points in a live A/B test. We also screened open-weight configurations in over 16,000 simulated conversations. In a subsequent live A/B test, the selected model increased self-service rate (SSR) by 8.82 percentage points to the highest level observed at Nubank, with no statistically significant change in tNPS. Simulation made broad exploration of models, reasoning settings, and prompts feasible without customer exposure, enabling production improvements that would have been impractical to pursue through live experimentation alone.

AI.tldr: 提出基于假设驱动的仿真工作流，在部署前用Snowglobe模拟器筛选CX客服Agent，仿真评分与生产评分高度相关，并助Nubank在线上A/B测试中提升tNPS与自助服务率。
AI.motivation: 客服CX Agent需检测意图、遵循复杂运营政策并可靠调用工具，尤其在受监管行业。人工端到端测试覆盖不足，而直接线上实验会让用户暴露于失败风险，损害信任，因此需要可扩展、低风险的部署前评估手段。
AI.method: 构建假设驱动的仿真工作流：用合成客户对Agent回复做出反应，并模拟工具输出以支持多步Agentic流程，无需调用生产后端。在Nubank的Card Delivery Agent及其后继Card Management上使用Snowglobe模拟器，覆盖4个已部署版本，对版本级二元评估器分数做仿真与生产相关性分析，并模拟逾16,000次对话筛选开放权重模型配置（模型、推理设置、提示词）。
AI.result: 仿真与生产的版本级二元评估器分数高度相关；仿真引导的迭代使线上A/B测试中tNPS提升36.69分；在16,000多次模拟对话中筛选出的开放权重模型，在后续线上A/B测试中使自助服务率（SSR）提升8.82个百分点，达到Nubank历史最高水平，tNPS无统计显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 仿真工作流可在不暴露真实客户的前提下，对模型、推理设置与提示词进行广泛探索，实现原本难以通过纯线上实验达成的生产改进，适合受监管行业的CX Agent部署前筛选。

title: GRASP: Generating, Revising, and Assessing for Strategic Planning with Agentic AI
comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) typically exhibit a performance profile where reliability degrades as task complexity increases. We address the challenge of generating high-quality natural language executable plans for complex tasks by introducing $\textbf{GRASP}$, a strategy-aware, multi-stage planning framework. GRASP decouples the planning pipeline across specialized, context-isolated modules: it pre-compiles global macro-guidelines (GenPlan), explores alternative localized strategies within isolated context windows (RevPlan), and independently evaluates trajectories using a multi-criteria discriminator (VerPlan). Empirical evaluations show that GRASP consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier across diverse datasets, yielding substantial accuracy gains over direct LLM planners on Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling ($\sim$12.4$\%$$\uparrow$), ZebraLogic ($\sim$30.8$\%$$\uparrow$), and SciBench Math. Crucially, under multi-task scaling-where standard planners suffer immediate performance collapse-GRASP completely flattens the multi-task degradation penalty. In interleaved dual-task environments, GRASP achieves an absolute accuracy gain of up to 16.7$\%$ over direct LLM planners. Furthermore, by isolating context and enforcing strict macro-regularization, GRASP outperforms frontier reasoning models (such as GPT-5-mini) by a margin of 14.5$\%$.

AI.tldr: GRASP 是一种策略感知的多阶段规划框架，通过将规划流程解耦为上下文隔离的专门模块，显著提升复杂任务的可执行计划生成质量，并在多任务场景下消除性能退化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在任务复杂度上升时可靠性会下降，生成高质量、可执行的复杂任务自然语言计划成为难题。现有直接规划器在复杂与多任务场景下表现脆弱甚至性能崩溃。
AI.method: GRASP 将规划流程解耦到多个上下文隔离的专门模块：GenPlan 预编译全局宏观准则；RevPlan 在独立上下文窗口中探索局部替代策略；VerPlan 通过多准则判别器独立评估规划轨迹。框架强调策略感知与严格宏观正则化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上达到新的最优表现：Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling 准确率提升约12.4%，ZebraLogic 提升约30.8%，SciBench Math 亦提升。在多任务扩展下，GRASP 完全消除了标准规划器出现的多任务性能退化惩罚；交错双任务环境中较直接规划器绝对准确率提升最高达16.7%；相较前沿推理模型（如 GPT-5-mini）高出14.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过上下文隔离与严格宏观正则化，GRASP 有效克服了 LLM 规划器在复杂和多任务场景下的可靠性衰减，确立了新的技术水平前沿。

title: Does a model's stated reason for rejecting a candidate do any work?
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at LLM4XAI 2026: Workshop on Large Language Models for Explainable AI, co-located with CIKM 2026, Rome, Italy, November 8, 2026. Code and per-item records: https://github.com/ArchitRastogi20/contrastive-rejection-test
summary: Asked to choose between candidates and explain the choice, a language model often rejects a rival by naming a fact its profile lacks: no director, no date of death. That sentence is a claim about the text in front of the model, and it can be tested without any judge. We insert a real corpus sentence stating the named fact into the rival's profile and ask again under greedy decoding. Two controls separate content from placement: a length-matched irrelevant sentence at the same profile, and the same two sentences at a third option the model never mentioned. In the largest of three runs, six open models on 2WikiMultihopQA, supplying the named fact at the profile the model named moves its choice more than the irrelevant control does, odds ratio 3.57 [1.54, 8.26], Holm p=0.0210, and this survives dropping any single model. The contrast the design was built to detect, the same fact at the option nobody named, does not clear correction, Holm p=0.2428. The strongest result in the family carries no content claim at all: the identical irrelevant sentence moves the choice more at the named rival than at the third option, Holm p=0.0008. Repair and control also differ in co-candidate mentions, relation template and fluency; post-hoc matching on the first two preserves the content effects' direction, matching fluency weakens one, so the content contrasts bound an effect rather than establish one. A forced single-token probability read disagrees in direction with the free-text choice on that same contrast, and three candidate explanations for the disagreement find no support. Every measurement is a string rule, so each was validated against the records it reads; validation caught eight defects. The largest, a choice-parsing rule that returned the option a model had just rejected in 17.1% of adjudicable responses, would have reported six surviving contrasts instead of four.

AI.tldr: 通过插入语料句子干预候选者简介，检验语言模型拒选理由中"缺失事实"陈述的可测试性；内容效应方向存在但需限定，最强结果是位置效应。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在候选比较中常以"缺少某项事实"为由拒绝某候选，该句子是关于输入文本的可检验断言，但此类理由是否真正驱动模型选择此前缺乏无需人工评判的因果检验。
AI.method: 在2WikiMultihopQA上，将真实语料中含所述事实的句子插入被点名候选的简介，用贪心解码重问；设置两个对照：同位置的等长无关句、以及模型从未提及的第三选项上放置同样的两句。所有测量均为字符串规则，并针对其读取的记录逐条验证。
AI.result: 最大一轮中，六个开源模型上，在被点名简介处补入所述事实比无关对照更能改变选择（OR 3.57 [1.54, 8.26]，Holm p=0.0210），剔除任一单模型后仍成立；而设计核心对比（同样事实置于无人提及的选项）未通过校正（Holm p=0.2428）。最强结果是纯位置效应：同一无关句在被点名对手处比在第三选项处更能改变选择（Holm p=0.0008）。修复与对照还在共候选提及、关系模板与流畅度上存在差异，事后匹配前两者保持内容效应方向，匹配流畅度削弱其一。强制单token概率读数在该对比上与自由文本选择方向相反，三种解释均无支持。验证共发现八处缺陷，最大一处选择解析规则在17.1%可判定回答中返回模型刚拒绝的选项，若未修正会报告六个存活的对比而非四个。
AI.conclusion: 内容对比界定的是效应上界而非确证效应；位置/呈现效应强于内容效应，方法上的字符串规则验证对结论稳健性至关重要。

title: A Training Criterion with Token-Level Tolerance to Transcription Ambiguity for Automatic Speech Recognition
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Automatic speech recognition is typically trained assuming that the reference transcript is the only valid labeling of an utterance, yet even nominally verbatim transcripts contain localized differences in pronunciation, spelling, or lexical realization that the acoustics do not uniquely determine. Omni-temporal Classification (OTC) tolerates such noise by adding wildcard paths to the connectionist temporal classification (CTC) alignment graph, but its word-level arcs are too coarse, since bypassing one unsupported token discards supervision for the whole word. We move wildcard arcs to token granularity so unsupported tokens can be bypassed while the rest of the word stays supervised, and we combine token- and word-level arcs as complementary escape paths. Across 19 languages and three corpora, token-level OTC improves over CTC on all 25 tasks. We also replace epoch-indexed relaxation of the wildcard weights with a predictive-entropy-indexed schedule, which performs comparably while reducing dependence on training length. Combining this schedule with the hybrid graph gives the lowest mean word error rate (WER) on every corpus and a 9.45% average relative WER reduction over CTC. Independent validator transcriptions show that token-level models place significantly more wildcard-bypass probability than CTC on disputed characters, indicating that token-level tolerance targets localized transcript ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 将CTC对齐图中的通配弧从词级细化到token级，并混合词/token两类逃逸路径，配合预测熵索引的松弛调度，在19种语言25个任务上取得较CTC平均9.45%的相对WER降低。
AI.motivation: ASR通常假设参考转写是话语的唯一有效标注，但即使是逐字转写也存在发音、拼写或词汇实现上的局部差异，而这些差异无法由声学唯一确定。现有Omni-temporal Classification（OTC）通过在CTC对齐图中引入通配路径来容忍这类噪声，但其词级弧过粗：绕过某个受支持不足的token会丢弃整词的监督信号。
AI.method: 1）将通配弧下沉至token粒度，使不受支持的token可被绕过、词内其余部分仍受监督；2）将token级弧与词级弧组合为互补的逃逸路径（混合图）；3）用预测熵索引的松弛调度替代按epoch索引的通配权重松弛。
AI.result: 在19种语言、三个语料库的25个任务上，token级OTC全面优于CTC；预测熵调度性能相当且降低了对训练长度的依赖；该调度与混合图结合后在每个语料库上取得最低平均WER，较CTC平均相对降低9.45%。独立验证者转写显示，token级模型在有争议字符上分配的通配绕过概率显著高于CTC。
AI.conclusion: token级容错能够精准针对局部转写歧义，混合粒度通配弧加熵驱动松弛调度是提升CTC鲁棒性的有效方案。

title: Do Audio Language Models Hear and Read Distinctive Features Alike?
summary: Audio language models pass speech and text through a single decoder. We ask whether that decoder represents a distinctive feature in the same direction when a phoneme is heard and when it is read. For minimal pairs of phonemes differing in one feature, we take the offset between the two members' mean representations. Averaging those offsets gives a direction for each stream, and we measure the cosine between the two. Because the two streams already agree about arbitrary phoneme pairs, we compare every measure against a reference built from random pairings rather than against zero. We apply this to 6 models, 7 features and 15 languages from 11 families. Only voicing in the two Qwen2.5-Omni models exceeds that reference after correction for multiple testing, and the reference varies by a factor of seven between models. In three of the six models, voicing has one direction in audio across the 14 languages with enough minimal pairs to measure it, and every language pair agrees in two of them. The model family, not the model size, predicts which stream represents a feature.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察音频语言模型的共享解码器在"听到"与"读到"同一音素时，是否以相同方向表征同一区别性特征。方法上对最小对立对取均值表征之差并求余弦相似度。结果显示6个模型中仅Qwen2.5-Omni两模型的"浊音性"显著超过随机基线，且模型家族而非规模决定表征方式。
AI.motivation: 音频语言模型将语音与文本通过单一解码器处理，但尚不清楚该共享解码器在听觉与阅读两种输入模态下，是否以一致的方向编码同一音素的区别性特征。作者希望检验跨模态表征的一致性及其影响因素。
AI.method: 针对仅在一个区别性特征上不同的音素最小对立对，计算两个成员平均表征之间的偏移量；对偏移量取平均得到每条流(音频/文本)的方向，并测量两方向间的余弦相似度。由于两条流对任意音素对本身已有共识，作者用随机配对构建参考基线而非以零为基准。实验覆盖6个模型、7个特征、来自11个语系的15种语言。
AI.result: 仅两个Qwen2.5-Omni模型的"浊音性"特征在多重检验校正后超过参考基线，且该基线在不同模型间相差达7倍。在6个模型中的3个里，浊音性在音频流中于14种具有足够最小对立对的语言上呈单一方向；其中两个模型中所有语言对方向一致。预测某特征由哪条流表征的是模型家族而非模型规模。
AI.conclusion: 音频语言模型的共享解码器在听觉与阅读路径上对区别性特征的编码方向总体并不一致；仅少数模型的特定特征(如浊音性)表现出跨模态一致性，且该一致性受模型家族主导，与模型规模无关。

title: ARGUS: Role-Aware Event Knowledge Graphs for U.S. Employment-Discrimination Complaints
summary: U.S. employment-discrimination complaints describe complex event sequences that are not explicitly captured by lexical or embedding-based representations alone. We present ARGUS, a source-grounded pipeline that combines a 5W1H-inspired schema, legal-domain models, and LLM-based structured generation to construct document-level Event Knowledge Graphs (EKGs) from CourtListener complaints. ARGUS extracts fact-bearing statements, builds chunk-level event graphs with participant, temporal, and causal structure, and merges them into document-level representations. We evaluate graph quality through human and multi-model assessment and test downstream utility on claim classification and legal QA. The graph-structured classifier outperforms raw and linearized baselines on the held-out set, and EKG-only retrieval improves document-scoped QA, while open-retrieval gains remain limited by low first-stage candidate recall. These results suggest that EKGs are most useful for organizing and reasoning over evidence once relevant material has been retrieved.

AI.tldr: 提出ARGUS流水线，从美国就业歧视投诉构建文档级事件知识图谱（EKG），在索赔分类与法律问答任务上验证其效用。
AI.motivation: 美国就业歧视投诉描述的事件序列复杂，仅靠词法或嵌入表示无法显式捕捉其中的参与者、时间与因果关系，需要结构化的知识表示来支撑下游推理。
AI.method: ARGUS整合5W1H启发式schema、法律领域模型与LLM结构化生成，从CourtListener投诉中抽取承载事实的陈述，构建含参与者、时间与因果结构的块级事件图谱，并合并为文档级EKG；通过人工与多模型评估图谱质量，并在索赔分类与法律问答上测试下游效用。
AI.result: 图结构分类器在留出集上优于原始文本与线性化基线；仅用EKG的检索提升了文档范围QA，但开放检索的增益受限于首阶段候选召回率低。
AI.conclusion: EKG在相关材料已被检索到之后，对证据的组织与推理最为有用。

title: Ego-Exo4D Human Meshes Dataset: 4D Human Motion Reconstruction for Ego-Exo Captures
summary: Ego-Exo4D is a large-scale dataset providing synchronized egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, a rich resource for skill learning and assessment, procedural activity understanding, and embodied AI. However, the dataset ships with only sparse 3D human pose annotations, and reconstructing dense human motion from its multi-view captures is nontrivial. To this end, we present Ego-Exo4D-HM, a large-scale dataset of 4D human motion reconstructions for Ego-Exo4D's captures, and release the accompanying reconstruction pipeline. The code, dataset, and documentation can be found at https://abhiram824.github.io/egoexo4d_human_meshes.

AI.tldr: 提出Ego-Exo4D-HM：为Ego-Exo4D多视角视频提供大规模4D人体运动重建数据集，并开源重建流程。
AI.motivation: Ego-Exo4D虽提供同步的第一人称与多视角第三人称视频，但仅含稀疏3D人体姿态标注，从其多视角素材重建稠密人体运动并不容易，限制了技能学习与评估、程序性活动理解及具身智能等应用。
AI.method: 构建面向Ego-Exo4D采集素材的大规模4D人体运动重建数据集，并配套发布可复现的重建pipeline。
AI.result: 生成覆盖Ego-Exo4D采集的大规模4D人体网格/运动重建数据，代码、数据集与文档已在项目主页公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以数据集与流程的形式补足Ego-Exo4D的稠密运动标注缺口，为相关下游研究提供资源。

title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
summary: Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. However, evaluating this ability is difficult: (1) how to verify whether a genuinely new hypothesis holds, and (2) how to determine whether a system has discovered it through exploration or merely recalled related knowledge from pre-training data. To this end, we introduce ExplorationBench, which turns the wicked problem of evaluating scientific exploration into a concrete and tractable framework built on verifiable Alien Worlds: their rules are executable, so every answer can be checked exactly, and they conflict with familiar knowledge, so recall alone cannot solve the tasks. The benchmark contains two sandboxes, AlienCode (31 discovery targets, 70 tasks) and AlienLogic (24 discovery targets, 70 tasks). Each sandbox provides a flawed manual, task-specific environmental feedback, and a dedicated tool-call schema. Systems use these resources to explore the sandbox, then solve held-out tasks. We evaluate 10 AI systems and find that the strongest systems can acquire and apply unfamiliar rules, while performance varies substantially across trajectories and continued exploration can stall or reverse earlier gains. ExplorationBench represents a step towards AI systems that can acquire and apply genuinely new knowledge through exploration in unknown environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ExplorationBench，将“科学探索”评估转化为基于“异世界”的可验证框架，通过规则可执行、与既有知识冲突的沙盒环境（AlienCode、AlienLogic）确保只能靠探索而非记忆求解，并对 10 个 AI 系统进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 科学发现始于已知问题的边界之外，此时 AI 需通过探索来提出假设、设计实验并迭代结果；但评估该能力存在两大难点：(1) 难以验证一个全新假设是否成立；(2) 难以判断系统是通过探索发现，还是仅从预训练数据中回忆了相关知识。
AI.method: 提出 ExplorationBench，将科学探索评估这一“棘手问题”转化为具体可处理的框架，构建于可验证的“异世界”（Alien Worlds）之上：其规则可执行，因此每个答案都能被精确校验；且其规则与熟悉知识相冲突，因此仅靠回忆无法完成任务。基准包含两个沙盒：AlienCode（31 个发现目标，70 个任务）与 AlienLogic（24 个发现目标，70 个任务）。每个沙盒提供一份有缺陷的手册、针对具体任务的环境反馈以及专门的工具调用模式；系统利用这些资源在沙盒中探索，再求解留出任务。
AI.result: 对 10 个 AI 系统进行评估，发现最强的系统能够习得并应用陌生规则，但性能在不同轨迹间差异显著，且持续的探索可能导致此前的收益停滞甚至倒退。
AI.conclusion: ExplorationBench 是迈向能够在未知环境中通过探索获取并应用真正新知识的 AI 系统的一步。

title: The Alignment Illusion in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Layer-wise visual-text similarity in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is widely interpreted as evidence that the language model progressively integrates visual content into a shared representation space. This reading rests on the assumption that scalar alignment scores reflect content-level cross-modal interaction. To test this assumption, we apply controlled interventions to the visual stream. Across 13 MLLMs from five families spanning 0.5B to 72B parameters, replacing projector-output visual tokens with Gaussian noise sharply reduces task accuracy, yet four standard scalar measures (CKA, SVCCA, MIR, and the leading principal-angle cosine) fail to consistently separate the corrupted stream from the original. We call this failure the alignment illusion and trace it to the shared language-model pathway: anisotropic MLP down-projections pull visual and text tokens toward common output directions, producing weight-induced alignment. Because this component is essentially one-dimensional, we introduce the principal-angle gap (PA gap), defined as the difference between the top two principal-angle cosines, which separates weight-induced similarity from multi-directional visual structure. Under graded visual corruption, the PA gap tracks task accuracy more consistently than the scalar scores we consider; under a structured but irrelevant image, it further exposes regimes in which internal geometry and task accuracy come apart. Internal visual-text alignment in MLLMs is therefore best read as a geometric diagnostic of the visual stream inside the language model rather than a direct proxy for content-level cross-modal interaction, and is most informative when calibrated by controlled task evidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示多模态大模型中层级视觉-文本相似度存在"对齐幻觉"，提出用主角度间隙（PA gap）区分权重诱导相似性与真实多方向视觉结构。
AI.motivation: 层级视觉-文本相似度被广泛解读为语言模型逐步将视觉内容整合进共享表征空间的证据，但这一解读基于"标量对齐分数反映内容级跨模态交互"的假设，尚缺乏验证。
AI.method: 对视觉流施加受控干预：将投影器输出的视觉token替换为高斯噪声，覆盖5个家族、0.5B至72B参数的13个MLLM，考察四种标量指标（CKA、SVCCA、MIR、主角度余弦）能否区分被破坏的视觉流；提出主角度间隙（PA gap），即前两个主角度余弦之差，并在渐变视觉破坏与结构化无关图像条件下进行验证。
AI.result: 替换为高斯噪声显著降低任务准确率，但四种标量指标无法一致区分被破坏的视觉流；失败源于共享语言模型通路中各向异性MLP下投影将视觉与文本token拉向共同输出方向，产生权重诱导对齐。PA gap在渐变破坏下比标量分数更一致地跟踪任务准确率，并在无关图像下揭示内部几何与任务准确率分离的情形。
AI.conclusion: MLLM内部视觉-文本对齐应被理解为语言模型内视觉流的几何诊断，而非内容级跨模态交互的直接代理，只有在受控任务证据校准下才最具信息量。

title: AlphaEarth distinguishes cities but compresses urban variation
summary: Cities differ in built form, land cover and development history, complicating comparison across places and time. Satellite foundation models map Earth's surface onto common numerical representations. Yet the tasks and targets used to shape them typically do not focus on cities: globally consistent labels for urban function do not exist, and many datasets - especially land cover and land use classifications - collapse the built environment into few classes. Here we audit the representation, focusing on AlphaEarth but with broader applicability to other Earth embeddings, by probing the geometry and geography of embeddings for 1,000 urban areas in 162 countries. We find that cities occupy a shifted but overlapping region on the hypersphere, 62.7° from the global mean direction, and continent and climate predict 24.3% of variation among the mean directions of urban centres in excluded countries. Inside cities, degrees of urbanisation carry 8.9% of the variation, and what they leave holds shared directions whose local orientation varies, not one universal axis of urbanisation. Retained variation is itself unequal: dispersion within urban centres is 14.1% greater per standard deviation of national development, even after adjusting for population, land area and continent. Further controls suggest cities in developing countries present less contrast in vegetation and texture, and dispersion follows that contrast: full adjustment for it leaves at most 6.4% of the gradient. Annually, a city's representation moves nearly eight times more than redrawing its own pixels explains, and contracts where the 2022 loss of Sentinel-1B removed a pass direction. AlphaEarth's representations therefore support comparison across regions, while the differences between its annual layers are not yet validated for comparison over time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过探测AlphaEarth等地球嵌入模型对全球162个国家1000个城市区域的表征几何与地理分布，发现城市占据超球面上偏移但可重叠的区域，城市间差异可由洲际、气候、城市化程度及国家发展水平等解释，但模型年度层之间的差异尚不适用于时间比较。
AI.motivation: 城市在建成形态、地表覆盖和发展历史上差异巨大，导致跨地点和跨时间比较困难。卫星基础模型将地表映射到统一数值表征，但其训练任务和目标通常不聚焦城市：缺乏全球一致的城市功能标签，且许多数据集（尤其土地覆盖与土地利用分类）将建成环境压缩为少数类别。因此需审计这类嵌入表征是否支持城市比较。
AI.method: 以AlphaEarth为主，兼顾其他地球嵌入，通过探测嵌入的几何（超球面方向、离散度）与地理属性，分析162个国家1000个城市区域；量化洲际、气候、城市化程度、国家发展水平等对嵌入变异的解释比例，并进行人口、土地面积、洲际等控制；进一步考察植被与纹理对比度对离散度的影响；另外分析年度表征变化与像素重绘及Sentinel-1B在2022年缺失的影响。
AI.result: 城市位于距全球平均方向62.7°的偏移但重叠区域；洲际与气候可预测排除国家城市中心平均方向变异的24.3%；城市内城市化程度承载8.9%变异，剩余变异具有局部方向可变的共享方向，而非单一城市化轴；城市中心内离散度随国家发展水平每标准差增加14.1%，控制人口、土地面积和洲际后仍存在；进一步控制显示发展中国家城市植被与纹理对比度较低，且离散度随对比度变化，完全调整对比度后该梯度最多剩6.4%；城市表征年际移动量约为其自身像素重绘所能解释的近八倍，并在2022年Sentinel-1B缺失一观测方向处收缩。
AI.conclusion: AlphaEarth的表征支持跨区域城市比较，但其年度层之间的差异尚未经过验证，不适合直接用于时间维度比较。

title: Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion U-Net for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Segmentation
summary: The segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images and particularly in MRI scans, is essential for clinical diagnosis and monitoring disease progression. While Deep Learning (DL) architectures, such as U-Net and its extensions are very effective in medical image segmentation tasks, they often struggle with preserving fine-grained details and global contextual information. This is especially challenging for MRI data segmentation, where anatomical structures are characterized by irregular boundaries and variations in shape, contrast, and scale. To address this challenge, we propose a novel DL architecture for MRI segmentation across different anatomical structures. Specifically, the architecture introduces a module, named Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF), that can be easily integrated into any U-Net-like architecture. The MRFF is integrated in all levels of an encode-decoder structure, along with attention mechanisms and skip connections to extract features at multiple resolutions, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained details and global contextual information. We evaluate the MRFFU-Net on two publicly available benchmark MRI datasets of different anatomical targets; one for Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) segmentation in spinal MR scans, and one for left atrium cardiac segmentation, from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) challenge. Experimental results indicate that MRFFU-Net outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple evaluation metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness in MRI segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出MRFFU-Net，通过多分辨率特征融合模块结合注意力与跳跃连接，在脊髓CSF和左心房MRI分割任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 医学图像（尤其MRI）分割对临床诊断与病程监测至关重要。U-Net及其变体虽有效，但难以同时保留细粒度细节与全局上下文信息；而MRI解剖结构边界不规则，且在形状、对比度和尺度上变化较大，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出一种面向不同解剖结构MRI分割的新型深度学习架构。其核心是Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion（MRFF）模块，可便捷嵌入任意U-Net类架构；MRFF被集成到编码器-解码器结构的每一层，并结合注意力机制与跳跃连接，从多分辨率上提取特征，兼顾细粒度细节与全局上下文。
AI.result: 在两个公开MRI基准数据集上评估：脊髓MR扫描的脑脊液（CSF）分割，以及MSD挑战赛的左心房心脏分割。实验结果显示MRFFU-Net在多项评价指标上优于当前最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: MRFFU-Net通过多分辨率特征融合有效提升MRI分割性能，验证了其在跨解剖结构MRI分割中的有效性，且该模块具备良好的通用性与可移植性。

title: WanPE: Towards Cinematic Prompt Enhancement for Modern Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Video generation begins in text space by authoring a cinematic screenplay, then materializes into pixels. As contemporary video generators scale to 30 seconds and faithfully follow complex conditions, the textual prompt largely directs the production, planning how actions, camera trajectories, lighting, and sound unfold across multi-shot sequences. In this paper, we present WanPE, a 397B-parameter prompt enhancement model trained on 1.05M real-world videos to master director-level cinematic planning. WanPE formulates shot-level cinematic plans via video-grounded reverse construction and employs Semantic-Consistency GRPO (SC-GRPO) to faithfully preserve user requirements across shots and over time. To benchmark this capability, we curate WanPEval, a human-annotated testbed covering durations from 5 to 30 seconds across varying intent granularities, supported by approximately 11K blind pairwise assessments. When powering Wan3.0's video generator, WanPE-397B boosts human preference over raw user prompts by 10.66-18.84 points at 5-15 seconds and by a dramatic 50.86 points in the 30-second arena. Ablation studies show that reverse construction demonstrates clear superiority over forward rewriting, while SC-GRPO robustly preserves semantic fidelity across model scales. Ultimately, WanPE leads all evaluated commercial offerings at 5-15 seconds and remains competitive with Seedance 2.5 at 30 seconds.

AI.tldr: 提出397B参数的提示增强模型WanPE，通过视频逆向构建镜头级电影化规划并用语义一致性GRPO训练，显著提升长视频生成的人类偏好，并在5-15秒领先所有商业方案。
AI.motivation: 当代视频生成器已能扩展至30秒并遵循复杂条件，文本提示实际承担了导演级规划职责，需在多镜头序列中规划动作、镜头轨迹、光照与声音；但原始用户提示缺乏这种镜头级电影化规划能力。
AI.method: WanPE为397B参数提示增强模型，基于105万真实视频训练。方法包含两点：(1) 通过视频接地的逆向构建（reverse construction）生成镜头级电影化规划；(2) 提出语义一致性GRPO（SC-GRPO），在跨镜头与跨时间上忠实保留用户需求。同时构建WanPEval人工标注测试基准，覆盖5-30秒、不同意图粒度，含约1.1万次盲测成对评估。
AI.result: 驱动Wan3.0视频生成器时，WanPE-397B相较原始用户提示在人类偏好上提升10.66–18.84分（5–15秒），30秒场景提升达50.86分。消融显示逆向构建明显优于前向改写，SC-GRPO在不同模型规模下稳定保持语义保真。评测中WanPE在5–15秒超越所有对比商业方案，在30秒与Seedance 2.5相当。
AI.conclusion: 提示增强可作为实现导演级电影化规划的有效手段；视频接地逆向构建与SC-GRPO是提升长时多镜头语义一致性及生成质量的关键，WanPE在长视频生成提示增强上达到领先或竞争性水平。

title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
summary: Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. We introduce TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker that breaks this trade-off by representing videos as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the insight that videos are 2D projections of an underlying 3D world, TrackEverything decouples model complexity from video duration, allowing it to scale with unique physical scene geometry instead. Our approach introduces three key innovations. First, we employ a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at sliding-window boundaries to merge co-located tracks, preventing repeated observations of the same surface from redundantly accumulating. Second, we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner that predicts each point's destination and static-versus-dynamic classification, followed by a lightweight trajectory refiner that decodes dense trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Third, we propose 3D WAFT, replacing memory-prohibitive 4D correlation volumes with efficient feature sampling in the scene cloud. To the best of our knowledge, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker capable of tracking all visible points across videos exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB of GPU memory. On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, despite tracking far more points.

AI.tldr: TrackEverything 将视频表示为世界坐标下的持久 3D 场景轨迹，打破“稀疏长时 vs 稠密短时”跟踪权衡，首次在 40GB 显存内实现千帧以上视频的全可见点 3D 跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 点跟踪模型存在根本性权衡：要么跟踪稀疏查询点、可覆盖长时序，要么跟踪全部点、但仅限短视频片段。作者希望打破该权衡，实现长时间、全点稠密跟踪。
AI.method: 核心洞察：视频是 3D 世界的 2D 投影，故以世界坐标下的持久 3D 场景轨迹表示视频，使模型复杂度与视频时长解耦，而随场景几何规模扩展。三项创新：1）基于体素化的去重机制，在滑窗边界合并共位轨迹，避免同一表面的重复观测冗余累积；2）将跟踪分解为端点精化器（预测每个点的目的地及静态/动态分类），再由轻量轨迹精化器仅对动态点解码稠密轨迹；3）提出 3D WAFT，用场景点云中的高效特征采样替代显存开销巨大的 4D 关联体。
AI.result: 在 TAPVid-3D 上，短视频段 APD 超越所有开源全帧稠密 3D 跟踪器 20% 以上；在长序列上与 SOTA 稀疏跟踪器相当（尽管跟踪点数远多）。
AI.conclusion: TrackEverything 是首个能在 40GB GPU 显存内跟踪超过 1000 帧视频中所有可见点的 3D 跟踪器，验证了以持久 3D 场景轨迹解耦模型复杂度与视频时长的有效性。

title: BiCC: Bidirectional Connected-Component Loss for Instance-Aware Segmentation
summary: Common segmentation losses aggregate errors voxel-wise, so lesions influence the objective in proportion to their volume, giving small but clinically critical lesions disproportionately little weight. Instance-aware losses aim to address this mismatch by assigning each lesion its own term. However, blob loss and CC-DiceCE derive their regions solely from annotations, so false-positive components receive no instance-level term. This matters in computer-assisted review, where each false-positive component may require separate inspection, making precision and false-positive burden important alongside recall. We introduce the bidirectional connected-component loss (BiCC), which pairs annotation- and prediction-derived partitions to score predicted components on their own scale. By deriving instances from the predictions, this branch directly penalizes false-positive components regardless of their size. The balance parameter $α$ allows control over the lesion-wise precision-recall trade-off. Across five datasets with five-fold cross-validation using nnU-Net, BiCC outperforms CC-DiceCE in lesion-wise F1 on four datasets and blob loss on all five. It significantly improves over DiceCE on three datasets and matches it on two; CC-DiceCE instead loses up to 0.363 precision by favoring recall. Code is available at https://github.com/TIO-IKIM/BiCC-Loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向连通组件损失（BiCC），通过同时使用标注和预测导出的分区来评估预测组件，从而直接惩罚假阳性组件，在五个数据集上优于现有实例感知损失。
AI.motivation: 常见分割损失按体素聚合误差，使病灶影响与体积成正比，导致小而关键的病灶权重过低。实例感知损失（如blob loss、CC-DiceCE）虽为每个病灶分配独立项，但其区域仅来自标注，无法为假阳性组件提供实例级惩罚。在计算机辅助复核场景中，每个假阳性组件都可能需要单独检查，因此精确率和假阳性负担与召回率同样重要。
AI.method: 提出双向连通组件损失（BiCC），将标注导出的分区与预测导出的分区配对，在预测组件自身的尺度上对其进行评分。通过从预测中导出实例，该分支可直接惩罚任意大小的假阳性组件。平衡参数α用于控制病灶级别的精确率-召回率权衡。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上使用nnU-Net进行五折交叉验证，BiCC在四个数据集上的病灶级F1优于CC-DiceCE，在全部五个数据集上优于blob loss；在三个数据集上显著优于DiceCE，在另外两个数据集上与之持平。而CC-DiceCE因偏向召回率，精确率最多下降0.363。
AI.conclusion: BiCC通过双向连通组件配对实现了对假阳性组件的实例级惩罚，在保持召回率的同时改善了病灶级精确率-召回率权衡，在多个数据集上优于现有实例感知损失。

title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
summary: Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. We hence ask: given a new reward function, is it possible to predict the RL outcomes without actually running RL on it? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing PoEM, a framework to predict the outputs of RL on a new reward function using a set of models already post-trained on other rewards. First, we show that if the new reward function can be written as a linear combination of existing ones, then the new policy in log-space can be written as a linear combination of the existing log-policies. Surprisingly, even in cases where the rewards are not linearly connected, we observe that often log-policies from RL training span an approximately low-rank subspace across rewards. To our benefit, the weighting coefficients for this combination can be estimated using only the reward or basis policy outputs on the samples. We turn these observations into an algorithm that takes post-trained models and a new reward function, and approximates the target RL policy without actually running any additional RL training. We experimentally validate our approach across synthetic and real rewards, spanning both text and image modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出 PoEM 框架，利用已有奖励上后训练的模型，通过 log-策略的线性组合近似预测新奖励下的 RL 结果，无需重新运行 RL。
AI.motivation: RL 后训练计算开销大、不稳定，且每当奖励模型变化或需组合多奖励时都要从头训练；因此希望：给定新奖励函数，能否不实际运行 RL 就预测其 RL 结果。
AI.method: 1) 证明若新奖励可写为现有奖励的线性组合，则新策略在 log 空间可表示为现有 log-策略的线性组合；2) 发现即使奖励非线性相关，RL 训练的 log-策略在不同奖励间也常张成近似低秩子空间；3) 仅用样本上的奖励或基策略输出即可估计组合权重；4) 据此设计算法，输入已后训练模型与新奖励函数，近似目标 RL 策略而无需额外 RL 训练。
AI.result: 在合成与真实奖励上、涵盖文本与图像两种模态进行了实验验证，方法有效。
AI.conclusion: 可以通过对已有后训练模型 log-策略的线性组合，在不运行 RL 的情况下预测新奖励下的 RL 输出，为 RL 后训练提供高效替代方案。

title: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
summary: Online misinformation increasingly appears in spoken formats such as news clips, podcasts, interviews, political speeches, and social media videos, creating a need for fact-checking systems that can verify claims directly from speech. We introduce VeriSpeak, a probe benchmark for studying speech-based fact verification in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs). VeriSpeak contains 3,879 spoken claims spanning temporal, geographical, and relational facts, with balanced true and false labels. The benchmark is designed to examine whether factual verification ability transfers from text to speech, and whether retrieval-augmented LALMs can use textual evidence to correctly support or refute spoken claims. Our experiments reveal a consistent text-speech modality gap: LALMs that verify written claims reliably often fail on the same claims when spoken. Moreover, retrieval alone provides limited gains because models frequently conflate retrieved evidence with the spoken claim. In contrast, retrieval combined with explicit reasoning improves claim-evidence comparison, with a thinking-tuned LALM reaching 86.1% accuracy. VeriSpeak highlights that effective speech misinformation detection requires not only speech understanding, but also grounded reasoning over retrieved evidence. The dataset is publicly available via Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhiram4572/VeriSpeak.

AI.tldr: VeriSpeak 是一个面向大音频语言模型（LALMs）的语音事实核查探针基准，包含 3,879 条语音声明，揭示出文本到语音存在稳定的模态鸿沟，且检索增强需配合显式推理才能有效验证语音声明。
AI.motivation: 在线虚假信息日益以语音形式出现（新闻片段、播客、访谈、演讲、社交媒体视频），因此需要能够直接从语音中验证声明的核查系统。该研究旨在探究：事实核查能力是否能从文本迁移到语音，以及检索增强的 LALMs 能否利用文本证据支持或反驳语音声明。
AI.method: 构建 VeriSpeak 探针基准，包含 3,879 条语音声明，覆盖时间、地理与关系类事实，真假标签均衡。通过实验对比 LALMs 在文本与语音同一声明上的表现，并评估纯检索增强与检索结合显式推理两种设置下利用文本证据进行验证的效果。
AI.result: 实验显示出一致的文本-语音模态鸿沟：能可靠验证书面声明的 LALMs 在相同声明以语音呈现时常失败。仅靠检索带来的增益有限，模型常将检索到的证据与语音声明混为一谈；而检索结合显式推理可改善声明-证据对比，采用思维链微调的 LALM 达到 86.1% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: 有效的语音虚假信息检测不仅需要语音理解能力，还需要对检索证据进行有依据的推理（grounded reasoning）。VeriSpeak 数据集已通过 Hugging Face 公开，链接为 https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhiram4572/VeriSpeak。

title: OmniFabric: Coherent UV Space Texture Synthesis for 3D Garment Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026. Project Page: https://humansensinglab.github.io/OmniFabric/
summary: Automated generation of production-ready 3D garment assets from a single image is a central challenge in digital content creation. While recent generative models have significantly advanced 3D geometry reconstruction, synthesizing high-quality textures remains a bottleneck. Existing methods often bake environmental illumination and shadows directly into the texture map, or they fail to maintain global structural coherence, making the resulting assets unusable for physical simulation and relighting. In this work, we introduce OmniFabric, a novel approach that synthesizes globally coherent texture maps directly within the 2D sewing pattern space. Given a single reference image, our pipeline utilizes an estimated 3D mesh and generative priors of powerful Vision-Language Models (VLM) to establish a complete but coarse texture initialization across the unwrapped sewing patterns. We then leverage a specialized diffusion transformer, trained via an automated synthetic data engine and conditioned on 3D positional features, to refine this initialization directly in the canonical UV domain. This effectively removes distortion and baked-in artifacts to extract a clean and normalized texture map that preserves the original garment design. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniFabric significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, yielding photorealistic 3D garments with high-quality textures.

AI.tldr: OmniFabric：在2D缝纫样板空间内合成全局一致的纹理贴图，从单张图像生成可用于物理仿真与重光照的高质量3D服装资产。
AI.motivation: 从单图自动生成生产级3D服装资产是数字内容创作的核心难题。现有生成模型虽在3D几何重建上进步显著，但纹理合成仍是瓶颈：常把环境光照与阴影烘焙进纹理贴图，或缺乏全局结构一致性，导致资产无法用于物理仿真与重光照。
AI.method: 方法分两阶段：（1）给定单张参考图，利用估计的3D网格与强大VLM的生成先验，在展开的缝纫样板上建立完整但粗糙的纹理初始化；（2）使用经自动化合成数据引擎训练、以3D位置特征为条件的专用扩散Transformer，在规范UV域中直接精化该初始化，去除畸变与烘焙伪影，提取保持原服装设计的干净归一化纹理贴图。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，OmniFabric显著优于当前最先进的基线方法，能够生成具有高质量纹理的逼真3D服装。
AI.conclusion: 在2D缝纫样板空间内直接合成全局一致纹理，可有效解决光照烘焙与结构不一致问题，为单图驱动的可仿真、可重光照3D服装资产生成提供了可行路径。

title: SemMSA: Latent Semantic-Aided Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Data
summary: Recent research on Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) has focused on learning from language, visual, and acoustic modalities with incomplete data to infer human sentiment. Most studies typically compensate for missing information by reconstructing modality features or designing complicated fusion mechanisms. However, these methods still suffer from spurious generation and noisy guidance due to the lack of high-level semantic grounding in partially observed multimodal evidence. To address these issues, we propose SemMSA, a latent semantic-aided framework that constructs rich sentiment-relevant semantics with LLMs, fully integrating with all modalities via anchor-free spectral alignment. It mainly consists of Cross-modal Semantic Refinement (CSR) and Cross-modal Spectral Alignment (CSA). Specifically, CSR first adaptively extracts visual and acoustic representations by corresponding adapters to form a unified multimodal prefix with language in the frozen LLM embedding space. It then iteratively produces continuous discriminative semantic states through a token-efficient latent refinement process without decoding explicit text. Next, CSA simultaneously aligns the refined semantics with all modalities by enhancing the dominant spectral component of their kernel Gram matrix. This captures global nonlinear dependencies among all representations without relying on a predefined anchor modality. In addition, an instance-level spectral separation constraint preserves cross-sample discriminability and mitigates representation collapse. Extensive experiments on SIMS, MOSI, and MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that SemMSA achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出SemMSA框架，利用大语言模型构建情感语义，并通过无锚点的谱对齐实现不完整多模态数据下的多模态情感分析，在SIMS、MOSI、MOSEI上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析中数据常存在模态缺失，现有方法多通过特征重建或复杂融合机制补全信息，但缺乏高层语义支撑，导致虚假生成与噪声引导问题。
AI.method: SemMSA包含跨模态语义精炼（CSR）与跨模态谱对齐（CSA）。CSR用适配器提取视觉与声学表示，与语言在冻结LLM嵌入空间组成统一多模态前缀，通过token高效的潜在精炼迭代生成连续判别性语义状态，无需解码显式文本；CSA通过增强核Gram矩阵的主谱分量，实现无预定义锚模态的全局非线性依赖对齐，并引入实例级谱分离约束保持跨样本判别性、缓解表示坍缩。
AI.result: 在SIMS、MOSI和MOSEI基准上实验表明，SemMSA达到state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 以LLM潜在语义为引导、结合谱对齐的框架能有效缓解部分观测多模态证据下的虚假生成与噪声引导问题，为不完整多模态情感分析提供新思路。

title: JevOut: Natural Context Can Flip Decision Models
comment: 46 pages, 8 figures, 30 tables. V2: substantially strengthened empirical evaluation with blinded human validation, a budget-matched independent-generation baseline, and repeatability analyses; expanded related work and updated author list. Homepage: https://xzx34.github.io/jevout/ ; Code: https://github.com/xzx34/JevOut
summary: An ordinary-looking background detail can turn a correct model decision into a confident mistake. We demonstrate this fragility in four decision systems, including Jev, across seven datasets covering knowledge, reasoning, and tool routing. Within 64 accepted target evaluations per decision, we uncover short context additions that redirect 61.4%-73.2% of each system's initially correct decisions toward a wrong option fixed in advance. The additions supply background or procedural information rather than explicit answer-selection instructions, leaving the original question and choices intact. We construct them through probability-guided context optimization, which uses shifts in the option distribution to refine surrounding text under naturalness and answer-preservation constraints. Redirection affects initially confident decisions, often produces high-confidence wrong choices, and transfers across models. In blinded human evaluation, 91.6% of 250 sampled successful contexts are judged natural, answer-preserving, and free of decisive answer-changing evidence by a majority of three independent annotators. These findings expose a weakness in current decision models: context that looks entirely compatible with an input can redirect the choices that agents, routers, and evaluators rely on.

AI.tldr: 看似无害的背景细节上下文可诱导决策模型从正确答案转向预设错误选项，攻击成功率约61.4%–73.2%，且对高置信决策有效并可跨模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 揭示当前决策系统对上下文的脆弱性：普通背景或流程信息即可将原本正确的决策重定向为自信错误，威胁智能体、路由与评估器的可靠性。
AI.method: 概率引导的上下文优化（probability-guided context optimization）：利用选项分布偏移，在自然性与答案保持约束下迭代精炼周边文本，生成不含显式选项指令的短上下文添加。覆盖4个决策系统（含Jev）、7个数据集（知识、推理、工具路由），每个决策限定64个被接受的目标评估并联动人工盲评。
AI.result: 在四个系统上分别将61.4%–73.2%的初始正确决策重定向到预先固定的错误选项；被重定向的决策常具高置信度，且攻击可跨模型迁移。三名独立标注者盲评250个成功上下文中，91.6%被多数判定为自然、不改变答案且无决定性改答证据。
AI.conclusion: 现有决策模型存在系统性弱点：与输入看似完全兼容的上下文即可改变选择，需在智能体、路由与评估环节加强对上下文的重定向防御。

title: Towards Practical Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis but requires substantial storage. Existing compression methods often rely on spatial context modeling over irregular 3D representations, increasing the complexity of training and coding. Meanwhile, floating-point context inference can introduce numerical inconsistencies across platforms, causing entropy-decoding failures. To address these practical challenges, we propose COSA-GS, which constructs context without spatial aggregation through anchor-wise causal factorization. Specifically, we use geometry context derived from each anchor's coordinates to model a compact learnable anchor latent. The anchor latent is then fused with the geometry context to form an anchor context for attribute coding. The resulting context model features a simple architecture composed solely of linear transformations and activations. We train COSA-GS using rate--distortion optimization with adaptive Gaussian pruning. Further, we develop quantization-aware training and integer inference for the context model to achieve bit-exact consistency of entropy-decoded symbols across platforms. Experiments demonstrate that COSA-GS achieves state-of-the-art compression performance while retaining fast and consistent cross-platform decoding, providing a simple yet effective framework for practical 3DGS compression. Code is available at https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/COSA-GS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 COSA-GS，通过逐锚点因果分解构建上下文、无需空间聚合，并结合率失真优化、自适应高斯剪枝及量化感知训练+整数推理，实现高效且跨平台一致的 3DGS 压缩。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 可高质量合成新视角，但存储开销巨大。现有压缩方法多依赖对不规则 3D 表示的空间上下文建模，训练与编码复杂度高；同时浮点上下文推理在不同平台间存在数值不一致，易导致熵解码失败。
AI.method: 提出 COSA-GS，通过 anchor-wise 因果分解在不做空间聚合的情况下构建上下文：利用每个锚点坐标得到的几何上下文来建模紧凑的可学习锚点潜变量，再与其融合形成锚点上下文用于属性编码。上下文模型仅由线性变换和激活构成。采用率失真优化与自适应高斯剪枝训练，并引入量化感知训练与整数推理以保证熵解码符号跨平台位精确一致。
AI.result: 实验表明 COSA-GS 达到 state-of-the-art 压缩性能，同时保持快速且跨平台一致的解码，为实用的 3DGS 压缩提供了简单而有效的框架。
AI.conclusion: COSA-GS 通过简化的锚点级上下文建模与整数化推理，兼顾了压缩率、解码速度与跨平台一致性，是面向实际部署的 3DGS 压缩方案；代码已开源。

title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Under review. Project page: https://rolling-wam.github.io/
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rolling-WAM，将视频-动作联合去噪过程分散到多个重规划周期中，通过滑动窗口与滚动噪声调度实现跨块上下文传递，在保持操作性能的同时获得4.5倍稳态重规划加速。
AI.motivation: World Action Models（WAMs）将动作生成与未来视觉预测耦合用于机器人操作，但每个重规划周期都需完成完整的联合视频-动作去噪，造成显著延迟，拖慢动作更新并限制闭环响应能力。
AI.method: Rolling-WAM 维护一个处于交错噪声水平的视频-动作块滑动窗口；每步通过滚动噪声调度将临近的动作块完全去噪以执行，同时对更远未来的块进行部分细化；随着窗口随新相机观测前移，保留的未来块继续其去噪过程，从而随时间分摊计算成本，并在块边界之间携带演化的视觉-动作上下文。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 以及真实世界 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的评测表明，Rolling-WAM 达到具有竞争力的操作性能；由于无需从头对整个预测时域去噪，相比标准联合 WAM 实现 4.5 倍稳态重规划加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过将联合去噪分布到连续重规划周期并跨块复用部分去噪的未来预测，Rolling-WAM 在维持操作性能的同时显著降低重规划延迟，提升闭环响应能力。

title: RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations
summary: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration. The iterative agentic loop of code refinement requires several key ingredients: (i) a testable task specification, (ii) action primitives for robot execution, and (iii) an interactive environment for program execution and verification. RAPID infers all three from the demonstration automatically. To make the resulting program reusable beyond the demonstration setting, RAPID uses an object-centric relational program representation that focuses on the underlying structure of the demonstrated strategy rather than the specific motion per se: it expresses the action primitives as trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, while composing them through relational constraints that capture scene-specific geometry at run time. We evaluated RAPID in simulation on eight challenging contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks as well as general prehensile manipulation tasks in the LIBERO-Pro benchmark. We also successfully deployed it on a real Franka arm and evaluated on all eight nonprehensile tasks. In all experiments, RAPID demonstrated strong performance, with generalization over object pose, shape, material, and environment. Website: https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.

AI.tldr: RAPID 提出一种面向机器人系统的"从演示中智能体编程"框架，仅凭单次人类视觉演示，即可自动生成、验证并迭代精炼机器人程序。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在复杂编程任务上表现优异，但要将其能力迁移到机器人系统，需要可测试的任务规范、可执行的技能基元以及可交互的验证环境。传统方法往往依赖人工定义这些要素，且生成的运动程序难以泛化到演示之外的新场景。
AI.method: RAPID 从单次视觉演示中自动推断三项关键要素：可测试任务规范、机器人执行所需的动作基元、以及用于程序执行与验证的交互环境。构建智能体式代码精炼循环，迭代生成、验证和修正程序。为实现跨场景复用，采用以物体为中心的关系式程序表示：动作基元被表达为轨迹优化程序，用以实现物体层面的运动效果；并通过关系约束在运行时捕捉场景特定几何，从而组合这些基元。
AI.result: 在仿真中评估了八个高难度的接触丰富非抓取操作任务，以及 LIBERO-Pro 基准中的通用抓取操作任务；并在真实 Franka 机械臂上部署，完成全部八个非抓取任务的评估。所有实验中 RAPID 均表现强劲，在物体位姿、形状、材质与环境方面具有泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RAPID 表明，将编码智能体的自动生成—验证—精炼循环与以物体为中心的关系式程序表示相结合，可从单次视觉演示自动构建可复用、可泛化的机器人操作程序，并在仿真与真实平台上验证了其有效性。

title: Agentic Detection of Online Conspiracies
summary: Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers. The same surface content may express endorsement, legitimate concerns, criticism, satire, or mockery. The main challenge is therefore not only recognizing conspiracy-related claims, but inferring the speaker's intent -- the utterance's illocutionary force. We argue that this can be achieved through the use of relevant social contexts and propose an agentic framework, equipped with a set of tools supporting social queries. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on a unique dataset of Hebrew tweets, covering 80\%--90\% of the public Hebrew tweets published over a four-year span (late 2018-- early 2023), encompassing several election cycles as well as the COVID pandemic years and related vaccination campaigns. This extensive coverage can be used in recovering different social contexts. Evaluating our framework on a manually-annotated adversarial dataset, we find that context-aware workflows consistently outperform text-only classification and that the agentic framework performs significantly better than other frameworks and settings, including a non-agentic model exposed to the same contexts available to the agent. We further provide an analysis of the results, the errors and efficiency (token economy) tradeoffs. These findings support viewing the task of conspiracy detection as a socially embedded interpretation task, in which effective classification depends not only on access to contexts, but also on adaptive reasoning in which the agent uses tools on a per-case basis, asking only for evidence relevant to its current reasoning step.

AI.tldr: 论文主张阴谋论检测应被视为社会嵌入的意图推断任务，提出配备社交查询工具的智能体框架，在希伯来语推特数据上验证上下文感知与自适应推理的优越性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上的阴谋论话语并非总以显式主张或稳定词汇标记出现；相同表层内容可能表达支持、合理关切、批评、讽刺或嘲弄。因此核心挑战不只是识别阴谋相关主张，而是推断说话者意图（即话语的言外之力）。作者认为这需要借助相关社会语境。
AI.method: 提出一个智能体（agentic）框架，配备一组支持社交查询的工具。数据集为独特的希伯来语推文，覆盖2018年末至2023年初四年间80%–90%的公开希伯来语推文，涵盖多个选举周期及新冠疫情期间与相关疫苗接种活动。广泛的覆盖范围可用于恢复不同社会语境。在人工标注的对抗性数据集上评估，比较上下文感知工作流与纯文本分类、智能体框架与非智能体但同样可访问上下文的模型。
AI.result: 上下文感知工作流持续优于纯文本分类；智能体框架显著优于其他框架和设置，包括可访问相同上下文的非智能体模型。论文还分析了结果、错误及效率（token经济性）的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 应将阴谋论检测视为社会嵌入的解读任务：有效分类不仅取决于能否访问上下文，还取决于自适应推理——智能体按案例使用工具，只请求与当前推理步骤相关的证据。

title: LiTe-GS: Oracle-Efficient Next Best View Selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Selecting informative camera views is critical for efficient training and adaptive refinement in 3D Gaussian Splatting, where each observation significantly influences model parameters. However, information-driven view-selection strategies can require repeated evaluations of expensive information-gain oracles as the number of candidate views increases. We propose LiTe-GS, an oracle-efficient method for next best view selection in 3D Gaussian Splatting. LiTe-GS reduces the number of information-oracle evaluations by performing randomized subset evaluation of candidate views rather than exhaustively scoring the full candidate pool. The resulting approach achieves expected $O(M\log(1/ε))$ oracle complexity with respect to the number of candidate views $M$, independent of the selection cardinality $K$, while providing an explicit trade-off between oracle efficiency and approximation quality through $ε$. We provide theoretical guarantees on oracle complexity and approximation performance under the proposed selection scheme. Experiments on Blender and Mip-NeRF 360 demonstrate that LiTe-GS maintains reconstruction quality comparable to Fisher-information-based baselines while substantially reducing the number of Fisher-oracle evaluations across different acquisition settings.

AI.tldr: LiTe-GS 提出一种对 oracle 高效的 3D Gaussian Splatting 下一最佳视角选择方法，通过随机子集评估将 oracle 复杂度降至期望 O(M log(1/ε))，且与选择基数 K 无关，在保持重建质量的同时显著减少 Fisher 信息 oracle 调用次数。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 中每个观测都会显著影响模型参数，因此选择信息量大的相机视角对高效训练和自适应细化至关重要。然而，基于信息增益的视角选择策略在候选视角数量增加时，往往需要反复调用昂贵的信息增益 oracle，导致计算开销过大。
AI.method: LiTe-GS 对候选视角进行随机子集评估，而非对完整候选池进行穷举打分，从而减少信息 oracle 的评估次数。该方法在理论上达到关于候选视角数 M 的期望 O(M log(1/ε)) oracle 复杂度，且与选择基数 K 无关，并通过 ε 在 oracle 效率与近似质量之间提供显式权衡。
AI.result: 论文给出了该选择方案在 oracle 复杂度与近似性能方面的理论保证。在 Blender 和 Mip-NeRF 360 数据集上的实验表明，LiTe-GS 在保持与基于 Fisher 信息的基线相当的重建质量的同时，在不同采集设置下大幅减少了 Fisher oracle 的评估次数。
AI.conclusion: LiTe-GS 通过随机子集评估实现了对 oracle 高效的下一最佳视角选择，在理论上具备优良的复杂度与近似保证，并在实验中验证了其在不损失重建质量前提下显著降低计算成本的有效性。

title: CSCWD: Cross-Scale Channel-wise Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Tiny Object Detection on Edge Devices
summary: Real-time tiny object detection in aerial imagery is constrained by the weak spatial evidence of very small objects and the loss of high-resolution detail in lightweight detectors. This study presents Cross-Scale Channel-wise Knowledge Distillation (CSCWD), a training-time framework that transfers high-resolution spatial representations from a YOLO11m-P2 teacher to a compact YOLO11n student without altering the student's inference architecture. Unlike conventional same-scale feature distillation, CSCWD transfers supervision from teacher P2 to student P3 after feature alignment while retaining same-scale distillation at deeper pyramid levels. Under the unified seven-sequence Drone-vs-Bird validation protocol, YOLO11n-CSCWD achieves 50.17% mean average precision at an intersection-over-union threshold of 0.5 (mAP@0.5) and 59.73% recall, improving the matched CA-YOLO11n baseline by 2.92 percentage points in mAP@0.5 and 3.55 points in recall. Cross-scale alignment further increases mAP@0.5 by 2.09 points over the corresponding same-scale channel-wise distillation configuration. In zero-shot evaluation on DUT-Anti-UAV, mAP@0.5 increases from 48.29% to 50.06% without target-domain fine-tuning. This domain was included because its challenging small targets make low-latency, computationally efficient detection particularly relevant. On Raspberry Pi 5 using NCNN-FP16 at 640x640 resolution, the 2.58-million-parameter student achieves 50.32% mAP@0.5 at 82.32 ms mean wall-clock latency, or 12.15 frames per second, while retaining essentially the same runtime and memory requirements as the matched baseline. The results support cross-scale distillation for improving tiny-target detection without increasing inference-time model complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨尺度通道知识蒸馏（CSCWD）框架，在不改变学生推理结构的前提下，将YOLO11m-P2教师的高分辨率空间表征迁移至轻量YOLO11n学生，显著提升航拍微小目标检测精度且保持推理开销不变。
AI.motivation: 航拍图像实时微小目标检测受限于两方面：极小目标的空间证据薄弱，以及轻量检测器在高分辨率细节上的丢失。常规同尺度特征蒸馏难以弥补学生网络缺失的高分辨率信息。
AI.method: 提出CSCWD训练时框架：以YOLO11m-P2为教师、YOLO11n为学生，保持学生推理架构不变。与常规同尺度蒸馏不同，CSCWD在特征对齐后将教师P2的监督迁移至学生P3，同时在更深金字塔层级保留同尺度蒸馏，形成跨尺度加同尺度相结合的通道级知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在Drone-vs-Bird七序列统一验证协议下，YOLO11n-CSCWD达到50.17% mAP@0.5与59.73%召回，较匹配的CA-YOLO11n基线分别提升2.92和3.55个百分点；跨尺度对齐相比对应同尺度通道蒸馏再提升2.09个百分点。DUT-Anti-UAV零样本测试中mAP@0.5由48.29%升至50.06%。在Raspberry Pi 5上以NCNN-FP16、640x640分辨率运行，258万参数学生达50.32% mAP@0.5、82.32 ms平均延迟（12.15 FPS），运行时与内存开销与基线基本一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明跨尺度蒸馏能在不增加推理期模型复杂度的条件下有效提升微小目标检测性能，兼顾精度与边缘端实时性。

title: What Improves Multimodal Misinformation Detection? Answers from a Large-Scale Empirical Study
comment: Accepted at the Tenth Widening NLP Workshop (WiNLP), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Multimodal misinformation is increasingly crafted to look convincing by pairing a textual claim with an image that appears to "prove" it. Yet in practice, building effective detectors often hinges on a small set of design choices that are rarely examined in a controlled way. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale study of multimodal design choices for misinformation detection with over 3,375 experiments- spanning three benchmark datasets and a broad range of pre-trained vision and language backbones. Through systematic comparisons and targeted robustness analyses, we distill practical guidance on which design choices help, when do they fail silently, and what aspects of the pipeline most strongly shape model behavior, answering 4 key Research Questions (RQs). We aim to provide a reliable foundation for designing stronger and more dependable multimodal misinformation detection systems, thus contributing to the broader research community.

AI.tldr: 本文通过超过3375次实验，系统研究了多模态虚假信息检测的设计选择，涵盖三个基准数据集和多种预训练视觉/语言骨干网络，回答4个关键研究问题并给出实用设计指导。
AI.motivation: 多模态虚假信息常通过文本声称与看似"证明"该声称的图像配对来增强说服力。然而，构建有效检测器在实践上往往依赖于少数设计选择，而这些选择很少被以受控方式加以检验，缺乏可靠的设计依据。
AI.method: 开展大规模多模态虚假信息检测设计选择研究，共进行超过3375次实验，覆盖三个基准数据集以及范围广泛的预训练视觉与语言骨干网络；通过系统性对比与针对性鲁棒性分析，提炼设计经验。
AI.result: 系统比较与鲁棒性分析揭示了哪些设计选择有益、何时会静默失效，以及流水线中哪些环节最强烈地影响模型行为，并据此回答4个关键研究问题。
AI.conclusion: 为设计更强大、更可靠的多模态虚假信息检测系统提供可靠基础，从而为更广泛的研究社区作出贡献。

title: A Unified Account of Concepts and Chunks
summary: Cognitive psychology has studied how people encode, use, and learn concepts that describe categories, and how they represent, recognize, and acquire chunks for familiar patterns of elements. The literatures on these two topics are nearly disjoint, which poses a challenge for unified theories of cognition. In this paper, we review Cobweb, a computational account of categorization and concept formation, then propose an extended theory that incorporates chunks and their acquisition. The theory makes no commitments about modality, applying to any experience that decomposes into elements and relations among them. We also present \trellis/, an implementation of this theory, and illustrate its application to learning context-free grammars, which we adopt as a testbed because they involve both concept-like and chunk-like elements. In addition, we report experimental results on learning for three synthetic grammars that demonstrate the system's ability to represent syntactic knowledge, use it to parse and generate sentences, and learn compositional structures from sample parses. We conclude by discussing related work on concepts and chunks, along with directions for future research on the problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一概念与组块（chunk）的认知理论：在Cobweb分类与概念形成框架上扩展出组块及其习得机制，并实现系统Trellis，在上下文无关文法学习任务上验证其表示句法知识、解析/生成句子及从样本解析中学习组合结构的能力。
AI.motivation: 认知心理学中关于“概念/类别”的研究与关于“组块/熟悉元素模式”的研究几乎相互独立，缺乏统一解释，这给统一的认知理论带来挑战。作者希望将二者整合到一个不依赖特定模态的框架中。
AI.method: 首先回顾Cobweb这一分类与概念形成的计算理论；随后提出扩展理论，将组块及其习得纳入同一体系。理论对模态不作承诺，适用于任何可分解为元素及元素间关系的经验。作者实现系统Trellis，并以上下文无关文法作为测试平台（因其同时包含类概念与类组块要素）。对三个合成文法开展学习实验。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Trellis能够表示句法知识，利用该知识解析和生成句子，并能从样本解析中学习组合结构。
AI.conclusion: 本文展示了统一概念与组块理论的可行性，并讨论了与概念、组块相关的已有工作及未来研究方向。

title: All In Good Time: Causality-Aware Framework for LLM-Based Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in low-resource offline translation; however, extending them to simultaneous speech-to-speech translation (Simul-S2ST) remains challenging due to the scarcity of causally aligned training data with high cross-lingual speaker fidelity. In addition, existing approaches rely on fixed translation policy or confidence heuristics, leading to suboptimal quality and higher latency. We propose a causality-aware Simul-S2ST framework with a novel data pipeline that generates high-fidelity, causally aligned segments with improved voice transfer. The framework introduces (i) a factorized S2ST architecture (FAST), (ii) a causality-aware adaptive policy (CAP), and (iii) causality-aware latency metric. Experiments on CVSS Spanish, German, and French show that FAST-CAP consistently improves the quality-latency trade-off, achieving up to +1.2 BLEU and a 26% relative latency reduction over a fixed policy. Despite using substantially less training data than existing systems, FAST-CAP achieves state-of-the-art results in speech translation quality and speaker fidelity while yielding up to a 38.8% relative reduction in latency.

AI.tldr: 提出因果感知的FAST-CAP框架用于同声传译语音到语音翻译，通过新数据管线、分解式架构与自适应策略，在质量-延迟权衡上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 同声传译语音到语音翻译（Simul-S2ST）面临两大难题：一是缺乏具有高跨语言说话人保真度的因果对齐训练数据；二是现有方法依赖固定翻译策略或置信度启发式，导致翻译质量欠佳且延迟较高。本文旨在解决数据稀缺与策略僵化问题。
AI.method: 提出因果感知Simul-S2ST框架，包含：(1) 新数据管线，生成高保真、因果对齐且语音迁移更好的分段；(2) 分解式S2ST架构（FAST）；(3) 因果感知自适应策略（CAP）；(4) 因果感知延迟度量指标。
AI.result: 在CVSS西班牙语、德语、法语上实验表明，FAST-CAP持续改善质量-延迟权衡，相比固定策略最高提升+1.2 BLEU，相对延迟降低26%。虽训练数据远少于现有系统，仍实现语音翻译质量与说话人保真度的SOTA，延迟相对降低最高达38.8%。
AI.conclusion: FAST-CAP框架在同声传译语音到语音翻译中兼顾翻译质量、说话人保真度与低延迟，在数据受限条件下达到先进水平，验证了因果对齐数据管线与自适应策略的有效性。

title: Beyond MSE: Rician Likelihood Denoising for Self-Supervised Cardiac $T2$ and $T1ρ$ MRI
summary: Magnetic resonance imaging involves an inherent trade-off among spatial resolution, acquisition time, and noise. This trade-off contributes to long scan times and high cost. Deep learning has improved image denoising, but cardiac MRI remains difficult because high-resolution, rapid acquisitions generally lack corresponding low-noise ground truth. Self-supervised denoising offers a potential solution by learning from noisy image pairs or even single noisy acquisitions. However, we show that Noise2Void-style blind-spot denoising, which uses a mean squared error (MSE) loss and assumes zero-mean, independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) noise, is poorly suited to MR magnitude images. When applied to short-axis $T2$-weighted and $T1ρ$-weighted cardiac MRI with synthetic Rician noise, it produces biased denoised images and biased parametric maps of $T2$ and $T1ρ$. To address this limitation, we formulate self-supervised denoising as maximum likelihood estimation under a known Rician noise model. This yields unbiased denoisers that are competitive with supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: 该文指出Noise2Void类盲点自监督去噪基于MSE与零均值i.i.d.噪声假设，不适用于MRI幅度图像的Rician噪声，会产生有偏结果；提出在已知Rician噪声模型下以最大似然估计进行自监督去噪，得到无偏且可媲美有监督基线的去噪器。
AI.motivation: MRI存在空间分辨率、采集时间与噪声之间的固有权衡，导致扫描时间长、成本高。心脏MRI尤为困难：高分辨率快速采集通常缺乏对应的低噪声真值（ground truth）。自监督去噪（从噪声图像对甚至单幅噪声图像学习）提供了潜在解决方案，但现有方法假设噪声特性与MRI幅度图像不符。
AI.method: 首先分析并证明Noise2Void式盲点去噪（采用均方误差损失、假设零均值独立同分布噪声）不适用于MR幅度图像。随后将自监督去噪重新表述为已知Rician噪声模型下的最大似然估计（MLE）。实验对象为短轴T2加权与T1ρ加权心脏MRI，并加入合成Rician噪声。
AI.result: 在带合成Rician噪声的短轴T2加权和T1ρ加权心脏MRI上，盲点去噪产生了有偏的去噪图像，以及有偏的T2和T1ρ参数图。基于Rician噪声模型的MLE自监督去噪器则无偏，且性能可媲美有监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 自监督去噪的噪声假设必须与MRI幅度图像的Rician噪声统计特性匹配；将去噪建模为已知Rician噪声模型下的最大似然估计，可消除偏差，并在心脏MRI参数映射任务中达到接近有监督水平的性能。

title: ProCAP: Probabilistic Cross-Attentive Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Pre-trained vision-language models such as CLIP can recognize new categories via prompting, but they often struggle when labeled data are scarce or the test distribution shifts. Prompt learning adapts only a small set of parameters while keeping the backbone frozen, yet many existing multimodal prompt learners couple the visual and textual branches weakly and can be brittle in low-shot regimes. We propose ProCAP, a probabilistic cross-attentive prompt learning framework that improves cross-modal interaction and training stability without updating any CLIP weights: it learns both visual and textual prompt tokens and links them through stacked bidirectional multi-head cross-attention so the two branches refine each other across prompt depth.
