To reduce overfitting under limited supervision, we parameterize prompt tokens with Gaussian means and variances and regularize them with lightweight KL and L2 penalties, and we further add a compact symmetric InfoNCE head that aligns cross-attended image features with class-level text representations in a shared low-dimensional space. Across few-shot base-to-novel generalization on 11 datasets, cross-dataset transfer, and domain generalization on ImageNet shift benchmarks, ProCAP achieves strong aggregate base-to-novel performance and competitive transfer performance while keeping the CLIP backbone unchanged.

AI.tldr: ProCAP：一种概率化交叉注意力提示学习框架，冻结CLIP主干，学习视觉与文本提示并通过双向多头交叉注意力交互，用高斯参数化与KL/L2正则抑制过拟合，并加对称InfoNCE对齐，在11个数据集少样本、跨数据集与域泛化任务上取得强基类-新类性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）支持通过提示识别新类别，但在标注稀缺或测试分布偏移时表现不佳。提示学习仅调少量参数、冻结主干，然而现有多模态提示学习方法视觉与文本分支耦合弱，在低样本情形下不稳定、易过拟合。
AI.method: 提出ProCAP概率化交叉注意力提示学习框架，不更新任何CLIP权重：学习视觉与文本提示token，通过堆叠的双向多头交叉注意力在提示深度上相互精炼；用高斯均值与方差参数化提示token，并施加轻量KL与L2正则；另加紧凑的对称InfoNCE头，在共享低维空间中对齐交叉注意力后的图像特征与类别级文本表示。
AI.result: 在11个数据集的少样本基类到新类泛化、跨数据集迁移以及ImageNet域偏移基准的域泛化实验中，ProCAP取得较强的基类-新类综合性能与有竞争力的迁移性能，同时保持CLIP主干不变。
AI.conclusion: 通过增强跨模态交互（双向交叉注意力）与训练稳定性（概率参数化+正则+InfoNCE对齐），ProCAP在不修改CLIP主干的前提下有效缓解低样本过拟合，提升少样本泛化与迁移能力。

title: WALT: Learning World-Model-Aligned Latent Trajectories for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving world models learn rich predictive representations of the surrounding environment from visual observations, yet accurate visual prediction does not necessarily translate into effective trajectory planning. We argue that a key bottleneck lies in the mismatch between visual world states and raw geometric trajectories, which may limit the planner's ability to exploit action-relevant semantics encoded by the world model. To address this issue, we propose World-Model Alignment for Latent Trajectories (WALT), which learns a compact generative trajectory latent space by transferring information from a frozen pretrained driving world model without modifying the world model itself. Rather than directly generating raw waypoints, WALT maps them into compact representations through a dual-branch trajectory autoencoder and transfers semantic knowledge from the frozen visual world model into this trajectory space, encouraging the learned action representation to capture scene-level cues relevant to future motion and planning. Beyond our proposed formulation, we systematically study latent learning based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) and feature alignment following Representation Alignment (REPA) to investigate how trajectory-only representation learning affects downstream planning. We evaluate WALT on the NAVSIM benchmarks. Relative to the raw-waypoint baseline, WALT improves PDMS from 89.4 to 89.8 on NAVSIMv1 and EPDMS from 87.3 to 87.9 on NAVSIMv2 while reducing trajectory planner FLOPs by 30.5%. These results suggest that preserving world representations while extracting action-relevant information provides an effective interface for world-model-based trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: WALT通过轨迹自编码器与冻结世界模型对齐，学习紧凑轨迹隐空间，提升NAVSIM规划性能并降低30.5% FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型虽能预测环境，但视觉世界状态与原始几何轨迹之间存在不匹配，限制规划器利用世界模型中与动作相关的语义信息。
AI.method: 提出WALT：不改动冻结预训练驾驶世界模型，用双分支轨迹自编码器将原始路点映射为紧凑表示，并将冻结视觉世界模型的语义知识迁移到轨迹空间；同时系统研究基于JEPA的隐空间学习与REPA式特征对齐对下游规划的影响。
AI.result: NAVSIMv1上PDMS由89.4提升至89.8，NAVSIMv2上EPDMS由87.3提升至87.9，同时轨迹规划器FLOPs降低30.5%。
AI.conclusion: 在保留世界表示的同时提取动作相关信息，是面向世界模型轨迹规划的有效接口。

title: Inference-Time Target Speaker Unlearning in LLM-Based Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: We introduce target-speaker unlearning ASR (TSU-ASR) task in a fully end-to-end framework for multi-speaker ASR and diarization. Given a multi-speaker utterance and a set of opt-out speakers who do not wish to have their speech transcribed, the task requires an ASR system to transcribe all speakers except the opt-out ones, while still indicating when those speakers are active. As a first step towards tackling this task, we introduce a novel, light-weight Enrollment-Conditioned Gating (ECG) module attachable to a frozen dual-stream speech LLM that enables ASR for new opt-out speakers dynamically during inference, even those who were not seen during initial ECG training phase. Our experiments on both AMI (English) and AliMeeting (Mandarin) datasets show that speech transcription accuracy for corresponding opt-out words or characters falls from 72.3% to 48.2% and from 73.6% to 27.3%, respectively, while retained speakers' transcription error rates maintain more or less the same. Our approach provides a practical solution for modern video conferencing platforms, allowing speakers to dynamically opt-out from automated AI transcriptions without forcefully leaving the meeting sessions, enabling a privacy-preserving interface for potentially millions of online meetings daily.

AI.tldr: 本文提出目标说话人遗忘ASR（TSU-ASR）任务，并设计轻量级注册条件门控（ECG）模块，附加于冻结的双流语音LLM，实现对多说话人语音中"选择退出"说话人的遗忘，同时保留其活跃时段标注，兼顾非退出说话人的转录精度。
AI.motivation: 在线会议等场景中，部分说话人不希望其语音被AI自动转录，但又不愿因此退出会议。现有ASR系统缺乏对指定说话人进行动态隐私保护的机制，因此需要一种能在推理阶段灵活"遗忘"特定说话人而保持其余功能的任务与方案。
AI.method: 提出TSU-ASR任务：给定多说话人语音及一组选择退出说话人，ASR系统须转录除退出者外的所有说话人，同时标注退出者的活跃时段。技术上是将轻量级Enrollment-Conditioned Gating（ECG）模块附加到冻结的双流语音LLM上，通过注册音频条件门控，使系统在推理时可动态处理训练阶段未见过的退出说话人。
AI.result: 在AMI（英语）与AliMeeting（中文）数据集上，对应退出说话人的词/字转录准确率分别从72.3%降至48.2%、从73.6%降至27.3%；而保留说话人的转录错误率基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为现代视频会议平台提供了可行方案，使说话人无需退出会议即可动态选择不参与AI自动转录，为每日数百万场在线会议提供隐私保护接口。

title: LensDesigner: A Self-Improving Agent for Optical Lens Design
summary: Optical lens design is a complex, non-convex optimization challenge that relies heavily on human experience and intuition. Existing optimized-based automatic lens design methods struggle to navigate this vast parameter space without meticulous manual tuning. In this paper, we present LensDesigner, an autonomous agent framework that mirrors the problem-solving workflow of expert opticians. To overcome the initial cold start problem, we construct LensLib100K, an extensive optical lens library, and employ Optics-Aware Retrieval to supply physically valid structural seeds. Within an interactive physical simulation environment, the agent executes macroscopic orchestration while receiving immediate optical feedback. Furthermore, we introduce a continuous self-evolving mechanism guided by a curriculum agent. By iteratively solving design tasks with progressively increasing difficulty, the agent autonomously extracts, accumulates, and reuses design heuristics, effectively evolving its optical lens design expertise over time. At the evaluation level, we introduce LensArena, a standardized evaluation benchmark comprising $120$ diverse optical design tasks, covering extreme configurations. Extensive experiments on this benchmark demonstrate that LensDesigner significantly outperforms publicly available baseline algorithms, achieving superior success rates and optimization efficiency. We hope this work sheds light on the emerging field of intelligent optics. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LensDesigner，一个模拟专家配镜师工作流的自主智能体框架，用于光学镜头设计。通过 LensLib100K 库与 Optics-Aware Retrieval 解决冷启动，结合交互式物理仿真、课程智能体驱动的持续自演化机制，并在新基准 LensArena 上显著优于公开基线。
AI.motivation: 光学镜头设计是复杂非凸优化问题，高度依赖人的经验与直觉；现有基于优化的自动设计方法在巨大参数空间中缺乏精细人工调参难以取得进展。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模光学镜头库 LensLib100K，并用 Optics-Aware Retrieval 提供物理可行的结构种子以解决冷启动；2) 在交互式物理仿真环境中，智能体执行宏观编排并接收即时光学反馈；3) 引入由课程智能体引导的持续自演化机制，通过难度递增的设计任务迭代求解，自主提取、积累并复用设计启发式。
AI.result: 提出标准化评测基准 LensArena，包含 120 个多样化光学设计任务并覆盖极端配置。实验表明 LensDesigner 的成功率与优化效率均显著优于公开可用基线算法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为智能光学这一新兴领域提供了思路，且代码将公开。

title: VkVIO: Cross-platform GPU Acceleration for Visual-Inertial Odometry with Vulkan
summary: Perception in robotics and XR fundamentally relies on good state estimation. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) are proven ways of achieving this goal in a cost-effective and accurate manner. Efficiency in these systems allows for smaller, cooler, and lighter devices. GPU acceleration is a natural approach for reducing latency, thanks to their wide availability in platforms like embedded computers, mobile phones, and XR headsets. However, previous works in the literature have limited themselves to the use of CUDA for this task, significantly reducing deployment options to a single vendor. We instead leverage the vendor-agnostic Vulkan API, originally designed for the strict performance requirements of 3D graphics applications. In this work, we present VkVIO, the first, to the best of our knowledge, cross-platform GPU-accelerated VIO method. We provide state-of-the-art accuracy with causal estimates required for real-time operation. We deploy VkVIO on a diverse range of devices spanning a workstation, a laptop, and an extremely inexpensive single-board computer, while outperforming CUDA-based systems on the same hardware. VkVIO enables possibilities for low-latency, low-power, and low-cost VIO in robotics and XR.

AI.tldr: 提出 VkVIO，首个基于 Vulkan 的跨平台 GPU 加速视觉惯性里程计（VIO）方法，在保持实时因果估计与 SOTA 精度的同时，可在工作站、笔记本与低成本单板机上部署，并在相同硬件上超越基于 CUDA 的系统。
AI.motivation: 机器人与 XR 的感知依赖高质量状态估计，VIO 与 VI-SLAM 是低成本、高精度的主流方案，而效率提升可支撑更小、更冷、更轻的设备。GPU 加速是降低延迟的自然选择，但既有工作局限于 CUDA，部署被锁定在单一厂商，缺乏跨平台能力。作者因此寻求一种厂商无关的 GPU 加速路径。
AI.method: 采用厂商无关的 Vulkan API（原本为 3D 图形应用的严格性能需求设计）实现 VIO 的 GPU 加速，构建跨平台系统 VkVIO，并提供满足实时运行所需的因果（causal）估计。
AI.result: 达到 SOTA 精度并具备实时所需的因果估计；在工作站、笔记本和极低成本单板机等多样设备上完成部署；在相同硬件上性能优于基于 CUDA 的系统。
AI.conclusion: VkVIO 使低延迟、低功耗、低成本的 VIO 在机器人与 XR 中成为可能，并验证了 Vulkan 作为跨平台 GPU 加速方案在状态估计任务上的可行性与优势。

title: RAZOR: Pruning Replaceable Experts in LLMs
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token but store the entire expert pool. Pruning this pool requires identifying experts whose removal preserves model behavior. Routing frequency and output magnitude do not fully describe deletion damage, which also depends on how the surviving and replacement experts compensate for the removed output. We introduce RAZOR, a training-free pruning method based on consensus residuals, the deviations of expert outputs from their original weighted mixture. At a fixed layer input, these residuals give the exact output change for a single deletion under survivor renormalization and router refill. RAZOR aggregates this damage by conditional root mean square and selects experts under a layerwise budget using forward computation alone, without gradients, subset search, or recovery training. Against frequency, activation-norm, and REAP baselines on GLM-4.7-Flash and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B at 25% and 50% expert removal, it attains the highest macro average over nine reasoning-intensive tasks in all four model-budget settings, gaining 2.12-5.59 points over REAP and lowering reverse KL in all four. On DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 and Hy3, it also achieves the highest macro average among the three residual criteria. Local exactness does not guarantee better joint pruning. Generation analyses show changes in diversity, formatting, and termination despite higher task scores.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAZOR，一种无需训练、基于共识残差的MoE专家剪枝方法，通过残差聚合精确刻画单专家删除的输出损伤，在多个模型与预算下取得最优宏平均性能，并揭示局部精确性不等于联合剪枝更优。
AI.motivation: MoE模型每token仅激活少量专家但需存储整个专家池，剪枝该池需识别"移除后仍能保持模型行为"的专家。然而路由频率与输出幅值无法完整刻画删除损伤，因为损伤还取决于幸存专家与替补专家如何补偿被移除的输出。因此需要一种能精确建模删除损伤的剪枝准则。
AI.method: 提出RAZOR，一种免训练的剪枝方法，基于"共识残差"——专家输出相对其原始加权混合的偏差。在固定层输入下，这些残差给出在幸存者重归一化与路由器回填条件下单次删除的精确输出变化。RAZOR以条件均方根（conditional RMS）聚合该损伤，并在逐层预算下仅通过前向计算选择专家，无需梯度、子集搜索或恢复训练。
AI.result: 在GLM-4.7-Flash与Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上，于25%与50%专家移除率下，相较频率、激活范数与REAP基线，RAZOR在全部四种模型-预算设置中，于九项推理密集型任务上取得最高宏平均，超过REAP 2.12–5.59分，并在四项设置中均降低reverse KL。在DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731与Hy3上，于三种残差准则中同样取得最高宏平均。生成分析显示，尽管任务分数更高，多样性、格式与终止行为均发生变化。
AI.conclusion: RAZOR以共识残差为准则实现了免训练、仅前向的MoE专家剪枝，在多项任务与模型上优于现有基线并降低分布偏移。但研究同时表明，局部单删除损伤的精确性并不保证联合剪枝更优；任务分数提升伴随生成特性（多样性、格式、终止）的改变。

title: Where Does Retrieval-Based Open-Ended Evaluation Fail? Automatic Taxonomy Induction from Long-Form Medical Answer Factuality Verification
comment: Experiments' corpus knowledge cutoff date May 2026
summary: Retrieval-based factuality evaluation, where LLM-generated claims are verified against evidence from authoritative medical corpora, has become the dominant paradigm for scalable hallucination detection in high-stakes clinical settings. Despite the urgency of reliable and transparent medical fact verification, most systems measure performance with aggregate metrics like F1, which obscure where and why failures occur. Existing RAG diagnostics require gold answers or annotated gold evidence, neither of which exists in this regime. We introduce two comprehensive taxonomies, grounded in a case study on the open-ended MedExpert dataset and 3 closed-ended datasets, decomposing failures into retrieval-stage errors along five quality dimensions, and verifier-reasoning errors into six consecutive steps. We adapt an automatic pattern induction pipeline using LLM-as-Judge to label evidence quality and classify verifier reasoning errors at scale, and then stress-test our findings across 4 retrieval methods and 6 frontier verifier models. Our analysis reveals that scaling model size, adding reasoning effort, expanding to authoritative web sources, and applying medical fine-tuning do not resolve these failure modes, demonstrating that they represent fundamental limitations of the retrieve-then-verify paradigm in open-ended medical settings rather than artifacts of outdated systems. We release our code and data at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Medical_RAG_eval-4AB5 for the full reproducibility of our results.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对医学领域检索式事实核查（retrieval-based factuality evaluation）中聚合指标掩盖失败原因的问题，提出两套失败分类体系，并借助LLM-as-Judge的自动模式归纳流程大规模标注证据质量与验证器推理错误，证明这些失败模式是"先检索后验证"范式在开放式医学场景中的根本局限。
AI.motivation: 在高风险临床场景中，检索式事实核查已成为可扩展幻觉检测的主流范式，但现有系统多依赖F1等聚合指标衡量性能，无法揭示失败发生的位置与原因。已有的RAG诊断方法需要金标准答案或标注好的金标准证据，而该开放域医学场景中二者均不存在，因此亟需一套不依赖金标准的失败诊断框架。
AI.method: 作者基于开放式MedExpert数据集及3个封闭式数据集的案例研究，构建了两套分类体系：将检索阶段错误分解为五个质量维度，将验证器推理错误分解为六个连续步骤。随后采用LLM-as-Judge的自动模式归纳流水线，在大规模上标注证据质量并对验证器推理错误进行分类，并在4种检索方法与6个前沿验证器模型上进行压力测试。
AI.result: 分析表明，扩大模型规模、增加推理投入（reasoning effort）、扩展至权威网络来源以及进行医学微调，均无法解决这些失败模式，说明其并非过时系统的产物，而是"先检索后验证"范式在开放式医学场景中的根本性局限。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了开放域医学事实核查中检索与验证环节的系统性失败模式，并证明这些模式对现有主流改进手段不敏感。作者公开了代码与数据（https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Medical_RAG_eval-4AB5）以保证结果可复现。

title: CARGO: Context-Aware Retrieval-Gated Evaluation of Agentic AI in Production
summary: Reference-based LLM-as-a-judge evaluation assumes the reference answer is the target. In deployed agentic systems that operate over dynamic entities (support cases, assets, accounts), the closest available reference typically applies the correct procedure to a different entity, so a literal judge penalizes different identifiers, dates, and statuses as errors or hallucinations. We name this failure mode reference-instance divergence (RID). We propose CARGO, a framework that (i) treats retrieved references as procedural exemplars and grounds factual judgments in the live instance's observed context, (ii) assigns each claim a three-way status (supported, contradicted, unverifiable) and penalizes only contradictions, and (iii) gates evaluation by retrieval confidence, casting production evaluation as selective prediction. We introduce CARGO-Bench, a perturbation-based diagnostic suite with ground truth by construction that separates leniency from discrimination. On CARGO-Bench (246 items, two judge models, 7,872 judgments), the standard reference-based judge penalizes 100% of correct entity-transplanted answers and is uninformative (discrimination index DI ~ 0); supplying the live facts without reframing changes nothing. CARGO eliminates these false penalties (0/50) while retaining near-complete contradiction recall (50/50 and 49/50), raising DI to 0.58 [0.48, 0.68]; a rubric-swap control attributes most of the effect to context-grounded dimension definitions. CARGO also exposes a limitation of its own design: the leniency that protects entity values suppresses detection of procedural corruptions (20% recall). A post-hoc fix does not close the gap, and an LLM-as-annotator study with written guidelines and adjudication shows the same blind spot. We release a preregistered protocol for extending the evaluation to expert agreement, risk-coverage, and cost on production traffic.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CARGO框架，解决动态实体场景下参考基准评估的"参考实例分歧(RID)"问题：将参考答案视为程序性范例、以实例实时上下文锚定事实判断、采用三态判定并仅惩罚矛盾、按检索置信度门控评估。在CARGO-Bench上，标准判定器惩罚了100%的正确实体移植答案且无区分度(DI~0)，CARGO将假惩罚降为0/50，DI提升至0.58[0.48,0.68]，但其宽松性导致程序性错误检测仅20%召回。
AI.motivation: 基于参考的LLM-as-a-judge评估默认参考答案是目标；但在动态实体(支持工单、资产、账户)的已部署智能体系统中，最接近的参考通常是把正确流程应用于不同实体，导致字面判定器把不同的标识符、日期和状态误判为错误或幻觉。作者将这一失效模式命名为"参考实例分歧(RID)"。
AI.method: CARGO框架包含三点：(i) 将检索到的参考视为程序性范例，把事实判断锚定在实时实例的观测上下文中；(ii) 为每条断言赋予三态状态(支持、矛盾、不可验证)，仅惩罚矛盾；(iii) 以检索置信度门控评估，将生产评估形式化为选择性预测。同时提出CARGO-Bench，一种基于扰动的诊断套件，构造式真值可分离宽松与区分能力。
AI.result: 在CARGO-Bench(246项、两个判定模型、7,872次判断)上：标准参考判定器惩罚100%的实体移植正确回答且无信息量(DI~0)；仅提供实时事实而不重构框架无改善。CARGO将假惩罚降至0/50，同时保持近乎完全的矛盾召回(50/50与49/50)，DI升至0.58[0.48,0.68]；评分表替换控制表明大部分效果来自上下文化维度定义。CARGO也暴露自身局限：保护实体值的宽松性抑制了对程序性破坏的检测(召回20%)，事后修补未能弥合差距，带书面指南与裁决的LLM-as-annotator研究显示同样盲点。
AI.conclusion: CARGO有效缓解RID导致的假惩罚并提升判定区分度，但在程序性错误检测上存在结构性盲点。作者发布预注册协议，用于将评估扩展至专家一致性、风险-覆盖率和生产流量上的成本。

title: Asymmetric Classifier-Free Guidance for Target-Speaker ASR
summary: Target-speaker automatic speech recognition (TS-ASR) must identify and transcribe a desired speaker under varying overlap and noise conditions. These changes alter the acoustic evidence for the target speaker in the speech mixture, motivating inference-time calibration of speaker conditioning. We introduce asymmetric classifier-free guidance (CFG) for TS-ASR using Whisper: the speaker-conditioned branch predicts the target transcript, while the speaker-unconditioned branch predicts serialized multi-speaker transcripts. CFG adjusts the contribution of speaker conditioning during decoding through a single guidance scale. We select a global guidance scale on target-domain development data and train a lightweight encoder-based predictor to adjust it for each utterance, keeping the recognition model fixed. Under domain shifts, our full system achieves relative word error rate (WER) reductions of up to 21.8% over the condition-only baseline, and 5.6% over standard conditional decoding of the same CFG-trained model. Oracle analysis shows that substantially larger WER reductions are possible through utterance-level scale selection and identifies how beneficial adjustments vary with domain shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向目标说话人语音识别（TS-ASR）的非对称无分类器引导（CFG）方法：说话人条件分支预测目标转写，无条件分支预测多说话人序列化转写，通过单一引导尺度调节说话人条件贡献，并训练轻量编码器预测器实现逐句自适应尺度调整，在域偏移下显著降低WER。
AI.motivation: TS-ASR需在重叠与噪声条件变化下识别并转写目标说话人，这些变化会改变混合语音中目标说话人的声学证据，因此需要在推理阶段对说话人条件进行校准，而已有固定条件解码方式难以适应域偏移。
AI.method: 基于Whisper构建非对称CFG：条件分支预测目标说话人转写，无条件分支预测多说话人序列化转写；用单一引导尺度在解码时调节说话人条件的贡献。先在目标域开发集上选取全局引导尺度，再训练轻量级基于编码器的预测器为每条语句自适应调整尺度，同时保持识别模型冻结。
AI.result: 在域偏移下，完整系统相较仅条件基线实现最高21.8%的相对WER下降，相较同一CFG训练模型的标准条件解码实现5.6%的相对WER下降；Oracle分析表明句子级尺度选择可带来更大WER下降，并揭示了有益调整随域偏移的变化规律。
AI.conclusion: 非对称CFG与逐句自适应引导尺度能有效提升TS-ASR在域偏移下的鲁棒性，且推理阶段校准说话人条件具有显著潜力，句子级尺度选择为后续优化提供了空间。

title: The Shape of Events: Edge-Based Inductive Biases via Cross-Domain Distillation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. All authors contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/snskysk/event2rgb-distillation
summary: Convolutional neural networks trained on ImageNet are known to exhibit a strong preference for local high-frequency texture, an inductive bias that translates into fragile robustness against distribution shifts in real-world environments. Event cameras, in contrast, record only changes in scene brightness and are therefore well suited to capturing contour information; however, due to the absence of diagnostic benchmarks in the event domain, the inductive bias that event-camera data instills in vision models has remained underexplored. In this work, we use knowledge distillation from the event domain to the RGB domain so as to exploit the rich evaluation toolkit available in the RGB domain and systematically dissect this inductive bias. Our experiments show that distillation from the event domain induces, in the RGB domain, color invariance, shape bias, and robustness to high-frequency noise. We identify the underlying mechanism as the model suppressing its dependence on high-frequency texture while acquiring a stronger dependence on edge-based object shape. This hypothesis is supported by changes in how color and spatial information are processed at the early layers, together with a spectral trade-off in which robustness to the absence of high-frequency components coexists with vulnerability to contamination of the relied-upon frequency bands and to disruption of geometric structure. We further show that this inductive bias differs from existing robustification methods and that it functions as a useful prior for diverse downstream tasks in which shape and contour information contribute alongside other cues. The code is available at https://github.com/snskysk/event2rgb-distillation .

AI.tldr: 本文通过从事件域到RGB域的知识蒸馏，系统剖析事件数据所赋予视觉模型的归纳偏置，发现其诱导颜色不变性、形状偏置与高频噪声鲁棒性，机制在于模型抑制高频纹理依赖并增强边缘形状依赖。
AI.motivation: ImageNet训练的CNN偏好局部高频纹理，导致对真实环境分布偏移的鲁棒性脆弱；事件相机仅记录亮度变化、擅长捕捉轮廓信息，但事件域缺乏诊断性基准，其给视觉模型带来的归纳偏置尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 利用事件域到RGB域的知识蒸馏，借助RGB域丰富的评测工具包来系统解构该归纳偏置；并通过分析早期层的颜色与空间信息处理方式及频谱特性来验证机制假设。
AI.result: 事件域蒸馏在RGB域诱导出颜色不变性、形状偏置和高频噪声鲁棒性；机制为模型抑制对高频纹理的依赖、增强对边缘物体形状的依赖；表现为早期层颜色与空间处理变化、频谱权衡——对高频成分缺失鲁棒，但对所依赖频段的污染及几何结构破坏敏感。
AI.conclusion: 该归纳偏置不同于现有鲁棒化方法，可作为有益先验服务于形状与轮廓信息与其他线索共同贡献的多种下游任务。代码已开源。

title: AcoustiClaim: A Numeric Claim Benchmark with Instrument Ground Truth
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Siyuan Zhai and Chien-Liang Kuo contributed equally. Code and outputs: https://github.com/sheng-tse/acousticlaim
summary: Audio language models state numbers for acoustic quantities, and neither human opinion nor a judge model says whether such a number is true of the signal. AcoustiClaim extracts each numeric claim from free text, scores it against the instrument that defines the quantity, and classes each quantity by where its reference can be read. Four open-weight systems and one closed model, asked for ten quantities five ways on two corpora, fill 207 cells. Of these, 49 emit fewer than five distinct values, and eight of the 158 cells that can be ranked exceed a rank correlation of 0.3, the bar we set, three with an interval clear of it, five of them one closed model reading pitch. Error sits at or above a constant-predictor floor in every ranked cell but three. The reference decoder we train declines the five voice quantities in prose on 95% of mixtures, with nothing withheld, and states them on the clean twins, reproducing its targets' rule from audio alone. With a calibrated threshold, withholding lowers error on all ten quantities on the mixtures in the mean and on eight at every split, against at most 0.6% from a random selector. A linear baseline orders errors at least as well as ours. F0 s.d. and shimmer stay above the constant floor.

AI.tldr: 音频语言模型在自由文本中陈述声学量的数值，其真实性缺乏人类或评判模型的验证。AcoustiClaim 抽取数值断言并依据定义该量纲的仪器打分，将数值按参考可读位置分类，发现模型在207个单元中表现普遍不佳，仅少数秩相关超过0.3，误差多不低于常数预测基线，但经校准阈值与特异性拒绝机制可显著降低误差。
AI.motivation: 音频语言模型能够以自然语言陈述声学量的数值，但现有评估缺少对这些数值真实性的判定标准——人类意见与评判模型均无法判断某数值是否真实反映信号。论文旨在建立可量化、可核查的数值断言评估框架。
AI.method: 提出 AcoustiClaim：从自由文本中抽取每个数值断言，对照定义该量纲的仪器进行打分，并按参考可读位置对量纲分类。在四个开放权重系统和一个闭源模型上，针对两个语料库、十种量纲、五种提问方式共形成207个评估单元。另外训练一个参考解码器，在混合（mixture）样本上以散文形式拒绝语音量纲、在干净孪生样本上陈述数值，并引入校准阈值与特异性拒绝机制。
AI.result: 207个单元中49个输出的不同取值少于5个；158个可排序单元中仅8个秩相关超过0.3的设定阈值，其中3个区间明确高于阈值，5个来自单一闭源模型的音高读取。除3个单元外，所有可排序单元的误差均处于或高于常数预测基线。参考解码器在95%的混合样本上拒绝五种语音量纲，在干净孪生样本上则陈述数值，仅从音频复现了目标规则。校准阈值下，拒绝机制在混合样本上使全部十种量纲的平均误差下降、且在每种划分下使8种量纲误差下降，而随机选择器最多仅降低0.6%。线性基线的误差排序能力至少与本文方法相当。F0标准差与shimmer仍高于常数基线。
AI.conclusion: 音频语言模型对声学量的数值陈述缺乏可靠真实性，多数情形不优于常数预测，仅少数（主要来自闭源模型的音高读取）达到弱相关。基于仪器定义的抽取-打分框架与校准阈值下的特异性拒绝可有效降低误差，但F0标准差与shimmer等量纲仍难以被可靠估计，线性基线在误差排序上具竞争力。

title: Breaking Homogeneity: Diversifying Persona Sets for Creative LLM Outputs
summary: Language models often produce homogeneous responses to open-ended tasks; such homogeneity can spawn groupthink-the convergence of ideas toward a singular and potentially suboptimal decision. We formulate persona diversification as a set-level conditioning problem and study two orthogonal design choices: selecting versus generating personas, and space-filling versus frontier-seeking diversity. We instantiate this design space with four methods spanning coverage and dispersion subset selections, uniform-coverage sampling, and evolutionary persona generation. Evaluations on the Alternative Uses Task (AUT), Infinity-Chat, and Divergent Association Task (DAT) show the benefits of the proposed methods across tasks and creativity objectives. On AUT, evolutionary persona generation increases response diversity by 78.8%, originality by 26.1%, flexibility by 49.5%, and holistic creativity by 13.9% over task-only prompting, while maintaining 98.5% validity; on Infinity-Chat, it nearly doubles persona-induced response separation relative to random personas. Moreover, evolutionary personas compose with creativity-optimized prompting, further increasing its response diversity by 18.6% and creativity by 6.3%. These results establish persona-set geometry as a task-agnostic mechanism for eliciting divergent LLM outputs, and support persona diversification as a reusable complement to prompt optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"人格多样化"建模为集合级条件化问题，研究"选择vs生成人格"与"填充空间vs探索前沿"两个正交设计维度，提出四类方法，并在AUT、Infinity-Chat、DAT任务上验证多样性收益。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在开放式任务中倾向给出同质化回答，导致"群体思维"——观点收敛于单一且可能次优的决策，因此需要通过人格多样化来激发发散性输出，但人格多样化的设计空间尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 将人格多样化形式化为集合级条件化问题，沿两个正交维度展开设计空间：选择 vs 生成人格、填充空间（覆盖/离散）vs 探索前沿；据此实例化四种方法——覆盖子集选择、离散子集选择、均匀覆盖采样与进化人格生成。
AI.result: 在AUT上，进化人格生成较仅任务提示使响应多样性提升78.8%、原创性26.1%、灵活性49.5%、整体创造力13.9%，并保持98.5%有效性；在Infinity-Chat上，其人格诱导的响应分离度较随机人格近乎翻倍；且可与创造力优化提示叠加，再提升多样性18.6%、创造力6.3%。
AI.conclusion: 人格集合的几何结构是一种任务无关的机制，可用于诱导LLM的发散性输出；人格多样化可作为提示优化的可复用补充手段。

title: Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer
summary: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.

AI.tldr: 提出PSP-DiT，将全景观场景程序作为一等潜变量与图像潜变量联合去噪，提升组合式文生图能力。
AI.motivation: 现有高保真文生图模型在需要实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间排序和角色敏感关系的组合式提示上仍表现不佳。
AI.method: PSP-DiT采用扩散Transformer架构，通过耦合的Transformer流联合去噪图像潜变量与场景程序潜变量，并引入全景接地与循环一致性目标，将对象实例、属性、关系与计数绑定到生成图像的视觉支撑上；场景程序被视为一等潜变量，而非外部控制信号或事后解析结果。
AI.result: 在匹配的训练与推理设置下，PSP-DiT在GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score和DetailMaster上均优于强扁平文本基线，在计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系和长结构化提示上增益最大；同时保持图像质量，推理开销适中，并对不完美的场景程序具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量联合建模，是提升文生图组合性且保持图像质量的有效途径。

title: Inquesto Score: A reliability Protocol For Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents are increasingly deployed in workflows where failed interactions can affect transactions, access, and other consequential outcomes, creating a need for reproducible and interpretable evaluation. We introduce Inquesto Score (IS), a protocol for measuring voice-agent reliability as the percentage of calls in a fixed, versioned evaluation population that achieve the caller's goal without a functional failure or worse. Rather than combining heterogeneous metrics, IS defines explicit failure events and severity levels and evaluates the deployed voice pipeline. Timing failures, including talk-over and delayed responses, are measured directly from audio, while semantic and state-dependent failures are evaluated using scenario predicates, tool traces, and a pinned open-model judge. Diagnostic views of behavior, acoustic robustness, identity handling, and speaker groups accompany the score without being combined into it. Inquesto Score v0.1 evaluates 30 scenarios, three acoustic conditions, four speaker groups, and 306 calls per agent across 13 configurations of a reference voice-agent system. Our evaluation shows that reliable measurement requires evidence beyond transcripts, explicit treatment of deployment conditions, and validation of the evaluators used to determine outcomes. We release the protocol, reference implementation, and evaluation records.

AI.tldr: 提出 Inquesto Score (IS) 协议，以"固定版本化评测人群中无功能失败达成通话目标的百分比"衡量语音智能体可靠性，并进行多场景多条件实证验证。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体已进入涉及交易、访问权限等具有后果性的工作流，交互失败会造成实质影响，因此需要可复现、可解释的评测方法；而现有做法常将异构指标混合，缺乏明确的失败定义与部署条件刻画。
AI.method: IS 不合并异构指标，而是定义显式失败事件与严重度等级，直接评测已部署的语音流水线：抢话、响应延迟等时序失败直接从音频测量；语义与状态相关失败通过场景谓词、工具调用轨迹及固定版本的开源模型判定器评估。行为、声学鲁棒性、身份处理、说话人分组等诊断视图作为附加信息，不并入总分。v0.1 在参考系统 13 种配置下评测 30 个场景、3 种声学条件、4 个说话人分组，每配置 306 通电话。
AI.result: 评测表明，可靠测量需要超越转写文本的证据、对部署条件的显式刻画，以及对判定器本身的有效性验证；同时给出了跨配置的失败率与诊断性结果。
AI.conclusion: IS 提供了一个可复现、可解释的语音智能体可靠性度量协议，并公开协议、参考实现与评测记录，强调音频级证据、部署条件显式化与评测器验证三要素。

title: Feeding BabyLMs Macaroni: Code-Switching Curricula Cause Cross-Lingual Convergence
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to the BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Children in multilingual communities often code-switch, using multiple languages in a single utterance. Can we induce cross-lingual alignment in language models by training on code-switched text? We pretrain small decoder-only transformers on two 100M-word multilingual corpora: a base corpus formed by mixing the English, Dutch, and Chinese BabyBabelLM datasets, and a corpus generated from it by inserting word- and sentence-level code-switching using an LLM. We find that training on code-switched data aligns the representations of parallel text, particularly across different scripts, and that this alignment persists through training on monolingual documents. Under a learning curriculum that progresses from word-level code-switching, to sentence-level code-switching, to monolingual documents, models trained on code-switched data outperform baselines trained without it on the BabyLM evaluation suite. Our work characterizes code-switching curriculum learning as an effective data augmentation method for multilingual pretraining. We release our code, data, and models at https://github.com/drooryck/multilingual-macaroni.

AI.tldr: 通过在LLM生成的语码转换语料上进行课程学习预训练，可有效提升多语言小模型的跨语言表示对齐与下游评测表现。
AI.motivation: 多语言社区中儿童常出现语码转换现象。作者希望探究能否通过训练于语码转换文本，在多语言语言模型中诱导出跨语言对齐，并验证其作为数据增强手段的有效性。
AI.method: 使用英、荷、中三个BabyBabelLM数据集混合构成基础语料，并借助LLM在其上插入词级与句级语码转换生成增强语料；以小型decoder-only Transformer进行预训练，并采用从词级转换、句级转换到单语文档的课程学习策略，与不使用语码转换的基线进行比较。
AI.result: 训练于语码转换数据可使平行文本的表示更加对齐，尤其在不同书写系统之间；该对齐在后续单语文档训练中仍能保持。在课程学习设置下，使用语码转换数据的模型在BabyLM评测套件上优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 语码转换课程学习是一种有效的多语言预训练数据增强方法；作者开源了代码、数据与模型。

title: Don't CLAP: Are Music-Text Models Bag-of-Words?
summary: Text-to-music systems are assessed on audio quality and on how faithfully the music follows its prompt, and the CLAP score, the cosine similarity between a music-text model's audio and text embeddings, is the standard objective metric of faithfulness. We ask how accurately that score reflects the text: when an attribute is linked to an instrument (e.g., distorted guitar), does the text embedding capture that binding? To find out, we introduce an attribute swap perturbation: the caption of a real recording is edited by exchanging exactly one property, timbre, lead versus accompaniment, or order of first appearance, between two instruments. We then test four contrastive music-text models and one large audio-language model on whether the audio scores higher against the original caption than against the perturbed one. No contrastive model distinguishes the two captions reliably. The audio-language model does better, but further experiments show that its advantage rests largely on audio-agnostic language priors. Our results thus provide compelling evidence that the CLAP score and related metrics do not capture fine-grained musical meaning or attribute bindings; their representation is closer to a bag-of-words that leaves them insensitive to meaning-changing perturbations of the caption.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"属性交换"扰动方法检验CLAP分数是否真正反映文本语义，发现四个对比式音乐-文本模型均无法可靠区分原始与扰动描述，大型音频-语言模型的优势主要来自与音频无关的语言先验，表明CLAP类指标更像词袋表示，不敏感于改变语义的扰动。
AI.motivation: CLAP分数（音乐-文本模型音频与文本嵌入的余弦相似度）是评估文本到音乐生成"忠实度"的标准客观指标。然而尚不清楚该分数是否真正捕捉文本的细粒度语义，尤其是当一个属性与某件乐器绑定时（如"失真的吉他"），文本嵌入能否表征这种绑定关系。论文旨在检验CLAP分数在多大程度上真实反映文本内容。
AI.method: 引入属性交换扰动：对真实录音的描述文本进行编辑，在两件乐器之间精确交换一种属性——音色、主奏与伴奏角色、或首次出现的顺序。随后在四个对比式音乐-文本模型和一个大型音频-语言模型上测试：音频对原始描述的得分是否高于对扰动描述的得分。
AI.result: 没有任何对比式模型能可靠区分原始与扰动描述。大型音频-语言模型表现较好，但进一步实验显示其优势主要建立在与音频无关的语言先验之上，而非真正的音频-文本绑定理解。
AI.conclusion: CLAP分数及相关指标并未捕捉细粒度的音乐语义或属性绑定；其表示更接近词袋模型，对改变语义的描述扰动不敏感。这为文本到音乐评估指标的可靠性提供了有力反证。

title: REALMS: An AI-Assistant Conversational System for Real-Time Exact Audience Sizing over High-Dimensional Nested Profiles
summary: Audience sizing is a critical component of digital marketing. It enables precise resource allocation, campaign planning, and performance optimization. Traditional approaches using skeleton audiences, sampling, or predictive modeling suffer from significant delays, estimation errors, and poor scalability over high-dimensional profile data. We present REALMS (Real-time Exact Audience sizing via LLM-based Multi-attribute Search), a conversational system for exact audience sizing deployed in production on an enterprise customer data platform. REALMS enables marketers to query massive profile stores with millions of profiles and thousands of attributes using natural language and receive precise counts in seconds. The system introduces three key components: (1) a categorical attribute retrieval mechanism using embedding-based vector search to dynamically identify relevant schema attributes without manual configuration; (2) an LLM-powered NL2SQL pipeline with template-based in-context learning for accurate query generation over complex nested schemas; and (3) schema standardization enabling industry-agnostic deployment across diverse enterprise environments. Evaluation on real enterprise data demonstrates strong recall for attribute retrieval, high SQL execution accuracy, and low latency, which enables real-time interactive audience insights where prior methods required hours.

AI.tldr: REALMS是一个基于LLM的会话式精确受众规模测算系统，通过嵌入向量检索、NL2SQL与模式标准化，在秒级完成百万级画像数据的高维精确查询，替代了需数小时的传统方法。
AI.motivation: 受众规模测算是数字营销的关键环节，用于资源分配、活动规划与效果优化。传统方法依赖骨架受众、抽样或预测建模，存在明显延迟、估计误差大、在高维画像数据上可扩展性差的问题，无法支持实时交互式洞察。
AI.method: REALMS包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于嵌入向量检索的分类属性检索机制，无需人工配置即可动态识别相关模式属性；(2) LLM驱动的NL2SQL流水线，采用基于模板的上下文学习，在复杂嵌套模式上生成准确查询；(3) 模式标准化，实现跨行业、多企业环境的通用部署。系统以会话方式在企业客户数据平台上生产运行。
AI.result: 在真实企业数据上的评估显示：属性检索召回率高、SQL执行准确率高、延迟低，可在数秒内响应百万级画像、数千属性的自然语言查询，实现实时交互式受众洞察。
AI.conclusion: REALMS将原本需要数小时的受众规模测算压缩至秒级精确响应，验证了LLM结合向量检索与NL2SQL在高维企业画像场景下的可行性与生产价值。

title: Probing Stability-Plasticity Tradeoffs in Agent Memory through Cognitive Experimental Paradigms
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Main, code is availble at https://github.com/jq-ding/MemProbe
summary: Agent memory systems are increasingly used to maintain long-term user preferences, task states and evolving facts, but current evaluations often collapse memory behavior into final-answer accuracy. We introduce MemProbe, a cognitive-science-inspired framework for diagnosing stability-plasticity tradeoffs in agent memory. The framework is motivated by a core insight from cognitive memory research: memory is reconstructive and shaped by interference, source reliability, reinforcement, and reactivation. MemProbe turns this insight into four reusable experimental paradigms (interference, misinformation, consolidation strength, and reconsolidation window) that manipulate when a memory should be updated, preserved, or treated as uncertain. It further decomposes correctness into behavioral profiles that reveal how systems update, preserve, attribute, and temporally organize information. We instantiate these paradigms in a 56-episode diagnostic suite and evaluate six incremental memory systems under a unified protocol. Results show that systems with similar aggregate scores exhibit distinct behavioral profiles. MemProbe provides such a diagnostic lens, turning aggregate performance into interpretable profiles of memory maintenance over time. Code is available at https://github.com/jq-ding/MemProbe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemProbe，一个受认知科学启发的智能体记忆诊断框架，用四个可复用实验范式揭示记忆系统的稳定性-可塑性权衡，并将正确率分解为可解释的行为画像。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆评测多将记忆行为压缩为最终答案准确率，无法体现记忆在时间维度上的更新、保持、归因与组织方式，也难以刻画稳定性-可塑性权衡。
AI.method: 受认知记忆中“记忆是重构性的、受干扰、来源可靠性、强化与再激活影响”的启发，设计四个实验范式：干扰、错误信息、巩固强度与再巩固窗口，用于操控记忆应被更新、保持还是视为不确定；并将正确性分解为揭示系统如何更新、保持、归因与时间组织信息的行为画像。在56个episode的诊断套件中实例化该框架，并以统一协议评测六个增量式记忆系统。
AI.result: 在统一协议下评测六个增量式记忆系统后发现：总体得分相近的系统，其行为画像存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: MemProbe提供了一种诊断视角，将聚合性能转化为可解释的记忆维持过程画像，代码已开源。

title: Thinking Less to Simulate Better: Intuitive Prompting Improves LLM Agents Simulating Individual Social Media Reactions, Including Unfamiliar Content
summary: Platform policies are increasingly tested on artificial users, making agent fidelity important. Yet convincing fake profiles could also manipulate perceived public opinion before elections. Validation has concentrated on agreement with human behaviour and has paid little attention to whether an agent behaves in line with the profile it was given. The present study profiled eight Serbian participants through a questionnaire, a deep interview, and a written self-presentation, recorded their reactions to sixty-eight social media posts, and asked four language models to predict those reactions under five prompt conditions varying profile content and instruction style. Attitudinal content improved prediction over demographic backstories by a wide margin. Agents matched their stated profiles more closely than participants matched their own survey answers, and consistency proved unrelated to fidelity once profile information was present. Instructing models to respond intuitively and immediately rather than analytically gave the highest fidelity of any condition and cut the compression of individual differences from seven times the human level to three. The advantage held on posts about topics the questionnaire never raised, where that condition reached the highest fidelity of any setup and beat a crowd baseline by a wide margin, which suggests that agents prompted this way could serve as general-purpose simulated users rather than specialists on the topics they were profiled for. Results may bear implications for the development of language models, because intuition-based setups appear better suited to some tasks than reasoning-based ones.

AI.tldr: 研究通过8名塞尔维亚被试的问卷、深度访谈与自述画像，收集其对68条社交媒体帖子的反应，并用4个语言模型在5种提示条件下预测反应。结果显示：态度类画像信息远优于人口学背景；智能体与自身画像的一致性高于被试与自身问卷答案的一致性；在具备画像信息后，一致性与保真度无关；直觉式即时作答指令保真度最高，将个体差异压缩从人类的7倍降至3倍，并在问卷未涉及话题上仍保持优势。
AI.motivation: 平台政策日益以人工用户进行测试，智能体保真度因此变得重要；但逼真的虚假画像也可能在选举前操纵公众舆论感知。既有验证多聚焦于智能体与人类行为的一致性，较少考察智能体行为是否与其被赋予的画像相符。
AI.method: 对8名塞尔维亚被试进行问卷、深度访谈和书面自我呈现以构建画像，记录其对68条社交媒体帖子的反应；让4个语言模型在5种提示条件下（变化画像内容与指令风格）预测这些反应。
AI.result: 态度类内容对预测的改进远超人口学背景信息；智能体与所述画像的匹配度高于被试与自身问卷答案的匹配度；一旦提供画像信息，一致性与保真度无关；指令模型直觉、即时而非分析式作答，获得所有条件中最高的保真度，并将个体差异压缩从人类的7倍降至3倍；该优势在问卷未涉及话题的帖子上依然成立，达到最高保真度并大幅超过群体基线。
AI.conclusion: 以直觉方式提示的智能体或可作为通用模拟用户，而非仅限画像所涉话题的专家；研究结果对语言模型开发具有启示，即基于直觉的设置在某些任务上比基于推理的设置更合适。

title: Atlases Are Already Inside: Recovering Population Templates from Pretrained Diffusion Models
summary: We present a new inference-time sampler for diffusion models that gives a pretrained model a capability it was never trained for: constructing the atlas of the population it synthesizes. The sampler converges from every random seed to the population's central anatomy, which we call the \emph{intrinsic atlas}. The advantage is threefold. (1) It requires no retraining. A diffusion model that has already learned a coherent population, including the released ones, yields its atlas in a single inference pass without involving deformable registration. (2) It applies to multiple domains, such as brain MRI, chest X-ray, faces, and 3D shapes. (3) It extends to subpopulations. One age-conditioned model gives an atlas at any age in its training range, and the resulting family reproduces the CSF expansion of healthy aging. Evaluated as a registration target, the intrinsic atlas is best or second-best on every dataset against classical and learned templates, and the most central template on held-out brain MRI cohorts. Atlas construction can be reframed as a byproduct of generative modeling: a diffusion model is a learned representation of population structure, and the atlas is what it already contains.

AI.tldr: 提出一种推理时扩散采样器，无需重训练即可从预训练扩散模型中提取人群"内在图谱"。
AI.motivation: 传统图谱构建依赖形变配准且需专门训练，本文希望将图谱构建重新定义为生成式建模的副产品。
AI.method: 设计新的推理时采样器，使扩散模型从任意随机种子收敛到人群中心解剖结构（内在图谱），无需重训练、不含形变配准，并可用于子人群（如年龄条件模型）。
AI.result: 在脑MRI、胸片、人脸及3D形状等多领域验证；作为配准目标时，在各数据集上均为最佳或次佳，且在留出脑MRI队列中是最中心的模板；年龄条件模型可复现健康衰老的脑脊液扩张。
AI.conclusion: 图谱构建可视为生成式建模的副产品，扩散模型即人群结构的学习表示，图谱是其内在包含的内容。

title: QSV: Quat-Sphere-Vision for Coupled Quaternion Attention on Spherical Lattices
summary: In standard attention, three separately learned projections decide how strongly a token attends to each neighbor ($W_Q$, $W_K$) and how the attended features are transformed before aggregation ($W_V$). We study Quat-Sphere-Vision (QSV), a sparse spherical vision model that replaces this projection triple with a single learned unit quaternion per token: the relative quaternion $r_{ij} = q_i^{*} \otimes q_j$ supplies both the attention logit $\operatorname{Re}(r_{ij})$ and a sandwich-product feature transport $x \mapsto r_{ij} \otimes x \otimes r_{ij}^{*}$, with messages passed over sparse kNN graphs on concentric Fibonacci spheres. Ablations that change only the targeted component show the two roles to be asymmetric. Removing the transport reduces test accuracy by about four percentage points on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 (single runs per CIFAR-100 variant), while replacing the learned attention weights with uniform averaging leaves it essentially unchanged. Parameter-matched controls then remove the geometry itself: standard attention on the same graph exceeds QSV (mean $87.3\%$ vs. $85.9\%$), and the same model on a flat 2D lattice reaches $91.1\%$, within $2.1$ points of a ResNet-20 trained under the same pipeline (single run). In the coupled kernel, nearly all of the learned pairwise computation resides in the transport channel.

AI.tldr: QSV用单个学习到的单位四元数替代标准注意力的三个投影，在稀疏球面kNN图上验证发现：特征传输（sandwich乘积）远比学习到的注意力权重重要，但去掉球面几何后标准注意力反而更优。
AI.motivation: 探究注意力机制中"注意力强度"与"特征变换"两个角色的相对重要性，并检验球面几何结构本身是否为性能带来增益，即尝试将标准注意力的三投影（W_Q、W_K、W_V）统一为单一几何表示。
AI.method: 提出Quat-Sphere-Vision（QSV）：每个token用单个学习到的单位四元数表示，相对四元数 r_ij = q_i* ⊗ q_j 同时提供注意力logit Re(r_ij) 和sandwich乘积特征传输 x ↦ r_ij ⊗ x ⊗ r_ij*；消息在同心Fibonacci球面上的稀疏kNN图中传递。通过仅改变目标组件的消融实验和参数匹配的对照实验（同一图上的标准注意力、平坦2D格点）分离各因素贡献。
AI.result: 消融显示两角色不对称：移除传输使CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100测试精度下降约4个百分点，而将学习到的注意力权重替换为均匀平均几乎无变化。参数匹配对照中，同一图上的标准注意力（均值87.3%）超过QSV（85.9%），平坦2D格点模型达91.1%，与同流程ResNet-20差距2.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在耦合核中几乎所有学习到的成对计算都集中在传输通道；球面几何本身未带来增益，反而标准注意力和平坦格点表现更好，说明QSV的优势主要来自特征传输而非注意力权重或球面结构。

title: Action Forcing: Training World Models on Unsupervised Video by Recovering Underlying Egomotion Bases
summary: Synchronised action annotations are needed to train controllable world models and these datasets remain elusive. Existing approaches make use of instrumented platforms with calibrated sensors, costly manual annotation, or latent-action models which lack grounding. We instead turn ordinary unlabelled video into action-supervised training data by recovering (without training) a data-derived egomotion basis. We track pixel displacements across frames and exploit the recurring coherent structure induced by egomotion to obtain grounded control signals directly. Using a method as simple as principal components analysis perform this, we find that the leading components provide signed, scalable, and composable throttle--yaw controls, although the method can recover only motion axes represented in the data. To prevent a high-capacity video DiT from exploiting pixel-level supervision, an online latent critic distils a frozen decoder--tracker--PCA (Principal Components Analysis) teacher without backpropagating through the decoder or tracker. Finally we critique the use of video generation metrics to evaluate WMs and introduce an example of an alternative, reference-free evaluation method. We measure \textit{controllability}, \textit{plausibility}, \textit{conjuring} (creating objects out of thin air) and \textit{geometric integrity}, revealing failures that conventional video metrics miss. We show that most baselines follow familiar action directions but struggle to reverse or remain stationary. Our model handles both while retaining compositional control and generation quality. Despite backwards actions being less than $1\%$ of our training data, we find that the model learns to reverse, scale its response linearly, and compose throttle with steering, all simply by learning through a grounded action space.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的动作基提取方法：对像素位移做PCA获得有符号、可缩放、可合成的egomotion控制信号，配合在线latent critic蒸馏冻结教师，训练可控视频DiT，并给出无参考的WM评估框架。
AI.motivation: 可控世界模型（WM）训练依赖同步的动作标注数据，但此类数据集稀缺。现有方案或依赖带标定传感器的仪器化平台，或依赖昂贵的人工标注，或借助缺乏grounding的latent-action模型。作者希望直接利用普通无标注视频，低成本地获取有物理依据（grounded）的控制信号。
AI.method: 1）跟踪跨帧像素位移，利用egomotion引起的反复出现的相干结构，无需训练即可恢复数据驱动的egomotion基；2）以PCA为例，取主成分作为有符号、可缩放、可合成的throttle–yaw控制量（局限：只能恢复数据中出现的运动轴）；3）为防止高容量视频DiT利用像素级监督走捷径，引入在线latent critic，对冻结的decoder–tracker–PCA教师进行蒸馏，且不通过decoder或tracker反向传播；4）批判视频生成指标用于WM评估，提出无参考的替代评估方法，度量controllability、plausibility、conjuring（凭空生成物体）与geometric integrity。
AI.result: 传统视频指标遗漏的失败模式被新评估方法揭示：多数baseline只沿常见动作方向运动，难以反向或保持静止；本模型在保持合成性控制与生成质量的同时能完成反向与静止。尽管反向动作不足训练数据的1%，模型仍学会了反向、响应线性缩放，并将throttle与steering合成——仅通过学习一个有grounding的动作空间即可实现。
AI.conclusion: 从无标注视频中通过PCA等简单方法恢复egomotion基，可提供有grounding、可组合的控制信号，使视频世界模型获得反向、线性缩放与组合控制能力；同时需以controllability、plausibility、conjuring、geometric integrity等无参考指标替代传统视频生成指标来评估WM。

title: The Hard Part Comes After Search: Benchmarking Web Agents on Synthesizing, Organizing, and Displaying Knowledge
comment: 9 pages main text. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://alexgill321.github.io/KNOWS-benchmark/
summary: Existing computer-use agent benchmarks do not fully evaluate agents acting as assistants. A useful assistant retrieves information across complex, multi-step workflows, synthesizes it into artifacts (documents, presentations, spreadsheets), and navigates program interfaces to produce a coherent final product. Such workflows demand reasoning and synthesis, decomposition of complex tasks, as well as visual and spatial understanding. To study agents on workflows like these, we introduce KNOWS, a benchmark of open-ended, complex, browser-based tasks that jointly evaluate these capabilities, with each task culminating in a produced artifact. To write tasks, we develop a task design rubric and a protocol for ensuring that tasks meet the requirements. Each task is paired with an evaluator, a program that combines deterministic checks with LLM judgments to balance the richness, reliability, and automation tradeoff inherent to agent evaluation. We evaluate and analyze frontier computer-use agents and browser-based harnesses. They achieve moderate scores on partial-success metrics, but the best performer fully succeeds in fewer than 3% of our complex, long-horizon tasks. Failures on visual steps render the resulting artifacts unusable, even when agents complete more than 50% of other evaluation steps. Our results expose limitations of current agents acting as end-to-end assistants, and call for progress on tool use, visual understanding, and long-horizon reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出KNOWS基准，用开放式、复杂、基于浏览器的任务评估计算机使用智能体作为端到端助手的能力，每项任务以产出文档、演示或表格等成品为终点，并配套融合确定性检查与LLM评判的评估器。前沿智能体在部分成功指标上表现中等，但完整成功率不足3%，视觉步骤失败会导致成品不可用。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体基准未能充分评估智能体作为助手的能力。真正有用的助手需要在复杂多步工作流中检索信息、将信息综合为文档/演示/表格等成品，并操作程序界面产出连贯的最终成果，这要求推理与综合、任务分解以及视觉和空间理解能力。为研究此类工作流中的智能体，作者提出KNOWS基准，以联合评估这些能力。
AI.method: KNOWS是一组开放式、复杂、基于浏览器的任务基准，每项任务均以生成的成品为终点。作者制定了任务设计准则和协议以确保任务满足要求。每项任务配有评估器，将确定性检查与LLM判断相结合，以平衡智能体评估中丰富性、可靠性和自动化之间的取舍。随后对前沿计算机使用智能体和基于浏览器的执行框架进行评估与分析。
AI.result: 前沿计算机使用智能体在部分成功指标上获得中等分数，但最佳者在少于3%的复杂长时程任务中完全成功。视觉步骤上的失败会导致生成的成品不可用，即使智能体完成了超过50%的其他评估步骤。结果暴露了当前智能体作为端到端助手的局限。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体尚不足以胜任端到端助手角色，研究结果呼吁在工具使用、视觉理解和长时程推理方面取得进展。

title: MVAgent: Multi-Agent Video Generation via Consistent Condition Construction and Shot-Level Policy Optimization
summary: Multi-shot agentic video generation requires consistent character appearance, stable spatial layout across camera angles, and continuous character state between shots. When every shot is a separate request to a frozen generator, repeated text does not determine appearance, layout or state. We therefore recast the problem as condition construction and present MVAgent, a multi-agent pipeline whose agents collaborate through typed conditioning inputs. Because an environment image shows one viewpoint, a Spatial Grounding agent samples views from generated camera-traversal clips and anchors each shot to the view matching its framing. As generated shots drift from the plan, an Observer records how each shot ends in a continuity memory, from which a Transition agent builds character action and spatial references for the next shot. An Orchestrator composes these inputs into each request. Since a request reveals its effect only after rendering, we train it by agentic reinforcement learning with Trunk-GDPO, which compares rendered candidates at every shot rather than once per video and continues the best as the trunk. With generator and judges frozen, MVAgent attains the highest cross-shot consistency and narrative-planning quality among the compared methods on ViMax-Bench and is preferred over the strongest agentic baseline in human evaluation.

AI.tldr: 将多镜头视频生成重构为“条件构造”问题，提出多智能体流水线 MVAgent，通过类型化条件输入协作，并采用 Trunk-GDPO 强化学习训练，提升跨镜头一致性与叙事规划质量。
AI.motivation: 多镜头视频生成需保证角色外观一致、跨机位空间布局稳定以及镜头间角色状态连续。但每个镜头若作为对冻结生成器的独立请求，重复文本无法确定外观、布局或状态，因此需要新的问题建模方式。
AI.method: 将问题重构为条件构造，提出 MVAgent 多智能体流水线，各智能体通过类型化条件输入协作：Spatial Grounding 智能体从生成的相机穿越片段中采样视角，并将每个镜头锚定到与其构图匹配的视角；Observer 将每个镜头的结尾记录进连续性记忆；Transition 智能体据此构建下一镜头的角色动作与空间参考；Orchestrator 组合输入形成请求。由于请求效果仅在渲染后显现，采用基于 Trunk-GDPO 的智能体强化学习训练，在每个镜头处比较渲染候选而非每个视频仅比较一次，并保留最优者作为主线。
AI.result: 在生成器与评委冻结的条件下，MVAgent 在 ViMax-Bench 上取得对比方法中最高的跨镜头一致性与叙事规划质量，并在人工评估中优于最强的智能体基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过多智能体条件构造与 Trunk-GDPO 训练，MVAgent 有效解决多镜头视频生成中的外观、布局与状态连续性问题，验证了以条件构造替代重复文本提示的可行性。

title: Epstein Files Engine: Agentic Search for Investigative Journalism
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Presented at the Computation + Journalism Symposium (C+J 2026)
summary: On Jan. 30, 2026, the U.S. Department of Justice released a mixed-media collection concerning Jeffrey Epstein, including about three million pages of PDFs. We describe the Epstein Files Engine, an A.I. agent The New York Times deployed to investigate the files. The Engine translated reporter questions into Google BigQuery SQL queries across three corpora: Epstein-related releases, the Times's archive and external, Epstein-related news headlines. It used an LLM to plan queries and returned citation-rich answers a reporter could verify and trust. More than 100 journalists used the Engine, and it contributed to at least 20 published stories. We report how reporters queried it and describe Diff, our text-and-visual duplicate matching method that amplified novelty signals and allowed the Engine to surface genuinely new information. We argue that newsroom agents serve newsrooms best not as autonomous writers, but as interfaces to source material and institutional knowledge.

AI.tldr: 《纽约时报》部署AI智能体"Epstein Files Engine"，将记者提问转为BigQuery SQL，跨三个语料库检索并返回带引用的答案；超100名记者使用，参与至少20篇报道；其Diff文本-视觉去重方法放大了新颖性信号；作者主张新闻室智能体应定位为源材料与机构知识的接口，而非自主写作者。
AI.motivation: 美国司法部于2026年1月30日释放了包含约三百万页PDF的混合媒体文件集，记者难以人工通读与核查，需要一种可验证、可信赖的检索与调查工具来支撑新闻生产。
AI.method: 构建AI智能体Epstein Files Engine：将记者自然语言提问转化为Google BigQuery SQL查询，覆盖三个语料库——Epstein相关发布文件、《纽约时报》档案、外部Epstein相关新闻标题；使用LLM规划查询，返回引用丰富的答案供记者核实；并引入Diff方法，结合文本与视觉进行重复匹配，以放大新颖性信号、浮现真正的新信息。
AI.result: 超过100名记者使用该引擎，其贡献至少20篇已发表报道；报告了记者实际的查询方式；Diff方法成功增强新颖性信号，使引擎能够发现真正的新信息。
AI.conclusion: 新闻室智能体的最佳定位是作为源材料与机构知识的接口（interface），而非自主写作者（autonomous writers），从而在可核查性、可信度与新闻专业性之间取得平衡。

title: MedTokenBudget: Lesion-Preserving Token Routing for Dermoscopic Image Classification
summary: Dermoscopy classifiers built on Vision Transformers process all image patches uniformly, although diagnostic evidence is concentrated in the lesion region. Existing token pruning methods reduce tokens using generic saliency or similarity signals, but rarely ask whether the retained subset still contains the lesion. This paper introduces MedTokenBudget, a supervised post-backbone token routing framework that learns to construct compact lesion-enriched representations when auxiliary lesion masks are available. Its Lesion-Aware Token Scoring (LATS) module fuses attention entropy, feature norm, and local feature contrast through a learned scorer, then routes the top-$K$ patches under a target budget. LATS is trained with budget curriculum learning, diversity regularization, attention distillation, and lesion-mask supervision. The trained router is evaluated with a lesion retention rate that directly measures how much ground-truth lesion evidence survives the token budget. On ISIC 2019, mask-supervised LATS consistently outperforms Random and ToMe at headline budgets while retaining substantially more lesion patches. Code is provided for reproducibility, and complete tabulated results are included in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedTokenBudget，一种监督式后骨干Token路由框架，通过Lesion-Aware Token Scoring（LATS）融合注意力熵、特征范数与局部特征对比度，学习构建病灶富集的紧凑表示，并在ISIC 2019上以病灶保留率验证其优于Random与ToMe。
AI.motivation: 基于Vision Transformer的皮肤镜分类器对全部图像块统一处理，但诊断证据集中在病灶区域；现有Token剪枝方法多依赖通用显著性/相似度信号，很少考察保留的子集是否仍包含病灶。
AI.method: MedTokenBudget为有监督的后骨干Token路由框架，在具备辅助病灶掩码时学习紧凑的病灶富集表示。其LATS模块通过可学习打分器融合注意力熵、特征范数与局部特征对比，在目标预算下路由Top-K图像块；训练采用预算课程学习、多样性正则、注意力蒸馏与病灶掩码监督。
AI.result: 在ISIC 2019上，掩码监督的LATS在主要预算设置下持续优于Random与ToMe，同时保留显著更多的病灶图像块；评估指标为直接度量真实病灶证据在Token预算下存活程度的病灶保留率。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将Token预算分配与病灶监督显式对齐可提升皮肤镜分类中表示的病灶富集程度；代码已提供以保证可复现性，完整表格结果见补充材料。

title: FRESHLATENT: Channel-Aware Latent Adaptation for Resource-Constrained Embodied VLM Perception
comment: Paper is currently under review. Authors' version posted for personal use and not for redistribution
summary: Mission-critical UAVs increasingly rely on split vision-language model (VLM) perception under tight onboard-resource and wireless-communication constraints. However, corruption of transmitted intermediate features creates a deployment mismatch for clean-trained split interfaces, while stronger channel-aware codecs can impose substantial onboard cost. We present FreshLatent, a lightweight channel-aware latent adapter that trains a power-normalized encoder-decoder through wireless corruption while keeping the surrounding VLM frozen. We formulate deployment around a mission-conditioned perception requirement and embedded interface cost, linking channel quality and communication budget to the operating conditions under which perception remains usable. At 0 dB and the tightest communication budget, FreshLatent improves gIoU and cIoU over clean split compression by 20.79 and 20.87 points, respectively. At the most adverse evaluated SNR (0 dB), across all three communication budgets, FreshLatent recovers 63.5-69.1% of the gIoU improvement achieved by a much heavier, range-trained feature-JSCC codec. On an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier in 10-W mode, FreshLatent uses 37-40x fewer encoder parameters, 7.7-9.9x lower edge-interface latency, and 8.8-10.0x lower edge-interface energy than the heavier codec. Together, these results show that lightweight channel-aware adaptation can recover a substantial fraction of the robustness of a much larger communication interface while broadening quality-valid operation under constrained wireless conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出FreshLatent——一种轻量级信道感知潜在适配器，在冻结VLM的前提下通过功率归一化的编解码器在无线信道损伤下训练，实现无人机分离式VLM感知的鲁棒性与低成本部署。
AI.motivation: 任务关键型无人机在机载资源与无线通信双重受限下依赖分离式VLM感知（边缘编码、云端解码）。但传输中间特征受信道损伤后，与干净训练的分裂接口产生部署失配；而更强的信道感知编解码器又会带来高昂的机载开销。因此需要兼顾鲁棒性与低开销的方案。
AI.method: FreshLatent是一种轻量级信道感知潜在适配器：训练一个功率归一化的编码器-解码器，在无线信道损伤条件下进行训练，同时保持周围VLM冻结。作者将部署问题形式化为任务条件化的感知需求与嵌入式接口成本的联合约束，把信道质量与通信预算同感知可用的工作条件关联起来。
AI.result: 在0 dB与最紧通信预算下，FreshLatent相比干净分裂压缩分别提升gIoU和cIoU达20.79与20.87个点；在最恶劣评估SNR（0 dB）下、三种通信预算中，恢复了一个更重、按距离训练的feature-JSCC编解码器所获gIoU改进的63.5–69.1%。在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier的10-W模式下，编码器参数量减少37–40倍，边缘接口延迟降低7.7–9.9倍，边缘接口能耗降低8.8–10.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级信道感知适配能够恢复更大通信接口所具有的相当比例鲁棒性，并在受限无线条件下拓宽质量有效运行范围。

title: Adapting Personalized Speech Enhancement for Low-Latency Audio-Visual Target-Speaker Extraction
summary: Online audio-visual target-speaker extraction aims to remove competing voices while preserving speech quality and bounding lookahead. Existing extractors are built and evaluated for separation on synthetic mixtures, leaving listening quality and meeting behavior largely untested. We introduce Audio-Visual Personalized Voice Quality Enhancement (AV-PVQE), which approaches these requirements from the other direction. We start from a personalized speech enhancement model that reconstructs a requested voice at high quality but confuses the target in 46% of two-speaker mixtures despite clean enrollment. Adding mouth features at its speaker-conditioning input and jointly fine-tuning the visual and reconstruction networks reduces this rate to 1.6%, with no future frames and 20 ms of algorithmic delay. Compared with an online autoregressive audio-visual extractor, AV-PVQE yields separation gains on two synthetic benchmarks and larger gains on recorded meetings, and keeps its advantage on excerpts with more speakers than the fine-tuning mixtures. In personalized P.835 listening tests on two meeting corpora, it improves overall quality over this extractor by 0.57 and 0.63 MOS, with similar mean rating relative to the starting model. Preservation and rejection tests show that it keeps the target intact when no competing voice is present and suppresses competing speech when the target is absent.

AI.tldr: 提出AV-PVQE，从个性化语音增强出发加入嘴部特征并联合微调，在无未来帧、20 ms延迟下实现高质量在线音视频目标说话人提取。
AI.motivation: 现有在线音视频目标说话人提取器多基于合成混合数据构建和评估，其听音质量与真实会议场景表现缺乏验证，需在保证语音质量与有限前瞻约束下兼顾分离与个性化增强。
AI.method: 以个性化语音增强模型为起点，在其说话人条件输入端加入嘴部视觉特征，并对视觉网络与重建网络进行联合微调；系统不使用未来帧，算法延迟为20 ms。
AI.result: 起点模型在两说话人混合中46%出现目标混淆，加入嘴部特征并联合微调后降至1.6%；相比在线自回归音视频提取器，在两个合成基准及录制的真实会议上均获分离增益，且在说话人数多于微调混合的片段上保持优势；在两个会议语料的个性化P.835听音测试中，整体质量分别提升0.57和0.63 MOS，与起点模型的平均评分相近；保留与拒绝测试显示无竞争语音时保持目标完整、目标缺失时抑制竞争语音。
AI.conclusion: 从个性化语音增强反推的AV-PVQE能在严格在线约束下显著降低目标混淆并提升真实会议场景的分离与感知质量，同时保持保留与拒绝行为。

title: Optimal transport meets speech: a tutorial review
summary: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for comparing and transforming probability distributions while preserving geometric structure. Recently, OT has gained significant attention in machine learning due to its ability to measure discrepancies between distributions, even when their supports do not overlap, making it effective for tasks such as generative modeling, domain adaptation, and transfer learning. Despite its success in fields such as computer vision and natural language processing, OT remains relatively underexplored in speech research. Speech signals present unique challenges, including temporal dynamics, speaker variability, noise, reverberation, and heterogeneous multimodal representations involving audio, text, and visual information. These factors often lead to distribution mismatches, where OT offers a natural framework for alignment and interpretation. This work aims to promote broader adoption of OT in speech processing by: (1) reviewing OT foundations through intuitive physical interpretations and highlighting connections to modern generative models; (2) presenting computational algorithms suitable for deep learning frameworks; and (3) demonstrating OT applications in cross-domain and cross-modal speech tasks, including speech enhancement, automatic speech recognition, language and speaker recognition, and audio spoof detection. We highlight OT's strong potential for addressing distributional variations in real-world speech applications.

AI.tldr: 该文综述最优传输（OT）在语音处理中的应用，介绍其理论基础、深度学习适用的计算算法，并展示其在语音增强、识别及伪造检测等跨域与跨模态任务中的作用。
AI.motivation: 最优传输能比较支撑集不重叠的分布并保持几何结构，已在生成建模、域适应等领域成功，但在语音研究中应用不足；语音存在时序动态、说话人差异、噪声混响及音文视多模态异构等挑战，易产生分布失配，OT为对齐与解释提供天然框架。
AI.method: 综述性研究：(1) 通过直观物理解释回顾OT基础，并揭示其与现代生成模型的联系；(2) 介绍适用于深度学习框架的计算算法；(3) 展示OT在跨域与跨模态语音任务中的应用。
AI.result: 展示了OT在语音增强、自动语音识别、语种与说话人识别以及音频伪造检测等任务中的应用效果，体现其处理分布变化的潜力。
AI.conclusion: OT在应对真实语音应用中的分布性变化方面具有强大潜力，本文旨在推动OT在语音处理领域的更广泛应用。
